English: And Reuben responded, “Didn’t I tell you not to sin against the boy? But you would not listen. Now we must account for his blood!”
Kiswahili: Reubeni akawajibu, “Sikuwaambieni msitende dhambi dhidi ya kijana? Lakini hamkunisikiliza! Sasa ni lazima tuadhibiwe kwa ajili ya damu yake.”
Ekegusii: Rubeni akabairaneria, “Tinabakanetie ng’a timomochera omosae oyo? Korende inwe mokanga, timwanyigwera. Ase igo, bono amanyinga aye aganigwe aakanwe.”

English: And when the king of Israel saw them, he asked Elisha, “My father, shall I kill them? Shall I kill them?”
Kiswahili: Wakati mfalme wa Israeli alipowaona, akamuuliza Elisha, “Je, baba yangu, niwaue?”
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli aroche abanto baria, akabooria Elisha: “Tata, ndaita abanto aba? Ndabaita?”

English: I stayed on the mountain, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights; and Yahweh listened to me that time also. Yahweh would not destroy you.
Kiswahili: Basi nilikaa mlimani kwa siku arobaini usiku na mchana, kama nilivyofanya mara ya kwanza, pia Bwana alinisikiliza hata wakati huu. Haikuwa nia yake kuwaangamiza.
Ekegusii: “Nkagenderera kobeera igoro ase egetunwa ase engaki y'amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso n'obotuko, buna ekero keria kie ritang'ani, n'Omonene akanyigwa ase engaki eyio boigo, agatiga tabasiria.

English: But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi ninakutumaini wewe peke yako, Ee Bwana; nimesema, “Wewe ndiwe Mungu wangu.”
Ekegusii: Korende inche nigo ngosemeretie aye Omonene. Nigo ngoteeba: “Aye naye Nyasae one.”

English: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa, haki itokayo kwa Mungu imedhihirishwa pasipo sheria, ambayo Sheria na Manabii wanaishuhudia.
Ekegusii: Korende bono oboronge bwa Nyasae bwaorokigwe machiiko ataiyo, obwaberetwe kirori namachiiko na ababani,

English: That same day King Xerxes awarded Queen Esther the estate of Haman, the enemy of the Jews. And Mordecai entered the king’s presence because Esther had revealed his relation to her.
Kiswahili: Siku ile ile Mfalme Ahasuero akampa Malkia Esta shamba la Hamani, adui wa Wayahudi. Naye Mordekai akaja mbele ya mfalme, kwa kuwa Esta alikuwa amesema jinsi anavyohusiana naye.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria omorwoti Ahaswero akaa Esiteri eting’ana enyomba ya Hamani, omobisa oria bw’Abayahudi. Moredekai akanyora ribaga gosoa ase omorwoti, ekiagera Esiteri konya oteebirie omorwoti igoro y’obwamate bwaye na moredekai.

English: You brought Your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs and wonders, with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and with great terror.
Kiswahili: Uliwatoa watu wako Israeli kutoka Misri kwa ishara na maajabu, kwa mkono wenye nguvu na ulionyooshwa na kwa matisho makuu.
Ekegusii: Nigo kwang’anyetie abanto bao Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ase enchera y’ebikone na amakumia, na okobua okonene, na okoboko koramboire kore ne chinguru, na ase okoondokia okonene,

English: Yahweh is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni mwenye neema na haki, Mungu wetu ni mwingi wa huruma.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are nobuya na oboronge; Ere, Nyasae oito nigo are omonyamaabera.

English: Abraham answered, “God Himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son.” And the two walked on together.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akajibu, “Mwanangu, Mungu mwenyewe atajipatia mwana-kondoo kwa ajili ya hiyo sadaka ya kuteketezwa.” Nao hawa wawili wakaendelea mbele pamoja.
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akamoiraneria: “Omwana one, Nyasae nenyorere emaanwa y’eng’ondi ase ekeng’wanso eke.” Erio bakagenderera amo bonsi babere.

English: Foreigners will dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
Kiswahili: Wageni watakalia mji wa Ashdodi, nami nitakatilia mbali kiburi cha Wafilisti.
Ekegusii: Asidodi nomenywe nabaanto batarochi inchera, na inche Omonene ninsirie kegima oboenenu bw'Abafilisti.

English: “‘“Vedan and Javan traded with yarn for your wares; wrought iron, cassia, and calamus were among your merchandise.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Wadani na Wayunani kutoka Uzali, walikuletea mali za biashara, nao wakabadilishana nawe chuma kilichofuliwa, mdalasini na mchaichai.
Ekegusii: Boigo abanto ba Wedani na aba Yavani bagakorentera ebioma bikomeka‐meka, na ebinsari bia kasia na ebia kalamusi.

English: “Proclaim further, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “My cities will again overflow with prosperity, and Yahweh will again comfort Zion, and will again choose Jerusalem.”'”
Kiswahili: “Endelea kutangaza zaidi kwamba: Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: ‘Miji yangu itafurika tena ustawi na Bwana atamfariji tena Sayuni na kumchagua Yerusalemu.' ”
Ekegusii: “Raria naende, otebe ng'a aya naro Omonene bw'Emeganda agoteeba: Emechie yane neichorigwe nogosesenigwa okonge, na inche Omonene nindemie Sayoni naende, na ninchore Yerusalemu obe oyone naende.”

English: After spending some time there, they were sent off by the brothers in peace to return to those who had sent them.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kukaa huko Antiokia kwa muda, wakaagwa kwa amani na wale ndugu ili waende kwa wale waliowatuma. [
Ekegusii: Magega kobamenyire agwo ase engaki etai ’nke, bakaegwa ribaga nabaminto bagende nomorembe ase baria baabatomete. [

English: Are You not from everlasting, O LORD, my God, my Holy One? We will not die. O LORD, You have appointed them to execute judgment; O Rock, You have established them for correction.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, je, wewe sio wa tangu milele? Mungu wangu, Uliye Mtakatifu wangu, hatutakufa. Ee Bwana, umewachagua wao ili watekeleze hukumu; Ee Mwamba, umewaamuru watuadhibu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, Omochenu one, tari aye oreo korwa kare na kare? Ase ayio titogokwa. Aye Omonene, egetare giaito, aye kwabachikiire batogambie ekiina, kwababekire batoe egesusuro ki’ogotorongeyia.

English: Of this measure you shall measure a length of twenty-five thousand, and a width of ten thousand. In it shall be the sanctuary, which is most holy.
Kiswahili: Katika eneo takatifu, pima sehemu yenye urefu wa dhiraa 25,000 na upana wa dhiraa 10,000. Ndani ya hilo eneo kutakuwa mahali patakatifu, Patakatifu pa Patakatifu.
Ekegusii: Ase oboremo obwo obochenu mwatanane ensemo ere nobotambe bwe chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), na obogare bwe chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000), agwo nao moraagache Aase Aachenu Mono.

English: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.
Kiswahili: Mbusu Mwana, asije akakasirika nawe ukaangamizwa katika njia yako, kwa maana hasira yake inaweza kuwaka ghafula. Heri wote wanaomkimbilia.
Ekegusii: Tugama inse na kworokia amasikani ase Omwana oye. Motakoreti bo, Omonene nigo arabe nendamwamu, abasirie ase chinchera chiaino, ekiagera endamwamu yaye nigo egwoka bwango mbasesenirie abanto bonsi bakomotamera.

English: He waters the mountains from His chambers; the earth is satisfied by the fruit of His works.
Kiswahili: Huinyeshea milima kutoka orofa zake, dunia inatoshelezwa kwa matunda ya kazi yake.
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo igoro ase omenyete, nigo ogotweria ebitunwa embura, na ense nigo egoisaneka nokwama kw’emeremo yao.

English: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon; and he cried out with a loud voice,
Kiswahili: Ndani ya sinagogi palikuwa na mtu aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo mchafu. Naye akapiga kelele kwa nguvu akisema,
Ekegusii: Naende ase esinagogi narengeo omonto obwatire n'Omoika bw'ekerecha ki'eubi. Ere agaaka eriogi ase chinguru, akabora,

English: and he said, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Dig this valley full of ditches.’
Kiswahili: naye akasema, “Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana, ‘Chimbeni bonde hili lijae mahandaki.’
Ekegusii: na ere akabora, “Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Kunya chingoro chinyinge ase rigoko eri rikamoku.

English: The fierce anger of the LORD will not turn back until He has fully accomplished the purposes of His heart. In the days to come you will understand this.
Kiswahili: Hasira kali ya Bwana haitarudi nyuma mpaka atakapotimiza makusudi yote ya moyo wake. Siku zijazo mtayaelewa haya.
Ekegusii: Endamwamu entindi y’Omonene tekonyara koirana ebatige goika abe oikeranirie ekiina kiaye na gokora buna okogania kwaye kore. Amang’ana ayio nigo morache koyamanya buya ase amatuko agochi‐gocha.

English: and I weighed out to them the contribution of silver and gold and the articles that the king, his counselors, his leaders, and all the Israelites there had offered for the house of our God.
Kiswahili: nami nikawapimia fedha, dhahabu na vifaa ambavyo mfalme, washauri wake, maafisa wake na Israeli wote waliokuwepo walikuwa wamevitoa sadaka kwa ajili ya nyumba ya Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: Bono nkabarengera chifeta, ne chitaabu; na ebikorero, ebio omorwoti, na abasemia baye, na abagaambi bare komokonya, na Abaisraeli bonsi abarenge agwo, konya barure ase enyomba ya Nyasae.

English: His mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my son. Only obey my voice, and go get them for me.”
Kiswahili: Mama yake akamwambia, “Mwanangu, laana na iwe juu yangu. Fanya tu ninalokuambia, nenda ukaniletee hao wana-mbuzi.”
Ekegusii: Ng'ina akamoteebia: “Okoragererigwa kwao tiga kobe igoro yane; igwa aya nkogoteebia rimo rioka, genda ondetere chimanwa echio chie chimbori.”

English: When Jehudi had read three or four columns, the king cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was in the brazier, until all the scroll was consumed in the fire that was in the brazier.
Kiswahili: Hata ikawa kila wakati Yehudi alipomaliza kusoma kurasa tatu au nne za hicho kitabu, mfalme alizikata kwa kisu cha mwandishi na kuzitupia motoni, hadi kitabu chote kikateketea.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yehudi asomire chinsemo isato, gose inye, chi'amang'ana aria, omorwoti akabogoria omoyio, agachinachana, agachiruta riko ase omorero, chikayia. Omorwoti akagenderera kona‐gokora boigo goika egetabu eria yonsi ekayia ekaera ase omorero oria.

English: that if you confess with your mouth, “Jesus is Lord,” and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu kama ukikiri kwa kinywa chako kwamba “Yesu ni Bwana,” na kuamini moyoni mwako kwamba Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu, utaokoka.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera koraorokie nomonwa oo, ng’a Yeso nere Omonene, na kwegena ime ase enkoro yao ng’a Nyasae namobogetie korwa ase abakuure, notoorigwe.

English: So they came forward and carried them, still in their tunics, outside the camp, as Moses had directed.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakaja na kuwaondoa, wakiwa bado wamevalia makoti yao ya ibada, wakawapeleka nje ya kambi, kama Mose alivyoamuru.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagaacha, bakabogoria emebere eria eboyirie chiganchwa chiabo, bakayeira isiko y’egetwori, buna Musa abateebeetie.

English: because they rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu walikuwa wameasi dhidi ya maneno ya Mungu na kudharau shauri la Aliye Juu Sana.
Ekegusii: ekiagera bangete koigwera ring’ana ria Nyasae, bagachaaya ogoseemia kw’Oyore Igoro Mono.

English: The Israelites grieved for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the time of weeping and mourning for Moses came to an end.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakaomboleza kwa ajili ya Mose kwenye tambarare za Moabu kwa siku thelathini, mpaka wakati wa kulia na kuomboleza ulipopita.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakamoreera ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etato agwo ase emieya ya Moabu, na magega y’ayio amatuko okomoreera na kobokia amagombo ase engencho yaye akaera.

English: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes and sprang into the multitude, crying out,
Kiswahili: Lakini mitume Paulo na Barnaba waliposikia haya, wakararua nguo zao, wakawaendea wale watu kwa haraka, wakawapigia kelele, wakisema,
Ekegusii: Korende abatomwa Barnaba na Paulo, ekero bachia koigwa amang'ana ayio bagatandora chianga chiabo, bakaayerera, bagasoa ase omoganda, bagaaka egeturi, bagoteeba,

English: Say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns.” The world is also established. It can't be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.
Kiswahili: Katikati ya mataifa semeni, “Bwana anatawala.” Ulimwengu ameuweka imara, hauwezi kusogezwa; atawahukumu watu kwa uadilifu.
Ekegusii: Teebia abanto bonsi b'ebisaku, “Omonene nere okogamba. Ense nigo eteneine bokong'u, tekonyegerigwa. Omonene nanachere abanto ekiina atari gwanchereria.”

English: Sailing from there, we came the following day opposite Chios. The next day we touched at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium, and the day after we came to Miletus.
Kiswahili: Kutoka huko tuliendelea kwa njia ya bahari, na kesho yake tukafika mahali panapokabili Kio. Siku iliyofuata tukavuka kwenda Samo, na kesho yake tukawasili Mileto.
Ekegusii: Tokamanora korwa agwo, ne rituko ria kabere togaika kororia Kio. Rituko ria gatato togaika Samo, tokabeera Torogilo, ne rituko ria kane togaika Mileto.

English: bringing praise to their lips. Peace, peace to those far and near,” says the LORD, “and I will heal them.”
Kiswahili: nikiumba sifa midomoni ya waombolezaji katika Israeli. Amani, amani, kwa wale walio mbali na kwa wale walio karibu,” asema Bwana. “Nami nitawaponya.”
Ekegusii: Nimbeeke ase ebikoba biabo okwama okuya, bikwane omorembe ase abwo bare aare na abare ang’e, na inche nimbagwenie.” Nab’Omonene agoteeba.

English: “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn't help you?'
Kiswahili: “Ndipo wao pia watajibu, ‘Bwana ni lini tulikuona ukiwa na njaa au kiu, au ukiwa mgeni au uchi, au ukiwa mgonjwa na kifungoni na hatukukuhudumia?'
Ekegusii: Erio barabwo nabamoiranerie: Omonene, indi twakorooche aye kore nenchara, gose kore nerang'o, gose kore omogeni, gose kore getirianda, gose kore omorwaire, gose kore echela ime, na titwagokorera?

English: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemy, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.
Kiswahili: Edomu itamilikiwa, Seiri, adui wake, itamilikiwa, lakini Israeli atakuwa na nguvu.
Ekegusii: Ense ya Edomu nebugwe eirwe, Edomu nebugwe ebe eyabo, eyio nense y'ababisa babo. Abaisraeli 'mbagenderere koba n'okobua.

English: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.
Kiswahili: Mali iliyopatikana kwa ulimi wa uongo ni mvuke upitao upesi na mtego wa kufisha.
Ekegusii: Chinibo chikonyorwa ase oromeme rw'obong'ainereria, nigo chikoera buna omooki, nigo chire n'obosongo buna emetego ya amakweri.

English: For wisdom is a defense, even as money is a defense; but the excellency of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life of him who has it.
Kiswahili: Hekima ni ulinzi kama fedha ilivyo ulinzi, lakini faida ya maarifa ni hii: kwamba hekima huhifadhi maisha ya aliye nayo.
Ekegusii: Obong'aini nigo bogotokonya buna chitaabu chigotokonya, korende obuya bw'omonyasemi mboria ng'a obong'aini nigo bokorenda obogima bw'oyio ong'ainiire.

English: Therefore you shall sanctify him, for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I Yahweh, who sanctify you, am holy.
Kiswahili: Waoneni kuwa watakatifu, kwa sababu ndio wanaotoa chakula cha Mungu wenu. Kumbukeni kuwa ni watakatifu, kwa sababu Mimi Bwana ni mtakatifu, Mimi niwafanyaye ninyi kuwa watakatifu.
Ekegusii: Goika omobare ng'a nomochenu, ekiagera nere okorua okoruegwa kw'endagera ase 'nde inche Omonene oo; nabe omochenu ase ore, ekiagera inche Omonene nomochenu inde, ninche nkobachena.

English: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.
Kiswahili: Huendelea toka nguvu hadi nguvu, hadi kila mmoja afikapo mbele za Mungu huko Sayuni.
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbabe bakomenta koba ne chinguru kogenderera botambe, mbarore Nyasae ayobuete chinyasae agwo Sayoni.

English: I will remove you from office, and you will be ousted from your position.
Kiswahili: Nitakuondoa kutoka kazi yako, nawe utaondoshwa kutoka nafasi yako.
Ekegusii: Inche Omonene ninkorusie orue ase emeremo yao, naende nkoiyerie korwa aase ao. Obobani igoro y’Eliakimu

English: Then Elijah said, “As surely as the LORD of Hosts lives, before whom I stand, I will present myself to Ahab today.” Elijah on Mount Carmel
Kiswahili: Eliya akasema, “Kama Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote aishivyo, yeye ninayemtumikia, hakika nitajionyesha kwa Ahabu leo.” Eliya Juu Ya Mlima Karmeli
Ekegusii: Elija akairaneria, agateeba: “Ekeene, buna Omonene bw’Emeganda are moyo, oria inche inteneine ase obosio bwaye, reero goika inyeorokie ase Ahabu.”

English: I will surely gather My people from all the lands to which I have banished them in My furious anger and great wrath, and I will return them to this place and make them dwell in safety.
Kiswahili: Hakika nitawakusanya kutoka nchi zote nilizowafukuzia katika hasira yangu kali na ghadhabu yangu kuu, nitawarudisha mahali hapa na kuwaruhusu waishi kwa salama.
Ekegusii: “Naama! Ninsangererie abanto abwo korwa ase chinse chionsi ase nabaseretie gochia, ekero narenge nendamwamu, na ekeririanda, na okogechigwa. Nimbairanie aase aiga, naende mbabeeke bamenye ase obotoereru.

English: Uzziah supplied the entire army with shields, spears, helmets, armor, bows, and slingstones.
Kiswahili: Uzia akalipatia jeshi lote ngao, mikuki, chapeo, dirii, pinde na mawe ya kombeo.
Ekegusii: Usia akagonchera abarwani baye chinguba, akabaturera na amatimo, akabaroiseria na ebigogwa, ne chingobo chi’ebioma, na amata, na amagena barenge koruta ne chinduruche.

English: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.
Kiswahili: Sina haja ya fahali wa banda lako, au mbuzi wa zizi lako.
Ekegusii: Tingwanchera chieri chikorwa ase ameeri aino, gose chigoree chikorwa ase amaicho aino;

English: The maid saw him and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”
Kiswahili: Yule mtumishi wa kike alipomwona mahali pale, akawaambia tena wale waliokuwa wamesimama hapo, “Huyu mtu ni mmoja wao.”
Ekegusii: Omoiseke oria omosomba akamorora naende, agachaaka goteebia abateneine ang'e, “Oyo n'oyomo obo.”

English: Yahweh's voice strikes with flashes of lightning.
Kiswahili: Sauti ya Bwana hupiga kwa miali ya umeme wa radi.
Ekegusii: Eriogi ri'Omonene nigo rikomesia chinsase chi'omorero.

English: It was thus that the ways of those who are on earth were corrected, and men were taught the things that are pleasing to you. They were saved through wisdom.”
Kiswahili: Ndivyo njia za wale walio duniani zilivyorekebishwa, na wanadamu walifundishwa mambo yanayokupendeza. Waliokolewa kwa hekima.
Ekegusii: Nabo chinchera chi'abaanto ase ense chiabegetwe buya, bakabwata aria agokogokia erio bagatorigwa ase engencho y'obong'aini.”

English: And if in spite of these things you do not accept My discipline, but continue to walk in hostility toward Me,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa pamoja na mambo haya hamtakubali maonyo yangu lakini mkaendelea kuweka uadui nami,
Ekegusii: “Komoraabe mwanyorire egesusuro ekio gionsi timong’iranera, korende mogenderere koba mamincha yane,

English: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,
Kiswahili: Wanaume wote kuanzia umri wa miaka thelathini hadi miaka hamsini ambao walikuja kutumika katika Hema la Kukutania,
Ekegusii: Abasacha abwo baare egati y'emiaka emerongo etato na merongo etano, naende barenge konyara gokora emeremo ase Eema y'Omosangererekano, bakariikwa.

English: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
Kiswahili: Yokshani alikuwa baba wa Sheba na Dedani, wazao wa Dedani walikuwa Waashuri, Waletushi na Waleumi.
Ekegusii: Yokisani akaibora Seba na Dedani. Na basinto ba Dedani nabwo aba: Ashurimu, na Letusi, na Leumi.

English: You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.
Kiswahili: Mshonee Aroni ndugu yako mavazi matakatifu ili yampe ukuu na heshima.
Ekegusii: Oroiserie Aroni, momura omino, chianga chinchenu chi'obonene na echi'oboseera.

English: Even if I caused you sorrow by my letter, I do not regret it. Although I did regret it, I now see that my letter caused you sorrow, but only for a short time.
Kiswahili: Hata kama niliwahuzunisha kwa barua yangu, sijutii. Ingawa nilijuta kwa muda mfupi, kwa kuwa najua kwamba barua yangu iliwaumiza, lakini ni kwa kitambo tu,
Ekegusii: Naki nonya nabaichanetie ase riruube riria tinkweitia (nonya neitetie ritang’ani), ekiagera narorire ng’a riruube riria ndiabaichanetie, korende nase ekero egeke gioka.

English: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.
Kiswahili: Kama vile mji ambao kuta zake zimebomoka ndivyo alivyo mtu ambaye hawezi kujitawala mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Omonto otamanyeti kwegambera omonyene nigo anga buna omochie chindwaki chiaye chiatagoirwe.

English: When he heard it said of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “Behold, he has come out to fight against you,” he sent messengers again to Hezekiah, saying,
Kiswahili: Basi Senakeribu akapata taarifa kwamba Tirhaka, Mkushi mfalme wa Misri, alikuwa anaenda kupigana naye. Basi akatuma tena wajumbe kwa Hezekia na neno hili:
Ekegusii: Na ekero omorwoti bw'Abaasuri aigwete amang'ana ng'a Tirihaka, omorwoti bw'Abaetiopia, ochire korwana esegi nere, agatoma abanto ase Hezekia naende, akabateebia,

English: You have also committed sexual immorality with the Egyptians, your neighbors, great of flesh; and have multiplied your prostitution, to provoke me to anger.
Kiswahili: Ulifanya ukahaba wako na Wamisri, jirani zako waliojaa tamaa, ukaichochea hasira yangu kwa kuongezeka kwa uzinzi wako.
Ekegusii: Nigo gwakorete obonyaka n'Abamisiri, abanto abwo mosinyaine bare nokogania okobe; okamenta obonyaka bwao, na okagera nkagechigwa nkaba n'endamwamu.

English: If the first part of the dough is holy, so is the whole batch; if the root is holy, so are the branches.
Kiswahili: Kama sehemu ya donge la unga uliotolewa kuwa limbuko ni mtakatifu, basi unga wote ni mtakatifu, nalo shina kama ni takatifu, vivyo hivyo na matawi nayo.
Ekegusii: Naende onye ensemo ye ritang’ani ye ribomba ri’obosie ere enchenu, naboigo ne ribomba rionsi rire; na onye ritina rire richenu, naboigo ne chinsagia chire.

English: A man or a woman who is a medium or spiritist must surely be put to death. They shall be stoned; their blood is upon them.’”
Kiswahili: “ ‘Mwanaume au mwanamke ambaye ni mchawi, mwaguzi au mwenye kupunga pepo miongoni mwenu lazima auawe. Mtawapiga kwa mawe; nayo damu yao itakuwa juu ya vichwa vyao wenyewe.’ ”
Ekegusii: “Omosacha, gose omokungu, orarigie ogosemigwa korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakwete, gose oyore omoorogi, goika aitwe akwe. Abanto abwo baakwe amagena bakwe; okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga abo nakobe okwabo.”

English: For Amos says, ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.'”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hili ndilo Amosi analosema: “ ‘Yeroboamu atakufa kwa upanga, na kwa hakika Israeli watakwenda uhamishoni, mbali na nchi yao.' ”
Ekegusii: Amang'ana aya naro akwanire: Yeroboamu naitwe nemioro, na Abaisraeli mbarusigwe ase ense yabo bairwe ase obosomba.”

English: Magnify the LORD with me; let us exalt His name together.
Kiswahili: Mtukuzeni Bwana pamoja nami, naam, na tulitukuze jina lake pamoja.
Ekegusii: Raria obonene bw’Omonene amo nainche totogie erieta riaye twensi amo.

English: Only the livestock we took for plunder for ourselves, with the plunder of the cities which we had taken.
Kiswahili: Lakini mifugo na nyara tulizoziteka kutoka ile miji tulijichukulia wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Togoosa chitugo chiabo, na gosakora ebinto biarenge ase emechie eyio bikaba ebiaito.

English: the mystery that was hidden for ages and generations but is now revealed to His saints.
Kiswahili: Hii ni siri iliyokuwa imefichika tangu zamani na kwa vizazi vingi, lakini sasa imefunuliwa kwa watakatifu.
Ekegusii: Obobisi boria bwabisetwe korwa kare ase ebigori ebinge, korende bono bwaorokigwe ase abachenu baye.

English: This also comes from the LORD of Hosts, who is wonderful in counsel and excellent in wisdom.
Kiswahili: Haya yote pia hutoka kwa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, mwenye mashauri ya ajabu, na anayepita wote kwa hekima.
Ekegusii: Amorokererio ayio nigo akorwa ase Omonene bw’Emeganda; ere nigo are omosemia bw’ogokumia, na obong’aini bwaye nobonene mono.

English: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn't do this.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa ninyi mnatafuta kuniua, mtu ambaye nimewaambia kweli ile niliyosikia kutoka kwa Mungu, Abrahamu hakufanya jambo la namna hii.
Ekegusii: Korende bono morigetie kong'ita, ninche oyo nabateebirie ekeene keria naigure korwa ase Nyasae. Aburaamu takorete igo.

English: They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands; neither shall they respect that which their fingers have made, either the Asherah poles or the incense altars.
Kiswahili: Hawataziangalia tena madhabahu, kazi za mikono yao, nao hawataheshimu nguzo za Ashera, na madhabahu za kufukizia uvumba zilizofanywa kwa mikono yao.
Ekegusii: Tibagosemeria ebisasimero ebire emeremo y'amaboko abo, gose tibakorigereria emete eteneneirie Asera, enyasae yabo enkuungu, gose ebisasimero bi'ogosambera ubani, ebi baroisirie nebiara biabo.

English: You were running so well. Who has obstructed you from obeying the truth?
Kiswahili: Mlikuwa mkipiga mbio vizuri. Ni nani aliyewazuia msiitii kweli?
Ekegusii: Nigo mwarenge kominyoka buya; ning’o obatangete timoigwera ekeene?

English: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater), has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
Kiswahili: Kwa habari ya mambo haya mjue hakika kwamba: Msherati, wala mtu mwovu, wala mwenye tamaa mbaya, mtu kama huyo ni mwabudu sanamu, kamwe hataurithi Ufalme wa Kristo na wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Inaki ring’ana eri mwarimanyire kegima, ng’a omotomani, gose oyo otachenegeti, gose omonto omwegimeria (engencho yaye omosasiimi emegwekano) takonyora omwando ase oborwoti bwa Kristo na Nyasae. Taara buna abana b’omobaso

English: Those who were within, trusting in the strength of the walls and their store of provisions, behaved themselves rudely toward Judas and those who were with him, railing, and furthermore blaspheming and speaking impious words.
Kiswahili: Wale waliokuwa ndani, wakitumaini nguvu za kuta na akiba yao ya vyakula, walijitendea kwa ukali dhidi ya Yuda na wale waliokuwa pamoja naye, wakimtukana, na zaidi ya hayo, wakimkufuru na kusema maneno machafu.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi b'omochie oyio nigo begenete chinyasi chi'omochie obo, na nigo babwate ogosemeria buna endagera eyio bagachete nabo yare kobaisana ase amatuko aria onsi baboereire. Ase igo bagachecheria Yuda n'abanto baye na korama Nyasae.

English: Who led them through the depths, like a horse in the wilderness, so that they didn't stumble?
Kiswahili: aliyewaongoza kupitia kwenye vilindi? Kama farasi katika nchi iliyo wazi, wao hawakujikwaa,
Ekegusii: Ere akabaetia ase chindiba ime buna chibarasi chigoeta ase erooro, barabwo tibagochetwe aande.”

English: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to Yahweh, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na ndugu zao wote walikuwa wamefundishwa na kuwa stadi wa uimbaji kwa Bwana. Idadi yao walikuwa 288.
Ekegusii: Omobaro obo amo nabaanto bamwabo borokereretigwe goterera Omonene, abamanyete goteera buya kegima, nigo barenge amagana abere, na emerongo etano na etato, na batano na batato (288).

English: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
Kiswahili: Lakini nimetuliza na kunyamazisha nafsi yangu; kama mtoto aliyeachishwa kunyonya na mama yake, kama mtoto aliyeachishwa kunyonya ndivyo ilivyo nafsi iliyoko ndani yangu.
Ekegusii: Korende inche nigo intoereretie omoyo one; buna omwana otigire okogonka oagatire koboko kwa ng’ina, ee, naboigo omoyo one ore ime yane.

English: As for the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, along with all his accomplishments, they are indeed written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel. Pekah Reigns in Israel
Kiswahili: Matukio mengine ya utawala wa Pekahia na yote aliyoyafanya yameandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Israeli. Peka Mfalme Wa Israeli
Ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Pekahia, na aya onsi akorete, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki’ogokora kw’Abarwoti b’Abaisraeli. Peka omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli

English: After the Holy Spirit had prevented them from speaking the word in the province of Asia, they traveled through the region of Phrygia and Galatia.
Kiswahili: Paulo pamoja na wenzake wakasafiri sehemu za Frigia na Galatia, kwa kuwa Roho Mtakatifu hakuwaruhusu kulihubiri neno huko Asia.
Ekegusii: Paulo na Timotheo bagaeta ase ense ya Furugia na Galatia, ekiagera bakanetigwe n’Omoika Omochenu ng’a tibarandia ring’ana agwo ase ense y’Asia.

English: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.
Kiswahili: Mahali pao na pawe ukiwa, wala asiwepo yeyote atakayeishi katika mahema yao.
Ekegusii: Tiga omochie obo otigare bosa, monto onde tamenya ase chiema chiabo.

English: The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”
Kiswahili: Ule umati wa watu uliomtangulia na ule uliomfuata ukapiga kelele ukisema, “Hosana, Mwana wa Daudi!” “Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa Jina la Bwana!” “Hosana juu mbinguni!”
Ekegusii: Emeganda eria yatang'aine, na eyare komotunyana, bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba, “Hosana ase Omwana o Daudi! Nasesenirie oyio ogocha ase erieta ri'Omonene! Hosana, aye ore igoro mono!”

English: They cried aloud toward heaven, saying, “What should we do with these men? Where should we carry them away?
Kiswahili: Walipiga kelele kwa sauti kubwa kuelekea mbinguni, wakisema, "Tuwafanye nini watu hawa? Tuwapeleke wapi?"
Ekegusii: Bono omosangererekano bwonsi ogasaba ase eriogi bagoteeba: “Ninki tokobakorera abatakerwa aba? Ng'ai tokobaira bono?

English: For from within the hearts of men come evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, adultery,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kutoka ndani ya moyo wa mtu hutoka mawazo mabaya, uasherati, wizi, uuaji, uzinzi,
Ekegusii: Ekiagera ime ase chinkoro chi’ abanto nigo bikorwao ebirengererio ebibe, obonyaka, oboibi, oboiti, obotomani,

English: the land of Egypt is before you; settle your father and brothers in the best part of the land. They may dwell in the land of Goshen. And if you know of any talented men among them, put them in charge of my own livestock.”
Kiswahili: nayo nchi ya Misri ipo mbele yako, uwakalishe baba yako na ndugu zako katika sehemu iliyo bora kupita zote katika nchi. Na waishi Gosheni. Kama unamfahamu yeyote miongoni mwao mwenye uwezo maalum, waweke wawe wasimamizi wa mifugo yangu.”
Ekegusii: Bono ense ya Misiri nigo ere ase obosio bwao; bae iso na bamura bamino ribaga bamenye aase are aagiya. Tiga bamenye ase ensemo ya Goseni, naende onye komanyete bande ase egati yabo abamanyete mono emeremo y’obotugi, obabeeke babe abateneneri ase chitugo chiane.” Yakobo ase obosio bwa Farao

English: who build Zion with bloodshed and Jerusalem with iniquity.
Kiswahili: mnaojenga Sayuni kwa kumwaga damu na Yerusalemu kwa uovu.
Ekegusii: Nigo mogendererete koagacha Yerusalemu omochie omonene o Nyasae, ase oboroso bw’ogoita n’borimo.

English: I will make justice the measuring line and righteousness the level. Hail will sweep away your refuge of lies, and water will flood your hiding place.
Kiswahili: Nitaifanya haki kuwa kamba ya kupimia na uadilifu kuwa timazi; mvua ya mawe itafagia kimbilio lenu, huo uongo, nayo maji yatafurikia mahali penu pa kujificha.
Ekegusii: Ninkore ekeene kebe ekerengo gi’okorenga, na oboronge bobe ekebiro gekorenga. “Nindete embura y’amagena yabuse kegima oborimo bore obotamero bwaino, na emegoko ebonganie obwebiso bwaino.”

English: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo sadaka utakazozipokea kutoka kwao: dhahabu, fedha na shaba;
Ekegusii: Na ebiegwa orasangererie korwa ase bare nabio ebi: chitaabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai;

English: The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the straw to the wheat?” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Mwache nabii aliye na ndoto aseme ndoto yake, lakini yule aliye na neno langu na aliseme kwa uaminifu. Kwa maana jani kavu lina uhusiano gani na ngano?” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omobani oria obwate chindoto, tiga achikwane, korende oyobwate ring'ana riane, tiga arikwane ase obwegenwa. Inee! Omoiriro, ninki oisaine ekero okoreng'anigwa nengano? Nabo inche Omonene natebiire.

English: Therefore Yahweh says: “You have not listened to me, to proclaim liberty, every man to his brother, and every man to his neighbor. Behold, I proclaim to you a liberty,” says Yahweh, “to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine. I will make you be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo, hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Hamkunitii mimi. Hamkutangaza uhuru kwa ndugu zenu. Hivyo sasa, ninawatangazia ninyi ‘uhuru,' asema Bwana: ‘uhuru' ili kuanguka kwa upanga, tauni na njaa. Nitawafanya mwe chukizo kwa falme zote za dunia.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: Inwe mwangire konyigwera, na koraria obosibore kera omonto ase oyomwabo, na ase omogisangio oye. Rora inche nkobaa nde inwe obosibore bwaino; obosibore obwo nabwo obo: Nigo moraitwe nemioro, na oborwaire bogoita, na enchara. Na amarwoti onsi ay'ense naondoke ase engencho y'amang'ana ayio ndabakorere inwe.

English: “Am I only a God nearby,” declares the LORD, “and not a God far away?”
Kiswahili: “Je, mimi ni Mungu aliyeko hapa karibu tu,” Bwana asema, “wala si Mungu aliyeko pia mbali?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Inche nigo inde Nyasae ore ang’e rioka? Tindi Nyasae ore aare boigo?

English: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.
Kiswahili: mwili wake ukiwa umenawiri, nayo mifupa yake ikiwa imejaa mafuta ndani yake.
Ekegusii: ebirandi biaye biichire namabeere, na amauga 'omobere oye aichire nemeseto.

English: Princes have been hung up by their hands; elders receive no respect.
Kiswahili: Wakuu wametungikwa juu kwa mikono yao, wazee hawapewi heshima.
Ekegusii: Abagaambi baito babwatirwe na gosungwa, na abagaaka baito tibasikiri.

English: Manasseh and Ephraim were born to Joseph in the land of Egypt by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.
Kiswahili: Huko Misri, Asenathi binti wa Potifera, aliyekuwa kuhani wa mji wa Oni, alimzalia Yosefu wana wawili, Manase na Efraimu.
Ekegusii: Yusufu akaiborerwa Manase na Efraimu, ase ense ya Misiri. Asenati, mosubati o Potifera, Omokuani bw’Oni, akamoiborera abana abwo abamura.

English: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.
Kiswahili: Atadumu kama jua lidumuvyo, kama mwezi, vizazi vyote.
Ekegusii: Abanto mbakoiroke, koreng'ana buna erioba na omotienyi bigendererete kobao, ebiaare ase ebiaare.

English: yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes will abhor me.
Kiswahili: wewe ungenitupa kwenye shimo la utelezi kiasi kwamba hata nguo zangu zingenichukia sana.
Ekegusii: nigo orantugute ime ase engoro, ne chianga chiane chigechigwe ase engencho yane.

English: I ate no rich food, no meat or wine entered my mouth, and I did not anoint myself with oil until the three weeks were completed.
Kiswahili: Sikula chakula kizuri; nyama wala divai havikugusa midomo yangu; nami sikujipaka mafuta kamwe mpaka majuma matatu yalipotimia.
Ekegusii: Tinarenge koria endagera engiya, gose koria enyama, gose konywa edivai. Tinarenge kweaka amaguta nonya ng’ake ase chichuma chiria isato.

English: From Benjamin, the kinsmen of Saul: 3,000, most of whom had remained loyal to the house of Saul up to that time.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Benyamini, ndugu zake Sauli, walikuwa 3,000; wengi wao walikuwa wameendelea kuwa waaminifu kwa Sauli mpaka wakati huo.
Ekegusii: Ababenjamini, abanto b’eamate ya Saulo, nigo barenge chilifu isato (3,000), nonya nase ekero ekio abange mono kobua b’abwo bagendererete kobwatana nenyomba ya Saulo.

English: You hypocrite! First take the beam out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.
Kiswahili: Ewe mnafiki, ondoa boriti ndani ya jicho lako kwanza, ndipo utaweza kuona dhahiri jinsi ya kuondoa kibanzi kilicho ndani ya jicho la ndugu yako.
Ekegusii: Aye omonga’inereria, rusia ritang’ani omoriibo ore ase eriiso riao, nario orarore buya omanye korusia ekeogoto korwa ase eriiso ri’oyomino.

English: So Abimelech brought sheep and cattle, menservants and maidservants, and he gave them to Abraham and restored his wife Sarah to him.
Kiswahili: Kisha Abimeleki akatwaa kondoo na ngʼombe, na watumwa wa kiume na wa kike akampa Abrahamu, akamrudisha Sara kwa mumewe.
Ekegusii: Erio Abimeleki akaimokia ching’ondi ne chiombe, amo nabasomba, abamura na abaiseke, akaa Aburaamu, akamoiraneria na Sara mokaye.

English: Then in the seventh year, Jehoiada sent for the commanders of hundreds, the Carites, and the guards, and had them brought into the house of the LORD. There he made a covenant with them and put them under oath. He showed them the king’s son
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa saba, Yehoyada akatumania wakuu wa vikundi vya mamia, na Wakari, na walinzi, nao wakaletwa kwake katika Hekalu la Bwana. Alifanya agano nao na kuwaapisha katika Hekalu la Bwana. Ndipo akawaonyesha mwana wa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatano na kabere, Yehoyada agatoma amang’ana korenta abatang’ani b’abarendi amagana b’omorwoti, na ab’enyomba y’omorwoti, akabairana ase enyomba y’Omonene, agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo, na akagera bakaria chimuma agwo ase enyomba y’Omonene. Erio akaborokia omwana oria bw’omorwoti.

English: O inhabitant of Lebanon, nestled in the cedars, how you will groan when pangs of anguish come upon you, agony like a woman in labor.” A Warning to Coniah
Kiswahili: Wewe uishiye Lebanoni, wewe uliyetulia kwenye majengo ya mierezi, tazama jinsi utakavyoomboleza maumivu makali yatakapokupata, maumivu kama yale ya mwanamke mwenye utungu wa kuzaa!
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Lebanoni, mwabeire more n’obotoereru ase ebiswa biaino ime, ase egati y’emecharake. Ekeene, namweumie ekero moraigwe obororo, obororo buna obw’omokuungu okobina aibore. Ekiina kia Nyasae igoro ya Konia

English: Suddenly two men, Moses and Elijah, began talking with Jesus.
Kiswahili: Ghafula wakawaona watu wawili, ndio Mose na Eliya, wakizungumza naye.
Ekegusii: Na agwo, abanto babere bakarorekana bagakwana nere, nabwo Musa na Elija.

English: They gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are mentioned by name:
Kiswahili: Kutoka makabila ya Yuda na Simeoni waligawa miji ifuatayo kwa majina
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, na egia Simioni bakarua emechie eyio egwatorwa aiga.

English: When the Israelites saw it, they asked one another, “What is it?” For they did not know what it was. So Moses told them, “It is the bread that the LORD has given you to eat.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli walipoona, wakaambiana, “Hiki ni nini?” Kwa kuwa hawakujua kilikuwa kitu gani. Mose akawaambia, “Huu ndio mkate ambao Bwana amewapa mle.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli babiroche tibamanyete gose mbinto ki, bagachaaka koborania barabwo ase barabwo, “Mbinto ki biria?” Musa akabateebia, “Oria nomogati oy’Omonene abaeire morie.

English: And the people implored the Lord Most High, in prayer before him who is merciful, until the worship of the Lord was finished, and so they accomplished his service.
Kiswahili: Nao watu wakamwomba Bwana Aliye Juu Zaidi, wakimwomba Yeye aliye na huruma, hata ibada ya Bwana ikamilike, nao wakakamilisha huduma yake.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto bakamogaramera Omonene kegima, bakamosaba ere omonyene amaabera goika omoroberio bw'okomosasiima Omonene okaera. Naboigo banyaarete gokora okomosasiima ere.

English: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa alitambua Yesu alikuwa amekabidhiwa kwake kwa ajili ya wivu.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera konya omanyire ng'a Abayahudi nigo baruete Yeso ase obogechi.

English: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu, “Wewe umenena. Lakini ninawaambia nyote: Siku za baadaye, mtamwona Mwana wa Adamu akiwa ameketi mkono wa kuume wa Mwenye Nguvu, na akija juu ya mawingu ya mbinguni.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Naboigo aye gwateebire, korende nabateebirie inwe, korwa bono inamorore Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto oikaransete ensemo y'okoboko gw'okorio kw'Oyore nokobua, ogocha ase amare a igoro.”

English: An evil man is trapped by his rebellious speech, but a righteous man escapes from trouble.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwovu hunaswa kwa mazungumzo yake ya dhambi, bali mwenye haki huepuka taabu.
Ekegusii: Omonto omobe nigo agotegwa n’ogosaria gokorwa ase ebikoba biaye, korende omonyene oboronge natooreke korwa ase emechando.

English: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
Kiswahili: Mtu atakayevichoma ni lazima afue nguo zake na aoge kwa maji; baadaye ataweza kuingia kambini.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria orasaambe ebinto ebio nigo arasibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namaache; magega y'ayio amanye gosoa ase egetwori.

English: who tell the seers, “Don't see!” and the prophets, “Don't prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things. Prophesy deceits.
Kiswahili: Wanawaambia waonaji, “Msione maono tena!” Nako kwa manabii wanasema, “Msiendelee kutupatia maono ambayo ni ya kweli! Tuambieni mambo ya kupendeza, tabirini mambo ya uongo.
Ekegusii: Nigo bagoteebia abarori b'amaroro: “Timobaisa korora amang'ana,” na bateebia ababani: “Timobaisa gotobaanera amang'ana amaronge; toteebie amang'ana amororo aya agotwansera, motobaanere ay'obong'ainereria.

English: Woe to the majestic crown of Ephraim’s drunkards, to the fading flower of his glorious splendor, set on the summit above the fertile valley, the pride of those overcome by wine.
Kiswahili: Ole kwa lile taji la maua, kiburi cha walevi wa Efraimu, kwa ua linalosinyaa, uzuri wa utukufu wake, uliowekwa kwenye kichwa cha bonde lenye rutuba: kwa ule mji, kiburi cha wale walioshushwa na mvinyo!
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwao aye ore egutwa y’oboenenu bw’abaanto ba Efraimu batindire. Nigo ore buna egesicha giasusanire, obwari bw’obonene bwao bwasirire. Nigo ore ase egetunwa igoro, igoro ye rikura ritobu ri’abwo babuirwe nedivai.

English: In those days Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim
Kiswahili: Wakati huu Amrafeli mfalme wa Shinari, Arioko mfalme wa Elasari, Kedorlaoma mfalme wa Elamu, na Tidali mfalme wa Goimu
Ekegusii: Ekaba ase amatuko ’Amurafeli, omorwoti o Shinari, na Arioki, omorwoti o Eleasari, na Kedorilaoma, omorwoti o Elamu, na Tidali, omorwoti o Goiimu,

English: Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
Kiswahili: Wapandao kwa machozi watavuna kwa nyimbo za shangwe.
Ekegusii: Abwo bakobusura bare namariga mbagese bare nomochengo.

English: He built the upper gate of Yahweh's house, and he built much on the wall of Ophel.
Kiswahili: Yothamu akajenga upya Lango la Juu la Hekalu la Bwana na kufanya kazi kubwa kwenye ukuta katika kilima cha Ofeli.
Ekegusii: Yotamu akaagacha Egeita kia Rogoro ki'enyomba y'Omonene, naende agakora emeremo emenene ase okoagacha orwaki rw'Ofeli.

English: These are the sons of Esau’s son Reuel: Chiefs Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. They are the chiefs descended from Reuel in the land of Edom, and they are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
Kiswahili: Wakuu wa wana wa Reueli, mwana wa Esau ni: Nahathi, Zera, Shama na Miza. Hawa ndio wakuu waliotoka kwa Reueli huko Edomu, waliokuwa wajukuu wa kiume wa Basemathi mkewe Esau.
Ekegusii: Naba nabwo basinto ba Reueli, mosinto bw’Esau: Omogambi Nahati, na omogambi Zera, na omogambi Sama, na omogambi Miza. Aba nabwo baarenge abagaambi korwa ase ororeeria rwa Reueli ase ense y’Edomu. Aba nabwo abachokoro abamura ba Basemati, moga Esau.

English: But as for ourselves, many afflictions and many wars have encompassed us, and the kings who are around us have fought against us.
Kiswahili: Lakini sisi wenyewe, mateso mengi na vita vingi vimetuzunguka, na wafalme walio karibu nasi wamepigana nasi.
Ekegusii: Korende intwe twabeire togotwara obokong'u ne emechando boigo chiseegi kera engaki, ase engencho ebisaku bitoetanaine biabeire bigotorwania.

English: Jerusalem has grievously sinned. Therefore she has become unclean. All who honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness. Yes, she sighs and turns backward.
Kiswahili: Yerusalemu ametenda dhambi sana kwa hiyo amekuwa najisi. Wote waliomheshimu wanamdharau, kwa maana wameuona uchi wake. Yeye mwenyewe anapiga kite na kugeukia mbali.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Yerusalemu bakorire ebibe ebinene; ase ayio babeire okogechia, bonsi abaabasigete baabachayire, ekiagera barorire obogetirianda bwabo. Ee, omochie omonyene nkweumia ore, bweonchoire gochia magega.

English: and you have seen their abominations and their idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold, which were among them);
Kiswahili: Mliona miongoni mwao vinyago vyao vya kuchukiza na sanamu za miti na mawe, za fedha na dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Mwarooche ebinto babwate bi'okogeechia, emegwekano yabo baare gosasiima, yaroisirie korwa ase emete, n'amagena, ne'chifeta, ne'chitaabu, eyio yarenge ase egati yabo.

English: Then Samson said: “With the jawbone of a donkey I have piled them into heaps. With the jawbone of a donkey I have slain a thousand men.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Samsoni akasema, “Kwa taya la punda malundo juu ya malundo. Kwa taya la punda nimeua watu 1,000.”
Ekegusii: Erio Samusoni agakwana. “Ase riuga ri’orosea rw’etigere naitire abanto elifu eyemo, ase riuga ri’orosea rw’etigere nababeekire inse ebinge chiebitondo.”

English: Then they turned back to invade En-mishpat (that is, Kadesh), and they conquered the whole territory of the Amalekites, as well as the Amorites who lived in Hazazon-tamar.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakarudi wakaenda En-Misfati (yaani Kadeshi), wakashinda nchi yote ya Waamaleki, pamoja na Waamori waliokuwa wakiishi Hasason-Tamari.
Ekegusii: Erio bakairana goika bagaika Enimisifati, noro okorokwa Kadeshi, bagasaria ense yonsi y’Abaameleki, na eya Abaamori abwo bamenyete Hasasoni-Tamari.

English: In the morning you will say, ‘If only it were evening!’ and in the evening you will say, ‘If only it were morning!’—because of the dread in your hearts of the terrifying sights you will see.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa asubuhi utasema hivi, “Laiti ingekuwa jioni!” Jioni utasema, “Laiti ingekuwa asubuhi,” kwa sababu ya hofu ile itakayojaza moyo wako na vitu vile macho yako yatakavyoviona.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’omoondoko bwe chinkoro chiraabe n’obwoba, na ase amakumia y’okoirokia, na ase aria morarore n’amaiso aino, nigo morateebe ase engaki ya mambia: ’Naki y’are koba buya onye yaaba mogoroba, na ase engaki ya mogoroba moteebe: Naki y’are koba buya onye yaaba mambia.

English: Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu upendo wako ni bora kuliko uhai, midomo yangu itakuadhimisha.
Ekegusii: Obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo bore obuya kobua obogima, ase ayio nimbe nkogotogia nomonwa one.

English: And David made a name for himself when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
Kiswahili: Naye Daudi akapata sifa baada ya kurudi kutoka kuwaua Waedomu 18,000 katika Bonde la Chumvi.
Ekegusii: Daudi akenyorera erieta rinene ekero arenge koirana, gaitire Abaedomu chilifu ikomi na isano’isato (18,000) ase Riranya ri’Omonyo.

English: In that day, Yahweh of Armies will become a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty to the residue of his people,
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atakuwa taji la utukufu, taji zuri la maua kwa mabaki ya watu wake.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi'Omonene bw'Emeganda nabe egutwa y'obonene, na ekiore ki'obwari ase abanto baye abatigari,

English: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.
Kiswahili: Mkia wake ukakokota theluthi ya nyota zote angani na kuziangusha katika nchi. Ndipo lile joka likasimama mbele ya yule mwanamke aliyekuwa karibu kuzaa ili lipate kumla huyo mtoto mara tu atakapozaliwa.
Ekegusii: Ekemincha kiaye kegakurura ensemo ya gatato ye ching'enang'eni chia igoro na gochiyeria ase ense. Na enchoka eria egatenena ase obosio bw'omokuungu oria orenge ang'e koibora, erinde ekero aiboire erie omwana oye.

English: If you turn your foot from breaking the Sabbath, from doing as you please on My holy day, if you call the Sabbath a delight, and the LORD’s holy day honorable, if you honor it by not going your own way or seeking your own pleasure or speaking idle words,
Kiswahili: “Kama ukitunza miguu yako isivunje Sabato, na kutokufanya kama vile upendavyo katika siku yangu takatifu, kama ukiita Sabato siku ya furaha na siku takatifu ya Bwana ya kuheshimiwa, kama utaiheshimu kwa kutoenenda katika njia zako mwenyewe, na kutokufanya yakupendezayo au kusema maneno ya upuzi,
Ekegusii: “Koratange okogoro kwao ase rituko ri’Esabato na bwetange tokora amang’ana ao agokogokia ase rituko riane richenu; koraroke Esabato ebe omogooko oo, rituko riria richenu ri’Omonene rituko ri’ogosikwa; korarisike otari kobwatia chinchera chiao omonyene, gose kwerigeria aya agokogokia, na tokwana amang’ana atagwenereti,

English: They shall bring the heaved thigh and the waved breast with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It shall be yours, and your sons' with you, as a portion forever, as Yahweh has commanded.”
Kiswahili: Paja lile lililotolewa na kidari kile kilichoinuliwa lazima viletwe pamoja na sehemu za mafuta ya sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto, ili kuinuliwa mbele za Bwana kama sadaka ya kuinuliwa. Hili litakuwa fungu lako la kawaida na wanao, kama Bwana alivyoagiza.”
Ekegusii: Ekenama gekoruegwa, ne ritaana riria rigosungusigwa, birentwe amo nebitinya bikoruegwa ebing'wanso bigosaambwa n'omorero, bisungusigwe bibe ebing'wanso bi'ogosungusigwa ase obosio bw'Omonene. Ebio nabibe egetari kiao amo neki'abamura bao kogenderera botaambe, buna Omonene achiigete.”

English: Then the high priest and all his associates, who belonged to the party of the Sadducees, were filled with jealousy. They went out
Kiswahili: Kisha kuhani mkuu na wenzake wote waliokuwa pamoja naye, waliokuwa wa kundi la Masadukayo, wakajawa na wivu.
Ekegusii: Omokuani omonene akaimoka, na bonsi abarenge amo nere; abwo nabwo barenge b’Abasadukai. Bagaichorwa ne ribero rinene ase Abatomwa ase igo bakaroberia kobaimokeria egetambokero.

English: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn't drive them out; but the Jebusites live with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.
Kiswahili: Yuda hakuweza kuwafukuza Wayebusi, waliokuwa wakiishi Yerusalemu; hadi leo Wayebusi huishi huko pamoja na watu wa Yuda.
Ekegusii: Korende Abayuda tibanyarete goseria Abayebusi, abamenyete Yerusalemu. Ase igo Abayebusi nigo bamenyete amo n'Abayuda goika reero iga.

English: Whoever eats from the carcass must wash his clothes and will be unclean until evening, and anyone who picks up the carcass must wash his clothes and will be unclean until evening.
Kiswahili: Yeyote atakayekula sehemu ya mzoga huo ni lazima afue nguo zake, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni. Yeyote atakayebeba mzoga huo ni lazima afue nguo zake, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
Ekegusii: Moonto onde bwensi oraarie enyama y’eng’iti eyio ekwete nasibie chianga chiaye, naende nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio, na onde bwensi oraimokie eng’iti eyio ekwete, nasibie chianga chiaye, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

English: But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor ever betray My faithfulness.
Kiswahili: lakini sitauondoa upendo wangu kwake, wala sitausaliti uaminifu wangu kamwe.
Ekegusii: Korende obwanchani bwane bogendererete botambe tinkoborusia asare, tingotiga koba omwegenwa asare.

English: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter,
Kiswahili: Kwa imani, Mose alipokuwa mtu mzima, alikataa kuitwa mwana wa binti Farao.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena Musa, kabeire omonto omonene, akaanga tarokwa omwana bw'omoiseke o Farao,

English: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
Kiswahili: Mapigo na majeraha huusafisha ubaya, nayo michapo hutakasa utu wa ndani.
Ekegusii: Obororo bw'ogoakwa nenyimbo nigo bogosibia ebibe, boigo ogoakwa kw'ebiranya nigo kogosoa ase enkoro ime kwayesibia.

English: Look at me and be appalled; put your hand over your mouth.
Kiswahili: Niangalieni mkastaajabu; mkaweke mkono juu ya vinywa vyenu.
Ekegusii: Indigererie na moichanigwe; erio motube emenwa yaino namaboko, mokire.

English: ‘Even the dust of your town that clings to our feet, we wipe off as a testimony against you. Yet be sure of this: The kingdom of God is near.’
Kiswahili: ‘Hata mavumbi ya mji wenu yaliyoshikamana na miguu yetu, tunayakungʼuta dhidi yenu. Lakini mjue kwamba Ufalme wa Mungu umekaribia.’
Ekegusii: Nonya norotu rw’omochie oino rwabwatereire amagoro aito twarwabusire ase more, korende manya aya, ng’a oborwoti bwa Nyasae bwaikire ang’e.

English: But they deliberately overlook the fact that long ago by God’s word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water,
Kiswahili: Lakini wao kwa makusudi hupuuza ukweli huu, ya kwamba kwa neno la Mungu mbingu zilikuwepo tangu zamani, nayo dunia ilifanyizwa kutoka ndani ya maji na kwa maji.
Ekegusii: Naki nigo bamiametie amaiso abo tibarora ng’a igoro nao yarenge korwa kare, na ense egatongwa korwa ase amaache, na goetera ase amaache, ase chinguru chi’ering’ana ria Nyasae.

English: For this is what the Lord GOD says: I will deal with you according to your deeds, since you have despised the oath by breaking the covenant.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Nitakushughulikia kama unavyostahili, kwa kuwa umedharau kiapo changu kwa kuvunja Agano.
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Ningokorere koreng’ana buna gwakorire, ekiagera gwachaayire eira gwatianete, na gwasaririe okobwatana kw’ogotianania.

English: For if the ministry of condemnation was glorious, how much more glorious is the ministry of righteousness!
Kiswahili: Ikiwa huduma ile inayowahukumu wanadamu ina utukufu, je, ile huduma iletayo haki haitakuwa ya utukufu zaidi?
Ekegusii: Naki onye ogokora gw’ekiina kwarenge nobonene, igo ogokora kw’oboronge nkore nobonene kobua mono.

English: When the battle intensified against Saul, the archers overtook him and wounded him.
Kiswahili: Mapigano yakawa makali kumzunguka Sauli na wakati wapiga mishale walipompata, wakamjeruhi.
Ekegusii: Esegi ekaba entindi mono ase Saulo, na abaruti emegwe bakamoromereria, bakamorasa, bakamoaka chingoma.

English: They will fill your houses and the houses of all your officials and every Egyptian—something neither your fathers nor your grandfathers have seen since the day they came into this land.’” Then Moses turned and left Pharaoh’s presence.
Kiswahili: Nzige hao watajaza nyumba zako, za maafisa wako wote na za Wamisri wote. Jambo ambalo baba zenu wala babu zenu hawajapata kuona tangu siku ile walipoanza kuishi katika nchi hii mpaka leo hii.’ ” Ndipo Mose akageuka na kumwacha Farao.
Ekegusii: Chinyomba chiaino amo nechi’abasomba bao, na echi’Abamisiri bonsi inachiichorwe ne chingige. Omogwekano bw’echio chisokoro chiao gose chisokoororia chitaroche nonya ng’ake korwa ekero bachaagete komenya ase ense eye goika reero iga.” Erio Musa akaonchoka, akarua o Farao.

English: Now therefore take twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, for every tribe a man.
Kiswahili: Sasa basi, chagueni watu kumi na wawili kutoka makabila ya Israeli, mtu mmoja kutoka kila kabila.
Ekegusii: Gaki bono chora abanto ikomi na babere korwa ase ebisaku bi'Abaisraeli, oyomo korwa ase kera egesaku.

English: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,
Kiswahili: kama nimekula mazao yake bila malipo, au kuvunja mioyo ya wapangaji wake,
Ekegusii: Onye nabeire nkoria okwama kwaye ntari goakana na kogera abanyene bakwe,

English: She was taken to King Xerxes in the royal palace in the tenth month, the month of Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign. Esther Becomes Queen
Kiswahili: Esta alipelekwa kwa Mfalme Ahasuero katika makao ya mfalme mwezi wa kumi, yaani mwezi wa Tebethi, katika mwaka wake wa saba wa kutawala.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, omwaka o gatano na kabere bw’okogamba kw’omorwoti Ahaswero, omotienyi o ikomi okorokwa Tebeti, Esiteri akarentwa ase omorwoti, agwo ase enyomba yaye y’oborwoti.

English: and said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces for yourself, for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and I will give you ten tribes.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamwambia Yeroboamu, “Chukua vipande kumi kwa ajili yako, kwa kuwa hivi ndivyo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli asemavyo: ‘Tazama, ninakwenda kuuchana ufalme kutoka mikononi mwa Solomoni na kukupa wewe makabila kumi.
Ekegusii: agateebia Yeroboamu, “Eimokerie aye omonyene ebing’ese ebi ikomi, ekiagera aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atebiire: Rora inche igo inde ang’e gotandorana oborwoti mborusie korwa ase okoboko gwa Sulemani, nkoe ebisaku ikomi.

English: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo viongozi wa makuhani wakafanya mpango wa kumuua Lazaro pia,
Ekegusii: Abakuani abanene bagakora ekiina baite Lazaro boigo,

English: They pursued them a day's journey from Adasa until you come to Gazara, and they sounded an alarm after them with the signal trumpets.
Kiswahili: Waliwafuata safari ya siku moja kutoka Adasa hadi ulipofika Gazara, nao wakapiga kengele nyuma yao kwa tarumbeta za ishara.
Ekegusii: Abayahudi bakabamonyokia omobaso boira, korwa Adasa goika Gazara na ekero bagendererete kobaminyokia bakaba bakobugia egetuureri gieseegi.

English: He has prepared His deadly weapons; He ordains His arrows with fire.
Kiswahili: Ameandaa silaha zake kali, ameweka tayari mishale yake ya moto.
Ekegusii: Oroisirie ebirwanero biaye ebiogoita omonto buna oyio, akore emegwe yaye esambe buna omorero.

English: Then his servants carried him by chariot to Jerusalem and buried him with his fathers in his tomb in the City of David.
Kiswahili: Watumishi wake wakambeba kwa gari la vita na kumpeleka Yerusalemu, wakamzika pamoja na baba zake kwenye kaburi lake katika Mji wa Daudi.
Ekegusii: Abasomba baye bakamobogoria ase egari, bakamoira Yerusalemu, bakamotindeka ase embeera yaye ase chisokoro chiaye chiatindegetwe, agwo ase Omochie o Daudi.

English: Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni mwema na mwenye adili, kwa hiyo huwafundisha wenye dhambi njia zake.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omuya na ere nere omonyene oboronge, ase ayio nigo akworokereria abanyabibe enchera bagwenerete kobwatia.

English: Yahweh says, “Where is the bill of your mother's divorce, with which I have put her away? Or to which of my creditors have I sold you? Behold, you were sold for your iniquities, and your mother was put away for your transgressions.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Iko wapi hati ya talaka ya mama yako ambayo kwayo niliachana naye? Au nimewauza ninyi kwa nani miongoni mwa watu wanaonidai? Kwa ajili ya dhambi zenu mliuzwa, kwa sababu ya makosa, mama yenu aliachwa.
Ekegusii: Aya nar'Omonene akoboria: “Ng'ai riruube ri'ogotigana rire, riria naete nyoko ng'a totigane? Gose monto ki nabwate esira yaye nkabaoonia inwe asare? Taibo! Ebibe nabio biagerete mokaoonigwa, na ogosaria kwaino nakwo kwagerete nyoko agaserigwa.

English: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.” She said, “Will you give me a pledge, until you send it?”
Kiswahili: Akamwambia, “Nitakutumia mwana-mbuzi kutoka kundi langu.” Akamuuliza, “Utanipa kitu chochote kama amana mpaka utakapompeleka?”
Ekegusii: Akamoiraneria: “Ninche ngotomera emaanwa egoree korwa ase riicho riane.” Omokungu oria akamobooria: “Inee! Inki orang'e kebe intenenera goika kwayentomeire?”

English: The spirit of man is Yahweh's lamp, searching all his innermost parts.
Kiswahili: Taa ya Bwana huchunguza roho ya mwanadamu, huchunguza utu wake wa ndani.
Ekegusii: Omoika ore ase omonto, n'oro etaya y'Omonene; nigo ekomoreka na komanya amang'ana onsi are ime y'enkoro y'omonto.

English: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
Kiswahili: jua halitakudhuru mchana, wala mwezi wakati wa usiku.
Ekegusii: Erioba tirikogoaka omobaso, gose omotienyi obotuko.

English: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he raised up altars for Baal, and made an Asherah, as Ahab king of Israel did, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served them.
Kiswahili: Akajenga upya mahali pa juu pa kuabudia miungu ambapo Hezekia baba yake alikuwa amepabomoa. Pia akasimamisha madhabahu za Baali na kutengeneza nguzo ya Ashera, kama Ahabu mfalme wa Israeli alivyofanya. Akalisujudia jeshi lote la angani na kuliabudu.
Ekegusii: Akaagacha naende aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, aria Hezekia ise asaretie. Naende agatenenia ebisasimero bia Baali, na akaroisia omote bw'Asera, enyasae eria enkuungu, buna Ahabu, omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli akorete. Agasasiima erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching'enang'eni, ebitongwa bia igoro, akabikorera.

English: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, nayahesabu mambo yote kuwa hasara tupu nikiyalinganisha na faida kubwa ipitayo kiasi cha kumjua Kristo Yesu Bwana wangu, ambaye kwa ajili yake nimepata hasara ya mambo yote, nikiyahesabu kuwa kama mavi ili nimpate Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ee, nabarire onsi, ng'a abeire bosa ase engencho y'obuya botari nekerengo, engencho yaye okomomanya Kristo Yese Omonene one. Ase engencho yaye natigire ebinto bionsi, na kobibara buna eubi, erinde imonyore Kristo,

English: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini sisi tunafikiriwa kama wanyama, na kuonekana wajinga machoni pako?
Ekegusii: Nase ki tokobarwa koba buna ching'iti? Nase ki tokobarwa koba abanto batamanyeti gento kende?

English: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa neema ya Mungu nimekuwa hivi nilivyo na neema yake kwangu haikuwa kitu bure. Bali nilizidi sana kufanya kazi kuliko mitume wote, lakini haikuwa mimi, bali ni ile neema ya Mungu iliyokuwa pamoja nami.
Ekegusii: Korende ase obuya bwa Nyasae nabeire buna inde; na obuya bwaye bore ase 'nde tibwarenge bosa. Korende kobua mono nakorire emeremo goetania bonsi, gose tari inche, korende obuya bwa Nyasae obore amo nainche.

English: Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, chief of the Reubenites, and the thirty with him,
Kiswahili: Adina mwana wa Shiza Mreubeni, ambaye alikuwa mkuu wa Wareubeni, akiwa pamoja na watu thelathini,
Ekegusii: Adina, mosinto o Sisa bw’egesaku kia Rubeni, omoraai bw’abaanto b’egesaku ekio, na amo nere abanto emerongo etato;

English: Behold, Yahweh's storm, his wrath, has gone out. Yes, a whirling storm! It will burst on the head of the wicked.
Kiswahili: Tazama, dhoruba ya Bwana itapasuka kwa ghadhabu, kisulisuli kitazunguka na kuanguka vichwani vya waovu.
Ekegusii: Rora, omwaga omotindi okorwa ase Omonene, oichire nendamwamu yaye enga buna ekerambauti osokire; nigo egocha igoro ase emetwe y'abanyabibe.

English: It is a miserable life to go from house to house. Where you are a guest, you dare not open your mouth.
Kiswahili: Ni maisha ya taabu kwenda nyumba kwa nyumba. Ukiwa mgeni, huthubutu kufungua mdomo wako.
Ekegusii: Nigo ere egento kiobosoku koombogana korwa enyomba gochia eyende, aande onsi ase ore omogeni tokoigora monwa oo.

English: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons—to minister in the priest's office.'”
Kiswahili: mavazi yaliyofumwa yanayovaliwa wakati wa huduma katika mahali patakatifu, yaani mavazi matakatifu kwa ajili ya kuhani Aroni, na mavazi kwa ajili ya wanawe watakapokuwa wakihudumu katika kazi ya ukuhani.”
Ekegusii: ne chianga chiria chinseera chigokorerwa ime y'Ase Achenu, engencho yaye chianga chia Aroni Omokuani, amo nechi'abamura baye, barabe bakobeeka ekero bagokora emeremo yabo y'obokuani.”

English: because a friend of mine has come to me on a journey, and I have nothing to set before him.’
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu rafiki yangu amekuja kutoka safarini, nami sina kitu cha kumpa.’
Ekegusii: ekiagera omosani one ochire ase ’nde korwa orogendo, na inche tindi na gento nkomoa;

English: Now Simon was visiting the cities that were in the country, and attending to their needs. He went down to Jericho—himself with Mattathias and Judas his sons—in the one hundred seventy-seventh year, in the eleventh month, which is the month Sebat.
Kiswahili: Sasa Simoni alikuwa akitembelea miji iliyokuwa mashambani, na kuwahudumia. Alishuka Yeriko, yeye mwenyewe pamoja na Matathia na wanawe Yuda, katika mwaka wa mia moja na sabini na saba, mwezi wa kumi na moja, ambao ni mwezi wa Sabati.
Ekegusii: Simioni na Matathia na Yuda nigo barenge gotaarera emechie ao ao erio kwemanyia amagania ya abanto. Omotienyi o Shebati, engencho yaye oyoikomi na rimo ase omwaka o 177, bagaika Yeriko.

English: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.
Kiswahili: Mnapokuja kwake, yeye aliye Jiwe lililo hai, lililokataliwa na wanadamu bali kwa Mungu ni teule na la thamani kwake,
Ekegusii: Mochiere ere, oyore rigena rire moyo, riangetwe na Mwanyabaanto, korende ase obosio bwa Nyasae nerichore, rire rie rigori rinene.

English: So you shall serve the LORD your God, and He will bless your bread and your water. And I will take away sickness from among you.
Kiswahili: Utamwabudu Bwana Mungu wako, na baraka zake zitakuwa juu ya vyakula vyako na maji yako. Nami nitaondoa maradhi miongoni mwako,
Ekegusii: Momokorere Omonene Nyasae oino, na inche ninsesenie endagera yaino na amaache aino, nindusie amarwaire ase more.

English: Theirs are the patriarchs, and from them proceeds the human descent of Christ, who is God over all, forever worthy of praise! Amen. God’s Sovereign Choice (Genesis 25:19–28; Malachi 1:1–5)
Kiswahili: Wao ni wa uzao wa mababa wakuu wa kwanza, ambao kutoka kwao Kristo alikuja kwa jinsi ya mwili kama mwanadamu, yeye ambaye ni Mungu aliye juu ya vyote, mwenye kuhimidiwa milele! Amen.
Ekegusii: Inaki abagaaka baito ba kare nabaabo, na korwa ase bare Kristo nao aiboretwe buna Mwanyabaanto; ere nigo are Nyasae igoro ase ebinto bionsi, oy’orabakwe goika kare na kare. Amina. Chiira chia Nyasae tichiamochete goikeranigwa

English: For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together; the land where they stayed could not support them because of their livestock.
Kiswahili: Mali zao zilikuwa nyingi sana kiasi kwamba haikuwa rahisi wao kuishi pamoja, nchi waliyokuwa wakiishi isingewatosha wote kwa ajili ya mifugo yao.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera babwate enibo enyinge tibare konyara komenya amo; na ense eria tiyare kobaisana bamenye babere bonsi ne chitugo chiabo.

English: I have come into my garden, my sister, my bride. I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk. Friends Eat, friends! Drink, yes, drink abundantly, beloved.
Kiswahili: Nimekuja kwenye bustani yangu, dada yangu, bibi arusi wangu; nimekusanya manemane yangu pamoja na kikolezo changu. Nimekula sega langu la asali na asali yangu; nimekunywa divai yangu na maziwa yangu. Marafiki Kuleni, enyi marafiki, mnywe; kunyweni ya kutosha, ee wapenzi.
Ekegusii: Aye moiseke ominto, omoriakari one, nasoire ase omogondo one, ngosangereria inde manemane amo nebinsari biane bigotioka buya; nkoria inde eriana amo nobooke bwane, nkonywa inde edivai yane amo namabeere aane. (Abakungu ba Yerusalemu) Inwe abasani, ragera na monywe! Inwe abanchani, kanywe mono goika moichorwe nobwanchani!

English: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring of the house of Judah.
Kiswahili: Wakati Athalia mamaye Ahazia alipoona kuwa mwanawe amekufa, akainuka na kuiangamiza jamaa yote ya mfalme ya nyumba ya Yuda.
Ekegusii: Ekero Atalia, ng'ina Ahasia, aroche ng'a omwana oye okuure, akaimoka, agaita ab'enyomba yonsi y'omorwoti bw'Abayuda.

English: The goat shall carry all their iniquities on himself to a solitary land, and he shall release the goat in the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Yule mbuzi atachukua juu yake dhambi zao zote mpaka mahali pasipo na watu; naye yule mtu atamwachia akimbilie jangwani.
Ekegusii: Naboigo embori eria ebogorie ebibe biabo bionsi, egende nabio gochia ase erooro ase abanto batamanyeti.

English: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
Kiswahili: Kama vile moshi upeperushwavyo na upepo, vivyo hivyo uwapeperushe mbali, kama vile nta iyeyukavyo kwenye moto, vivyo hivyo waovu na waangamie mbele za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Tiga baserigwe gochia aare, buna erioki rikoirwa aa n'aaria; Tiga abakori amabe basirigwe kegima, barue ase obosio bwa Nyasae, basirigwe buna obochoe bokonyititoka ase omorero.

English: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
Kiswahili: Kisha Eliakimu mwana wa Hilkia msimamizi wa jumba la kifalme, Shebna katibu, na Yoa mwana wa Asafu, mwandishi wakamwendea Hezekia, nguo zao zikiwa zimeraruliwa, na kumwambia yale jemadari wa jeshi aliyoyasema.
Ekegusii: Erio Eliakimu, mosinto o Hilikia, oria orenge omoteneneri bw'enyomba y'omorwoti, na Sebuna omoriki, na Yoa mosinto bw'Asafu, omoriki bw'amang'ana are gokoreka, bagacha ase Hezekia bare ne chianga chitandogete, bakamoteebia amang'ana ayio Rabi‐Sake akwanete.

English: Let both grow together until the harvest. At that time I will tell the harvesters: First collect the weeds and tie them in bundles to be burned; then gather the wheat into my barn.’” The Parable of the Mustard Seed (Mark 4:30–34; Luke 13:18–19)
Kiswahili: Acheni ngano na magugu vikue vyote pamoja mpaka wakati wa mavuno. Wakati huo nitawaambia wavunaji wayakusanye magugu kwanza, wayafunge matita matita ili yachomwe moto; kisha wakusanye ngano na kuileta ghalani mwangu.’ ” Mfano Wa Mbegu Ya Haradali (Marko 4:30-32; Luka 13:18-19)
Ekegusii: Bitige bikiine bionsi bibere goika rigesa, na ekero kie rigesa ninteebie abakogesa: Ritang’ani sangereria amabanchore, moyaboe emesaima monyare koyasamba; korende engano moyesangererie gochia kiage kiane.” Omobayeeno bw’entetere y’Omosirapi na oyo bw’ememera (Mar 4:30-34; Luk 13:18-21)

English: When the offerings were completed, the king and all those present with him bowed down and worshiped.
Kiswahili: Kutoa sadaka kulipomalizika, mfalme na kila mtu aliyekuwepo pamoja naye wakapiga magoti na kuabudu.
Ekegusii: Ekero okoruegwa gw’ekeng’wanso gwakoorirwe, omorwoti amo nabaanto bonsi barenge amo nere bagekumba, bagasasiima.

English: but he didn't call Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother.
Kiswahili: lakini hakumwalika nabii Nathani, Benaya, walinzi maalum wa mfalme, wala ndugu yake Solomoni.
Ekegusii: Korende tarangeretie Nathani omobani, gose Benaya, gose abanto baria baarenge abarwani chituoni, gose Sulemani, momura omwabo.

English: Declare, therefore, that I am granting him My covenant of peace.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mwambie Finehasi ninafanya Agano langu la amani naye.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, moteebie ng’a, ’ngokora inde nere okobwatana kwane kw’omorembe.

English: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.
Kiswahili: Hakuna adui atakayemtoza ushuru, hakuna mtu mwovu atakayemwonea.
Ekegusii: Ababisa tibakomobwata mobosokano, na abakori amabe tibakomochanda.

English: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite;
Kiswahili: Eluzai, Yeremothi, Bealia, Shemaria, Shefatia, Mharufi;
Ekegusii: Elusai na Yerimoti, Bealia na Semaria, na Sefatia korwa Harufi;

English: Of the Danites who could set the battle in array: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Dani 28,600 waliokuwa tayari kwa vita.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Abadani: abanto baisanerete ase okorwana esegi, chilifu emerongo ebere na isano na isato, na amagana atano na rimo (28,600).

English: What man is there who has planted a vineyard, and has not used its fruit? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man use its fruit.
Kiswahili: Je, kuna yeyote aliyepanda shamba la mizabibu na hajaanza kulifurahia? Yeye na arudi nyumbani, au sivyo anaweza kufa vitani na mtu mwingine akalifurahia.
Ekegusii: Gose onye omonto ore aiga osimegete emesabibu ase omogondo oye, nere tararia amatunda korwao, tiga airane ageende 'nka, tabaisa gochia gokwera ase esegi, na omonto omoao achie koria amatunda y'omogondo oye.

English: and he burned fragrant incense on it, just as the LORD had commanded him.
Kiswahili: na kufukiza uvumba wenye harufu nzuri, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.
Ekegusii: na igoro yaye agasambera ubani ekorua rimisu rigiya, buna Omonene konya amochikiire.

English: They worshiped the dragon because he gave his authority to the beast; and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast? Who is able to make war with him?”
Kiswahili: Watu wakaliabudu lile joka kwa sababu lilikuwa limempa huyo mnyama mamlaka yake, pia wakamwabudu huyo mnyama na kuuliza, “Ni nani aliye kama huyu mnyama? Ni nani awezaye kupigana vita naye?”
Ekegusii: Abanto bagasasiima enchoka eria, ekiagera yaete eng'iti eria okobua. Naende bagasasiima eng'iti eria bagoteeba, “Ning'o oreng'aine neng'iti eye? Ning'o oranyare koyerwania?”

English: Abijah went into battle with an army of 400,000 chosen men, while Jeroboam drew up in formation against him with 800,000 chosen and mighty men of valor. Civil War against Jeroboam
Kiswahili: Abiya aliingia vitani na jeshi la watu 400,000 wenye uwezo wa kupigana, naye Yeroboamu akapanga jeshi dhidi ya Abiya akiwa na jeshi la watu 800,000 wenye uwezo.
Ekegusii: Abiya akagenda korwana esegi, akaira abasikari chilifu amagana ane (400,000), abanto chituoni chi’esegi bachoretwe, korende Yeroboamu agacha komorwania, akaroberia abarwani baye b’esegi chilifu amagana atano na atato (800,000), abanto chituoni.

English: As it has been said: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion.”
Kiswahili: Kama ilivyonenwa: “Leo, kama mkiisikia sauti yake, msiifanye mioyo yenu migumu kama mlivyofanya wakati wa kuasi.”
Ekegusii: Agwo igo egokwanwa, “Reero, komoraigwe eriogi ria Nyasae, timokong’ia chinkoro chiaino’ buna ekero keria gi’okogechia.”

English: “Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
Kiswahili: “Maana ya mfano huu ni hii: Mbegu ni neno la Mungu.
Ekegusii: Omoreng'anio noro oyo: Embusuro nering'ana ria Nyasae.

English: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya ishirini na saba ya mwezi wa pili dunia ilikuwa imekauka kabisa.
Ekegusii: Rituko ri'emerongo ebere, na gatano na kabere ri'omotienyi o kabere, ense ekaba yakamokire kegima.

English: The elders of the Jews built and prospered, through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. They built and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the decree of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wazee wa Wayahudi waliendelea kujenga na kustawi kutokana na mahubiri ya manabii Hagai na Zekaria, mwana wa Ido. Wakakamilisha ujenzi wa Hekalu kulingana na agizo la Mungu wa Israeli na amri ya Koreshi, Dario na Artashasta wafalme wa Uajemi.
Ekegusii: Abagaaka b'Abayahudi bakagenderera koagacha na konyora ogosesenigwa goetera ase obobani bwa Hagai na Zakaria bw'ororeria rwa Ido. Igo abanto bagakoora emeremo y'oboagacho obwo buna bachigetwe na Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, na buna Koresi, na Dario, na Aritasasita, abarwoti b'Abaayemi bachigete.

English: It is like a man going on a journey who left his house, put each servant in charge of his own task, and instructed the doorkeeper to keep watch.
Kiswahili: Ni kama mtu anayesafiri. Anaiacha nyumba yake na kuwaachia watumishi wake kuiangalia, kila mtu na kazi yake, kisha akamwamuru yule bawabu aliye mlangoni akeshe.
Ekegusii: Igo enga buna omonto ore kogenda ense eng’ao konya otigire enyomba yaye, oeire abasomba baye okobua, na kera omonto emeremo yaye; agachiika omorendi bw’egesieri arende.

English: Sheol, the barren womb, the earth that is not satisfied with water, and the fire that doesn't say, ‘Enough!'
Kiswahili: Ni kaburi, tumbo lisilozaa, nchi isiyoshiba maji kamwe, na moto, usiosema kamwe, ‘Yatosha!'
Ekegusii: aase abakuure, na enda engomba, ne riroba rirang'ete amaache, na omorero. Ebio tibiana goteeba, “Twaisanekire.”

English: For judgment without mercy will be shown to anyone who has not been merciful. Mercy triumphs over judgment. Faith and Works (Galatians 3:1–9)
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hukumu bila huruma itatolewa kwa mtu yeyote asiyekuwa na huruma. Huruma huishinda hukumu. Imani Na Matendo
Ekegusii: Naki ekiina tikeri namaabera asere oyotari namaabera. Amaabera nigo agochenga igoro y’ekina. Okwegena n’ogokora

English: So they came near, and carried them in their tunics out of the camp, as Moses had said.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakaja na kuwaondoa, wakiwa bado wamevalia makoti yao ya ibada, wakawapeleka nje ya kambi, kama Mose alivyoamuru.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagaacha, bakabogoria emebere eria eboyirie chiganchwa chiabo, bakayeira isiko y'egetwori, buna Musa abateebeetie.

English: The first living creature was like a lion, the second like a calf, the third had a face like a man, and the fourth was like an eagle in flight.
Kiswahili: Kiumbe wa kwanza mwenye uhai alikuwa kama simba, wa pili alikuwa kama ngʼombe dume, wa tatu alikuwa na uso kama wa mwanadamu, na wa nne alikuwa kama tai anayeruka.
Ekegusii: Eng’iti ye ritang’ani ere moyo nigo yagwekaine endo, na eya kabere nigo yagwekaine emori, na eya gatato nigo yabwate obosio buna obw’omonto, na eya kane nigo yagwekaine ensoti ekoiruruka.

English: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.
Kiswahili: Lakini nawaandikia amri mpya, yaani, lile neno lililo kweli ndani yake na ndani yenu, kwa sababu giza linapita na ile nuru ya kweli tayari inangʼaa.
