Ekegusii: Naende nkobariikera nde ogochika okoyia, okore ogw'ekeene ime yaye, na ime yaino, ekiagera omosunte ngoeta ore, na omobaso bw'ekeene oikire kobara.

English: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To the elect who are exiles of the Dispersion throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia, chosen
Kiswahili: Petro, mtume wa Yesu Kristo: Kwa wateule wa Mungu, wageni katika ulimwengu, waliotawanyika kote katika Ponto, Galatia, Kapadokia, Asia na Bithinia.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Petero, omotomwa o Yeso Kristo, gochia ase abachore ba Nyasae, abamwatananekire gochia komenya buna abamenyi ase Ponto, na Galatia, na Kapadokia, na Asia, na Bitinia.

English: Don't be made a beggar by banqueting with borrowed money when you have nothing in your purse.
Kiswahili: Usikubali kuombwa ombaomba kwa kula karamu na pesa zilizokopwa wakati huna chochote mfukoni mwako.
Ekegusii: Tiga gwekora omotaka ase okonagosaberera, erio gotwara chitaabu chi'emeyega emeneene ekero aye otari nagento ase ekemoya kiao ime.

English: So Jesus told them, “When you pray, say: ‘Father, hallowed be Your name. Your kingdom come.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Mnapoomba, semeni: “ ‘Baba yetu (uliye mbinguni), jina lako litukuzwe, ufalme wako uje. (Mapenzi yako yafanyike hapa duniani kama huko mbinguni.)
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, Komogosaba, teba iga: Tata, Erieta riao risikwe, Oborwoti bwao boche,

English: I loathe my life! I would not live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.
Kiswahili: Ninayachukia maisha yangu; nisingetamani kuendelea kuishi. Niache; siku zangu ni ubatili.
Ekegusii: Nagechire obogima bwane; tinganeti kogenderera koba moyo. Takondosia namange; amatuko aane nigo are buna embeo bosa.

English: for they hadn't understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa walikuwa hawajaelewa kuhusu ile mikate. Mioyo yao ilikuwa migumu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera tibamanyete amang'ana y'emegati eria, korende chinkoro chiabo nigo chiarenge chinkong'u.

English: Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, “See, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and they have hanged him on the gallows because he laid his hand on the Jews.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Ahasuero akawajibu Malkia Esta na Mordekai Myahudi, “Kwa sababu Hamani aliwashambulia Wayahudi, nimetoa shamba la Hamani kwa Esta, naye ameangikwa kwenye mti wa kunyongea.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Ahaswero agateebia Esiteri eting'ana na Moredekai Omoyahudi, “Rora, naeire Esiteri enyomba ya Hamani, na Hamani otongirwe igoro ase orobambo roria, ekiagera arigetie goita Abayahudi.

English: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.
Kiswahili: miujiza katika nchi ya Hamu na mambo ya kutisha huko Bahari ya Shamu.
Ekegusii: oria okorete ogokora kw'ogokumia ase ense ya Hamu, naende agakora amang'ana ay'okoondokia aaria ase Enyancha Embariri.

English: The king spoke to Ashpenaz, the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring in some of the children of Israel, even of the royal offspring and of the nobles:
Kiswahili: Kisha mfalme akamwagiza Ashpenazi, mkuu wa maafisa wa mfalme, kumletea baadhi ya Waisraeli kutoka jamaa ya mfalme na kutoka jamaa kuu,
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti agachiika Asipenasi, omoteneneri bw'abasomba b'enyomba yaye, arente abamura korwa ase egati y'Abaisraeli, abare ab'enyomba y'omorwoti, na abande abarenge ab'amasikani.

English: “Look, these women caused the sons of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to turn unfaithfully against the LORD at Peor, so that the plague struck the congregation of the LORD.
Kiswahili: “Wanawake hao ndio waliofuata ushauri wa Balaamu, nao ndio waliowasababisha Waisraeli wamwasi Bwana kwa kile kilichotokea kule Peori, na kwa hiyo pigo liliwapata watu wa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inyora ng’a nabwo baigwerete ogosemia gwa Baalamu, bakagera Abaisraeli tibaaba abegenwa ase Omonene, ekero barenge agwo Peori, na ase ayio amaakwa agacha ase egati y’omoganda bw’ abanto ba Omonene.

English: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the heights of the city,
Kiswahili: Huketi kwenye mlango wa nyumba yake, juu ya kiti katika mahali pa juu sana pa mji,
Ekegusii: Nigo agoikaransera ekerogo ase egesieri ki’enyomba yaye, agwo aase aimokererete igoro ase omochie,

English: They are worthless, a work to be mocked. In the time of their punishment they will perish.
Kiswahili: Havifai kitu, ni vitu vya kufanyia mzaha tu, hukumu yavyo itakapowadia, vitaangamia.
Ekegusii: Eyio mbosa kegima, emeremo eyio nesekererwe. Ekero eraegwe egesusuro, nesirigwe kegima.

English: Therefore, behold, the days are coming when I will punish the idols of Babylon. Her entire land will suffer shame, and all her slain will lie fallen within her.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hakika wakati utawadia nitakapoziadhibu sanamu za Babeli; nchi yake yote itatiwa aibu, na watu wake wote waliouawa wataangukia ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, amatuko ngocha are, ekero ndarente egesusuro ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa ya Babiloni. Ense eyio yonsi nenyore obosooku, na abanto baye mbaiterwe aroro agwo.

English: Gorgias came into the camp of Judas at night and found no man. He sought them in the mountains; for he said, “These men are running away from us.”
Kiswahili: Gorgia aliingia kambini mwa Yuda usiku na hakupata mtu yeyote. Aliwatafuta milimani; kwani alisema, "Watu hawa wanatukimbia."
Ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Georigia na abarwani esegi baye baika ekaaambi ya Yuda ase obotuko obwo. Tibanyoora monto onde aroro. Bagachaaka kobarigia igoro ase ebitunwa, ekiagera bakagete buna nigo baatamete.

English: Does it make you a king to excel in cedar? Did not your father have food and drink? He administered justice and righteousness, and so it went well with him.
Kiswahili: “Je, inakufanya kuwa mfalme huko kuongeza idadi ya mierezi? Je, baba yako hakuwa na chakula na kinywaji? Alifanya yaliyo sawa na haki, hivyo yeye akafanikiwa katika yote.
Ekegusii: Inee! Nigo okagete ng’a aye nomorwoti ore, ekiagera okoamererania nabande ase okoagachera emecharake? Inee! Iso tariete endagera na konywa, naende agakora ayare ay’ekeene na oboronge? Ee, ase engencho eyio amang’ana nigo abeete amaya asare.

English: Micah said to him, “Where did you come from?” He said to him, “I am a Levite of Bethlehem Judah, and I am looking for a place to live.”
Kiswahili: Mika akamuuliza, “Wewe umetoka wapi?” Akamjibu, “Mimi ni Mlawi kutoka Bethlehemu ya Yuda, ninatafuta mahali pa kuishi.”
Ekegusii: Mika akamobooria, “Ng'ai okorwa?” Ere akairaneria, “Inche n'Omolawi o Bethlehemu korwa omochie o Yuda, naende nigo 'nkogeenda korigia aase 'nkomenya.”

English: Others went out to sea in ships, conducting trade on the mighty waters.
Kiswahili: Wengine walisafiri baharini kwa meli, walikuwa wafanyabiashara kwenye maji makuu.
Ekegusii: Abwo bageendete ne chimeeri ase enyancha, bagakora oboonchoreria ase chinyancha chinene,

English: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;
Kiswahili: aliyemwacha mwenzi wa ujana wake na kupuuza agano alilofanya mbele ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: oyio otigire omwanchi bw'oboke bwaye, naende bwebire okobwatana kw'ogotianania kwa Nyasae oye.

English: He who repays good turns is mindful of that which comes afterward. In the time of his falling he will find a support.
Kiswahili: Yeye anayelipa mema hukumbuka yatakayokuja baadaye. Wakati wa kuanguka kwake atapata msaada.
Ekegusii: Oyokororera oyomwabo amaabera nigo akorengereria aare, erio engaki y'emechando okoonywa.

English: He left Lysias, an honorable man, and one of royal lineage, to be over the affairs of the king from the river Euphrates to the borders of Egypt,
Kiswahili: Alimwacha Lisia, mtu mwenye heshima, na wa ukoo wa kifalme, awe msimamizi wa mambo ya mfalme kuanzia mto Frati hadi mipaka ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Akamochoora Lisia, omonto omanyekanete korwa ase eamate yomorwoti, ere abe omoteneneri bw'omorwoti ase ensemo eyio yonsi gochaakera orooche rwe Eyufurate goika orobebe rwa Misiri.

English: Remember the days of old; consider the years long past. Ask your father, and he will tell you, your elders, and they will inform you.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka siku za kale; tafakari vizazi vya zamani vilivyopita. Uliza baba yako, naye atakuambia, wazee wako, nao watakueleza.
Ekegusii: “Inyora amatuko a kare, rengereria igoro y’emiaka y’ebiaare biaetire. Boria iso, nere nakworokererie amang’ana ayio, boria abagaaka baino, nabarabwo mbakoyateebie.

English: When I brought your fathers out of Egypt and you reached the Red Sea, the Egyptians pursued them with chariots and horsemen as far as the Red Sea.
Kiswahili: Nilipowatoa baba zenu Misri, mlifika kwenye bahari, nao Wamisri wakawafuatia baba zenu kwa magari na wapanda farasi mpaka kwenye Bahari ya Shamu.
Ekegusii: Nkarusia chisokoro chiaino korwa Misiri, mogaika ase Enyancha Embariri, Abamisiri bakababwatia goikao ne chigari ne chibarasi.

English: Then Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. They fell facedown, and the glory of the LORD appeared to them.
Kiswahili: Mose na Aroni wakaondoka pale kwenye kusanyiko mpaka kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania na kuanguka kifudifudi, nao utukufu wa Bwana ukawatokea.
Ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bakarua agwo ase omoganda oria, bakageenda ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, bagatung’ama inse bakaumama agwo ase egesoero. Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokabaorokera.

English: but the word of the Lord stands forever.” And this is the word that was proclaimed to you.
Kiswahili: lakini neno la Bwana ladumu milele.” Hili ndilo neno lililohubiriwa kwenu.
Ekegusii: korende ring’ana ri’Omonene nigo rirabeo goika kare na kare.” Ne ring’ana eri nario enchiri eye mwaranderetigwe.

English: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,
Kiswahili: Yeye alichaguliwa kabla ya kuwekwa kwa misingi ya ulimwengu, lakini akadhihirishwa katika siku hizi za mwisho kwa ajili yenu.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo achoretwe na Nyasae korwa kare, ritang'ani ense etarabekwa oboroso, korende oorokigwe ase amatuko aya ay'omoerio ase engencho yaino.

English: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.
Kiswahili: Katika mwezi wa saba wa mwaka ule ule, nabii Hanania akafa.
Ekegusii: Ase omotienyi o gatano na kabere ase omwaka oria Hanania omobani agakwa.

English: Do not swerve to the right or to the left; turn your feet away from evil.
Kiswahili: Usigeuke kulia wala kushoto; epusha mguu wako na ubaya.
Ekegusii: Togobera gochia aande, ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee. Rusia okogoro kwao korwa ase ebibe.

English: They also took away the pots, shovels, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes, and all the articles of bronze used in the temple service.
Kiswahili: Wakachukua pia vyungu, masepetu, mikasi ya kusawazishia tambi, mabakuli ya kunyunyizia, sahani na vyombo vyote vya shaba vilivyotumika katika huduma ya Hekalu.
Ekegusii: Boigo bakaira chindogio, na ebichiko, na ebiinachi, ne chisani, na ebitaabo bi’ogosambera ubani, na ebikorero bionsi bie chitaai biarenge gokorerwa emeremo ase Hekalu.

English: King Solomon answered his mother, “Why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Ask for him the kingdom also, for he is my elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.”
Kiswahili: Mfalme Solomoni akamjibu mama yake, “Kwa nini uombe Abishagi, Mshunami, kwa ajili ya Adoniya? Ungeweza pia kuomba ufalme kwa ajili yake, kwani yeye ni ndugu yangu mkubwa: naam, kwa ajili yake, na kwa kuhani Abiathari na Yoabu mwana wa Seruya!”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani akairaneria ng'ina, “Nase ki okoboria ng'a Abisagi, aegwe Adonia Moborerie aegwe noborwoti boigo, inyora nga ere momura ominto omonene; na Abiatari Omokuani, na Yoabu, omwana bw'omokuungu Seruya, babwatanire nere.”

English: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.
Kiswahili: Meshelemia alikuwa na wana na jamaa zake, waliokuwa watu wenye uwezo: jumla yao watu kumi na wanane.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Meselemia amo nabaanto bamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na batano, abamanyete buya gokora emeremo yabo.

English: He has set fire and water before you. You will stretch forth your hand to whichever you desire.
Kiswahili: Ameweka moto na maji mbele yako. Utanyoosha mkono wako kwa chochote unachotaka.
Ekegusii: Omonene obekire bosio bwao omorero amo n'amache: rambora okoboko kwao, bwechorere keria oganeti.

English: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “The sons of Israel are oppressed, and the sons of Judah as well. All their captors hold them fast, refusing to release them.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Watu wa Israeli wameonewa, nao watu wa Yuda pia. Wote waliowateka wamewashikilia sana, wanakataa kuwaachia waende.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Abaisraeli amo n’Abayuda nigo bachandire. Abanto abwo baabairete ase obosomba nigo baababwatete bokong’u, bangire kobaa ribaga bagende sobo.

English: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza vyombo vyake vyote kwa shaba: vyungu vyake vya kuondolea majivu, masepetu, mabakuli ya kunyunyizia, uma za nyama, na vyombo vya kuchukulia moto.
Ekegusii: Okore chindogio chi'okobuucha ribu korwa ase egesasiimero. Naende okore ebichiko, na ebitaabo, ne chigami, ne chindogio chi'okorenta omorero. Ebinto ebi bionsi biroisigwe korwa ase chitaai.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what Yahweh says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nenda kwa Farao ukamwambie, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Waachie watu wangu waende, ili wapate kuniabudu.
Ekegusii: Eri'Omonene agateebia Musa, “Genda oteebie Farao: Aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende gonkorera.

English: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
Kiswahili: Ninajua kwamba Mkombozi wangu yu hai, naye kwamba mwishoni atasimama juu ya nchi.
Ekegusii: “Korende nimanyete ng'a Omobooria one moyo are, omoerio nigo aratenene igoro ye riroba.

English: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.
Kiswahili: Yule mkuu wa gereza alipoamka na kuona milango ya gereza iko wazi, akachomoa upanga wake akataka kujiua, akidhani ya kuwa wafungwa wote wametoroka.
Ekegusii: Omorendi bw'echela akaboka na akarora ebisieri bi'echela biaigokire, akang'usa omoyio o birende, akarigia gweita, ekiagera akagete ng'a abasibwa mbatamire.

English: Your borders are in the heart of the seas. Your builders have perfected your beauty.
Kiswahili: Mipaka yako ilikuwa katika moyo wa bahari, wajenzi wako walikamilisha uzuri wako.
Ekegusii: Chimbebe chiao nigo chigete enyancha gati; abaagachi bao nabwo bagokorete okaba omoseera omoikeranu.

English: You have said, ‘Woe is me because the LORD has added sorrow to my pain! I am worn out with groaning and have found no rest.’”
Kiswahili: Ulisema, ‘Ole wangu! Bwana ameongeza huzuni juu ya maumivu yangu, nimechoka kwa kulia kwa uchungu wala sipati pumziko.’ ”
Ekegusii: Nigo gwakwanete ng’a obobe nobwao, ekiagera Omonene omentire omoichano ase obororo bwao, naende ng’a kwarosire ase ogochandeka kwao, gose tori nogotimoka.

English: And there he built an altar to the LORD and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. Then the LORD answered the prayers on behalf of the land, and the plague upon Israel was halted.
Kiswahili: Kisha Daudi akamjengea Bwana madhabahu mahali hapo, na kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani. Kisha Bwana akajibu kwa ajili ya nchi, nayo tauni ikakoma katika Israeli.
Ekegusii: Na Daudi akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero, agwo akarua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na eki’omorembe. Ase ayio Omonene akaigwa ogosaba gw’ense eria, na amarwaire agatangwa korwa ase Abaisraeli.

English: The children of Benjamin came out of Gibeah, and on that day destroyed twenty-two thousand of the Israelite men down to the ground.
Kiswahili: Wabenyamini wakatoka Gibea na kuwaua watu 22,000 wa Israeli siku ile.
Ekegusii: korende Ababenjamini bagasooka korwa Gibea, bagaita Abaisraeli chilifu emerongo ebere na babere, ase rituko erio.

English: How long will this be in the heart of the prophets who prophesy lies, even the prophets of the deceit of their own heart?
Kiswahili: Mambo haya yataendelea mpaka lini ndani ya mioyo ya hawa manabii wa uongo, ambao hutabiri maono ya uongo ya akili zao wenyewe?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ngoika ririri oborimo boragenderere koba ime ase chinkoro chi'ababani abwo bakobana obong'ainereria bwe chinkoro chiabo?

English: I begged Yahweh at that time, saying,
Kiswahili: Wakati huo nilimsihi Bwana:
Ekegusii: “Ase engaki eria 'ngasaba mono,

English: Then Miriam and Aaron criticized Moses because of the Cushite woman he had married, for he had taken a Cushite wife.
Kiswahili: Miriamu na Aroni walianza kuzungumza dhidi ya Mose kwa sababu ya mke wake Mkushi, kwa kuwa alikuwa ameoa Mkushi.
Ekegusii: Miriamu na Aroni bagakwana amang’ana arenge mamincha ya Musa, ekiagera Musa konya onyuomire omokungu korwa ase Abaetiopia.

English: And Solomon replied, “If he is a man of character, not a single hair of his will fall to the ground. But if evil is found in him, he will die.”
Kiswahili: Solomoni akajibu, “Kama akijionyesha kuwa mtu mstahiki, hakuna unywele wake utakaoanguka juu ya ardhi, lakini kama uovu ukionekana ndani yake, atakufa.”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani agateeba: “Karanyorekane ore omonto bw’ekeene, nonya nagatukia akamo k’omotwe oye tigakogwa inse; korende obobe koboranyorekane asare, goika akwe.”

English: In the twelfth year of the reign of Ahaz over Judah, Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria nine years.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa kumi na mbili wa utawala wa Ahazi mfalme wa Yuda, Hoshea mwana wa Ela akawa mfalme wa Israeli katika Samaria, akatawala kwa miaka tisa.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na kabere bw’okogaamba kw’Ahasi, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, Hosea, mosinto o Ela, agachaaka kogaambera Abaisraeli agwo Samaria, na akagaamba emiaka kianda.

English: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I will do according to your anger, and according to your envy which you have shown out of your hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.
Kiswahili: kwa hiyo hakika kama niishivyo, asema Bwana Mwenyezi, nitakutenda kwa kadiri ya hasira na wivu uliouonyesha katika chuki yako juu yao nami nitafanya nijulikane miongoni mwao wakati nitakapokuhukumu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, inche Omonene Nyasae nigo ngoteeba iga: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, ningokorere koreng'ana nendamwamu yao, ne ribero ria'o, erio kwaorogetie, ekiagera ogechete Abaisraeli. Ekero ndakonachere ekiina, nimanyekane ase egati yabo.

English: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”
Kiswahili: Akitarajia yasiyoweza kutarajiwa, Abrahamu akaamini, akawa baba wa mataifa mengi, kama alivyoahidiwa kwamba, “Uzao wako utakuwa mwingi mno.”
Ekegusii: Ere akeegena ase ogosemeria ase ay'atanyare gosemerigwa, erinde abe ise bw'ebisaku ebinge, buna ateebetigwe, “Naboigo oroiboro rwao rorabe.”

English: at the sound of the galloping hooves of stallions, the rumbling of chariots, and the clatter of their wheels. The fathers will not turn back for their sons; their hands will hang limp.
Kiswahili: kwa sauti ya kwato za farasi waendao mbio, kwa sauti ya magari ya adui na mngurumo wa magurudumu yake. Baba hawatageuka kuwasaidia watoto wao, mikono yao italegea.
Ekegusii: Ekero baraigwe amariogi ’ebititiro bi’ebitaago bie chibarasi, na okwoga kw’amagoro e chigari. Abaise tibakorigia magega barore ase abana babo bare; ekiagera amaboko abo nigo araborwe chinguru.

English: I say this to move you to shame. Isn't there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?
Kiswahili: Nasema hivi ili mwone aibu. Je, inawezekana kuwa miongoni mwenu hakuna mtu mwenye hekima ya kutosha kuamua ugomvi kati ya waaminio?
Ekegusii: Nateebire aya ase okobasookia. Inee! Onde tari ase egati yaino ore ne chisemi chiisaine oranyare konacha amang'ana are ase egati y'abamwabo?

English: Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Jihadharini. Jilindeni na chachu ya Mafarisayo na ya Masadukayo.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Rigereria, mwerende nememera y'Abafarisai na Abasadukai.”

English: Early in the morning Jerubbaal (that is, Gideon) and all the men with him camped beside the spring of Harod. And the camp of Midian was north of them in the valley near the hill of Moreh.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yerub-Baali (yaani Gideoni) na lile jeshi lililokuwa pamoja naye, wakaondoka asubuhi na mapema na kupiga kambi kando ya chemchemi ya Harodi. Kambi ya Wamidiani ilikuwa kaskazini yao katika bonde karibu na kilima cha More.
Ekegusii: Yerubi‐Baali (nere Gidioni) amo n’abanto abarenge komo bakaimoka mambia chuni, bagatoora ang’e n’ensoko ya Harodi. Abamidiani nigo batoorete ase ense omweya sugusu yabo, ang’e n’egetunwa kia More.

English: Sometimes you were publicly exposed to ridicule and persecution; at other times you were partners with those who were so treated.
Kiswahili: Wakati mwingine mlitukanwa na kuteswa hadharani; wakati mwingine mlikuwa radhi kuungana na wale waliofanyiwa hivyo.
Ekegusii: Engaki ende mokarorerigwa ase okoramwa na ogochandwa maiso marore, na engaki ende mokabwatana nabwo bakoreretwe ayio.

English: And the letters were sent by couriers to each of the royal provinces with the order to destroy, kill, and annihilate all the Jews—young and old, women and children—and to plunder their possessions on a single day, the thirteenth day of Adar, the twelfth month.
Kiswahili: Barua zilipelekwa na tarishi katika majimbo yote ya mfalme zikiwa na amri ya kuharibu, kuua na kuangamiza Wayahudi wote, wadogo kwa wakubwa, wanawake na watoto wadogo, siku moja, yaani siku ya kumi na tatu ya mwezi wa kumi na mbili, ndio mwezi wa Adari, na pia kuteka nyara vitu vyao.
Ekegusii: Amarube aria akaegwa abanto abaango bakayaminyokia gochia ase chingongo chionsi chiare ase oborwoti boria. Nigo arenge goteeba ng’a ase rituko erimo rioka, rituko ria ikomi na gatato ri’omotienyi o ikomi na kabere, noro Adari, Abayahudi bonsi, abanto abake na abagotu, abakungu na abana, baitwe tibarorerwa mabeera basirigwe pi, na ebinto biabo bisakorwe.

English: When Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, He found the man and said, “Do you believe in the Son of Man?”
Kiswahili: Yesu aliposikia kuwa wamemfukuzia nje yule mtu aliyemfumbua macho, alimkuta akamuuliza, “Je, unamwamini Mwana wa Adamu?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akaigwa ng’a bamosokirie isiko, akamorora, akamobooria, “Aye kwamwegenire Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto?”

English: But I will remember the covenant I made with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.
Kiswahili: Lakini nitakumbuka Agano nililolifanya nawe wakati wa ujana wako, nami nitaweka nawe Agano imara la milele.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo ning’inyore okobwatana kw’ogotianania nakorete naye ase amatuko aria y’obobe bwao, ninkore naye okobwatana kw’ogotianania koragenderere goika kare na kare.

English: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.
Kiswahili: Abishua akamzaa Buki, Buki akamzaa Uzi,
Ekegusii: Abisua akaibora Buki, na Buki akaibora Usi;

English: My children, for whom I am again in the pains of childbirth until Christ is formed in you,
Kiswahili: Watoto wangu wapendwa, ambao kwa mara nyingine ninawaonea utungu, ninatamani kwamba Kristo aumbike ndani yenu.
Ekegusii: Abana baane abake, ninde nokoromwa gw’okobina gw’okobaibora naende, goika Kristo arorekane ime yaino.

English: When the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they each departed to his place.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli walipoona kuwa Abimeleki amekufa, kila mtu akaenda nyumbani kwake.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli barooche ng'a Abimeleki okuure, bakairana 'nka, kera oyomo goika bwoye.

English: They came to Jerusalem with stringed instruments, harps, and trumpets to Yahweh's house.
Kiswahili: Wakaingia Yerusalemu na kwenda hekaluni mwa Bwana wakiwa na vinubi, zeze na tarumbeta.
Ekegusii: Bagacha Yerusalemu bakobugia amakano abo, na amakano abo ay'ebirigisa, na ebitureeri, bakagenda ase enyomba y'Omonene.

English: Good is the opposite of evil, and life is the opposite of death; so the sinner is the opposite of the godly.
Kiswahili: Wema ni kinyume cha uovu, na uzima ni kinyume cha kifo; vivyo hivyo mwenye dhambi ni kinyume cha mcha Mungu.
Ekegusii: Obuya nigo bore mamincha y'obobe, na obomoyo nigo bore mamincha y'ogokwa, nabo ere boigo omonyabibe nigo are mamincha y'omonto omosigete Omonene.

English: Like one who murders his neighbor is he who takes away his living. Like a shedder of blood is he who deprives a hireling of his hire.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu anayemuua jirani yake, ndivyo alivyo mtu anayejichukulia riziki yake. Kama mtu anayemwaga damu, ndivyo alivyo mtu anayemnyima mwajiriwa ujira wake.
Ekegusii: Omonene tari gwancha chisadaka chi'abaanto batamoirogeti, gose obonge bw'okorwa tigokorenta okobwatanigwa.

English: The archers attacked him with bitterness; they aimed at him in hostility.
Kiswahili: Kwa uchungu wapiga mshale walimshambulia, wakampiga mshale kwa ukatili.
Ekegusii: Abaruti emegwe bakomoimokera ase okomogwera n’bororo, bakomoruta emegwe na komoorosia,

English: He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—
Kiswahili: Hulikumbuka agano lake milele, neno ambalo aliamuru, kwa vizazi elfu,
Ekegusii: Botambe nigo akoinyora okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, boigo goika ebiare elifu eyemo nigo akoinyora ring’ana achigete,

English: Solomon's provision for one day was thirty cors of fine flour, sixty measures of meal,

English: The king was grieved, but because of his oaths and his guests, he ordered that her wish be granted
Kiswahili: Mfalme akasikitika, lakini kwa sababu ya viapo alivyoapa mbele ya wageni, akaamuru kwamba apatiwe ombi lake.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti agaichana, korende ase engencho ye chiira chiaye na abageni baye ase omoyega, agachiika ayoegwe.

English: I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for their good and the good of their children after them.
Kiswahili: Nitawapa moyo mmoja na kutenda pamoja, ili kwamba waniche daima kwa mema yao wenyewe na kwa mema ya watoto wao baada yao.
Ekegusii: Nimbakore babe nomoyo oyomo, erinde babe bakobwatia enchera eyemo; erio nario barang'iroke kogenderera botambe, ase engencho y'obuya bwabo, na obw'abana babo bararwe magega yabo.

English: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to El Paran, which is by the wilderness.
Kiswahili: na Wahori katika nchi ya kilima cha Seiri, hadi El-Parani karibu na jangwa.
Ekegusii: n'Abahori ase egetunwa Edomu goika Eli-Parani ore ang'e nerooro.

English: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En-gedi—six cities, along with their villages.
Kiswahili: Nibshani, Mji wa Chumvi, na En-Gedi; miji sita pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: na Nibusani, na Omochie bw’Omonyoo, na Eni‐Gedi, emechie etano nomo, amo nebichie biabo.

English: If anyone has in his hand a deadly object of wood, and he strikes and kills another, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.
Kiswahili: Au kama mtu ana chombo cha mti mkononi mwake ambacho chaweza kuua, naye akampiga mwenzake akafa, yeye ni muuaji; muuaji huyo sharti atauawa.
Ekegusii: Gose onye omonto oakire omonto onde nomote abwate ase okoboko kwaye, erinde omonto oria akwe, omoiti oyio nigo aita oria moeneno, nere goika aitwe akwe.

English: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.
Kiswahili: Hata kama maji yake yatanguruma na kuumuka, milima nayo ikitetemeka kwa mawimbi yake.
Ekegusii: gose emerindo y'enyancha neba ekoruma na koimokerera igoro, na ebitunwa bibe bigotengechigwa ase ogoturubanigwa okwo.

English: For at just the right time, while we were still powerless, Christ died for the ungodly.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hata tulipokuwa dhaifu, wakati ulipowadia, Kristo alikufa kwa ajili yetu sisi wenye dhambi.
Ekegusii: Amaene ekero totarenge ne chinguru, ekero engaki yaigete, Kristo agakwa ase engencho y’abanyabibe.

English: Yahweh also will save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of David's house and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem not be magnified above Judah.
Kiswahili: “Bwana atayaokoa makao ya Yuda kwanza, ili heshima ya nyumba ya Daudi na wakazi wa Yerusalemu isiwe kubwa zaidi kuliko ile ya Yuda.
Ekegusii: “Inche Omonene nintoorie obomenyo bw'Abayuda ritang'ani, erinde abanto b'enyomba ya Daudi, na aba Yerusalemu, tibaabaisa gwetogia ng'a mbare nobonene igoro y'Abayuda.

English: In overflowing wrath I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting loving kindness I will have mercy on you,” says Yahweh your Redeemer.
Kiswahili: Katika ukali wa hasira nilikuficha uso wangu kwa kitambo, lakini kwa fadhili za milele nitakuwa na huruma juu yako,” asema Bwana Mkombozi wako.
Ekegusii: Ekero nabeete nekeririanda ekenene, nigo nabisete obosio bwane korwa asore ase engaki enke, korende ase obwanchani bwa kare na kare ninkororere amaabera.” Nab'Omonene, oyore Omobooria oo atebiire.

English: Because they have led My people astray, saying, ‘Peace,’ when there is no peace, and whitewashing any flimsy wall that is built,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kwa sababu ni kweli wanapotosha watu wangu, wakisema, “Amani,” wakati ambapo hakuna amani, pia kwa sababu, wakati ukuta dhaifu unapojengwa, wanaufunika kwa kupaka chokaa,
Ekegusii: “Abaabani abwo basiririe abanto bane, babaebereirie na kobateebia: Omorembe; na omorembe tori aande. Ekero abanto baagachire orwaki barabwo nigo bakoroaka echooka etochoganiri buya.

English: I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.
Kiswahili: Nitaifanya haki kuwa kamba ya kupimia na uadilifu kuwa timazi; mvua ya mawe itafagia kimbilio lenu, huo uongo, nayo maji yatafurikia mahali penu pa kujificha.
Ekegusii: Ninkore ekeene kebe ekerengo gi'okorenga, na oboronge bobe ekebiro gekorenga. “Nindete embura y'amagena yabuse kegima oborimo bore obotamero bwaino, na emegoko ebonganie obwebiso bwaino.”

English: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.
Kiswahili: Binti wa Tiro atakuletea zawadi, watu wenye utajiri watatafuta upendeleo wako.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Turo, abare abanda mono, nigo barakorentere ebiegwa, barigie ogwancherwa kwao.

English: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa Timotheo atakuja kwenu, hakikisheni kwamba hana hofu yoyote akiwa nanyi, kwa sababu anafanya kazi ya Bwana, kama mimi nifanyavyo.
Ekegusii: Ekero Timotheo arache, rigereria ng'a amenye amo nainwe atari nobwoba, ekiagera nigo agokora emeremo y'Omonene buna inche.

English: My son, if you are willing, you will be instructed. If you will yield your soul, you will be prudent.
Kiswahili: Mwanangu, ukitaka, utafundishwa; Ukiitoa roho yako, utakuwa na busara.
Ekegusii: Omwana one, onye kore n'okogania nosome. Onye gotagete koba omong'aini nabo okonyara onye gokwerwa ase okomanya.

English: and that they had pulled down the abomination which he had built upon the altar that was in Jerusalem, and that they had surrounded the sanctuary with high walls, as before, and also Bethsura, his city.
Kiswahili: na kwamba walikuwa wamebomoa chukizo alilokuwa amejenga juu ya madhabahu iliyokuwa Yerusalemu, na kwamba walikuwa wamezunguka patakatifu kwa kuta ndefu, kama hapo awali, na pia Bethsura, mji wake.
Ekegusii: buna barabwo batagoire egesasiimero kia enyasae y'oborimo eyio Antioko aagachete agwo igoro y'egesasiimero kia Abayahudi agwo Yerusalemu; boigo buna barabwo baetananirie enyasi entambe ase Hekalu buna yarenge omochakano konye ere Antioko ataracha, buna barabwo bairire na koyorenda omochie o Beth-zuri oyio oreenge oyomo bw'emechie y'omorwoti Antioko.

English: Seven years of famine will arise after them, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will consume the land,
Kiswahili: lakini itafuata miaka saba ya njaa. Ndipo neema yote ya Misri itasahaulika na njaa itaikumba nchi.
Ekegusii: korende magega y'ayio neche emiaka ende etano na ebere y'enchara; na omoigoto oria bwonsi nigo ogochia kwebwa ase ense ya Misiri, ekiagera enchara eria nigo erarie ense eye.

English: This is the offering you are to accept from them: gold, silver, and bronze;
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo sadaka utakazozipokea kutoka kwao: dhahabu, fedha na shaba;
Ekegusii: Na ebiegwa orasangererie korwa ase bare nabio ebi: chitaabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai;

English: No one shall be weary nor stumble among them; no one shall slumber nor sleep, neither shall the belt of their waist be untied, nor the strap of their sandals be broken,
Kiswahili: Hakuna hata mmoja wao anayechoka wala kujikwaa, hakuna hata mmoja anayesinzia wala kulala, hakuna mkanda uliolegezwa kiunoni, hakuna gidamu ya kiatu iliyokatika.
Ekegusii: Ase abanto abwo onde takorosa, gose kogochwa, gose gosundoka, gose korara chitoro, gose orokini rwa kenema tirokonyanyoka, gose chinuga chi'ebikoroto tichikobutoka.

English: O LORD, who may abide in Your tent? Who may dwell on Your holy mountain?
Kiswahili: Bwana, ni nani awezaye kukaa katika Hekalu lako? Nani awezaye kuishi katika mlima wako mtakatifu?
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ’monto ki oranyare komenya ase obomenyo bwao? Ning’o oranyare komenya ase egetunwa kiao egechenu?

English: I teach you today, even you, so that your trust may be in Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Ili tumaini lako liwe katika Bwana, hata wewe, ninakufundisha leo.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria reero nakoyamanyirie, ee, nakoyamanyirie, erinde omosemerie Omonene.

English: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.
Kiswahili: Aliisafisha anga kwa pumzi yake; kwa mkono wake alimchoma joka aendaye mbio.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akoeyana, na omoika oye omechiera igoro, ere nigo aitete nokoboko kwaye engiti eria yare gotama.

English: And when the time was fulfilled for Esther the daughter of Aminadab the brother of Mordecai's father to go in to the king, she neglected nothing which the chamberlain, the women's keeper, commanded; for Esther found grace in the sight of all who looked at her.
Kiswahili: Hata wakati ulipowadia wa Esta, binti Aminadabu, nduguye Mordekai, kuingia kwa mfalme, hakupuuza kitu cho chote alichoamriwa na msimamizi wa nyumba, mtunza wanawake; kwa maana Esta alipata kibali machoni pa wote waliomtazama.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero engaki y'okogenda ase omorwoti yaigete ase Esiteri, oyio orenge omoiseke bw'Abihaili, ise moke Modekai, oyio omorerete buna omwana oye, taboretie gento kende akoira otatiga ebi Hegai, omosomba bw'omorwoti, oria otenererete abaiseke baria, amosemetie. Bono Esiteri nigo agogetie abanto bonsi baare komoorora.

English: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the covenant, and still escape?
Kiswahili: Lakini mfalme aliasi dhidi yake kwa kutuma wajumbe wake kwenda Misri ili kupatiwa farasi na jeshi kubwa. Je, atashinda? Je, atafanikiwa? Je, mtu afanyaye mambo kama hayo ataokoka? Je, atavunja mapatano na bado aokoke?
Ekegusii: Ere oyio agasaria okobwatana koria, agatoma abanto ase ense ya Misiri gosaba aegwe chibarasi na abarwani esegi abange. Inee! Omonto ogokora amang'ana buna ayio nasesenigwe? Natooreke? Omonto osaririe okobwatana kw'ogotianania natooreke?

English: The burnt offering that the prince presents to the LORD on the Sabbath day shall be six unblemished male lambs and an unblemished ram.
Kiswahili: Sadaka ya kuteketezwa aletazo mkuu anayetawala kwa Bwana siku ya Sabato itakuwa ni wana-kondoo sita na kondoo dume mmoja, wote wasiwe na dosari.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’Esabato omogambi arue ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase Omonene, chimanwa chi’eching’ondi isano nemo, na emingichi eyemo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.

English: Salmon was the father of Boaz by Rahab, Boaz the father of Obed by Ruth, Obed the father of Jesse,
Kiswahili: Salmoni akamzaa Boazi, na mama yake Boazi alikuwa Rahabu, Boazi akamzaa Obedi, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Ruthu, Obedi akamzaa Yese,
Ekegusii: na Salimoni akaibora Boazi ase Rahabu, na Boazi akaibora Obedi ase Rutu, na Obedi akaibora Yese,

English: They spread out like palm groves, like gardens beside a stream, like aloes the LORD has planted, like cedars beside the waters.
Kiswahili: “Kama mabonde, yanaenea, kama bustani kando ya mto, kama miti ya udi iliyopandwa na Bwana, kama mierezi kando ya maji.
Ekegusii: Igo mogwekaine omweya orambogete gochia aare, gose emegondo ere mbarabare y’orooche, nigo more buna emegaka Omonene asimegete. Gose emecharake ere ase amaache mbarabare.

English: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
Kiswahili: Nitajilaza chini na kulala kwa amani, kwa kuwa wewe peke yako, Ee Bwana, waniwezesha kukaa kwa salama.
Ekegusii: Ekero ngochia gwetoora koraara, nigo nkorara chitoro inde nomorembe, ekiagera aye Omonene naye okogera imenye ase okorendwa okuya.

English: For truly all men who had no perception of God were foolish by nature, and didn't gain power to know him who exists from the good things that are seen. They didn't recognize the architect from his works.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kweli watu wote ambao hawakuwa na ufahamu wa Mungu walikuwa wapumbavu kwa asili, na hawakupata uwezo wa kumjua yeye aliyepo kutokana na mambo mema yanayoonekana. Hawakumtambua mbunifu kutokana na kazi zake.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi baria batamanyeti Nyasae nigo bare abariri nonya korwa ime. Abanto abwo barorire ebinto ebiya bireo, korende basinyirwe komwancha Nyasae ore moyo. Ere nigo okorigereria ebitongwa biaye korende birobio tibimomanyeti ere oyio ore omoroisia obo.

English: and Og king of Bashan— His loving devotion endures forever.
Kiswahili: Ogu mfalme wa Bashani, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Agaita na Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: While they were on the way, a report reached David: “Absalom has struck down all the sons of the king; not one of them is left!”
Kiswahili: Wakati wakiwa njiani, taarifa ilimjia Daudi, kusema: “Absalomu amewaua wana wote wa mfalme; hakuna hata mmoja aliyesalia.”
Ekegusii: Ekaba kobare inchera kogeenda sobo, Daudi agateebigwa ng’a, “Abisalomu oitire abamura bao bonsi, onde tatigareti nonya n’oyomo.”

English: And do not call anyone on earth your father, for you have one Father, who is in heaven.
Kiswahili: Nanyi msimwite mtu yeyote ‘Baba,’ hapa duniani, kwa maana mnaye Baba mmoja, naye yuko mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Naende timobaisa koroka monto ase ense tata, ekiagera Iso oino noyomo, oyore igoro.

English: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
Kiswahili: “Dunia ilitetemeka na kutikisika, misingi ya mbingu ikatikisika, vilitetemeka kwa sababu alikuwa amekasirika.
Ekegusii: Erio ense ekanyegerigwa na koondoka, amaroso a igoro agatengechigwa. Ee, ense ekaiguswa, ekiagera Omonene areenge n'endamwamu.

English: As Peter talked with him, he went inside and found many people gathered together.
Kiswahili: Petro alipokuwa akizungumza naye akaingia ndani na kukuta watu wengi wamekusanyika.
Ekegusii: Ekero are gokwana na Kornelio, agasoa ime, akanyora abanto abange basangererekaneteo.

English: Tell them, ‘As I live, says Yahweh, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so I will do to you.
Kiswahili: Hivyo waambie, ‘Hakika kama niishivyo, asema Bwana, nitawafanyia vitu vilevile nilivyosikia mkisema:
Ekegusii: Obateebie ng'a inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Buna inche inde moyo, naigure amang'ana ayio mwakwanire, ayio naro ndabakorere.

English: She said, “I will surely go with you. Nevertheless, the journey that you take won't be for your honor; for Yahweh will sell Sisera into a woman's hand.” Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.
Kiswahili: Debora akamwambia, “Hakika nitakwenda pamoja nawe, lakini njia unayoiendea haitakupa heshima wewe, kwa kuwa Bwana atamtia Sisera mikononi mwa mwanamke.” Hivyo Debora akaenda pamoja na Baraka mpaka Kedeshi,
Ekegusii: Debora akamoiraneria, “Goika ''ngende amo naye, korende orogeendo oro tirogokorentera ogotogigwa, ekiagera Omonene nigo agochia gotiga Sisera agwe ase amaboko y'omokuungu.” Erio Debora akaimoka akageenda amo na Baraki, bagaika Kedesi.

English: Who cuts a channel for the flood or clears a path for the thunderbolt,
Kiswahili: Ni nani aliyepasua mifereji kwa ajili ya maji mengi ya mvua yaendayo kasi na njia ya umeme wa radi,
Ekegusii: Ning’o oremete omotaro ase chiooro chi’embura chigoeta, gose enchera ase chinkoba chikogukura goeta,

English: He walked in the way of Ahab's house and did that which was evil in Yahweh's sight, as did Ahab's house, for he was the son-in-law of Ahab's house.
Kiswahili: Akaenenda katika njia za nyumba ya Ahabu, na kutenda maovu machoni pa Bwana, kama nyumba ya Ahabu ilivyokuwa imefanya, kwa kuwa alikuwa ameoa kutoka nyumba ya Ahabu.
Ekegusii: Ahasia akaba omoko bw'enyomba y'Ahabu, na igo akabwatia chinchera chi'abaanto b'enyomba yaye. Agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw'Omonene, buna abanto b'enyomba y'Ahabu bakorete.

English: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.
Kiswahili: Meza iliyoandaliwa mbele yao na iwe mtego, nayo iwe upatilizo na tanzi.
Ekegusii: Tiga endagera ere ase amasio abo, ebe egesugunia ase bare, na oboreba ase abwo bekagete ng'a mbuya bare.

English: The king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said to them, “Why have you done this thing and saved the boys alive?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo mfalme wa Misri akawaita hao wakunga, akawauliza, “Kwa nini mmefanya hivi? Mbona mmeacha watoto wa kiume waishi?”
Ekegusii: Erio Omorwoti o Misiri akarangeria abaiboria baria, akababoria, “Nase ki mwakorire iga Mwatigire abana abaisia bakoiborwa bare moyo.”?

English: If only I had a traveler’s lodge in the wilderness, I would abandon my people and depart from them, for they are all adulterers, a crowd of faithless people.
Kiswahili: Laiti ningekuwa na nyumba ya kukaa wasafiri jangwani, ningewaacha watu wangu na kwenda mbali nao, kwa kuwa wote ni wazinzi, kundi la watu wadanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Onye ndiria nare konyora aase ngotimokera ase erooro, anga nagenda aare, ntige abanto baane, ekiagera bonsi nabatomani, bagosasiima emegwekano; barabwo nomoganda bw’abasigaani.

English: But the man was unwilling to spend the night. He got up and departed, and arrived opposite Jebus (that is, Jerusalem), with his two saddled donkeys and his concubine.
Kiswahili: Lakini akakataa kulala tena, akaondoka na kwenda mpaka Yebusi (ndio Yerusalemu), akiwa na punda wake wawili waliotandikiwa, pamoja na suria wake.
Ekegusii: Korende omonto oria tancha korara aroro ase obotuko boria. Ase igo akaimoka amo n’omokuungu oye o sere‐sere, bagachaaka orogeendo rwabo gochia Yebusi, (n’oro Yerusalemu), babwate chitigere chiabeekire ebiikaransero.

English: The other Jews who were in the king's provinces gathered themselves together, defended their lives, had rest from their enemies, and killed seventy-five thousand of those who hated them; but they didn't lay their hand on the plunder.
Kiswahili: Wakati ule ule, Wayahudi wengine waliokuwa kwenye majimbo ya mfalme, wakakusanyika kujilinda nao wakapata nafuu kutokana na adui zao. Waliua adui zao wapatao 75,000 lakini hawakugusa nyara zao.
Ekegusii: Abayahudi bande abarenge ase chingongo chinde chi'obogambi obwo bagasangerereka amo ase okoegera obogima bwabo, ase okwenyorera obotoereru na gwetooria korwa ase ababisa babo. Bagaita abanto chilifu emerongo etano na ebere na isano (75,000), korende tibakuneti ebinto biabo kobisakora.

English: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.
Kiswahili: Macho yangu yamefifia kwa ajili ya majonzi; umbile langu lote ni kama kivuli.
Ekegusii: Emechando yagerire amaiso aane abeire orotutu, na ebiimo biane bionsi biabeire buna omorengari bosa.

English: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to Yahweh, and said, “I will sing to Yahweh, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose na Waisraeli wakamwimbia Bwana wimbo huu: “Nitamwimbia Bwana, kwa kuwa ametukuzwa sana. Farasi na mpanda farasi amewatosa baharini.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa na Abaisraeli bakamoterera Omonene ogoteera oko, bagoteeba: Nimoterere Omonene, ekiagera ere obuire ase okobua okonene; chibarasi amo nabachiriinete obarimeirie ase enyancha ime.

English: Then Jonathan said to David, “Whatever your soul desires, I will even do it for you.”
Kiswahili: Yonathani akamwambia Daudi, “Chochote unachotaka nifanye, nitakufanyia.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yonathani akamoteebia, “Gento kende gionsi oganetie ningokorere.”

English: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD.
Kiswahili: Jua litageuzwa kuwa giza na mwezi kuwa mwekundu kama damu, kabla ya kuja siku ya Bwana ile kuu na ya kutisha.
Ekegusii: Erioba narionchoke ribe omosunte, na omotienyi noonchoke obe buna amanyiga, ekero rituko riria ri’Omonene, erire rinene, na eri’okoondokia, ritaracha.

English: A trap seizes his heel; a snare grips him.
Kiswahili: Tanzi litamkamata kwenye kisigino; mtego utamshikilia kwa nguvu.
Ekegusii: Omotego nomobwate ase egetingiro na omoeto nomobwate omong’userere bokong’u.

English: So I am like a moth to Ephraim, and like decay to the house of Judah.
Kiswahili: Mimi ni kama nondo kwa Efraimu, na kama uozo kwa watu wa Yuda.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nimbe buna ekeegwankwa kegosaria ase Abaefraimu, na buna obogundo ase Abayuda.

English: they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.
Kiswahili: Lakini mitume walipopata habari hizi wakakimbilia Listra na Derbe, miji ya Likaonia na sehemu zilizopakana nayo.
Ekegusii: barabwo bakanyora amang'ana, bagatama gochia Listra na Deribe, emechie ya Lukania, ne chinsemo chionsi echiarenge ang'e.

English: In the seventeenth year of Pekah son of Remaliah, Ahaz son of Jotham became king of Judah.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa kumi na saba wa utawala wa Peka mwana wa Remalia, Ahazi mwana wa Yothamu mfalme wa Yuda alianza kutawala.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano na kabere bw’okogaamba gwa Peka, mosinto o Remalia, Ahasi mosinto o Yotamu, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, agachaaka kogamba.

English: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo, Roho akamwongoza Yesu kwenda nyikani,
Ekegusii: Erio kegima Omoika okamoira ase erooro.

English: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says to them: ‘Behold, I Myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kwa hiyo, hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi awaambialo: Tazama, mimi mwenyewe nitahukumu kati ya kondoo wanono na waliokonda.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agochiteebia: Inche bweka omonyene ninache ekiina ase egati ye ching’ondi chinoru ne chindeu.

English: or when a feeling of jealousy comes over a husband and he suspects his wife. He is to have the woman stand before the LORD, and the priest is to apply to her this entire law.
Kiswahili: au hisia za wivu zinapomjia mwanaume kwa sababu ya kumshuku mkewe. Kuhani atamfanya huyo mwanamke kusimama mbele za Bwana na atatumia sheria hii yote kwa huyo mwanamke.
Ekegusii: Naboigo ekero omosacha arabe n’Omoika bwe endamwamu na gokagera mok’aye ng’a nomotomani, omosacha oria amorente ase obosio bw’Omonene, na Omokuani akore onsi aya achiikire.

English: If a man has committed a sin worthy of death, and he is executed, and you hang his body on a tree,
Kiswahili: Kama mtu ana hatia ya kosa linalompasa kuuawa naye akauawa, mwili wake utaangikwa mtini,
Ekegusii: “Onye omonto okorire ebibe na koegwa egesusuro ki’ogoitwa, asungwe ase omote.

English: May the LORD repay every man for his righteousness and faithfulness. For the LORD delivered you into my hand today, but I would not stretch out my hand against the LORD’s anointed.
Kiswahili: Bwana humlipa kila mtu kwa ajili ya haki yake na uaminifu wake. Bwana alikutia katika mikono yangu leo, lakini sikuinua mkono wangu juu ya mpakwa mafuta wa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoakana kera omonto buna oboronge bwaye bore, na obwegenwa boigo. Ase rituko ria rero Omonene nigo akobeka ase okoboko kwane, korende naanga korambora okoboko kwane igoro ase omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene.

English: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”
Kiswahili: Nilipofanikiwa nilisema, “Sitatikiswa kamwe.”
Ekegusii: Ekero amang'ana onsi arenge amaya asende, ngateeba ng'a tinkobugwa.

English: Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Yoshua na Israeli wote wakaruhusu kurudishwa nyuma mbele yao, na kuelekea jangwani.
Ekegusii: Yoshua amo n'Abaisraeli bonsi bagekora buna babuirwe, bagatama gochia erooro.

English: Moreover I will give all the riches of this city, and all its gains, and all its precious things, yes, I will give all the treasures of the kings of Judah into the hand of their enemies. They will make them captives, take them, and carry them to Babylon.
Kiswahili: Nitatia utajiri wote wa mji huu kwa adui zao: yaani mazao yao yote, vitu vyao vyote vya thamani, na hazina zote za wafalme wa Yuda. Watavitwaa kwa nyara na kuvipeleka Babeli.
Ekegusii: Nindue obotenenku bw'omochie oyio, ne chinibo chiaye chionsi, na ebinto bi'amagori amanene bireo ne chikungo chionsi chi'abarwoti b'Abayuda, mbibeeke ase amaboko 'ababisa babo, na abwo babisakore na kobiira Babiloni.

English: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.
Kiswahili: Tena kama Kristo hajafufuliwa, imani yenu ni batili; nanyi bado mko katika dhambi zenu.
Ekegusii: Na onye Kristo tabogetigwe, okwegena kwaino nokwa bosa; nigo more nonya mbono ase ebibe biaino.

English: To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These are the words of the First and the Last, who died and returned to life.
Kiswahili: “Kwa malaika wa kanisa lililoko Smirna andika: “Haya ndiyo maneno yake yeye aliye wa Kwanza na wa Mwisho, aliyekufa kisha akafufuka.
Ekegusii: Na ase omomalaika bw’ekanisa ya Sumurina riika: Amang’ana aya naro agokwana, ere oyore bw’eritang’ani na oyo bw’omoerio, oyo konya okuure, naende akaba moyo.

English: I encountered the watchmen on their rounds of the city: “Have you seen the one I love?”
Kiswahili: Walinzi walinikuta walipokuwa wakizunguka mji. Nikawauliza, “Je, mmemwona yule moyo wangu umpendaye?”
Ekegusii: Ekero abarendi barenge goetanana omochie koyorata, bakanyoora inche, na inche nkababooria, “Mwarora omwanchi bw’omoyo one?”

English: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);
Kiswahili: Lakini hakuna mgeni aliyelala njiani, kwa maana mlango wangu ulikuwa wazi kwa msafiri;
Ekegusii: Nigo narenge koigorera abaeti ebisieri biane basoa; gose motaari onde tabeete okorara isiko botuko.

English: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn't know that it was Jesus.
Kiswahili: Mara baada ya kupambazuka, Yesu akasimama ufuoni, lakini wanafunzi hawakumtambua kwamba alikuwa Yesu.
Ekegusii: Goika bogachia gokia mambia, Yeso agatenena ase engegu, korende aborokigwa tibamanya ng'a n'Yeso.

English: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven. Whether it was in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows.
Kiswahili: Namjua mtu mmoja katika Kristo ambaye miaka kumi na minne iliyopita alichukuliwa juu hadi mbingu ya tatu. Kama ni katika mwili au nje ya mwili, sijui, Mungu ajua.
Ekegusii: Namanyire omonto oyomo ase Kristo, yaetire emiaka ikomi na ene, omonto oyio akabogorigwa gochia igoro ya gatato, (onye orenge ase omobere tinkomanya, onye orenge isiko y’omobere tinkomanya, Nyasae nere omanyete).

English: She treats her young harshly, as if not her own, with no concern that her labor was in vain.
Kiswahili: Yeye huyafanyia makinda yake ukatili kama vile si yake; hajali kwamba taabu yake inaweza ikawa bure,
Ekegusii: Nigo ere entindi mono ase ebichuchu biaye, yabikorera biaba buna mbitari ebiaye; teri gwechandera oroiboro rwaye,

English: But the meek will inherit the land and delight in abundant prosperity.
Kiswahili: Bali wanyenyekevu watairithi nchi na wafurahie amani tele.
Ekegusii: Abaitongo mbaire ense ebe omwando obo, na barabwo mbagoke na goisaneka ase obonge bw’omorembe.

English: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don't boast and don't lie against the truth.
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa mna wivu na ni wenye chuki na ugomvi mioyoni mwenu, msijisifu kwa ajili ya hayo wala msiikatae kweli.
Ekegusii: Korende onye more ne ribero rire nobororo, na okweancha ase chinkoro chiaino ime, timwetogia na gokwana oborimo igoro y'ekeene.

English: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that Yah God might dwell there.
Kiswahili: Ulipopanda juu, uliteka mateka, ukapokea vipawa kutoka kwa wanadamu, hata kutoka kwa wale walioasi, ili wewe, Ee Bwana Mungu, upate kuishi huko.
Ekegusii: Aye ogatiira gochia igoro ogoosa abasibwa, na okanyora ebiegwa ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto, ee, nonya nase egati y'abasaria, ng'a aye Omonene Nyasae onyare komenya aroro.

English: You must not eat anything with blood still in it. You must not practice divination or sorcery.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Msile nyama yoyote yenye damu ndani yake. “ ‘Msifanye uaguzi wala uchawi.
Ekegusii: “Timobaisa koria enyama ende yonsi ebwate amanyinga ime yaye. Timobaisa gwancha oboragori, gose oborogi bonde bwonsi.

English: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”
Kiswahili: Macho yao yakafunguka. Yesu akawaonya vikali, akisema, “Angalieni mtu yeyote asijue kuhusu jambo hili.”
Ekegusii: Amaiso abo akaramokigwa. Yeso akabatianera bokong'u, “Rigereria monto onde tabaisa komanya amang'ana aya.”

English: No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain. Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain.”
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote asije pamoja nawe, wala asionekane mtu popote juu ya mlima, wala kondoo na mbuzi au ngʼombe wasilishe karibu mbele ya huo mlima.”
Ekegusii: Monto onde tatiira amo naye, gose monto onde tarorekana aande onsi ase egetunwa eke, gose ching'ondi ne chiombe tichiba chikorisia ang'e negetunwa eke.”

English: When Jacob finished charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, breathed his last breath, and was gathered to his people.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yakobo kumaliza kutoa maelekezo hayo kwa wanawe, akarudisha miguu yake kitandani, akapumua pumzi ya mwisho, na akakusanywa kwa watu wake.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo akoorete gochiika abamura baye amang'ana aya, akaimokia amagoro aye, akayabeeka borere igoro; erio agakwa, erio agasangererekana amo nabaanto baye.

English: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;
Kiswahili: Huko mpaka ukazungukia upande wa kaskazini hadi Hanathoni na kuishia katika Bonde la Ifta-Eli.
Ekegusii: Ensemo ya sugusu orobebe rokaonchokera Hanatoni, rogaikera ense omweremo ya Ifuta‐Eli.

English: I won't hide my face from them any more, for I have poured out my Spirit on the house of Israel,' says the Lord Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Sitawaficha tena uso wangu, kwa maana nitamimina Roho wangu juu ya nyumba ya Israeli, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.”
Ekegusii: Bono tinkobisa obosio bwane naende korwa ase bare. Ning'umore omoika one igoro y'Abaisraeli. Nabo Omonene ateebire.”

English: Therefore, because you trample on the poor and exact from him a tax of grain, you will never live in the stone houses you have built; you will never drink the wine from the lush vineyards you have planted.
Kiswahili: Mnamgandamiza maskini na kumlazimisha awape nafaka. Kwa hiyo, ingawa mmejenga majumba ya mawe ya fahari, hamtaishi ndani yake; ingawa mmepanda mashamba mazuri ya mizabibu, hamtakunywa divai yake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, buna koreng’ana mwatindacheire abataka inse na kobaura engano yabo ebe ebango, nebe ekero moraagache chinyomba chi’amagena abaachire, timogochimenya, na ekero morasimeke emesabibu ase emegondo emiya, timokonywa edivai yaye.

English: I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands. I will draw out the sword after them.
Kiswahili: Wote wanaomzunguka nitawatawanya pande zote, watumishi wake na majeshi yake yote, nami nitawafuatilia kwa upanga uliofutwa.
Ekegusii: Ninsiarere gochia ase chinsemo chionsi abanto bonsi abamoetanaine ase okomokonya, na abarwani baye bonsi b'esegi boigo, naende nimbabwatie n'omoro one.

English: Then Belshazzar gave the command, and they clothed Daniel in purple, placed a gold chain around his neck, and proclaimed him the third highest ruler in the kingdom.
Kiswahili: Ndipo kwa amri ya Belshaza, Danieli akavikwa nguo za zambarau na mkufu wa dhahabu shingoni, tena akatangazwa kuwa mtawala wa tatu katika ufalme.
Ekegusii: Erio Belisasari akarua ogochika ng’a Danieli abeekerwe eanga emonyinga, ne chisonoi chi’echitaabu igoti riaye, na ararigwe ng’a ere nomogambi o gatato ase obogambi obo.

English: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;
Kiswahili: “Nami sasa nimesukumwa na Roho, ninakwenda Yerusalemu wala sijui ni nini kitakachonipata huko.
Ekegusii: Gaki bono rora, nkogenda nde Yerusalemu, nasibirwe n'Omoika. Timanyeti ayarachie konyoora aaria,

English: Or why was I not hidden like a stillborn child, like an infant who never sees daylight?
Kiswahili: Au kwa nini sikufichwa ardhini kama mtoto aliyezaliwa mfu, kama mtoto mchanga ambaye kamwe hakuuona mwanga?
Ekegusii: Nigo nanga nabeete buna enda erekeire egatindekwa, na buna abana bataroche omobaso.

English: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
Kiswahili: Nayo maji hayo ni kielelezo cha ubatizo ambao sasa unawaokoa ninyi pia: si kwa kuondoa uchafu kwenye mwili, bali kama ahadi ya dhamiri safi kwa Mungu, kwa njia ya ufufuo wa Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Omogwekano bw'amang'ana aya nebatiso, eyekobatooria inwe bono, tari ase okobeeka aare riko ri'omobere, korende ase okoiraneria Nyasae enkoro etari kobagambia, goetera ase okobokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo,

English: Therefore show respect for my words; for it is not good to retain every kind of shame. Not everything is approved by all in good faith.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo heshimu maneno yangu; kwa maana si vizuri kubaki na kila aina ya aibu. Sio kila kitu kinachokubaliwa na wote kwa nia njema.
Ekegusii: Aye oyasike amang'ana aane; ekiagera teri buya orore obosooku ase kera egento na tari kera egento kegwancherwa na kera omonto.

English: Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly, both men and women, and all who could hear with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month.
Kiswahili: Basi katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa saba, kuhani Ezra akaleta Sheria mbele ya kusanyiko, ambamo walikuwamo wanaume, wanawake na watu wote walioweza kufahamu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang'ani, ri'omotienyi o gatano na kabere, Ezra Omokuani akarenta Egetabu ekio ki'Amachiko ase omoganda bwonsi, abasacha na abakungu, nabwo bonsi barenge konyara komanya aya baigwete.

English: Yet a righteous one holds to his way, and the one with clean hands grows stronger.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, waadilifu watazishika njia zao, nao wale wenye mikono safi wataendelea kupata nguvu.
Ekegusii: Korende omonyene oboronge nabwaterere enchera yaye, na oyio obwate amaboko achenegete nagenderere koba ne chinguru.

English: For our transgressions are multiplied before You, and our sins testify against us. Our transgressions are indeed with us, and we know our iniquities:
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu makosa yetu ni mengi machoni pako, na dhambi zetu zinashuhudia dhidi yetu. Makosa yetu yako pamoja nasi daima, nasi tunayatambua maovu yetu:
Ekegusii: Ogosaria gwaito kwamentekanire na kwabuchire ase obosio bwao, na ebibe biaito biatobereire birori. Ogosaria gwaito nigo kore amo naintwe, twamanyire obobe bwaito.

English: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem two years.
Kiswahili: Amoni alikuwa na miaka ishirini na miwili, alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka miwili.
Ekegusii: Amoni nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na ebere, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emiaka ebere agwo Yerusalemu.

English: My son, in your sickness don't be negligent, but pray to the Lord, and he will heal you.
Kiswahili: Mwanangu, katika ugonjwa wako usiwe mzembe, bali mwombe Bwana, naye atakuponya.
Ekegusii: Aye omwana one, ekero orarware tobaisa koba omworo ase engencho yoborwaire, korende omosabe Omonene nere nakogwenie.

English: Turn Your gaze away from me, that I may again be cheered before I depart and am no more.”
Kiswahili: Tazama mbali nami, ili niweze kufurahi tena kabla sijaondoka na nisiwepo tena.”
Ekegusii: Intige, inyore chinguru chinyia ntararua ase ense, na ntabeo naende.

English: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Mtendee wema mtumishi wako Ee Bwana, sawasawa na neno lako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, koreng'ana ne ring'ana riao gwankoreire inche omosomba oo obuya obonge.

English: Just then a synagogue leader named Jairus came and fell at Jesus’ feet. He begged Him to come to his house,
Kiswahili: Kisha mtu mmoja, jina lake Yairo, aliyekuwa kiongozi wa sinagogi, akaja na kuanguka miguuni mwa Yesu, akimwomba afike nyumbani kwake,
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo, erieta riaye Yairo, omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, agacha, akagwa ase amagoro a Yeso, akamosorora asoe nyomba mwaye,

English: “You and Eleazar the priest and the family heads of the congregation are to take a count of what was captured, both of man and beast.
Kiswahili: “Wewe na kuhani Eleazari pamoja na viongozi wa jamaa ya jumuiya mtahesabu watu wote na wanyama ambao walitekwa.
Ekegusii: “Aye amo n’Eleazari Omokuani na abaraai b’ebisaku bi’omoganda bwonsi, mobare ebinto biasakorwa, na abanto abooswa, amo ne chitugo barenta.

English: King Ahaz cut off the panels of the bases, and removed the basin from off them, and took down the sea from off the bronze oxen that were under it, and put it on a pavement of stone.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Ahazi akaondoa mbao za pembeni na kuondoa masinia kwenye vile vishikilio vilivyohamishika. Akaondoa ile Bahari kutoka kwenye mafahali wa shaba walioishikilia, na kuiweka kwenye kitako cha jiwe.
Ekegusii: Ahasi omorwoti akabutora emetobwa y'ebibekerero bi'ebituba, akarusia ebituba korwa aroro, akarusia negetuba keria ekenene giaterekereretwe igoro ase emegwekano ye chiombe yaroisirie korwa ase etai akageterekerera inse aase atichire namagena.

English: The Israelites set out from Rameses and camped at Succoth.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli waliondoka Ramesesi na kupiga kambi huko Sukothi.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakarua Ramesesi, bakageenda Sukoti, bagatoora aroro.

English: those who had their pastime with the fowls of the air, and those who hoarded up silver and gold, in which people trust, and of their getting there is no end?
Kiswahili: wale waliofurahia ndege wa angani, na wale waliojikusanyia fedha na dhahabu, ambazo watu huzitumainia, na kupata kwao hakuna mwisho?
Ekegusii: Ng'ai bare baria baroberetie na gwechanda korigia enibo abwo emeremo yabo etatigete kemanyererio kende?

English: Now there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate. They said to one another, “Why do we sit here until we die?
Kiswahili: Basi kulikuwepo na watu wanne wenye ukoma katika ingilio la lango la mji. Wakaambiana, “Kwa nini tukae hapa mpaka tufe?
Ekegusii: Bono abanto baane barwarete oborwaire bwa ukoma mbaarenge agwo ase egesoero ki'egeita. Barabwo bagateebania: “Ninki gekogera toikaranse aiga goika tokwe?

English: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wako yu pamoja nawe, yeye ni mwenye nguvu kuokoa. Atakufurahia kwa furaha kubwa, atakutuliza kwa pendo lake, atakufurahia kwa kuimba.”
Ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oo, oyomenyete ase egati yao, nigo are omorwani etuoni okogotooria. Ere nigo akogokerete nomogooko omonene. Nabe okirete‐kiri ore nobwanchani bwaye; akogokere nogoteera kw'omogooko.

English: Ahihud son of Shelomi, a leader from the tribe of Asher;
Kiswahili: Ahihudi mwana wa Shelomi, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Asheri;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri, Ahihudi, mosinto o Selomi.

English: by the God of your father who helps you, and by the Almighty who blesses you, with blessings of the heavens above, with blessings of the depths below, with blessings of the breasts and womb.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu ya Mungu wa baba yako, anayekusaidia, kwa sababu ya Mwenyezi, yeye anayekubariki kwa baraka za mbinguni juu, baraka za kilindi kilichoko chini, baraka za matitini na za tumbo la uzazi.
Ekegusii: Nyasae o iso, nere oragokonye, Nyasae Omobui, nere oragosesenie nogosesenigwa gokorwa igoro, na ogosesenigwa gokorwa chindiba inse, na ogosesenigwa gokorwa inda na ase chimbeere.

English: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,
Kiswahili: wakati hasira yao ilipowaka dhidi yetu, wangalitumeza tungali hai,
Ekegusii: nanga nigo batomerete gatore moyo, ekiagera babete n'endamwamu enene ase tore;

English: Then the priest gave to the commanders of hundreds the spears and shields of King David from the house of the LORD.
Kiswahili: Ndipo akawapa wale wakuu mikuki na ngao zilizokuwa za Mfalme Daudi, zilizokuwa ndani ya Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omokuani akaa abatang’ani baria amatimo ne chinguba chiria chiarenge echi’omorwoti Daudi; ebinto ebio biarenge ime ase enyomba y’Omonene.

English: You shall burn the engraved images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it for yourself, lest you be snared in it; for it is an abomination to Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: Vinyago vya miungu yao mtavichoma moto. Msitamani fedha wala dhahabu iliyo juu yao, wala msizichukue kwa ajili yenu, la sivyo mtakuwa mmetekwa navyo. Kwa kuwa ni chukizo kwa Bwana Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: Emegwekano yabo bagosasiima moyesambe n'omorero. Timogania koira chifeta gose chitaabu chire ase emegwekano eyio. Moise gochigania nigo chiraabe chikobatega. Ayio onsi nigo arabe okogeechia ase Omonene Nyasae oino.

English: They answered, “Come on, let us go up against them, for we have seen the land, and it is very good. Why would you fail to act? Do not hesitate to go there and take possession of the land!
Kiswahili: Wakajibu, “Twendeni, tukapigane nao! Tumeona kuwa nchi ni nzuri sana. Je, hamtafanya chochote? Msisite kupanda ili kuimiliki.
Ekegusii: Bakairaneria, “Imoka, togende korwania abanto baria, ekiagera ntwarora ense eria, ng’a n’engiya mono. Inaki mogoikaransa aa bosa? Timobaisa goteeba na kogeenda aroro na koira ense eria.

English: “Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their ways and by their deeds. Their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, nyumba ya Israeli walipokuwa wakiishi katika nchi yao wenyewe, waliinajisi kwa mwenendo wao na matendo yao. Mwenendo wao mbele zangu ulikuwa kama mwanamke aliye katika hedhi.
Ekegusii: Aye Mwanyabaanto, ekero Abaisraeli bamenyete ase ense yabo, bakayekora ekaba eyetachenegeti goetera ase chinchera chiabo na ogokora kwabo, ekiagera ogokora kwabo nigo kwabete ase obosio bwane buna ogotacheneka kw'omokuungu, ekero are nomotienyi.

English: Behold, this is the joy of his way. Out of the earth, others will spring.
Kiswahili: Hakika uhai wake hunyauka, na kutoka udongoni mimea mingine huota.
Ekegusii: Ee, oyio noro omogooko ere abwate ase obogima bwaye, naende abande mbache babe ase ribaga riaye.

English: containing the golden altar of incense and the gold-covered ark of the covenant. Inside the ark were the gold jar of manna, Aaron’s staff that had budded, and the stone tablets of the covenant.
Kiswahili: ambapo palikuwa na yale madhabahu ya dhahabu ya kufukizia uvumba, na lile Sanduku la Agano lililofunikwa kwa dhahabu. Sanduku hili lilikuwa na gudulia la dhahabu lenye mana, ile fimbo ya Aroni iliyochipuka, na vile vibao vya mawe vya Agano.
Ekegusii: Ime aroro mbiarengeo egesasiimero gi’etaabu ki’ogosambera ubani, na esanduki y’okobwatana yaoomire netaabu chinsemo chionsi. Ime ase esanduki eria mbiarengeo: Egetaabo gi’etaabu aase biabegetwe endagera yare korokwa mana, na enyimbo ya Aroni yasebogete, ne chibao chi’amagena aase amang’ana okobwatana kw’ogotianania ariikire.

English: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”
Kiswahili: Mtawala atakuja kutoka kwa Yakobo na kuangamiza walionusurika katika mji.”
Ekegusii: Omogambi naoroke korwa ase egati y' abanto ba Yakobo asirie abanto batameire emechie banyore oborendi.”

English: Then Haggai said, “If one who is unclean by reason of a dead body touches any of these, will it be unclean?” The priests answered, “It will be unclean.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Hagai akasema, “Je, kama mtu aliyetiwa unajisi kwa kugusa maiti akigusa mojawapo ya vitu hivi, kitu hicho kitakuwa kimetiwa unajisi?” Makuhani wakajibu, “Ndiyo, huwa kimenajisiwa.”
Ekegusii: Naende Hagai akaboria, “Onye omonto obeire oyotachenegeti ase ogokuna egetondo karakune ekemo ase ebinto ebio, Inee, ekio nakebe egetachenegeti?” Abakuani bakairaneria, bagateeba, “Ee, nkebe egetachenegeti.”

English: with a crown of gold upon the mitre, having engraved on it, as on a signet, “HOLINESS”, an ornament of honor, the work of an expert, the desires of the eyes, goodly and beautiful.
Kiswahili: na taji ya dhahabu juu ya kilemba, ikiwa imechorwa juu yake, kama kwenye muhuri, "UTAKATIFU", pambo la heshima, kazi ya mtaalamu, tamaa za macho, nzuri na nzuri.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase oroiboro rwa Yakobo akamoorokia omonto obwate ogwancherwa ase abanto bonsi, ere aganchwa n'Omonene boigo na abanto bonsi. Oyio nere Musa tokogoka komoinyora.

English: but don't think that you will be unpunished, having tried to fight against God!”
Kiswahili: lakini usidhani kwamba hutaadhibiwa, kwa kuwa umejaribu kupigana na Mungu!
Ekegusii: Korende tokagera buna aye tokonyora egesusuro ase engencho y'okoamererania na Nyasae.”

English: For Yahweh your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wenu anawaleta katika nchi nzuri, nchi yenye vijito na mabwawa ya maji, yenye chemchemi zinazotiririka mabondeni na katika vilima;
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, 'nkobaira are ase ense engiya ebwate chindooche ne'chinsooko, ne'chintuboka chigosookia amaache gochia ase amagoko na ase ebitunwa.

English: You are not to do as we are doing here today, where everyone does what seems right in his own eyes.
Kiswahili: Msifanye kama tunavyofanya hapa leo, kila mtu anavyopenda mwenyewe,
Ekegusii: “Ase ekero keria timobaisa gokora buna togokora bono aiga. Kera omonto nigo agokora buna arooche omonyene ng’a ’mboronge.

English: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.
Kiswahili: Kingo zake zilikuwa ndefu kwenda juu na za kutisha, nazo zote nne zilijawa na macho pande zote.
Ekegusii: Amagoro ayio ane nigo arenge ne chibonyi chingare chi'okoondokia, chiaichire namaiso ase chinsemo chionsi.

English: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words you can't understand. Surely, if I sent you to them, they would listen to you.
Kiswahili: Sikukutuma kwa mataifa mengi yenye maneno ya kutatiza na lugha ngumu ambao maneno yao hutayaelewa. Hakika ningekutuma kwa watu hao, wangekusikiliza.
Ekegusii: Gose tindi kogotoma ase abanto b'ebisaku ebinge bagokwana emenwa emekong'u, abwo ogokwana kwabo otanyare komanya. Ekeene, onye narenge kogotoma gochia ase abanto buna abwo, nigo barenge gokoigwera.

English: The children of the Kenite, Moses' brother-in-law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the south of Arad; and they went and lived with the people.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa yule Mkeni, baba mkwe wa Mose, wakapanda pamoja na watu wa Yuda kutoka Mji wa Mitende, wakaenda kuishi miongoni mwa watu wa jangwa ya Yuda huko Negebu karibu na mji wa Aradi.
Ekegusii: Abanto b'ororeeria rw'oyomo bw'Abaakeni, ise biara Musa, bakageenda amo n'Abayuda korwa ase Omochie bw'Emekendo gochia erooro, Irianyi y'Aradi, ase ense ya Yuda, na bakamenya ase egati y' abanto b'aroro.

English: Now the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for it was the great high place. Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on the altar there.
Kiswahili: Mfalme akaenda Gibeoni kutoa dhabihu, kwa maana ndipo palipokuwa mahali pa juu pa kuabudia, naye Solomoni akatoa sadaka elfu moja za kuteketezwa juu ya hayo madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akagenda Gibeoni gochia korua ekeng’wanso aroro, ekiagera nao egesasiimero kiareenge aase aimokererete igoro mono; akarua aroro ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa elifu eyemo.

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, nimekukimbilia wewe, usiache nikaaibika kamwe, kwa haki yako uniokoe.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, naye ngotamera, tobaisa gontiga nsookigwe; ntoorie goetera ase oboronge bwao!

English: For I will spread My terror in the land of the living, so that Pharaoh and all his multitude will be laid to rest among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.”
Kiswahili: Ingawa nilimfanya Farao aeneze vitisho vyake katika nchi ya walio hai, Farao pamoja na makundi yake yote ya wajeuri watalazwa miongoni mwa wasiotahiriwa, pamoja na wale waliouawa kwa upanga, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.”
Ekegusii: “Inche nigo naete Farao ribaga arente obwoba ase ense y’abare moyo; ase ayio ere amo nomoganda oye bwonsi barare ase egati y’abatarogeti, abwo baitetwe nemioro. Nabo Omonene atebiire.”

English: They are to wear linen turbans on their heads and linen undergarments around their waists. They must not wear anything that makes them perspire.
Kiswahili: Watavaa vilemba vya kitani safi vichwani mwao na nguo za ndani za kitani safi viunoni mwao. Hawatavaa chochote kitakachowafanya kutoa jasho.
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbabeeke ase emetwe yabo ebitambaa biroisirie korwa ase egatani, naende babeeke chisirwari chi’egatani; tibakweboeria kende gionsi keragere bagiramore.

English: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?
Kiswahili: Basi kuna faida gani kuwa Myahudi? Au kuna thamani gani katika tohara?
Ekegusii: Gaki rende, Omoyahudi inki abuete abande? Na okwaroka inki kogwenerete?

English: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.
Kiswahili: Mtu anayekasirika kwa haraka hufanya mambo ya upumbavu, naye mtu wa hila huchukiwa.
Ekegusii: Omonto okogechigwa bwango nigo agokora ay'oboriri, na omonto okoroberia ay'obobe nigo akogechwa.

English: and that whoever would not seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
Kiswahili: Wale wote ambao hawangemtafuta Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli wangelazimika kuuawa, akiwa mdogo au mkubwa, mwanaume au mwanamke.
Ekegusii: Bagatianania ng'a monto onde bwensi orenge kwanga korigia Omonene, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, goika aitwe akwe, abe omwana gose omonto omonene, omosacha gose omokungu.

English: Obadiah son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
Kiswahili: Obadia mwana wa Shemaya, mwana wa Galali, mwana wa Yeduthuni. Berekia mwana wa Asa, mwana wa Elikana, ambao waliishi katika vijiji vya Wanetofathi. Jamaa Za Mabawabu
Ekegusii: Obadia, mosinto o Semaya o Galali, o Yedutuni; na Berekia, mosinto bw’Asa bw’Elikana, oyomenyete ase emechie y’Abaanetofa. Abarendi b’ebiita bie Hekalu abamenyete Yerusalemu

English: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
Kiswahili: Kipimo chake ni kirefu kuliko dunia, nacho ni kipana kuliko bahari.
Ekegusii: Obotambe bwaye nigo boetanetie obw'ense, na obogare bwaye mboetanetie obw'enyancha.

English: Yet have respect for the prayer of your servant and to his supplication, Yahweh my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer which your servant prays before you;
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo sikiliza dua ya mtumishi wako na maombi yake kwa huruma, Ee Bwana Mungu wangu. Sikia kilio na dua ambayo mtumishi wako anaomba mbele zako siku hii ya leo.
Ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene, Nyasae one, koranche oigwe ogosaba kwane, inche omosomba oo, na okoboria kwane kw'oboitongo; oigwe ekerero na ogosaba oko inche, omosomba oo, nkogosaba.

English: “Hear my words, O wise men; give ear to me, O men of learning.
Kiswahili: “Sikieni maneno yangu, enyi watu wenye hekima; nisikilizeni mimi, ninyi watu wenye maarifa.
Ekegusii: “Inwe abanto abang’aini, igwa amang’ana aane! Inwe abamanyi chisemi, ntegerera!

English: Then Jesus said to them, “I ask you, which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia wale walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo, “Nawauliza ninyi, ni lipi lililo halali siku ya Sabato? Ni kutenda mema au kutenda mabaya? Ni kuokoa maisha au kuyaangamiza?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Nkobaboria nde ring’ana erimo: Mboronge rituko ri’Esabato gokora amaya gose amabe, gotooria obogima gose kobosiria?”

English: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.
Kiswahili: Sasa kwa kuwa Mungu ameilegeza kamba ya upinde wangu na kunitesa, wamekuwa huru kunitendea waonavyo.
Ekegusii: Nyasae ong'urire chinguru, naende onkorire koba omoitongo, na abanto abwo babeire abaremu ase ogonkorera bobe.

English: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii nakukumbusha uchochee ile karama ya Mungu, iliyowekwa ndani yako nilipokuwekea mikono yangu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio ngokoinyoria, oigererie ekeegwa ekiaruure ase Nyasae, ekere ime yao, ekio kwaetwe ekero nakobeekerete amaboko aane,

English: The people of Gaza pleaded with Jonathan, and he gave them his right hand, and took the sons of their princes for hostages, and sent them away to Jerusalem. Then he passed through the country as far as Damascus.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Gaza walimsihi Yonathani, naye akawapa mkono wake wa kuume, akawachukua wana wa wakuu wao kama mateka, akawapeleka Yerusalemu. Kisha akapita katika nchi hadi Damasko.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto ba Gaza bakamosaba omorembe, nere akaroisia omoroberio bw'omorembe. Ere ekababogoria abana bonsi ba abarai na kobaira Yerusalemu erio barabwo bae abooswa.
