English: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.
Kiswahili: “Lakini ninao ushuhuda mkuu zaidi kuliko wa Yohana. Kazi zile nizifanyazo, zinashuhudia juu yangu, zile ambazo Baba amenituma nizikamilishe, naam, ishara hizi ninazofanya, zinashuhudia kuwa Baba ndiye alinituma.
Ekegusii: Korende oborori inde nabwo nobonene kobua boria bwa Yohana, naki emeremo eria naetwe na Tata inyekoore. Emeremo eyio ngokora, yambereire kirori, ng'a Tata nere ontomete.

English: Because of this, the children of our people besieged the citadel and were alienated from us; but as many of us as they could catch, they killed, and plundered our inheritances.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii, watoto wa watu wetu waliizingira ngome na wakatengwa nasi; lakini wengi wetu kadiri walivyoweza kuwakamata, waliua, na kupora urithi wetu.
Ekegusii: Intwe inki twanyoorete? Bono abanto baminto babeire ababisa baito. Ase ekeene bamoitire kera oyomo oito oyio bakorora na boigo gotoibera chinibo chiaito.

English: the field is the world, the good seeds are the children of the Kingdom, and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.
Kiswahili: Shamba ni ulimwengu na mbegu nzuri ni wana wa Ufalme. Magugu ni wana wa yule mwovu.
Ekegusii: omogondo nense; embusuro eyio engiya nabana b'oborwoti; na amabanchore nabwo abana boria omobe.

English: that I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, and rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, and give glory with Your inheritance.
Kiswahili: ili niweze kufurahia mafanikio ya wateule wako, niweze kushiriki katika furaha ya taifa lako, na kuungana na urithi wako katika kukusifu.
Ekegusii: Erio inyare korora ebisio abanto bao abachore baranyore, na inche inyare kogokera omogooko bw’abaanto bao, naende inyare gwetogia amo n’abanto bare omwando oo.

English: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, “Why do you prophesy, and say, ‘Yahweh says, “Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will take it;
Kiswahili: Basi Sedekia mfalme wa Yuda alikuwa amemfunga huko akisema, “Kwa nini unatabiri hivyo? Wewe unasema, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Ninakaribia kuutia mji huu mkononi mwa mfalme wa Babeli, naye atauteka.
Ekegusii: Zedekia, omorwoti bw'Abayuda, konya omosibire, ogoteeba, “Nase ki okobana kogoteeba ng'a aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: Rora, nkobeeka nde omochie oyo ase okoboko kw'omorwoti o Babiloni, ayoire.

English: He will convey to you a message by which you and all your household will be saved.’
Kiswahili: Yeye atakupa ujumbe ambao kwa huo wewe na wa nyumbani mwako wote mtaokoka.’
Ekegusii: Nere oragoteebie amang’ana ayarakorentere ogotooreka, aye na ab’enyomba yao yonsi.

English: The priests, prostrating themselves before the altar in their priestly garments, and called toward heaven upon him who gave the law concerning deposits, that he should preserve these treasures safe for those who had deposited them.
Kiswahili: Makuhani, wakisujudu mbele ya madhabahu wakiwa wamevaa mavazi yao ya kikuhani, na kumwita mbinguni kwa yule aliyetoa sheria kuhusu amana, kwamba ahifadhi hazina hizi salama kwa wale walioziweka.
Ekegusii: Abakuani bonsi bakabeka chianga chi'obokuani bakagwa inse maumama ase emesa eria y'egesasiimero, bagasaba Nyasae arende enibo eyio, ekiagera nere orwete ogochika nga enibo abanto barure gochia Hekalu erendwe.

English: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus approaching the boat, walking on the sea—and they were terrified.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi walipokuwa wamekwenda mwendo wa karibu maili tatu au nne, walimwona Yesu akitembea juu ya maji akikaribia mashua, nao wakaogopa sana.
Ekegusii: Nabo kabang’usire obwato chimaeli isato gose inye bakarora Yeso ogotaara ase enyancha igoro, ogoika ang’e ase obwato. Erio bakairoka,

English: The house that I am building will be great, for our God is greater than all gods.
Kiswahili: “Hekalu nitakalolijenga litakuwa kubwa, kwa sababu Mungu wetu ni mkuu kuliko miungu mingine yote.
Ekegusii: Enyomba inche ngochia koagacha nigo erabe enene mono, ekiagera Nyasae nomonene goetania chinyasae chinde chionsi.

English: for he is keeping track, inwardly counting the cost. “Eat and drink,” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.
Kiswahili: kwa maana yeye ni aina ya mtu ambaye kila mara anafikiri juu ya gharama. Anakuambia, “Kula na kunywa,” lakini moyo wake hauko pamoja nawe.
Ekegusii: Buna omonto akorengereria ime ase enkoro yaye, naboigo are. Nigo akogotiotereria, “Karie na kanywe!”, Korende enkoro yaye tegwancheti.

English: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.
Kiswahili: Kisha akawakataza wanafunzi wake wasimwambie mtu yeyote kwamba yeye ndiye Kristo.
Ekegusii: Erio akabatianera bokong'u aborokigwa baye ng'a tibateebia onde nere Kristo.

English: He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.
Kiswahili: Mungu amenishambulia na kunirarua katika hasira yake, na kunisagia meno yake; adui yangu hunikazia macho yake makali.
Ekegusii: Omonene obeire nendamwamu ase 'nde, ontandoranire, naende ongechire; oromananirie amaino aye ase 'nde; omochandi one omogoreirie inche amaiso bobe.

English: Never let loving devotion or faithfulness leave you; bind them around your neck, write them on the tablet of your heart.
Kiswahili: Usiache kamwe upendo na uaminifu vitengane nawe; vifunge shingoni mwako, viandike katika ubao wa moyo wako.
Ekegusii: Totiga obuya na ekeene birue ase ore; obisibe ase rigoti ria’o, na obiriike ase enkoro yao.

English: Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning the people of Anathoth who are seeking your life and saying, “You must not prophesy in the name of the LORD, or you will die by our hand.”
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana asemalo kuhusu watu wa Anathothi wale wanaotafuta uhai wako wakisema, ‘Usitoe unabii kwa jina la Bwana, la sivyo utakufa kwa mikono yetu’:
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya nar’Omonene agoteeba igoro y’abanto b’Anatoti, abwo bakorigia kong’ita, bagoteeba ng’a timbaisa kobana ase erieta ri’Omonene, bateba ng’a inse gokora igo nigo barang’ite.

English: He also put to the sword Nob, the city of the priests, with its men and women, children and infants, oxen, donkeys, and sheep.
Kiswahili: Pia akaupiga Nobu kwa upanga, mji wa makuhani, wakiwemo wanaume na wanawake, watoto wadogo na wale wanyonyao, ngʼombe wake, punda na kondoo.
Ekegusii: Boigo Saulo agaita n’omoro Abanto bonsi baarenge agwo Nobu, omochie bw’abakuani. Agaita abasacha, na abakungu, na abana amo nabwo bakogonka, ne chiombe, ne chitigere, ne ching’ondi.

English: And the western border was the coastline of the Great Sea. These are the boundaries around the clans of the descendants of Judah. Caleb’s Portion and Conquest (Judges 1:8–26)
Kiswahili: Mpaka wa magharibi ni pwani ya Bahari Kuu. Hii ndiyo mipaka ya watu wa Yuda kwa koo zao. Nchi Aliyopewa Kalebu (Waamuzi 1:11-15)
Ekegusii: eyarenge orobebe rwa bosongo. Abanto be chiamate chia Yuda nabwo bamenyete ase orogongo orwo. Kalebu okobua Heburoni na Debiri

English: in Jeshua, Moladah, and Beth-pelet;
Kiswahili: katika Yeshua, katika Molada, katika Beth-Peleti,
Ekegusii: abande bakamenya Yesua, na Molada, na Beti-Peleti,

English: But Jephthah asked them, “If you take me back to fight the Ammonites and the LORD gives them to me, will I really be your leader?”
Kiswahili: Yefta akawaambia, “Ikiwa mtanirudisha kwetu kupigana na Waamoni, naye Bwana akanisaidia kuwashinda, Je, ni kweli nitakuwa kiongozi wenu?”
Ekegusii: Yefta agateebia abagaaka baria, “Onye mokong’irania inka naende ’ngende korwania Abaamoni, n’Omonene k arabeeke abanto abwo ase amaboko ane, inche nimbe omotang’ani oino.”

English: Let your conversation be with men of understanding. Let all your discourse be in the law of the Most High.
Kiswahili: Mazungumzo yako yawe na watu wenye ufahamu. Mazungumzo yako yote yawe katika sheria ya Aliye Juu Zaidi.
Ekegusii: Gokogamba, gamba n'abanto bare n'echisemi, n'enkwana yaino ebe igoro y'amachiko a Nyasae.

English: And they said many other blasphemous things against Him. Jesus before the Sanhedrin (Matthew 26:57–68; Mark 14:53–65; John 18:19–24)
Kiswahili: Wakaendelea kumtukana kwa matusi mengi. Yesu Apelekwa Mbele Ya Baraza (Mathayo 26:59-66; Marko 14:55-64; Yohana 18:28-38)
Ekegusii: Bakamokwana bobe amang’ana ande amange ay’okomorama. Yeso ase obosio bw’abakuani abanene (Mat 26:59-66; Mar 14:55-64; Yoh 18:19-24)

English: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.
Kiswahili: Hata kama watoto wake watakuwa wengi kiasi gani, fungu lao ni kuuawa kwa upanga; wazao wake hawatakuwa kamwe na chakula cha kuwatosha.
Ekegusii: Abana b'omokori amabe nabaisa komentekana, nigo bareo ase ogocha goitwa n'omoro, abanto b'ororeria rwaye tibakonyora endagera eisaine.

English: Why do you go about so much to change your ways? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.
Kiswahili: Kwa nini unatangatanga sana, kubadili njia zako? Utakatishwa tamaa na Misri kama ulivyokatishwa na Ashuru.
Ekegusii: Nase ki mokwerosia kobwatia chinchera ching'ao? Inwe mwasookigwe n'Abamisiri buna mwasoogetigwe n'Abaasuri.

English: you shall set apart three cities for yourselves in the middle of your land, which Yahweh your God gives you to possess.
Kiswahili: ndipo mtenge miji mitatu iliyopo katikati ya nchi kwa ajili yenu, katika nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa kuimiliki.
Ekegusii: mwatanane emechie etato ase ense eyi'Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa.

English: “The king of the south will be strong. One of his princes will become stronger than him and have dominion. His dominion will be a great dominion.
Kiswahili: "Mfalme wa kusini atakuwa hodari; mmoja wa wakuu wake atakuwa hodari kuliko yeye, naye atakuwa na mamlaka; mamlaka yake yatakuwa mamlaka kubwa."
Ekegusii: “Omorwoti o Irianyi nabe ne chinguru, korende oyomo bw'abagaambi b'oborwoti bwaye nabe ne chinguru komobua, na oborwoti bwaye mbobe obonene mono.

English: So he came and tried to take the city and to pillage it; and he was not able, because his plan was known to them of the city,
Kiswahili: Basi akaja akajaribu kuuteka mji na kuuteka nyara; lakini hakuweza, kwa sababu mpango wake ulifahamika kwao kuhusu mji huo,
Ekegusii: Antioko agaika Elimaisi, agateema gosakora na koyoira omochie oyio korende tanyaara egekogera konye abamenyi b'omochie oyio bamanyire omoroberio oye,

English: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples' feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamimina maji kwenye sinia na kuanza kuwanawisha wanafunzi wake miguu na kuikausha kwa kile kitambaa alichokuwa amejifunga kiunoni.
Ekegusii: Erio akabeeka amaache ase esani, agachaaka gosibia aborokigwa baye amagoro abo, na koyatinyia negetambaa keria eboyetie.

English: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and the drink offerings of it.
Kiswahili: Weka beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, kwa nyongeza ya kawaida ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na sadaka yake ya nafaka, pamoja na sadaka zao za vinywaji.
Ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng'wanso ki'ebibe. Ebing'wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng'wanso ki'ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, na okoruegwa kw'endagera na okw'ebinyugwa gochiikire amo nabirobio.

English: God brought him out of Egypt with strength like a wild ox, to devour hostile nations and crush their bones, to pierce them with arrows.
Kiswahili: “Mungu alimleta kutoka Misri; yeye ana nguvu kama nyati. Anayararua mataifa yaliyo adui zake, na kuvunja mifupa yao vipande vipande; huwachoma kwa mishale yake.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nere obarentire korwa Misiri, chinguru chiabo nigo chire buna echi’eng’era. Barabwo mbasirie abanto abare mamincha yabo, babune amauga y’emebere y’ababisa babo, na baabarase ne chinsara chiabo.

English: Do not take a pair of millstones or even an upper millstone as security for a debt, because that would be taking one’s livelihood as security.
Kiswahili: Usitoe jozi ya mawe ya kusagia, hata ikiwa lile la juu, kuweka rehani kwa ajili ya deni, kwa sababu itakuwa ni kuweka uhai wa mtu kama dhamana.
Ekegusii: “Onye omonto okoa omonto onde egento singo, taira orogena gose ensio bibe intenenera, ekiagera igo n’obogima bwaye akoira bobe intenenera.

English: So Gideon said to the men of Succoth, “Please give my troops some bread, for they are exhausted, and I am still pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.”
Kiswahili: Akawaambia watu wa Sukothi, “Tafadhali lipatieni jeshi langu mikate, kwa maana wamechoka, nami ningali ninawafuatia Zeba na Salmuna, wafalme wa Midiani.”
Ekegusii: Gidioni agateebia abanto ba Sukoti, “Komoranche moe abanto aba bagontunyana emegati. Barabwo bagoyire, nainche ’nkobwatia inde Seba na Salimuna, abarwoti b’Abamidiani, mbarwanie.”

English: When they heard this, they glorified God. Then they said to Paul, “You see, brother, how many thousands of Jews have believed, and all of them are zealous for the law.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kusikia mambo haya wakamwadhimisha Mungu. Ndipo wakamwambia Paulo, “Ndugu, unaona kulivyo na maelfu ya Wayahudi walioamini, nao wote wana juhudi kwa ajili ya sheria.
Ekegusii: Barabwo, ekero bachia koigwa, bagatogia Nyasae, bakamoteebia: “Oyominto, kwarorire ng’a Abayahudi chilifu chinyinge begenire; na barabwo bonsi nigo bare nomokia ng’a amachiiko abwatwe.

English: Some of the children of Israel, including some of the priests, the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants went up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.
Kiswahili: Pia baadhi ya Waisraeli, wakiwemo makuhani, Walawi, waimbaji, mabawabu na watumishi wa Hekalu, nao walikuja Yerusalemu mwaka wa saba wa utawala wa Mfalme Artashasta.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatano na kabere bw'okogamba kw'Aritasasita omorwoti, abande b'Abaisraeli, na abakuani, na Abalawi, na abateri, na abarendi b'ebiita, na abakori emeremo be Hekalu, bakagenda Yerusalemu.

English: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,
Kiswahili: Watu walikuwa na matazamio makubwa. Wakawa wanajiuliza mioyoni mwao iwapo Yohana angeweza kuwa ndiye Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto baganyete na konakorengereria, bonsi bakeboria ase chinkoro chiabo ime gose Yohana nere Kristo.

English: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.
Kiswahili: Alipoona jambo hilo limewapendeza Wayahudi, akaendelea, akamkamata pia Petro. Hii ilitokea wakati wa Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu.
Ekegusii: Ekero aroche ng'a aya agweneire Abayahudi, akagenderera, Petero nere akabwatwa. Amatuko ayio naro amatuko emegati etabekiri memera.

English: The discourse of a godly man is always wise, but the fool changes like the moon.
Kiswahili: Mazungumzo ya mtu mcha Mungu huwa na hekima sikuzote, lakini mpumbavu hubadilika kama mwezi.
Ekegusii: Chinkwana chi'abaanto bamoirogete Omonene nigo chire nobong'aini botambe, korende abariri nigo bakoonchoka buna omotienyi.

English: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo, wengi wataacha imani yao, nao watasalitiana kila mmoja na mwenzake na kuchukiana.
Ekegusii: Na ekero ekio abanto abange inabagwe korwa ase okwegena kwabo, inabasigaanane na kobeekana ase ababisa babo, naende nabagechane,

English: As they set out, a terror from God fell over the surrounding cities, so that they did not pursue Jacob’s sons.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakaondoka, na hofu ya Mungu ikawapata miji yote iliyowazunguka. Kwa hiyo hakuna aliyewafuatia wana wa Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Ekero baimogete kogenda orogendo rwabo, okoondokia gokarua ase Nyasae, gokabwata abanto b’emechie eria yabaetanaine; Ase igo tibanyara komonyookia basinto ba Yakobo.

English: and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
Kiswahili: Naye alitawala katika Mlima Hermoni, Saleka, Bashani yote hadi mpaka wa watu wa Geshuri, na watu wa Maaka na nusu ya Gileadi, hadi kwenye mpaka wa Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni.
Ekegusii: akaba okogamba ase egetunwa kia Herimoni, na ase Saleka, na ase Basani engima goika orobebe rw'Abagesuri na Abamaaka, amo nekeng'ese kende kia Gileadi goika orogongo rwa Sihoni, omorwoti o Hesiboni.

English: Buy the truth, and don't sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.
Kiswahili: Nunua kweli wala usiiuze, pata hekima, adabu na ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Gora ekeene, na tobaisa gokeoonia; boigo gora obong'aini, na amorokererio, na obomanyi.

English: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ninyi ni watoto wa Mungu, Mungu amemtuma Roho wa Mwanawe mioyoni mwetu, anayelia, “Abba, Baba.”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera inwe more abana baye, Nyasae agatoma Omoika bw'Omwana oye ase chinkoro chiaito, okorera, “Abba!” Engencho yaye “Tata!”

English: For Israel is not forsaken, nor Judah, by his God, by Yahweh of Armies; though their land is full of guilt against the Holy One of Israel.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Israeli na Yuda hawajaachwa na Mungu wao, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, ingawa nchi yao imejaa uovu mbele zake yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, Omonene bw'Emeganda, tatigeti Abaisraeli na Abayuda, nonya ense yabo yabeire nebibe ebinge ase Nyasae ore omochenu bw'Abaisraeli.

English: In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth day of the month—in the fourteenth year after Jerusalem had been struck down—on that very day the hand of the LORD was upon me, and He took me there.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa ishirini na tano wa uhamisho wetu, mwanzoni mwa huo mwaka, siku ya kumi ya mwezi, katika mwaka wa kumi na nne baada ya kuanguka kwa mji, siku hiyo hiyo mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa juu yangu, naye akanipeleka huko.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo ebere, na etano, bw’okong’anyigwa gwaito, ase omochakano bw’omwaka, ase rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi, ase omwaka o ikomi na kane magega omochie kobuirwe, ee, ase rituko riria riria okoboko kw’Omonene gokaba igoro y’ane gokang’ira aaria.

English: He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.
Kiswahili: Yeye ndiye atakayejenga nyumba kwa ajili yangu, nami nitakifanya imara kiti cha ufalme wake milele.
Ekegusii: Oyio nere orang'agachere enyomba; nainche ninkong'ie ekerogo kiaye ki'oborwoti kebeo kogenderera botambe.

English: Saul said nothing that day because he thought, “Something has happened to David to make him ceremonially unclean—surely he is unclean.”
Kiswahili: Sauli hakusema chochote siku ile kwa kuwa alifikiri, “Kuna kitu cha lazima kimetokea kwa Daudi ambacho kimemfanya najisi asihudhurie karamuni, hakika yeye yu najisi.”
Ekegusii: Saulo takwanete gento kende ase rituko riria, ekiagera nigo arengereretie ng’a ring’ana gete riamonyorire Daudi; ande tagachenegeti.

English: “What are these, my lord?” I asked the angel who was speaking with me.
Kiswahili: Nikamuuliza malaika aliyezungumza nami, “Hivi ni vitu gani, bwana wangu?”
Ekegusii: Erio nkaboria omomalaika oria okwanete nainche, “Omonene one, ninki engencho y’ebinto ebi?”

English: For this, clothe yourself with sackcloth, lament and wail; for the fierce anger of Yahweh hasn't turned back from us.
Kiswahili: Hivyo vaeni nguo za magunia, ombolezeni na kulia kwa huzuni, kwa kuwa hasira kali ya Bwana haijaondolewa kwetu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, eboyie chigunia, morere na kweng'ereria, ekiagera endamwamu enene y'Omonene nigo ere ase tore, teraonchoka etotige.

English: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you!
Kiswahili: Sasa tayari mnayo yale yote mnayohitaji! Tayari mmekwisha kuwa matajiri! Mmekuwa wafalme, tena bila sisi! Laiti mngekuwa wafalme kweli ili na sisi tupate kuwa wafalme pamoja nanyi!
Ekegusii: Mwaikire koigota! Mwaikire konyora obotenenku! Mwanyorire oborwoti intwe totaiyo! Anga mbuya onye mwagambete, erinde naintwe togambe amo nainwe!

English: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye than for a rich man to enter into God's Kingdom.”
Kiswahili: Tena nawaambia, ni rahisi zaidi kwa ngamia kupita kwenye tundu la sindano kuliko mtu tajiri kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Naende nabateebirie inwe, naororo engamia goeta ase ekebao gi'esindani, kobua omonto omonda gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”

English: Yahweh said, “Judah shall go up. Behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akajibu, “Yuda ndiye atakayetangulia; nimewapa hiyo nchi mikononi mwao.”
Ekegusii: Omonene akabairaneria, “Abayuda 'mbabe ab'eritang'ani kogeenda; rora, nayebeekire ense eria ase amaboko abo.”

English: About ten days later, the LORD struck Nabal dead. David Marries Abigail
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku kumi, Bwana akampiga Nabali, naye akafa.
Ekegusii: Naende magega y’amatuko ikomi kaerire Omonene agaaka Nabali, na ere agakwa.

English: Woe to those who call evil good and good evil, who turn darkness to light and light to darkness, who replace bitter with sweet and sweet with bitter.
Kiswahili: Ole wao wanaoita ubaya ni wema, na wema ni ubaya, wawekao giza badala ya nuru, na nuru badala ya giza, wawekao uchungu badala ya utamu, na utamu badala ya uchungu.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bakoroka ayare amabe amaya, na ayare amaya amabe, na babeeka omosunte ase oborabu bore, na oborabu ase omosunte ore, na babeeka obororo ribaga ri’obwansu, na obwansu ribaga ri’obororo.

English: How long will you lie there, O slacker? When will you get up from your sleep?
Kiswahili: Ewe mvivu, utalala hata lini? Utaamka lini kutoka usingizi wako?
Ekegusii: Aye omworo, ’ngoika ririri oragenderere korara? Ndiriri orabooke korwa ase chitoro chiao?

English: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,
Kiswahili: Hivyo nawaambia hivi, nami nasisitiza katika Bwana kwamba, msiishi tena kama watu wa Mataifa waishivyo, katika ubatili wa mawazo yao.
Ekegusii: Bono 'ngokwana nde ring'ana eri, na koba kirori ase Omonene; korwa bono timogeenda buna abanto b'Ebisaku bakogeenda ase ebirengorerio biabo bitari nengeencho.

English: Now, brothers, we want you to know about the grace that God has given the churches of Macedonia.
Kiswahili: Basi sasa ndugu, nataka ninyi mjue kuhusu ile neema ambayo Mungu amewapa makanisa ya Makedonia.
Ekegusii: Bono nkobamanyia tore inwe abaminto amang’ana y’obuya bwa Nyasae, obo chikanisa chia Makedonia chiaetwe.

English: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”
Kiswahili: Yeye si Mungu wa wafu, bali wa walio hai, kwa kuwa kwake wote ni hai.”
Ekegusii: Nabo ere tari Nyasae bw'abakuure, korende Nyasae bw'abare moyo, ekiagera bonsi nigo bare moyo asare.”

English: Above the expanse over their heads was the likeness of a throne with the appearance of sapphire, and on the throne high above was a figure like that of a man.
Kiswahili: Juu ya ile nafasi ya wazi iliyokuwa juu ya vichwa vyao kulikuwa na kitu mfano wa kiti cha enzi cha yakuti samawi. Na juu ya kile kiti cha enzi kulikuwa na umbo mfano wa mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Igoro y’eaanga eria yarenge igoro y’emetwe yabo norengeo omogwekano bw’ekerogo ki’obonene keroisirie korwa ase esafiro. Ase omogwekano oria bw’ekerogo ki’obonene naikaranseteo oyomo ekieni kiaye kiarenge buna eki’omonto.

English: Remember, O LORD, what has happened to us. Look and see our disgrace!
Kiswahili: Kumbuka, Ee Bwana, yaliyotupata, tazama, nawe uione aibu yetu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyora aya atonyorire, origererie orore ogochaywa gwaito.

English: From that day forward the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia siku ile na kuendelea nyumba ya Israeli itajua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana, Mungu wao.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio na kogenderera botambe, Abaisraeli mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae obo.

English: He said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” I answered, “Lord Yahweh, you know.”
Kiswahili: Akaniuliza, “Mwanadamu, mifupa hii yaweza kuishi?” Nikajibu, “Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, wewe peke yako wajua.”
Ekegusii: Erio akamboria, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, amauga aya nanyare koba moyo?” Nkairaneria, nkamoteebia: “Aye Omonene, naye omanyete.”

English: As he stayed there many days, Festus laid Paul's case before the king, saying, “There is a certain man left a prisoner by Felix;
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa walikuwa wakae huko Kaisaria kwa siku nyingi, Festo alijadili shauri la Paulo na mfalme, akisema, “Kuna mtu mmoja hapa ambaye Feliksi alimwacha gerezani.
Ekegusii: Na ekero baikaransire aroro amatuko amange, Festo agateebia omorwoti amang'ana igoro ya Paulo, agateeba: “Nare aa omonto oyomo omosibwa, otigetwe na Feliki.

English: On the first day you are to hold a sacred assembly; you are not to do any regular work.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya kwanza, mtakuwa na kusanyiko takatifu, na msifanye kazi zenu za kawaida.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima, na timobaisa gokora emeremo ya kera rituko,

English: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it;
Kiswahili: Walipewa Hebroni katika nchi ya Yuda pamoja na sehemu ya malisho inayouzunguka.
Ekegusii: ase igo bakaegwa Heburoni amo namarisio aetanaineo, agwo ase ense ya Yuda.

English: They said to him, “We neither received letters from Judea concerning you, nor did any of the brothers come here and report or speak any evil of you.
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Hatujapokea barua zozote kutoka Uyahudi zinazokuhusu, wala hapana ndugu yeyote aliyekuja hapa ambaye ametoa taarifa au kuzungumza jambo lolote baya juu yako.
Ekegusii: Baria bakamoteebia: “Intwe titwana konyora amarube ande agokwana amang'ana igoro yao korwa Boyahudi, gose onde ominto tari nonya noyomo oikire aiga na gototeebia amang'ana, gose okwanire ring'ana riibe igoro yao.

English: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”
Kiswahili: na kumtia mikononi mwa watu wa Mataifa ili wamdhihaki na kumpiga mijeledi na kumsulubisha msalabani. Naye atafufuliwa siku ya tatu!”
Ekegusii: naende nabamorue ase amaboko y' abanto b'Ebisaku; nakorerwe echeche, naende naakwe emecharichi na kobambwa; na ase rituko ria gatato nabokigwe.”

English: Pray that the LORD your God will tell us the way we should walk and the thing we should do.”
Kiswahili: Omba ili Bwana Mungu wako atuambie twende wapi na tufanye nini.”
Ekegusii: Otosabere ase Omonene, Nyasae oo, atworokie enchera togwenerete kobwatia, na eki togwenerete gokora.”

English: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,
Kiswahili: Seraya, Azaria, Yeremia,
Ekegusii: Seraya, na Asaria, na Yeremia;

English: I said to the LORD, “You are my Lord; apart from You I have no good thing.”
Kiswahili: Nilimwambia Bwana, “Wewe ndiwe Bwana wangu; pasipo wewe sina jambo jema.”
Ekegusii: Nigo ngoteebia Omonene iga: “Aye naye Omonene one, obuya bwonsi ’nde nabwo nigo bokorwa asore.”

English: O come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.
Kiswahili: Njooni, tusujudu, tumwabudu, tupige magoti mbele za Bwana Muumba wetu,
Ekegusii: Inchuo, twekumbe ase obosio bw’Omonene, totung’ame asare, ekiagera nere ototongete.

English: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;' and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.'
Kiswahili: Kwa mfano, Mose alisema, ‘Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako,' na, ‘Yeyote amtukanaye baba yake au mama yake, na auawe.'
Ekegusii: Inaki Musa nigo ateebete: Sika iso na nyoko, na: Oyorakwane bobe ase ise, gose ase ng'ina, ogokwa nakwe.

English: You will keep whoever's mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
Kiswahili: Utamlinda katika amani kamilifu yeye ambaye moyo wake ni thabiti kwa sababu anakutumaini wewe.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore nebirengererio ebironge asore, aye Omonene nigo okomoa omorembe omoikeranu, ekiagera agosemeretie.

English: Luxury is unseemly for a fool— how much worse for a slave to rule over princes!
Kiswahili: Haistahili mpumbavu kuishi katika anasa, itakuwa vibaya kiasi gani kwa mtumwa kuwatawala wakuu.
Ekegusii: Tari buya omonto omoriri amenye ase obogima bw’okwegokia; onye ere bo, tari buya nonya ng’ake ng’a omosomba agaambere abagaambi.

English: At this, King Nebuchadnezzar fell on his face, paid homage to Daniel, and ordered that an offering of incense be presented to him.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mfalme Nebukadneza akaanguka kifudifudi mbele ya Danieli kumpa heshima, akaagiza wamtolee Danieli sadaka na uvumba.
Ekegusii: Erio Nebukadinesaro omorwoti akagwa inse maumama, akaorokia amasikani ase Danieli, agachiika ng’a ekeng’wanso na ubani biruegwe ase Danieli.

English: The time we spent traveling from Kadesh-barnea until we crossed over the Brook of Zered was thirty-eight years, until that entire generation of fighting men had perished from the camp, as the LORD had sworn to them.
Kiswahili: Miaka thelathini na minane ilipita tangu wakati tulipoondoka Kadesh-Barnea mpaka tulipovuka Bonde la Zeredi. Kwa wakati huo kile kizazi chote cha wanaume kuanzia wale wawezao kwenda vitani kilikuwa kimekufa, kama Bwana alivyokuwa amewaapia.
Ekegusii: Korwa engaki twarwete Kadeshi‐Barinea goika ekero twambogete akarooche ga Seredi nigo yarenge emiaka emerongo etato, na etano na etato (38). Abanto bonsi b’ekegori keria, abamanyete korwana esegi, bagakwa bakaera, buna Omonene konya atianire.

English: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”
Kiswahili: Katika kizazi cha nne wazao wako watarudi hapa, kwa maana dhambi ya Waamori bado haijafikia kipimo kilichojaa.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagoika ase ekiaare gia kane inabairane gocha aa, ekiagera obobe bw'Abaamori tiboraikerana goika bono.”

English: There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:
Kiswahili: Huko ndiko Abrahamu na Sara mkewe walikozikwa, huko akazikwa Isaki na Rebeka mkewe, na huko nilimzika Lea.
Ekegusii: Agwo nao Aburaamu atindegetwe ase Sara mokaye ensemo; agwo nao Isaka na Rebeka mokaye batindegetwe, na agwo inche omonyene natindegete Lea.

English: Then Yahweh said to Isaiah, “Go out now to meet Ahaz, you, and Shearjashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the fuller's field.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Isaya, “Toka uende, wewe na mwanao Shear-Yashubu, mkutane na Ahazi huko mwisho wa mfereji wa Bwawa la Juu, kwenye barabara iendayo Shamba la Dobi.
Ekegusii: Eri'Omonene agateebia Isaya: “Genda amo na Seari‐Yasuba, momura oo, morotote Ahasi agwo ase omotaro bw'amaache e ritibo ria rogoro ase enchera ekogenda egetii ki'omosibia ebitambaa bikoroisigwa chianga,

English: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, along with the might he exercised and how he waged war, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
Kiswahili: Kwa habari ya matukio mengine ya utawala wa Yehoshafati, mafanikio aliyokuwa nayo na uhodari wake katika vita, je, hayakuandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Yuda?
Ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi Yehosafati akorete, na okobua kwaye aorogetie, naende buna arwanete chiseegi, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki’ogokora kw’Abarwoti b’Abayuda.

English: I pray for them. I don't pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.
Kiswahili: Ninawaombea wao. Mimi siuombei ulimwengu, bali nawaombea wale ulionipa kwa sababu wao ni wako.
Ekegusii: Inche nabasabeire barabwo; tindi gosabera ense, korende barabwo aba kwang'eire ekiagera barabwo nabao.

English: When you reap the harvest of your land, you are not to reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Wakati uvunapo mavuno ya nchi yako, usivune hadi kwenye mipaka ya shamba lako, wala usikusanye mabaki ya mavuno yako.
Ekegusii: “Ekero mokogesa emegondo yaino, timogesa moikie ase chingito kegima, gose timoirana gochora ebitigari ase emegondo.

English: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.
Kiswahili: Lakini mwenye mnyama akiwa angalipo na mnyama wake, mwazimaji hatalazimika kumlipa. Kama mnyama alikuwa amekodishwa, fedha iliyolipwa kwa kukodisha inatosha kwa kufidia hasara.
Ekegusii: Korende onye ise omoiseke okwanga, tamomoa, omonto oyio goika aakane chitaabu chireng'aine rigori ri'omoiseke omwekungi.

English: You have increased your merchants more than the stars of the skies. The grasshopper strips and flees away.
Kiswahili: Umeongeza idadi ya wafanyabiashara wako mpaka wamekuwa wengi kuliko nyota za angani, lakini kama nzige wanaacha nchi tupu kisha huruka na kwenda zake.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo kwaiborete abaonchoreria abange kobwa ching'enang'eni chire ase erioba! Korende bono bachiire, buna chingige chikorambora chimbaba chiabo chiairuruka chiagenda.

English: For the more words, the more futility—and how does that profit anyone?
Kiswahili: Maneno yanavyokuwa mengi, ndivyo yanavyokosa maana, Je, hilo linamfaidia vipi yeyote?
Ekegusii: Ogokwana okonge nigo gokorenta amang’ana amange are bosa. Inee! Ayio mbuya ki akorenta ase Mwanyabaanto?

English: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu wangu uniokoe kutoka kwenye mkono wa mwovu, kutoka kwenye makucha ya watu wabaya na wakatili.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, ntoorie korwa ase okoboko kw'omokori amabe, indusie korwa ase okobua kw'oyo otari omooronge, na oyore omotindi.

English: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,
Kiswahili: Sanduku la Ushuhuda pamoja na mipiko yake na kiti cha rehema,
Ekegusii: na Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, amo nemiaro yaye, na ekerogo kia amaabera,

English: For Adam was formed first, and then Eve.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Adamu aliumbwa kwanza, kisha Eva.
Ekegusii: ekiagera Adamu nere otongetwe ritang’ani, na magega yaye Hawa.

English: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.
Kiswahili: Ikawa jioni, ikawa asubuhi, siku ya tano.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bogakia mambia, rituko ria gatano.

English: For they prophesy to you a lie that will serve to remove you from your land; I will banish you and you will perish.
Kiswahili: Wanawatabiria uongo ambao utawafanya ninyi mhamishwe mbali kutoka nchi yenu. Nitawafukuzia mbali, nanyi mtaangamia.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakobang’aina na bagere moirwe ase ense y’aare; inche nimbaserie morue aiga mochie gosira.

English: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the Tent, and anointed Solomon. They blew the trumpet; and all the people said, “Long live King Solomon!”
Kiswahili: Kuhani Sadoki akachukua pembe ya mafuta kutoka kwenye hema takatifu na kumtia Solomoni mafuta. Kisha wakapiga tarumbeta na watu wote wakapaza sauti wakisema, “Mfalme Solomoni aishi maisha marefu!”
Ekegusii: Aroro agwo Zadoki Omokuani akabogoria orogunchara rw'amaguta korwa ase Eema y'Omosangererekano, agaaka Sulemani amaguta ayio ase okomwatanana. Erio bakabugia egetureeri, na abanto bonsi bagateeba: “Omorwoti Sulemani ochie kare!”

English: When Elisha reached the house, there was the boy lying dead on his bed.
Kiswahili: Elisha alipofika kwenye ile nyumba, mtoto alikuwa amelala juu ya kitanda chake angali amekufa.
Ekegusii: Ekero Elisha asoete nyomba, akarora omwana bwareirie igoro ase oborere bwaye okwete.

English: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.
Kiswahili: Mtu mvivu hutumbukiza mkono wake kwenye sahani, naye huchoka kuupeleka kwenye kinywa chake.
Ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo akobeeka okoboko kwaye ase esani y'endagera, orosa gokobogoria gocha ase omonwa oye.

English: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.
Kiswahili: Watu wengine wawili wahalifu, walipelekwa pamoja na Yesu ili wakasulubiwe.
Ekegusii: Abande babere abasaria bakairwa, baitwe amo nere.

English: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Merari: kutoka kwa Yaazia: ni Beno, Shohamu, Zakuri na Ibri.
Ekegusii: Abanto b'ororeria rwa Merari ase Yaasia, omwana oye omomura, nabwo aba: Beno na Sohamu, Sakuri na Ibiri.

English: If anyone from the house of Israel or a foreigner living among them eats any blood, I will set My face against that person and cut him off from among his people.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Mwisraeli yeyote au mgeni anayeishi miongoni mwao ambaye atakunywa damu yoyote, nitakuwa kinyume cha mtu huyo atakayekunywa damu na kumkatilia mbali na watu wake.
Ekegusii: “Onde bwensi ase Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, oraarie amanyinga ande onsi, inche Omonene nimbe mamincha y’omonto oyio, na inche nimwatanane korwa ase abanto baye.

English: So I will cause my wrath toward you to rest, and my jealousy will depart from you. I will be quiet, and will not be angry any more.
Kiswahili: Ndipo ghadhabu yangu dhidi yako itakapopungua na wivu wa hasira yangu utaondoka kwako. Nitatulia wala sitakasirika tena.
Ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio ning'isanekie endamwamu y'ane ase ore, ne risemi riane ndirue ase ore, erio nario ndabe n'obotoereru, gose tinkogechigwa naende.

English: Behold, David's servants and Joab came from a raid and brought in a great plunder with them; but Abner was not with David in Hebron, for he had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo, watu wa Daudi na Yoabu walirudi kutoka kwenye kushambulia, nao wakarudi na nyara nyingi mno. Lakini Abneri hakuwa tena pamoja na Daudi huko Hebroni, kwa sababu Daudi alikuwa amemruhusu aende zake, naye akaenda kwa amani.
Ekegusii: Kobachiire, Yoabu agacha korwa ase achiete gosakora amo nabasomba ba Daudi, nabarabwo mbabwate ebisakorwa ebinge. Korende Abineri konya ochiire, tarenge amo na Daudi agwo Heburoni, ekiagera Daudi konya omoeire ribaga, nere ogendire nomorembe.

English: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,
Kiswahili: Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo mwenyewe na Mungu Baba yetu, aliyetupenda na kwa neema yake akatupatia faraja ya milele na tumaini jema,
Ekegusii: Bono Omonene oito Yeso Kristo omonyene, na Nyasae Tata oito, oyotwanchete na otoete okoremia gwa kare na kare, na ogosemeria okuya ase obuya bwaye,

English: Of the sons of Pahathmoab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Pahath-Moabu: Adna, Kelali, Benaya, Maaseya, Matania, Bezaleli, Binui na Manase.
Ekegusii: abeamate ya Pahati‐Moabu: Adina na Kelali, Benaya na Maaseya, Matania na Besaleli, Binui na Manase;

English: If these people go up to offer sacrifices in the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, their hearts will return to their lord, Rehoboam king of Judah; then they will kill me and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.”
Kiswahili: Kama watu hawa watapanda kwenda kutoa dhabihu katika Hekalu la Bwana huko Yerusalemu, mioyo yao itamrudia bwana wao, Rehoboamu mfalme wa Yuda. Wataniua mimi na kurudi kwa Mfalme Rehoboamu.”
Ekegusii: Abanto aba baise kona kogenda korua ebing’wanso ase enyomba y’Omonene agwo Yerusalemu, chinkoro chiabo nigo chiramoiranere omonene obo Rehoboamu, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, na kobaramoiranere nigo barang’ite.”

English: Shall I wait, because they don't speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?
Kiswahili: Je, ningoje sasa kwa sababu wamekuwa kimya, kwa vile sasa wanasimama bila kuwa na la kujibu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nainche nigo nkogenderera koganya, ekiagera tibari gokwana, na ekiagera bateneine agwo batari koiraneria?

English: Defend the cause of the weak and fatherless; uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed.
Kiswahili: Teteeni wanyonge na yatima, tunzeni haki za maskini na walioonewa.
Ekegusii: Kae abataka ne chintakana oboronge bwabo; boigo nabwo bagokorerwa bobe, na abaremeire.

English: Meat that touches anything unclean must not be eaten; it is to be burned up. As for any other meat, anyone who is ceremonially clean may eat it.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Nyama ile inayogusa chochote ambacho ni najisi kwa kawaida ya ibada kamwe haitaliwa, ni lazima iteketezwe kwa moto. Kuhusu nyama nyingine, mtu yeyote aliye safi kwa kawaida ya ibada anaweza kuila.
Ekegusii: Enyama eyio keraakune gento kende gionsi getachenegeti esambwe n’omorero, eyie eere. “Onye enyama echenegete, kera omonto ochenekire nare ne ribaga ri’okoyeria,

English: Then he brought me into the outer court, and there were chambers and a pavement laid out all around the court. Thirty chambers faced the pavement,
Kiswahili: Kisha akanileta katika ukumbi wa nje. Huko nikaona vyumba vingine pamoja na njia iliyokuwa imejengwa kuzunguka ukumbi wote, kulikuwa na vyumba thelathini vimepangana kando ya hiyo njia.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria akang’ira goika ase eraaro ya isiko yatichire inse namagena ase chinsemo chionsi, na aroro agwo ’nkarora ebinyomba emerongo etato biaagachire igoro y’amagena ayio.

English: They did so, and made them all sit down.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wakafanya hivyo, wakawaketisha wote.
Ekegusii: Bagakora boigo, bakabaikaransia bonsi.

English: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?
Kiswahili: Je, hutaacha kamwe kunitazama, au kuniacha japo kwa kitambo kidogo tu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nengaki eng'ana naki ogochia koba gokona‐kondigereria? Naki otagontiga, erinde inyore obosibore imere amate?

English: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me free, because there was no cause of death in me.
Kiswahili: Wao walipokwisha kunihoji, wakataka kuniachia huru kwa sababu hawakuona kosa lolote nililolifanya linalostahili adhabu ya kifo.
Ekegusii: Ekero bakoorire komboria bakarigia gonsibora, ekiagera tibanyorete engencho ende yonsi yangwenerete ng'itwe.

English: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up Yahweh's ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.
Kiswahili: Daudi akawakusanya Israeli wote huko Yerusalemu ili kulipandisha Sanduku la Bwana na kulileta hadi kwenye sehemu aliyokuwa ametengeneza kwa ajili yake.
Ekegusii: Daudi agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi agwo Yerusalemu gochia korenta Esanduki eria y'Omonene gocha aase aye ayeroiseretie.

English: But the free gift isn't like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.
Kiswahili: Lakini ile karama iliyotolewa haikuwa kama lile kosa. Kwa maana ikiwa watu wengi walikufa kwa sababu ya kosa la mtu mmoja, zaidi sana neema ya Mungu na ile karama iliyokuja kwa neema ya mtu mmoja, yaani, Yesu Kristo, imezidi kuwa nyingi kwa ajili ya wengi.
Ekegusii: Korende ekeegwa keria ki'amaabera tikeri buna ogosaria koria. Inaki ase ogosaria kw'omonto oyomo abange bagakwa, korende amaabera a Nyasae na ekeegwa eke ki'amaabera biamentekire kobua mono ase abange ase omonto oyomo Yeso Kristo.

English: As silver is melted in a furnace, so you will be melted within the city. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have poured out My wrath upon you.’” Israel’s Wicked Leaders
Kiswahili: Kama fedha iyeyukavyo kalibuni, ndivyo mtakavyoyeyuka ndani ya huo mji, nanyi mtajua kuwa Mimi Bwana nimemwaga ghadhabu yangu juu yenu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Buna efeta ekonyititorwa ase eriko ri’omorero naboigo nainwe moranyititorwe ase egati‐gati y’omochie oyio; erio momanye ng’a ninche Omonene naumoire endamwamu y’ane igoro ase more.” Ebibe bi’abaraai b’Abaisraeli

English: And the LORD will remove from you all sickness. He will not lay upon you any of the terrible diseases you knew in Egypt, but He will inflict them on all who hate you.
Kiswahili: Bwana atawakinga na kila ugonjwa. Mungu hatatia juu yenu ugonjwa wowote mbaya mlioufahamu huko Misri, lakini atatia ugonjwa juu ya wale wote wanaokuchukia.
Ekegusii: Omonene narusie amarwaire onsi korwa ase more; nonya nobomo bw’amarwaire aria amabe arenge Misiri, aria ase mwamenyete, tagoocha igoro ase more kobachaanda, korende nigo arayarente ase abanto baria bonsi babageechete.

English: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.
Kiswahili: “Nilisema, ‘Ninyi ni “miungu”; ninyi nyote ni wana wa Aliye Juu Sana.'
Ekegusii: Natebiire ng'a: “Inwe nechinyasae; inwe mwensi nabana b'Omonene Ore Igoro Mono.

English: The LORD our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wetu alifanya Agano nasi katika mlima wa Horebu.
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oito, nakorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania amo naintwe agwo Horebu.

English: and all the people of the land rejoiced. And the city was quiet, because Athaliah had been put to the sword at the royal palace.
Kiswahili: nao watu wote wa nchi wakafurahi. Mji ukatulia, kwa sababu Athalia alikuwa ameuawa kwa upanga nyumbani kwa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’ense eria bakaba nomochengo; na omochie okaba omotoereru, ekiagera Atalia aitirwe n’omoro, agwo ase enyomba y’omorwoti.

English: He who gives glory to his father will have length of days. He who listens to the Lord will bring rest to his mother,
Kiswahili: Amtukuzaye baba yake atakuwa na siku nyingi, naye amsikilizaye Bwana atamstarehesha mama yake,
Ekegusii: Mwana onde bwensi osigete ise na komogokia ng'ina oyio namenye obogima obotambe.

English: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.
Kiswahili: Zekaria alipomwona huyo malaika, akafadhaika sana, akajawa na hofu.
Ekegusii: Ere agaichana gachia komorora, na omoondoko okamobwata.

English: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,
Kiswahili: Yesu alipoondoka huko, walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo wakaanza kumpinga vikali na kumsonga kwa maswali,
Ekegusii: Agachia gosoka korwa aroro, aborokia b'amariiko na Abafarisai bagachaaka komomiga namaborio amakong'u, na komochegia akwane igoro y'ebinto ebinge;

English: I am bringing My righteousness near; it is not far away, and My salvation will not be delayed. I will grant salvation to Zion and adorn Israel with My splendor.
Kiswahili: Ninaleta haki yangu karibu, haiko mbali; wala wokovu wangu hautachelewa. Nitawapa Sayuni wokovu, Israeli utukufu wangu.
Ekegusii: Narentire oboronge bwane ang’e, tibori aare, na ogotooreka kwane tikogoteebana; nimbeeke ogotooreka ase Sayoni; ning’ee Abaisraeli obonene bwane.”

English: and she replies, ‘Drink, and I will draw water for your camels as well,’ may she be the woman the LORD has appointed for my master’s son.
Kiswahili: naye kama akiniambia, “Kunywa, nami nitateka maji kwa ajili ya ngamia wako pia,” basi huyo awe ndiye mke ambaye Bwana amemchagulia mwana wa bwana wangu.’
Ekegusii: Onye ere okong’iraneria: Ee, kanywe, na nimbuuchere chingamia chiao nachirochio; otige oyio abe nere omokungu Omonene achoreire omwana bw’omonene one.”

English: So Gad came to David, and told him, saying, “Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? Or will you flee three months before your foes while they pursue you? Or shall there be three days' pestilence in your land? Now answer, and consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.”
Kiswahili: Basi Gadi akaenda kwa Daudi na kumwambia, “Je, ije njaa ya miaka mitatu katika nchi yako? Au miezi mitatu ya kukimbia adui zako wakikufuatia? Au siku tatu za tauni katika nchi yako? Basi sasa, fikiri juu ya hilo na uamue jinsi nitakavyomjibu huyo aliyenituma.”
Ekegusii: Erio Gadi akageenda ase Daudi, akamomanyia amang'ana ayio, akamoteebia, “Nigo origetie enchara eche ase ense yao emiaka etato? Gose nigo origetie otame korwa ase ababisa bao emetienyi etato? Gose nigo origetie oborwaire obobe bw'ogoita abanto bosoe ense yao amatuko atato? Bono rengereria mono na ong'e amairanerio imoirere oyio ontomete.”

English: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo simameni imara mkiwa mmejifunga kweli kiunoni na kuvaa dirii ya haki kifuani,
Ekegusii: Tenena gaaki, mweboyie ebinema biaino nekeene, na kobeeka oboronge buna engobo y'ekioma ase ebikuba biaino,

English: The children of Israel and Judah, who lived in the cities of Judah, also brought in the tithe of cattle and sheep, and the tithe of dedicated things which were consecrated to Yahweh their God, and laid them in heaps.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Israeli na Yuda walioishi katika miji ya Yuda wakaleta pia fungu la kumi la makundi yao ya ngʼombe na makundi ya kondoo na mbuzi pia na fungu la kumi la vitu vitakatifu vilivyowekwa wakfu kwa ajili ya Bwana Mungu wao na kuvikusanya katika malundo.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli na Abayuda, baria bamenyete ase emechie y'Abayuda, bakarenta ensemo ya ikomi ye chiombe na eye ching'ondi, ebinto baatananete ase Omonene, Nyasae obo; ebio bakabibeka amo, bikaba ebinge.

English: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”
Kiswahili: Lakini, ili mpate kujua kwamba Mwana wa Adamu anayo mamlaka duniani kusamehe dhambi…” Ndipo akamwambia yule aliyepooza, “Inuka, chukua mkeka wako, uende nyumbani kwako.”
Ekegusii: Korende monyare komanya ng'a Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nare nokobua ase ense gw'okwabera ebibe.” Erio agwo agateebia oria orenge rigata, “Imoka, bwetweke egeseero ki'ao, ogende bwoo.”

English: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”
Kiswahili: Inua mkuki wako na fumo lako dhidi ya hao wanaonifuatia. Iambie nafsi yangu, “Mimi ni wokovu wako.”
Ekegusii: Aye orute abanto abwo bakombwatia ritimo na esimisi! Ontebie ase omoyo one: “Ninche Omotooria oo.”

English: Therefore the LORD who redeemed Abraham says of the house of Jacob: “No longer will Jacob be ashamed and no more will his face grow pale.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana, aliyemkomboa Abrahamu, analosema kwa nyumba ya Yakobo: “Yakobo hataaibishwa tena, wala nyuso zao hazitabadilika sura tena.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene, oria obooretie Aburaamu, okwanire amang’ana aya igoro y’ororeeria rwa Yakobo, “Abanto ba Yakobo tibakogenderera koba nobosooku; amasio abo takoirura nonya ng’ake naende.

English: In the fifth year of the reign of Joram son of Ahab over Israel, Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat succeeded his father as king of Judah.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa tano wa Yoramu mwana wa Ahabu mfalme wa Israeli, wakati huo Yehoshafati akiwa mfalme wa Yuda, Yehoramu mwana wa Yehoshafati akaanza kutawala kama mfalme wa Yuda.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatano bw’okogaamba kwa Yoramu, mosinto bw’Ahabu, omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli, ekero Yehosafati arenge omorwoti bw’Abayuda, Yehoramu, mosinto o Yehosafati, agachaaka kogamba.

English: Being inflamed with anger, he immediately stripped off Andronicus's purple robe, and tore off his under garments, and when he had led him round through the whole city to that very place where he had committed the outrage against Onias, there he put the murderer out of the way, the Lord rendering to him the punishment he had deserved.
Kiswahili: Akiwa amewaka hasira, mara moja alimvua Androniko vazi la zambarau, na kurarua nguo zake za ndani, na alipompeleka kuzunguka jiji lote hadi mahali pale pale alipomfanyia Onias ghadhabu, hapo ndipo alipomtoa muuaji, Bwana akimlipa adhabu aliyostahili.
Ekegusii: Obororo obonene bokamosoa goika agatandora chianga chi'Andronika, erio akamoetanania omochie bwonsi goika aria ase aiterete Onia, agwo nere akamoita agakwa. Igo nabo Omonene aete Androniko egesusuro ekio aganeirie.

English: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won't turn away until they are consumed.
Kiswahili: Niliwafuatia adui zangu na nikawapata, sikurudi nyuma mpaka walipoangamizwa.
Ekegusii: Nkabwatia ababisa baane, nkabaikeera inchera; gose tinairanete goika nkabakoora.

English: They will roam the land, dejected and hungry. When they are famished, they will become enraged; and looking upward, they will curse their king and their God.
Kiswahili: Watazunguka katika nchi yote, wakiwa na dhiki na njaa. Watakapotaabika kwa njaa, watapatwa na hasira kali, nao, wakiwa wanatazama juu, watamlaani mfalme wao na Mungu wao.
Ekegusii: Abanto mbaetanane ase ense yonsi, bare nemechando emenene mono, na enchara, na ekero babeire nenchara mbabe nekeririanda ekenene, baragererie omorwoti obo na Nyasae obo. Mbaonchore amasio abo barigererie gochia igoro,

English: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.
Kiswahili: Washtaki wangu na waangamie kwa aibu, wale wanaotaka kunidhuru na wafunikwe kwa dharau na fedheha.
Ekegusii: Ababisa abwo bakorigia obogima bwane, tiga basookigwe na gosirigwa kegima; abwo bakorigia gonkora bobe, tiga bachaywe na gochecherigwa mono.

English: Even on My menservants and maidservants I will pour out My Spirit in those days, and they will prophesy.
Kiswahili: Hata juu ya watumishi wangu, wanaume kwa wanawake, katika siku zile nitamimina Roho wangu, nao watatabiri.
Ekegusii: Naboigo, ase amatuko ayio nimbaiterere abasomba baane, abasacha na abakungu, Omoika one, na barabwo inababane.

English: He said to me, ‘Who are you?' I answered him, ‘I am an Amalekite.'
Kiswahili: “Akaniuliza, ‘Wewe ni nani?' “Nikamjibu, ‘Mimi ni Mwamaleki.'
Ekegusii: Erio akamboria: Naye ng'o? Nkamoiraneria ng'a n'Omoameleki inde.

English: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and Ahab his son reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Omri akalala pamoja na baba zake na akazikwa huko Samaria. Ahabu mwanawe akatawala mahali pake.
Ekegusii: Omuri akaraara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete agatindekwa agwo Samaria, na Ahabu, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

English: “Yahweh who does it, Yahweh who forms it to establish it—Yahweh is his name, says:
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo, yeye aliyeumba dunia, Bwana aliyeifanya na kuithibitisha, Bwana ndilo jina lake:
Ekegusii: “Aya nar'Omonene oyotongete ense, oyo oyebombete akayekora egenderere kobao, ere oyio erieta riaye n'Omonene, agoteeba:

English: Simon also built Adida in the plain country, made it strong, and set up gates and bars.
Kiswahili: Simoni pia alijenga Adida katika nchi tambarare, akaiimarisha, na kuweka malango na makomeo.
Ekegusii: Simioni nere akaywagaacha boyia omochie bwa Adida ase eraaro ya Shefela, akayokong'ia na koyobeekera ebisieri nechiboriti.

English: You are all beautiful, my love. There is no spot in you.
Kiswahili: Wewe ni mzuri kote, mpenzi wangu, hakuna hitilafu ndani yako.
Ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, nigo ore omoseera bori, tori na kemoa kende!

English: The next day Moses said to the people, “You have committed a great sin. Now I will go up to the LORD; perhaps I can make atonement for your sin.”
Kiswahili: Siku iliyofuata Mose akawaambia watu, “Mmefanya dhambi kubwa. Lakini sasa nitapanda juu kwa Bwana, labda nitaweza kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi yenu.”
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Musa agateebia abanto, “Mwakorire ebibe ebinene mono. Na bono ngotiira inde gochia ase Omonene, aande nabo ndabanyorere okobwatanigwa, ekiagera mwakorire ebibe.”

English: How could we have strength to glorify him? For he is himself the greater than all his works.
Kiswahili: Tunawezaje kuwa na nguvu ya kumtukuza? Kwa maana yeye mwenyewe ndiye mkuu kuliko kazi zake zote.
Ekegusii: Intwe ng'ai toranyoore chinguru chi'okomotogia? Ekiagera ere nigo are omonene kobua emeremo yaye yonsi.

English: When we arrived in Rome, Paul was permitted to stay by himself, with a soldier to guard him.
Kiswahili: Tulipofika Rumi, Paulo aliruhusiwa kuishi peke yake akiwa na askari wa kumlinda. Paulo Ahubiri Rumi Chini Ya Ulinzi
Ekegusii: Ekero twasoa Rumi, Paulo akaegwa ribaga komenya ere bweka, amo nomorendi ore komorenda. Paulo ogokwana n’Abayahudi agwo Rumi

English: “What is your name?” Jesus asked. “My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamuuliza, “Jina lako ni nani?” Akamjibu, “Jina langu ni Legioni, kwa kuwa tuko wengi.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamobooria, “Erieta riao naki okorokwa?” Akairaneria, “Erieta riane n’Elegioni abasigari chilifu isano nemo na goetani erombe y’ abanto, ekiagera nabange tore.”

English: Who knows if the spirit of man rises upward and the spirit of the animal descends into the earth?
Kiswahili: Ni nani ajuaye kama roho ya mtu huenda juu na roho ya mnyama hushuka chini ardhini?”
Ekegusii: Ning’o omanyete gose omoika o Mwanyabaanto niigoro ogochia, na oyo bwe ching’iti ogenda inse y’ense?

English: Then Paul went back upstairs, broke bread, and ate. And after speaking until daybreak, he departed.
Kiswahili: Kisha Paulo akapanda tena ghorofani, akamega mkate na kula. Baada ya kuongea mpaka mapambazuko, akaondoka.
Ekegusii: Paulo akariina igoro naende, agasamunyora omogati akaria, agakwana nabarabwo goika bogakia mambia. Erio akaimoka, akagenda.

English: But Jesus answered, “It also says, ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’ ”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Imesemwa, ‘Usimjaribu Bwana Mungu wako.’ ”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Neteebire, Toteema Omonene Nyasae oo.”

English: doesn't rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;
Kiswahili: Upendo haufurahii mabaya bali hufurahi pamoja na kweli.
Ekegusii: tibokogokera obobe, korende bogokera ekeene.

English: Everyone who competes in the games trains with strict discipline. They do it for a crown that is perishable, but we do it for a crown that is imperishable.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja anayeshiriki katika mashindano hufanya mazoezi makali. Wao hufanya hivyo ili wapokee taji isiyodumu, lakini sisi tunafanya hivyo ili kupata taji idumuyo milele.
Ekegusii: Na kera oyokoamererania ase chigosori nigo agwetanga ase onsi. Na abwo nigo bagokora bo, erinde banyore egutwa egosareka, korende intwe tonyore eye etagosareka.

English: Then I sent him this reply: “There is nothing to these rumors you are spreading; you are inventing them in your own mind.”
Kiswahili: Nilimpelekea jibu hili: “Hakuna jambo kama hilo unalosema linalofanyika. Unalitunga tu kwenye kichwa chako.”
Ekegusii: Erio ngatoma amang’ana gochia asare, nkamoiraneria, “Amang’ana buna ayio tari ay’ekeene, ayio namang’ana ao aye omonyene okorengereria korwa ase enkoro yao na koyaroisia boigo.”

English: then may You hear from heaven and forgive the sin of Your people Israel. May You restore them to the land You gave to their fathers.
Kiswahili: basi usikie kutoka mbinguni, ukasamehe dhambi ya watu wako Israeli na kuwarudisha katika nchi uliyowapa baba zao.
Ekegusii: rirorio oigwe korwa agwo igoro. Bwabere ebibe bi’abaanto bao Abaisraeli, naende obarente gocha ase ense eye kwaete chisokoro chiabo.

English: the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, the basin and its base,
Kiswahili: madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa na vyombo vyake vyote, sinia na kinara chake,
Ekegusii: egesasiimero ase ebing'wanso birasamberwe na ebikorero biaye, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye,

English: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Mungu ni shahidi wangu jinsi ninavyowaonea shauku ninyi nyote kwa huruma ya Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Naki Nyasae nere kirori one, buna 'nde namaiga ase more mwensi nobwanchani bokorwa ase Kristo Yeso.

English: If the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac, had not been with me, surely by now you would have sent me away empty-handed. But God has seen my affliction and the toil of my hands, and last night He rendered judgment.” Jacob’s Covenant with Laban
Kiswahili: Kama Mungu wa baba yangu, Mungu wa Abrahamu na Hofu ya Isaki, hakuwa pamoja nami, hakika ungenifukuza mikono mitupu. Lakini Mungu ameona taabu yangu na kazi ngumu ya mikono yangu, naye usiku uliopita amekukemea.”
Ekegusii: Onye Nyasae o tata, Nyasae o Aburaamu, Nyasae oyio Isaka airogete ataarenge amo nainche, amaene, nanga nigo gwanseria bono inde namaboko amasa. Emechando na emeremo yane Nyasae oyerorire, Ase igo ere nagotogonyerete obotuko bwaetete.” Yakobo na Labani bagokora okobwatana

English: The slacker buries his hand in the dish; he will not even bring it back to his mouth.
Kiswahili: Mtu mvivu hutumbukiza mkono wake kwenye sahani, lakini hawezi hata kuupeleka kwenye kinywa chake!
Ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo akobeeka okoboko kwaye ase esani y’endagera, gose tagokoimokia gocha ase omonwa oye.

English: They had come to hear Him and to be healed of their diseases, and those troubled by unclean spirits were healed.
Kiswahili: Walikuwa wamekuja kumsikiliza na kuponywa magonjwa yao. Wale waliokuwa wakiteswa na pepo wachafu akawaponya.
Ekegusii: Bagacha koigwa amang’ana aye boigo nakogwenigwa amarwaire abo, na abwo bachandire nebirecha bi’eubi bakagwenigwa.

English: Speak to him and tell him that this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I am against you, O Pharaoh king of Egypt, O great monster who lies among his rivers, who says, ‘The Nile is mine; I made it myself.’
Kiswahili: Nena, nawe useme: ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: “ ‘Mimi ni kinyume nawe, Farao, mfalme wa Misri, joka kubwa ulalaye katikati ya vijito vyako. Unasema, “Mto Naili ni wangu mwenyewe; niliufanya kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe.”
Ekegusii: Kwana nere, omoteebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Aye Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, rora, inche nigo inde mamincha yao; aye ore enchoka enene eraire gati‐gati ye chindooche chiao, kogoteeba: Orooche oro rwa Naili norwane, ninche omonyene narotongete.

English: The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former, says the LORD of Hosts. And in this place I will provide peace, declares the LORD of Hosts.” Blessings for a Defiled People
Kiswahili: ‘Utukufu wa nyumba hii ya sasa utakuwa mkubwa kuliko utukufu wa ile nyumba ya mwanzoni,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote. ‘Na mahali hapa nitawapa amani,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.” Baraka Kwa Watu Waliotiwa Unajisi
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba ng’a obonene bw’enyomba eye ya bono nabobe obonene goetania obw’eria ya kare. Aase aiga nindete omorembe obe okogambao. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebiire.” Ogosemia korwa ase abakuani

English: Even to your old age, I will be the same, and I will bear you up when you turn gray. I have made you, and I will carry you; I will sustain you and deliver you.
Kiswahili: Hata mpaka wakati wa uzee wenu na mvi, Mimi ndiye, Mimi ndiye nitakayewasaidia ninyi. Nimewahuluku, nami nitawabeba, nitawasaidia ninyi na kuwaokoa.
Ekegusii: Ninche ndabe amo nainwe nonya ngoika engaki y’obogotu bwaino, ekero morabe mwagotire kegima ne chimbuche chiarabire se, nimbe nkobabogoria. Ninche nabatongete, nimbarende, nimbabogorie na kobatooria.

English: And Joshua spared Rahab the prostitute, with her father’s household and all who belonged to her, because she hid the men Joshua had sent to spy out Jericho. So she has lived among the Israelites to this day.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yoshua akamhifadhi Rahabu yule kahaba, jamaa yake yote na wote waliokuwa wa kwake, kwa sababu aliwaficha watu waliotumwa na Yoshua kuipeleleza Yeriko, naye anaishi miongoni mwa Waisraeli hata leo.
Ekegusii: Yoshua agatooria obogima bwa Rahabu, na obw’abaanto b’enyomba ya ise, na obw’abaanto baye bonsi, ekiagera abisete abanto baria batometwe nere koroota Yeriko. Ase ayio Rahabu, oria omotayayi, nigo amenyete amo n’Abaisraeli, ororeria rwaye nao romenyete goika reero iga.

English: where your fathers tested and tried Me, though they had seen My work.
Kiswahili: ambapo baba zenu walinijaribu na kunipima, ingawa walikuwa wameyaona matendo yangu.
Ekegusii: Aaria chisokoro chiaino nigo chianteemete, nonya chiaroche emeremo yane nigo chiandengete.

English: I will keep My eyes on them for good and will return them to this land. I will build them up and not tear them down; I will plant them and not uproot them.
Kiswahili: Macho yangu yatakuwa juu yao kwa ajili ya kuwapatia mema, nami nitawarudisha tena katika nchi hii. Nitawajenga wala sitawabomoa, nitawapanda wala sitawangʼoa,
Ekegusii: Nimbarende na kobakorera amaya goika mbairanie naende ase ense eye. Nimbatenenie gose tinkobatagora, nimbasimeke gose tinkobasimora.

English: And whenever the king entered the house of the LORD, the guards would bear the shields, and later they would return them to the guardroom.
Kiswahili: Kila wakati mfalme alipokwenda katika Hekalu la Bwana, walinzi walizichukua hizo ngao, na baadaye walizirudisha kwenye chumba cha ulinzi.
Ekegusii: Botambe ekero omorwoti arenge gosoa ase enyomba y’Omonene, abarendi nigo baarenge gochibogoria, naende bachiirania ase enyomba y’oborendi.

English: There is Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them, the princes of Judah in their company, the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.
Kiswahili: Liko kabila dogo la Benyamini likiwaongoza, wakifuatwa na kundi kubwa la watawala wa Yuda, hatimaye watawala wa Zabuloni na Naftali.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Benjamini, abare abasinini mono ase egati yabo, nao bare baabatang’aine, na abanene b’Abayuda nao bare amo nomoganda obo, na abanene b’Abasabuloni na ab’Abanafutali.

English: In the letters she wrote: “Proclaim a fast and give Naboth a seat of honor among the people.
Kiswahili: Katika barua hizo aliandika: “Tangazeni siku ya watu kufunga na mkamketishe Nabothi mahali pa wazi miongoni mwa watu.
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria akarika ase amarube aria: “Raria okweng’ata gokorwe, na mobeke Naboti ase amasio ’abaanto ase okomoa amasikani.

English: You may eat any animal that has a split hoof completely divided and that chews the cud.
Kiswahili: Mwaweza kula mnyama yeyote mwenye kwato zilizogawanyika sehemu mbili na ambaye hucheua.
Ekegusii: Eng’iti ende yonsi ebwate ebitaago biatananegete kegima, naende ekoria eng’ang’ura, nero moraarie.

English: Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth.
Kiswahili: Heri walio wapole, maana hao watairithi nchi.
Ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abare noboitongo, ekiagera barabwo ’nabaire omwando bw’ense.

English: But now he is dead. Why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? I will go to him, but he will not return to me.”
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa kwa kuwa amekufa, kwa nini nifunge? Je, naweza kumrudisha tena? Mimi nitakwenda kwake, lakini yeye hatanirudia mimi.”
Ekegusii: Korende bono okuure, nase ki rende 'ndeng'ate? Inee! Ninyare komoirania abe moyo? Ninche ndageende aase ageenda, korende ere takoirana ase 'nde.”

English: Then my servants will bring you back into the hill country, and will set you in one of the cities by the passes.
Kiswahili: Kisha watumishi wangu watakurudisha milimani, na kukuweka katika mojawapo ya miji iliyo karibu na njia za kuingilia.
Ekegusii: “Bono abanto baane mbakoire na gokobeeka ime yomochie oyomo agwo ase ebitunwa ase ebisaku bia Abairaeli,

English: In which direction is the lightning dispersed, or the east wind scattered over the earth?
Kiswahili: Ni ipi njia iendayo mahali umeme wa radi unapotawanyiwa, au mahali upepo wa mashariki unaposambaziwa juu ya dunia?
Ekegusii: Inchera ki ekogenda aase oborabu bokoruerwa, gose ekogenda aase omwaga okorwa moocha bwesiarera ense yonsi?

English: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.
Kiswahili: Atakapokuja huyo Roho wa kweli atawaongoza awatie katika kweli yote. Yeye hatanena kwa ajili yake mwenyewe, bali atanena yale yote atakayosikia, naye atawaonyesha mambo yajayo.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero arache ere, Omoika bw'Ekeene, nobaraae ase onsi ayare ay'ekeene, ere tagokwana ayare ayaye, korende onsi ayaranyare koigwa nayakwane, naende amang'ana agochi‐gocha nabateebie engencho yaye.

English: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?
Kiswahili: ili kuitosheleza nchi ya ukiwa na jangwa, na majani yaanze kumea ndani yake?
Ekegusii: Embura eyio nigo ekoigotia ense ere bosa etamenyiri, yagera yamera obonyansi.

English: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
Kiswahili: Mungu huwaweka wapweke katika jamaa, huwaongoza wafungwa wakiimba, bali waasi huishi katika nchi kame.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akoa abatigirwe bosa chinka ase bakomenya. Nigo agosibora abanto basibire baseseneka, korende abasaria nigo bakomenya ase ense enyomo kegima.

English: They will recompense your lewdness on you, and you will bear the sins of your idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.'”
Kiswahili: Utapata adhabu kwa ajili ya uasherati wako na kuchukua matokeo ya dhambi zako za uasherati. Ndipo utakapojua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana Mwenyezi.”
Ekegusii: Egesusuro ki'obonyaka bwaino 'nkebe igoro yaino, ee, imonyore egesusuro ki'ebibe biaino bi'ogosasiima emegwekano. Erio momanye ng'a inche ninche Omonene.”

English: Yahweh said to Moses and to Aaron, “Take handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the sky in the sight of Pharaoh.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose na Aroni, “Chukueni majivu ya tanuru, naye Mose ayarushe angani mbele ya Farao.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa na Aroni, “Genda mobuuche ribu riichire roe korwa riko, na Musa arisiare gochia igoro, ase obosio bwa Farao.

English: and from the tribe of Gad, Geuel son of Machi.
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Gadi, Geueli mwana wa Maki.
Ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi, Geueli, mosinto o Maki.

English: They arose out of Midian and came to Paran; and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house, and appointed him food, and gave him land.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Midiani wakaenda Parani. Basi wakichukua pamoja nao wanaume kutoka Parani, wakaenda Misri, kwa Farao mfalme wa Misri, ambaye alimpa Hadadi nyumba, ardhi na akampatia chakula.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Midiani, bakagenda bagaika Parani, naende bakagenda amo nabaanto bande korwa Parani, bagaika Misiri. Aroro bakagenda ase Farao, omorwoti o Misiri. Ere akamoa enyomba, naende akamochikera endagera arenge koba okonyora botambe; boigo akamoa oboremo.

English: Ask your young men, and they will tell you. Therefore let the young men find favor in your eyes, for we come on a good day. Please give whatever comes to your hand to your servants and to your son David.'”
Kiswahili: Waulize watumishi wako nao watakuambia. Kwa hiyo uwatendee wema vijana wangu, kwani tumekuja wakati wa furaha. Tafadhali wape watumishi wako na mwanao Daudi chochote kitakachokuja mkononi mwako kwa ajili yao.' ”
Ekegusii: Boria abasomba bao, nabarabwo mbakoenekerie bo. Ngochia koba tore nomoyega bwe Rituko Rinene; ase ayio tiga abamura abwo natomire asore banyore ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao. Ase ayio, obae barabwo amo nainche Daudi, omwana oo, gento kende obwate ogotoa.”

English: After sighting Cyprus and passing south of it, we sailed on to Syria and landed at Tyre, where the ship was to unload its cargo.
Kiswahili: Tulipokiona kisiwa cha Kipro, tukakizunguka tukakiacha upande wetu wa kushoto, tukasafiri mpaka Shamu, tukatia nanga katika bandari ya Tiro ambapo meli yetu ilikuwa ipakue shehena yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero twachia korora egesinka gekorokwa Kuporo, tokagetiga ensemo y’okobee; tokagenda goika Siiria, togaika Turo; na agwo chigurube chikarusigwa ase emeeri.

English: Solomon loved Yahweh, walking in the statutes of David his father, except that he sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.
Kiswahili: Solomoni akaonyesha upendo wake kwa Bwana kwa kuenenda sawasawa na amri za Daudi baba yake, ila yeye alitoa dhabihu na kufukiza uvumba huko mahali pa juu.
Ekegusii: Sulemani nigo anchete Omonene, akabwatia emeroberio Daudi achiigete, korende nigo aruete ebing'wanso na gosamba ubani agwo aase aimokererete igoro.

English: In the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly.
Kiswahili: Katika ile miaka saba ya neema nchi ilizaa mazao kwa wingi sana.
Ekegusii: Emiaka eria etano na ebere y'omoigoto egaika, ense ekaama endagera enyinge,

English: With hailstones of mighty power, he caused war to break violently upon the nation, and on the slope he destroyed those who resisted, so that the nations might know his armor, how he fought in the sight of the Lord; for he followed the Mighty One.
Kiswahili: Kwa mawe ya mvua ya mawe yenye nguvu nyingi, alisababisha vita vikali dhidi ya taifa, na kwenye mteremko aliwaangamiza wale waliopinga, ili mataifa wajue silaha zake, jinsi alivyopigana mbele za Bwana; kwa maana alimfuata Yeye Mwenye Nguvu.
Ekegusii: Nere Omonene ore n'Okobua, akamoiraneria akabatomera embura ere nechinguru ya amagena. Omonene agasaagana egesaku ase egetirimboko gia Beth-horoni akabasiria bonsi baria barenge komoengereria. Ekagera ebisaku bikerorera obuya bwebirwanero biaye, buna ere nigo arenge korwana ase obosio Omonene, ekiagera ere amotunyanete Omonene nenkoro yaye yonsi.

English: But when the troops were at the point of taking the tower, and were forcing the door of the court, and asked for fire to burn the doors, he, being surrounded on every side, fell upon his sword,
Kiswahili: Lakini wakati wanajeshi walipokaribia kuuteka mnara, na kulazimisha mlango wa ua, na kuomba moto uchome milango, yeye, akiwa amezungukwa pande zote, akaanguka juu ya upanga wake,
Ekegusii: Abarwani esegi ba Nikanori bakabuna egesieri ki'enyomba ya Rizi, erio bakaba ange koboera Rizi. Bagasoyia omorero osambe egesieri keria. Rizi akanyora oetenanirwe n'ababisa akarigia gweita n'omoro oye;

English: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;
Kiswahili: katika safari za mara kwa mara. Nimekabiliwa na hatari za kwenye mito, hatari za wanyangʼanyi, hatari kutoka kwa watu wangu mwenyewe, hatari kutoka kwa watu wa Mataifa; hatari mijini, hatari nyikani, hatari baharini; na hatari kutoka kwa ndugu wa uongo.
Ekegusii: nkaba ase orogendo ekero ase ekero, ase emechando ye chindooche, ase ogochandwa nabauri, ase ogochandwa neamate yane, ase ogochandwa nabaanto b'Ebisaku, ase emechando emechie ime, ase emechando y'erooro, ase emechando y'enyancha, ase ogochandwa nabaminto b'oborimo;

English: Now therefore send a man whom you trust, and let him go and see all the destruction which he has brought on us and the king's country, and how he has punished them and all who helped them.”
Kiswahili: Basi sasa mtume mtu unayemwamini, aende zake akaone uharibifu wote aliouleta juu yetu na juu ya nchi ya mfalme, na jinsi alivyowaadhibu wao na wote waliowasaidia.
Ekegusii: Bono aye motome monto onde bwensi omwegenete arore buna barabwo basambete chinibo chiaito na buna ense yomorwoti yasaretigwe erio aye obae egesusuro Yuda na bamura bamwabo na abakoonyi baabo bonsi.”

English: We know that God doesn't listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, he listens to him.
Kiswahili: Tunajua ya kuwa Mungu hawasikilizi wenye dhambi, lakini huwasikiliza wote wanaomcha na kumtii.
Ekegusii: Twamanyire ng'a Nyasae tari koigwa abanyene ebibe; korende omonto karabe omosasimi Nyasae, na gokora ogwancha kwaye, oyio nere Nyasae akoigwa.

English: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
Kiswahili: Ikawa Rehoboamu alipofika Yerusalemu, akakusanya nyumba yote ya Yuda na kabila la Benyamini, wanaume wapiganaji 180,000, kufanya vita dhidi ya nyumba ya Israeli na kuurudisha tena ufalme kwa Rehoboamu mwana wa Solomoni.
Ekegusii: Ekero Rehoboamu achete Yerusalemu, agasangereria abanto bonsi b'enyomba ya Yuda, na egesaku kia Benjamini, abanto chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo etano na etato, abamanyete korwana esegi, bagende korwania Abaisraeli na bairanie oborwoti ase Rehoboamu, mosinto o Sulemani.

English: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.
Kiswahili: Huzunikeni, ombolezeni na kulia. Kicheko chenu na kigeuzwe kuwa kuomboleza, na furaha yenu kuwa huzuni.
Ekegusii: Eichanie na kweng'ereria, na korera. Ogoseka kwaino koonchorwe kobe okweng'ereria, na omogooko oino obe omoichano.

Kiswahili: Farao akamuuliza, “Je una umri gani?”
Ekegusii: Farao akabooria Yakobo: “Inee! Emiaka yao nerenga?”

English: This is the way of an adulteress: She eats and wipes her mouth and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’
Kiswahili: “Huu ndio mwendo wa mwanamke mzinzi, hula akapangusa kinywa chake na kusema, ‘Sikufanya chochote kibaya.’
Ekegusii: Eyio nenchera y’omokuungu omotomani: Nigo akoria na otinyia omonwa oye, erio oteeba, “Inche tindakora bonyaka bonde.”

English: The two kings joined battle, and the army of Alexander fled; and Demetrius followed after him, and prevailed against them.
Kiswahili: Wafalme hao wawili walijiunga vitani, na jeshi la Aleksanda likakimbia; na Demetrio akamfuata, akawashinda.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero abarwani esegi ba abarwoti abwo babere baumeranete ase esegi, abarwani esegi ba Alekisanda bagekiora bagataama. Erio Demeturio akabamonyokia na akabua esegi.

English: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Mungu akamwambia, “Umchukue mwanao, mwana wako wa pekee, Isaki umpendaye, uende katika nchi ya Moria. Mtoe huko kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa juu ya mlima mmojawapo nitakaokuambia.”
Ekegusii: Nyasae akamoteebia: “Moire Isaka, omwana oyo oo omomoima, oyobwanchete, ogende nere goika ense ya Moria. Agwo omorue abe ekeng'wanso ki'ogosaambwa ase egetunwa ekemo ki'ebio ndakworokie.”

English: and the chief priests and scribes were looking for a way to put Jesus to death; for they feared the people. Judas Agrees to Betray Jesus (Matthew 26:14–16; Mark 14:10–11)
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria walikuwa wanatafuta njia ya kumuua Yesu, kwa sababu waliwaogopa watu.
Ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko bakarigia enchera y’okomoita, ekiagera nigo bairogete abanto.

English: Instead, he called to his attendant and said, “Throw this woman out and bolt the door behind her!”
Kiswahili: Akamwita mtumishi wake mahsusi na kumwambia, “Mtoe huyu mwanamke hapa na ufunge mlango nyuma yake.”
Ekegusii: Amunoni akarangeria omomura ore komokorera, akamoteebia, “Rusia omokungu oyo aa ase ’nde, omoire isiko, osieke egesieri bokung’u.”

English: Joseph replied, “This is the interpretation: The three baskets are three days.
Kiswahili: Yosefu akamwambia, “Hii ndiyo maana yake: Vikapu vitatu ni siku tatu.
Ekegusii: Na Yusufu akamoiraneria: “Engencho y’okoroota okwo nero eye: Chinteru echio isato, ayio namatuko atato.

English: The children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spoke to them.
Kiswahili: Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase wakavuka mbele ya Waisraeli, wakiwa wamevaa silaha, kama Mose alivyowaamuru.

Kiswahili: Shahidi wa uongo hataacha kuadhibiwa, naye amwagaye uongo ataangamia.
Ekegusii: Kirori bw’oborimo takomocha konyora egesusuro, na oyo ogokwana oborimo goika asire.
