English: But when his accusers rose to speak, they did not charge him with any of the crimes I had expected.
Kiswahili: Washtaki wake waliposimama, hawakushtaki kwa uhalifu wowote niliokuwa ninatarajia.
Ekegusii: Na baria abamosoeri ekero batenenete, tibamosoera ase ing’ana riibe, buna nakagete,

English: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; He led them through the depths as through a desert.
Kiswahili: Alikemea Bahari ya Shamu, nayo ikakauka, akawaongoza katika vilindi vyake kama vile jangwani.
Ekegusii: Nigo atogonyerete Enyancha eria Embariri egakamoka, erio agaetia Abaisraeli aroro buna nase ense enyomo.

English: Will He be angry forever? Will He be indignant to the end?’ This you have spoken, but you keep doing all the evil you can.” Judah Follows Israel’s Example
Kiswahili: je, utakasirika siku zote? Je, ghadhabu yako itaendelea milele?’ Hivi ndivyo unavyozungumza, lakini unafanya maovu yote uwezayo.” Wito Kwa Ajili Ya Toba
Ekegusii: Inee! Omonene nigo aratobee goika kare na kare, na endamwamu yaye nigo eragenderere kobao goika omoerio? Ee, inwe nabo mogoteeba, naende nigo mogendererete gokora amabe onsi buna moranyare.” Abaisraeli na Abayuda goika baonchoke

English: The earth trembles at the noise of their fall; there is a cry, the noise which is heard in the Red Sea.
Kiswahili: Kwa sauti ya anguko lao, dunia itatetemeka. Kilio chao kitasikika hadi Bahari ya Shamu.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto b'Edomu baragwe, eriogi riabo naritengechie ense; na eriogi ri'okorera kwabo narigugwe gochia ase Enyancha Embariri.

English: This is what the LORD says: “I will restore the fortunes of Jacob’s tents and have compassion on his dwellings. And the city will be rebuilt on her own ruins, and the palace will stand in its rightful place.
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “ ‘Nitarudisha baraka za mahema ya Yakobo, na kuhurumia maskani yake. Mji utajengwa tena juu ya magofu yake, nalo jumba la kifalme litasimama mahali pake halisi.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Naama! Ning’iranie abanto ba Yakobo ase chiema chiabo, nimbe namaabera ase obomenyo bwabo. Omochie o Yerusalemu noagachwe naende ase orenge. Na enyomba y’omorwoti neagachwe ase yarenge.

English: then Yahweh will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration, and severe sicknesses, and of long duration.
Kiswahili: Bwana ataleta mapigo ya kutisha juu yako na kwa wazao wako, maafa makali na ya kudumu, magonjwa mazito na ya kudumu.
Ekegusii: rirori'Omonene narente ase more, na igoro ase abana baino, amaakwa are amanene na amatindi aragenderere ase engaki entambe.

English: Isaac said to his son, “How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?” He said, “Because Yahweh your God gave me success.”
Kiswahili: Isaki akamuuliza mwanawe. “Umepataje haraka namna hii, mwanangu?” Akajibu, “Bwana Mungu wako amenifanikisha.”
Ekegusii: Isaka akamobooria: “Omwana one, naki gwakora kwanyora ching'iti bwango iga?” Yakobo akamoiraneria: “mboora Omonene, Nyasae oo, ochindetera.”

English: They who were of understanding in sayings also became wise themselves, and poured out apt proverbs.
Kiswahili: Wale waliokuwa na ufahamu katika misemo nao wakawa na hekima, wakamimina mithali zinazofaa.
Ekegusii: Abanto baria bagotegerera chimbachero nigo bagochia baba n'echisemi; nabarabwo nigo baichire n'emebayeno.

English: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu akimdekeza mtumishi wake tangu ujanani, atamletea sikitiko mwishoni.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogotuga omosomba oye na omoa ebinto bionsi aganetie korwa obwana bwaye, omosomba oyio nabo araire omwando oye.

English: This is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the foolish prophets who follow their own spirit, yet have seen nothing.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Ole wao manabii wapumbavu wafuatao roho yao wenyewe na wala hawajaona chochote!
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Obobe nobw’ababani abwo abariri bakobwatia emeika yabo abanyene, na tibabwati korora konde gwonsi bagokwana.

English: “But out of a shoot from her roots one will stand up in his place, who will come to the army and will enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and will deal against them and will prevail.
Kiswahili: “Mmoja kutoka jamaa ya huyo binti atainuka na kuchukua nafasi yake. Atashambulia majeshi ya mfalme wa Kaskazini na kuingia katika ngome yake; atapigana dhidi yao naye atashinda.
Ekegusii: Erio omonto natoke korwa ase orosagia rw'omori bw'omokuungu oria, ere naache arwanie abarwani esegi b'omorwoti o sugusu, asoe ase chiburi chiaye, akore ase abanto buna anchete na kobabua.

English: Then the devil left Him, and angels came and ministered to Him. Jesus Begins His Ministry (Isaiah 9:1–7; Mark 1:14–15; Luke 4:14–15)
Kiswahili: Ndipo ibilisi akamwacha, nao malaika wakaja na kumhudumia. Yesu Aanza Kuhubiri (Marko 1:14-15; Luka 4:14-15)
Ekegusii: Erio Saitani akamotiga, na rora, abamalaika bagaacha, bakamokorera. Yeso ogochaaka emeremo yaye Galili (Mar 1:14-15; Luk 4:14-15)

English: Otherwise it will happen, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon will be considered criminals.”
Kiswahili: Kama sivyo, mara tu bwana wangu mfalme atakapopumzishwa pamoja na baba zake, mimi na mwanangu Solomoni tutatendewa kama wahalifu.”
Ekegusii: Onye taibo, nebe ekero aye, omonene one omorwoti, gwakuure na koraraare ase chisokoro chiao chiaraarete, inche na omwana one Sulemani toche kobarwa koba abamochi abanene.”

English: “Therefore, son of man, prophesy, and tell Gog, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In that day when my people Israel dwells securely, will you not know it?
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo, mwanadamu, tabiri na umwambie Gogu: ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Katika siku ile, watu wangu Israeli watakapokuwa wanaishi salama, Je, wewe mwenyewe hutalijua hilo?
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aye Mwanyabaanto, bana oteebie Gogi ng'a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Ase engaki eyio Abaisraeli, abanto bane, mbabe bamenyete ase obotoereru, nario oramanye amang'ana ayio.

English: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh, for every man of the Egyptians sold his field, because the famine was severe on them, and the land became Pharaoh's.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yosefu akamnunulia Farao nchi yote ya Misri. Wamisri, mmoja baada ya mwingine, waliuza mashamba yao, kwa sababu njaa ilikuwa kali sana kwao. Nchi ikawa mali ya Farao,
Ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akagorera Farao amaremo onsi areenge Misiri, naki Abamisiri nigo baoonetie kera omonto oboremo bwaye, ekiagera enchara yareenge endito mono. Naboigo ense ekaba eya Farao.

English: Rehum the commander and Shimshai the scribe wrote the letter against Jerusalem to King Artaxerxes as follows:
Kiswahili: Rehumu afisa msimamizi na mwandishi Shimshai waliandika barua kwa Mfalme Artashasta dhidi ya watu wa Yerusalemu kama ifuatavyo:
Ekegusii: Boigo Rehumu, omosemia omonene, na Simusai omoriki, bakarikera Aritasasita riruube bagosoera Yerusalemu.

English: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. And after He had said this, He told him, “Follow Me.” Jesus and the Beloved Disciple
Kiswahili: Yesu alisema haya ili kuashiria ni kifo cha aina gani Petro atakachomtukuza nacho Mungu. Kisha Yesu akamwambia Petro, “Nifuate!”

Kiswahili: Akawaweka waamuzi katika nchi, kwenye miji yote ya Yuda yenye maboma.

Kiswahili: Ni lazima wapimwe kwanza; kisha kama hakuna neno dhidi yao, basi na waruhusiwe kuhudumu kama mashemasi.
Ekegusii: Barabwo boigo barengwe ritang'ani: onye bakonyorekana ng'a tibari ne chingeencho chimbe, erio baegwe emeremo y'obokonyi ase ekanisa.

English: “There is no peace,” says the LORD, “for the wicked.”
Kiswahili: “Hakuna amani kwa waovu,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonene oteebire, “Omokori amabe tabwati omorembe.”

English: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn't run in vain nor labor in vain.

English: And he brought into the house of the LORD the silver and gold and other articles that he and his father had dedicated. War between Asa and Baasha (2 Chronicles 16:1–6)
Kiswahili: Akaleta ndani ya Hekalu la Bwana fedha na dhahabu na vile vyombo ambavyo yeye na baba yake walikuwa wameviweka wakfu.

English: Jesus invited a little child to stand among them.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwita mtoto mdogo na kumsimamisha katikati yao.
Ekegusii: Akarangeria omwana, akamobeka gati‐gati yaabo,

English: I said, ‘Surely you will fear Me and accept correction.’ Then her dwelling place would not be cut off despite all for which I punished her. But they rose early to corrupt all their deeds.
Kiswahili: Niliuambia huo mji, ‘Hakika utaniogopa na kukubali maonyo!’ Ndipo makao yake hayatafutiliwa mbali, wala adhabu zangu zote hazitakuja juu yake. Lakini walikuwa bado na shauku kutenda kwa upotovu katika yote waliyofanya.”
Ekegusii: Nigo natebeetie abanto b’omochie oyo ng’a goika banyiroke na banche amorokererio ay’okobarongeyia, erinde tinsiria aase abo bamenyete, buna nabachikerete. Korende nigo bagendererete koba ababe goetania ase ogokora kwabo gwonsi.”

English: Then Ziba said to the king, “According to all that my lord the king commands his servant, so your servant will do.” So Mephibosheth ate at the king's table like one of the king's sons.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Siba akamwambia mfalme, “Mtumishi wako atafanya chochote bwana wangu mfalme atakachoagiza mtumishi wake kufanya.” Basi Mefiboshethi akala chakula mezani pa Daudi kama mmoja wa wana wa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Erio Siba akairaneria omorwoti, “Inche omosomba oo ninkore ayio onsi gwachiikire.” Ase igo Mefiboseti akaba okoragera ase emesa ya Daudi Omonene oye, akaba buna oyomo bw'abana b'omorwoti.

English: In all cases of illegal possession of an ox, a donkey, a sheep, a garment, or any lost item that someone claims, ‘This is mine,’ both parties shall bring their cases before the judges. The one whom the judges find guilty must pay back double to his neighbor.
Kiswahili: Pakiwepo jambo lolote la mali isiyo halali, ikiwa ni maksai, punda, kondoo, mavazi, ama mali yoyote iliyopotea ambayo fulani atasema, ‘Hii ni mali yangu,’ pande zote mbili wataleta mashauri yao mbele ya waamuzi. Yule ambaye waamuzi watamwona kuwa na hatia atamlipa jirani yake mara mbili.

Na oria Nyasae araorokie ng’a nomomochi, goika aakane oria onde ara kabere.

English: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo dunia yote ilikuwa na lugha moja na msemo mmoja.
Ekegusii: Abanto b'ense engima nigo baarenge nomonwa oyomo na amang'ana abwekaine.

English: The Benjamites, however, failed to drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem. So to this day the Jebusites live there among the Benjamites.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, Wabenyamini walishindwa kuwafukuza Wayebusi, waliokuwa wanaishi Yerusalemu; hivyo hadi leo Wayebusi huishi humo pamoja na Wabenyamini.

English: I will enter into judgment with him with pestilence and with blood. I will rain on him, on his hordes, and on the many peoples who are with him, torrential rains with great hailstones, fire, and sulfur.
Kiswahili: Nitatekeleza hukumu juu yake kwa tauni na kwa umwagaji wa damu. Nitaifanya mvua ya mafuriko kunyesha, mvua ya mawe na moto wa kiberiti juu yake na juu ya vikosi vyake na juu ya mataifa mengi walio pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Nimonachere ekiina goetera ase oborwaire bogoita, na ogoiteka kw'amanyinga; nindete igoro yaye, na igoro y'emeganda yaye y'eseegi, na abanto abange bare amo nere, embura ere nomoubera, na amagena are nomorero mbibaite.

English: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and behold, they have done this in the middle of my house.
Kiswahili: Siku ile ile walitoa watoto wao kuwa kafara kwa sanamu zao, waliingia patakatifu pangu na kupatia unajisi. Hilo ndilo walilolifanya katika nyumba yangu.
Ekegusii: Nigo banyenyete abana babo bakaba ebing'wanso ase emegwekano yabo bagosasiima ase rituko erio bachete Aase ane Aachenu, bagaakora akaba aatachenegeti. Rora, amang'ana ayio naro bakorete ase enyomba y'ane ime.

English: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.
Kiswahili: Yeturi, Nafishi na Kedema. Hao ndio wana wa Ishmaeli. Wazao Wa Ketura
Ekegusii: Yeturi na Nafisi, na Kedema. Aba nabwo abana abamura ba Isumaeli.

English: But the wisdom from above is first of all pure, then peace-loving, gentle, accommodating, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial, and sincere.
Kiswahili: Lakini hekima itokayo mbinguni kwanza ni safi, kisha inapenda amani, tena ni ya upole, iliyo tayari kusikiliza wengine kwa unyenyekevu, iliyojaa huruma na matunda mema, isiyopendelea mtu, tena isiyokuwa na unafiki.
Ekegusii: Korende obong’aini bokorwa igoro ritang’ani nigo bore obochenu, naende obw’omorembe, na obwororo, na obokanyeku. Igo boichire namaabera na okwama okuya, botari na gosiereria gose na bong’ainereria.

English: saying to them, “Hear, O Israel, today you are going into battle with your enemies. Do not be fainthearted or afraid; do not be alarmed or terrified because of them.
Kiswahili: Atasema: “Sikia, ee Israeli, leo unakwenda vitani kupigana na adui zako. Usife moyo wala usiogope, usitishwe wala usitiwe hofu mbele yao.
Ekegusii: abateebie: Inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera! Bono mwabeire ang’e kogeenda korwania ababisa baino. Timobaisa gokwa emioyo, timoiroka gose koiguswa, gose timoboboa,

English: In God we have boasted all day long, and Your name we will praise forever. Selah
Kiswahili: Katika Mungu wetu tunajivuna mchana kutwa, nasi tutalisifu jina lako milele.
Ekegusii: Intwe ntogenderere gwetogia asore aye Nyasae, ntobe tokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riao kogenderera botambe.

English: Every morning and every evening they present burnt offerings and fragrant incense to the LORD. They set out the rows of showbread on the ceremonially clean table, and every evening they light the lamps of the gold lampstand. We are carrying out the requirements of the LORD our God, while you have forsaken Him.
Kiswahili: Kila asubuhi na jioni wao hutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na kufukiza uvumba wa harufu nzuri kwa Bwana. Wao huweka mikate juu ya meza safi kwa taratibu za kiibada na kuwasha taa kwenye kinara cha dhahabu kila jioni. Sisi tunazishika kanuni za Bwana Mungu wetu. Lakini ninyi mmemwacha Mungu.
Ekegusii: Kera emambia na omogoroba nigo baare koruera Omonene ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na gosambera ubani ere nogotioka okuya, naende babeka igoro y’emesa y’etaabu emegati ekoruegwa ase Nyasae. Naende nigo barendete ebibekerero bie chitaaya biroisirie korwa ase chitaabu, erinde chitaaya chiria chigenderere gwoka kera omogoroba. Intwe nigo torendete amang’an’Omonene, Nyasae oito, achigete, korende inwe mwamotigire.

English: but Abraham gave gifts to the sons of Abraham's concubines. While he still lived, he sent them away from Isaac his son, eastward, to the east country.
Kiswahili: Lakini Abrahamu alipokuwa bado hai, akawapa watoto wa masuria wake zawadi, kisha akawaondoa waende kuishi pande za mashariki mbali na mwanawe Isaki.
Ekegusii: Korende abana b'abakuungu baria ba sere‐sere Aburaamu akabaa ebiegwa. Ekero are moyo, konya atarakwa, akabateebia barue ase omwana oye Isaka, bagende gochia moocha, ase ense ya Moocha.

English: Satan answered the LORD, “Does Job fear God for nothing?
Kiswahili: Shetani akamjibu Bwana, “Je, Ayubu anamcha Mungu bure?
Ekegusii: Erio Saitani akairaneria, agateebia Omonene, “Inee! Ayubu nigo agosigete aye Nyasae ngencho etaiyo?

English: Don't boast about tomorrow; for you don't know what a day may bring.
Kiswahili: Usijisifu kwa ajili ya kesho, kwa kuwa hujui ni nini kitakachozaliwa kwa siku moja.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gwetogeria rituko ri'ankio, ekiagera tomanyeti aya rituko erio rikorenta.

English: Why do you boast in the valleys, your flowing valley, backsliding daughter? You trusted in her treasures, saying, ‘Who will come to me?'
Kiswahili: Kwa nini unajivunia mabonde yako, kujivunia mabonde yako yaliyozaa sana? Ee binti usiye mwaminifu, unayeutumainia utajiri wako na kusema, ‘Ni nani atakayenishambulia?'
Ekegusii: Inwe abaiseke baane ababiare motari abegenwa, nase ki mogwetogia ng'a amakura aino naichire chindagera? Inwe mwegenete obonda bwaino mogoteeba ng'a onde tari oranyare kobarwania.

English: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and you shall not gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.
Kiswahili: Msivune na kuweka akiba kinachoota chenyewe, wala kuvuna na kusindika zabibu ambayo hamkuhudumia mashamba yake. Nchi lazima iwe na mwaka wa mapumziko.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa kogesa echikwemeria korwa ase chimbusuro chiagwete, gose timosangereria amasabibu y'emesabibu etacheeretwe. Oyio nigo oraabe omwaka bw'ogotimoka kegima gw'ense eyio.

English: He will serve among great men and appear before him who rules. He will travel through the land of foreign nations, for he has learned what is good and evil among men.
Kiswahili: Atahudumu miongoni mwa watu wakuu na kuonekana mbele yake anayetawala. Atasafiri katika nchi ya mataifa ya kigeni, kwa maana amejifunza mema na mabaya miongoni mwa wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akobakorera abanene, na gwesookia ase obosio bwa abarai; nigo agotaara ase chinse chia isiko naboigo bw'emanyeire obuya nobobe bwa abanto.

English: Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
Kiswahili: Bwana anazifahamu siku za wanyofu, na urithi wao utadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo amanyete amatuko ya abamoirogete, na omwando obo nogenderere kobao kare na kare.

English: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ninajua makosa yangu, na dhambi yangu iko mbele yangu daima.
Ekegusii: Inche namanyire ogosaria kwane, na ebibe biane nigo bire bosio bwane botambe.

English: The Levites did as Moses commanded, and that day about three thousand of the people fell dead.
Kiswahili: Walawi wakafanya kama Mose alivyoamuru, siku ile wakafa watu wapatao 3,000.
Ekegusii: Abana ba Lawi bagakora buna Musa abateebeetie, na abanto chilifu isato bagaitwa ase rituko erio.

English: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.
Kiswahili: Yeyote aaminiye na kubatizwa ataokoka. Lakini yeyote asiyeamini atahukumiwa.
Ekegusii: Oyoregene na kobatiswa, natooreke, ko oyotegeneti, nagambigwe.

English: Then he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering over the tent, just as the LORD had commanded him.
Kiswahili: Kisha akalitandaza hema juu ya Maskani ya Mungu na kuifunika hema, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.
Ekegusii: Akaara eema igoro y’obomenyo boria, na kobeeka egietubo kiaye buna Omonene konya amochikiire.

English: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
Kiswahili: Ndipo utapata kibali na jina zuri mbele za Mungu na mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Igo nario oranyore ogwancherwa na okomanya okuya ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na ase Mwanyabaanto.

English: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.
Kiswahili: Kama konokono ayeyukavyo akitembea, kama mtoto aliyezaliwa akiwa mfu, wasilione jua.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tiga babe buna amakorominyo akonyititoka amarenda aera, na buna oborito bw'omokuungu bokogwa botaraika engaki yaye.

English: Asa did that which was right in Yahweh's eyes, as David his father did.
Kiswahili: Asa akatenda yaliyo mema machoni mwa Bwana, kama alivyokuwa ametenda Daudi baba yake.
Ekegusii: Asa agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso 'Omonene, buna Daudi, sokororia yaye, akorete.

English: Be swift to hear and answer with patience.
Kiswahili: Uwe mwepesi wa kusikia na kujibu kwa uvumilivu.
Ekegusii: Kabe omwango ase ogotegerera, n'omong'ora na korenda ng'a ninki okoiraneria.

English: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David, along with cedar logs, stonemasons, and carpenters, to build a palace for him.
Kiswahili: Basi Hiramu mfalme wa Tiro akawatuma wajumbe kwa Daudi, wakiwa na magogo ya mierezi, waashi na maseremala ili kumjengea jumba la kifalme.
Ekegusii: Hiramu, omorwoti o Turo, agatoma abatomwa ase Daudi, akamotomera ebingese bi’emete y’emecharake na abaagacheri amagena, na abasenia be chibao, erinde baagachere Daudi enyomba.

English: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwa wana wa Amramu, wana wa Ishari, wana wa Hebroni na wana wa Uzieli:
Ekegusii: Ase ebiombe bie chinderia chi'Amuramu, na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli:

English: God didn't reject his people, whom he foreknew. Or don't you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:
Kiswahili: Mungu hajawakataa watu wake, ambao yeye aliwajua tangu mwanzo. Je, hamjui yale Maandiko yasemayo kuhusu Eliya, jinsi alivyomlalamikia Mungu kuhusu Israeli?
Ekegusii: Nyasae tangeti abanto baye baria amanyete korwa kare. Gose timomanyeti aya amariiko agoteeba igoro y'Elija, buna akweng'ereria ase Nyasae igoro y'Abaisraeli?

English: And you shall teach them diligently to your children and speak of them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.
Kiswahili: Wafundishe watoto wako kwa bidii. Nena kuhusu amri hizi uketipo nyumbani na wakati utembeapo njiani, ulalapo na uamkapo.
Ekegusii: Moyorokererie abana baino mono, mobe mokona‐koyairanerera botambe; moyakwane ekero moikaransete ase chinyomba chiaino, na ekero more ase orogeendo inchera, na ekero mogochia korara, na ekero mokobooka.

English: “Do not be afraid or discouraged,” Joshua said. “Be strong and courageous, for the LORD will do this to all the enemies you fight.”
Kiswahili: Yoshua akawaambia, “Msiogope, wala msivunjike moyo. Kuweni hodari na wenye ushujaa. Hili ndilo Bwana atakalowatendea adui zenu wote mnaokwenda kupigana nao.”
Ekegusii: Naende Yoshua agateebia abatang’ani baria b’abarwani, “Timoiroka, timokwa emioyo; mobe noboremu na gotenena bokong’u, ekiagera naboigo Omonene arakore ababisa bonsi morarwanie.”

English: Now we know that whatever the law says, it says to those who are under the law, so that every mouth may be silenced and the whole world held accountable to God.
Kiswahili: Basi tunajua ya kwamba chochote sheria inachosema, inawaambia wale walio chini ya sheria ili kila kinywa kinyamazishwe na ulimwengu wote uwajibike kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a amang’ana onsi agokwanwa n’amachiiko nigo agokwanwa ase baria bare inse y’amachiiko, erinde kera omonwa osiekwe, na ense yonsi ebekwe inse ase ekiina kia Nyasae.

English: Now the Philistines had come and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim.
Kiswahili: Basi Wafilisti walikuwa wamekuja na kusambaa kwenye Bonde la Warefai,
Ekegusii: na Abafirisiti bagaacha bagesiarera ase ense omweya y’Abarefai.

English: Then the priests and the Levites stood to bless the people, and God heard their voice, and their prayer came into His holy dwelling place in heaven.
Kiswahili: Ndipo makuhani na Walawi wakasimama wakawabariki watu, naye Mungu akawasikia, kwa sababu maombi yao yalifika mbinguni, makao yake matakatifu.
Ekegusii: Erio abakuani na Abalawi bagatenena, bagasesenia abanto, na amariogi abo akaigugwa, na ogosaba kwabo kogaika ase obomenyo obochenu Omonene aaria igoro.

English: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.
Kiswahili: “Furahini na kurukaruka kwa shangwe, kwa sababu thawabu yenu ni kubwa mbinguni, kwa kuwa hivyo ndivyo baba zao walivyowatenda manabii.
Ekegusii: Goka ase rituko riria, na gochenga, ekiagera ekeene eng'eria yaino nenene igoro; naki chisokoro chiabo nabo chiakorerete ababani engencho eyio eyio.

English: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the residue of the elders of the captivity, and to the priests, to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon,
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo maneno ya ile barua ambayo nabii Yeremia aliituma kutoka Yerusalemu kwenda kwa wazee waliobaki miongoni mwa wale waliohamishwa, na kwa makuhani, manabii na watu wengine wote ambao Nebukadneza alikuwa amewachukua kwenda uhamishoni Babeli kutoka Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Yeremia omobani agatoma riruube korwa Yerusalemu gochia ase abagaaka b'abaanto barenge ase obosomba na ase abakuani, na ababani, na abanto bonsi aba Nebukadinesaro oosete korwa Yerusalemu, akabaira Babiloni ase obosomba.

English: So the people of Judah gathered to seek the LORD, and indeed, they came from all the cities of Judah to seek Him. Jehoshaphat’s Prayer
Kiswahili: Watu wa Yuda wakakusanyika pamoja ili kutafuta msaada kutoka kwa Bwana. Wakaja kutoka kila mji wa Yuda ili kumtafuta.
Ekegusii: Abayuda bagasangererekana amo, bakarigia ogokonywa korwa ase Omonene. Ee, bagacha korwa ase emechie yonsi y’Abayuda korigia Omonene.

English: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?
Kiswahili: Nasi kwa upande wetu kwa nini tunajihatarisha kila saa?
Ekegusii: Nase ki tore nemechando kera engaki?

English: And after he had become the father of Seth, Adam lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Sethi kuzaliwa, Adamu aliishi miaka 800, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa gwa Seti, Adamu akagenderera komenya goika emiaka ende amagana atano na atato (800), erio akaba ise bw’abana baabande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: They looked, but there was no one to save them— to the LORD, but He did not answer.
Kiswahili: Walipiga yowe, lakini hapakuwepo na yeyote wa kuwaokoa; walimlilia Bwana, lakini hakuwajibu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakarigereria, korende onde tarenge obatooretie; bakarangeri’Omonene, korende ere tabaigwa.

English: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
Kiswahili: Shida za moyo wangu zimeongezeka, niokoe katika dhiki yangu.
Ekegusii: Omoichano nigo oichire ase enkoro yane, ndusie ase obokong'u bwane,

English: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
Kiswahili: Pasipo ushauri wa hekima taifa huanguka, bali washauri wengi hufanya ushindi uwe wa hakika.
Ekegusii: Ase ogoseemia okuya gotari, egesaku nigo gekogwa, korende ase abasemia abange abaya bare, oborendi obuya 'mboreo.

English: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.
Kiswahili: Kama vile mateso ya Kristo yanavyozidi ndani ya maisha yetu, hivyo ndivyo faraja yetu inavyofurika kwa njia ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naki buna emechando ya Kristo yatobucheire, naboigo okoremigwa gwaito gwatobucheire ase enchera ya Kristo.

English: When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.
Kiswahili: Inapochipua majani, ninyi wenyewe mnaweza kuona na kutambua wenyewe ya kuwa wakati wa kiangazi umekaribia.
Ekegusii: ekero egochaka goseboka mwarora na komanya ase emioyo yaino ng’a egura gura ng’ang’e ere.

English: Yahweh says: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build to me? Where will I rest?
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, “Mbingu ni kiti changu cha enzi, nayo dunia ni mahali pa kuweka miguu yangu. Iko wapi nyumba mtakayoijenga kwa ajili yangu? Mahali pangu pa kupumzikia patakuwa wapi?
Ekegusii: Aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: “Igoro nero ekerogo kiane ki'obonene, na ense negeteni kiane ki'amagoro; inyomba ki moranyare kong'agachera? Gose ng'ai aase are ndanyare gotimokera?

English: As for their appearance, all four had the same form, like a wheel within a wheel.
Kiswahili: Kule kuonekana kwake, yote manne yalifanana kila gurudumu lilikuwa kama linazunguka ndani ya lingine.
Ekegusii: Amagoro aria ane nigo agwekaine, kera okogoro nigo kwaroisirie kogasoanigwa nokonde.

English: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news, who proclaims salvation, who says to Zion, “Your God reigns!”
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi miguu ya wale waletao habari njema ilivyo mizuri juu ya milima, wale wanaotangaza amani, wanaoleta habari njema, wanaotangaza wokovu, wauambiao Sayuni, “Mungu wako anatawala!”
Ekegusii: Naki amagoro abo are amaseera, abwo bakorenta amang'ana amaya, bagoeta igoro ase ebitunwa, abwo bakoraria omorembe, na barenta obotomwa obore namang'ana amaya. Nigo bakoraria ogotooreka, bateebia Sayoni: “Nyasae oo nere okogaamba.”

English: It will be a special portion for them set apart from the land, a most holy portion adjacent to the territory of the Levites.
Kiswahili: Itakuwa toleo maalum kwao kutoka sehemu takatifu ya nchi, yaani, sehemu takatifu sana, inayopakana na nchi ya Walawi.
Ekegusii: Orogongo orwo nigo rorabe aase mokoruera okoruegwa ogochenu aatananire korwa ase ensemo eria ere enchenu. Nigo rorabe oroochenu mono robebekane norw’Abalawi.

English: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza kifuniko cha hema kwa ngozi za kondoo dume zilizotiwa rangi nyekundu, na juu yake kifuniko cha ngozi za pomboo.
Ekegusii: “Oroisie rirondia ri'amasankwa e chimingichi aakire etaago, ribe rigotuba eema, ne rirondia rinde ri'amasankwa amaterere e ching'iti chia rooche, ribe rikobekwa igoro ye rirondia rie ritang'ani.

English: O Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
Kiswahili: Ee nyumba ya Israeli, mtumainini Bwana, yeye ni msaada na ngao yao.
Ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, mosemerie Omonene; ere nere Omokonyi oino na enguba yaino.

English: Joshua said to Achan, “My son, please give glory to Yahweh, the God of Israel, and make confession to him. Tell me now what you have done! Don't hide it from me!”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yoshua akamwambia Akani, “Mwanangu, mtukuze Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, nawe ukiri kwake. Niambie ni nini ulichotenda; usinifiche.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yoshua agateebia Akani, “Omwana one, mosike Omonene Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, oyaorokie erinde ere atogigwe. Ontebie aya gwakorire, toyabisa!”

English: Even if you have been banished to the farthest horizon, He will gather you and return you from there.
Kiswahili: Hata kama umefukuziwa katika nchi ya mbali kiasi gani chini ya mbingu, kutoka huko Bwana Mungu wako atakukusanya na kukurudisha.
Ekegusii: Nonya mwasiareretwe gochia ase chinsinyo chi’ense, Omonene Nyasae oino, nabasangererie korwao,

English: He devours the barren who don't bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.
Kiswahili: Huwafanya mawindo wanawake tasa na wasio na watoto, nao hawaonyeshi huruma kwa wajane.
Ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akoibera omokungu omogomba; gose tari gokorera omoboraka amaya.

English: But the LORD replied, “Have you any right to be angry?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana akamjibu, “Je unayo haki yoyote kukasirika?”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akamobooria, “Inee! Igo mboronge ogokora ase okogechigwa igo?”

English: But I took your father Abraham from beyond the Euphrates and led him through all the land of Canaan, and I multiplied his descendants. I gave him Isaac,
Kiswahili: Lakini nilimwondoa baba yenu Abrahamu kutoka nchi hiyo ngʼambo ya Mto, nami nikamwongoza katika nchi yote ya Kanaani, nikampa wazao wengi. Nikampa Isaki,
Ekegusii: Korende inche nkarusia Aburaamu, sokoro yaino, korwa ng’umbu y’orooche orwo, nkamotang’ana, ere agaeta ase ense engima ya Kaanani; nkamenta oroiboro rwaye. Nkamoa Isaka,

English: Then Jesus said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at My hands. Reach out your hand and put it into My side. Stop doubting and believe.”
Kiswahili: Kisha akamwambia Tomaso, “Weka kidole chako hapa na uone mikono yangu, nyoosha mkono wako uguse ubavuni mwangu. Usiwe na shaka, bali uamini tu.”
Ekegusii: Erio agateebia Thomas, “Renta aiga ekiara kiao. Orore amaboko aane. Renta okoboko kwao, okobeke ase rikere riane; toba oyotegeneti, korende oyo bwegenete.”

English: he said, “Cursed be Canaan! A servant of servants shall he be to his brothers.” Shem’s Blessing and Noah’s Death
Kiswahili: akasema, “Alaaniwe Kanaani! Atakuwa mtumwa wa chini sana kuliko watumwa wote kwa ndugu zake.”
Ekegusii: agateeba, “Kaanani aragererigwe; nigo arabe omosomba bw’abasomba ase abamwabo.”

English: “But what about you?” Jesus asked. “Who do you say I am?”
Kiswahili: Akawauliza, “Je, ninyi mnasema mimi ni nani?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akababoria, “Nainwe mokobora ng’a ninche ning’o?”

English: The victory that day was turned into mourning among all the people, for the people heard it said that day, “The king grieves for his son.”
Kiswahili: Kwa jeshi lote, ushindi wa siku ile ukageuka kuwa maombolezo, kwa sababu siku ile vikosi vilisikia ikisemwa, “Mfalme anahuzunika kwa ajili ya mwanawe.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo omogooko bw'obobui okaonchoka okaba omoichano ase abanto bonsi ba Daudi, ekiagera ase rituko riria abanto nigo baigwete ng'a Daudi 'nkona‐korera are ase engencho y'omwana oye.

English: All the princes, the mighty men, and also all of the sons of King David submitted themselves to Solomon the king.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wote na mashujaa, pamoja na wana wote wa Daudi, wakaahidi kumtii Mfalme Solomoni.
Ekegusii: Abaraai bonsi, na abanto chituoni, amo nabamura bonsi ba Daudi omorwoti bakaria chiira ng'a mbabwatane nomorwoti Sulemani.

English: I want to know Christ and the power of His resurrection and the fellowship of His sufferings, being conformed to Him in His death,
Kiswahili: Nataka nimjue Kristo na uweza wa kufufuka kwake na ushirika wa mateso yake, ili nifanane naye katika mauti yake,
Ekegusii: Nindigetie komomanya Kristo ne chinguru chi’okobokigwa kwaye, inyare kobwatana nogochandwa kwaye, ngwekanigwe nere ase ogokwa kwaye;

English: and that they are valiant men. They told him of their wars and exploits which they do among the Gauls, and how they conquered them, and forced them to pay tribute;
Kiswahili: na kwamba wao ni mashujaa. Walimwambia kuhusu vita vyao na ushujaa wao wanaofanya miongoni mwa Wagaul, na jinsi walivyowashinda, na kuwalazimisha kulipa kodi;
Ekegusii: Boigo abanto mbamoteebetie Yudaigoro ye esegi ya Abaroma yarwanete, na buna bababuete Abagalatia noboremu na kobetereria abanto baabo kobaruera ebango.

English: Nevertheless he held to the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn't depart from them.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo akashikamana na dhambi za Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati, ambazo alisababisha Israeli kuzitenda, wala hakuziacha.
Ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, igo abwatanete nebibe bia omorwoti Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, biria akorete akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe; onde tabatangata.

English: My master’s wife Sarah has borne him a son in her old age, and my master has given him everything he owns.
Kiswahili: Sara mkewe bwana wangu amemzalia mwana katika uzee wake, naye amempa kila kitu alichokuwa nacho.
Ekegusii: Na Sara, moka omonene one, akamoiborera omwana omomura ekero amenyire omogotu; na omonene one oeire omwana oyio bionsi ebi abwate.

English: He had a son whose name was Saul, an impressive young man; and there was not among the children of Israel a more handsome person than he. From his shoulders and upward he was taller than any of the people.
Kiswahili: Alikuwa na mwana aliyeitwa Sauli, kijana anayevutia sana, hakuwepo aliyelingana naye miongoni mwa Waisraeli, alikuwa mrefu kuliko wengine wote.
Ekegusii: Nabwate omwana omomura ore korokwa Saulo. Ere nigo areenge omonyakieni mono. Momura onde tareenge ase egati y'Abaisraeli obwate ekieni ekiya komobua. Ere nigo aetanetie Abanto bande bonsi ase obotaambe bw'omotwe korwa ase amareko gochia igoro.

English: “What can we say to my lord?” Judah replied. “How can we plead? How can we justify ourselves? God has exposed the iniquity of your servants. We are now my lord’s slaves—both we and the one who was found with the cup.”
Kiswahili: Yuda akajibu, “Tutaweza kusema nini kwa bwana wangu? Tutaweza kuzungumza nini? Tutawezaje kuthibitisha kwamba hatuna hatia? Mungu amefunua hatia ya watumishi wako. Sasa sisi tu watumwa wa bwana wangu, sisi wenyewe pamoja na yule aliyepatikana na kikombe.”
Ekegusii: Yuda akairaneria: “Ninki togoteeba asore, Omonene oito? Ninki togokwana? Gose inatonyare kweenekia ng’a nabaronge tore? Nyasae ororire ebibe biaito intwe abasomba bao; na bono, omonene oito, intwe amo nere, oyo egekombe kianyorekana ase okoboko kwaye, tiga tobe abasomba bao.”

English: Then all the survivors from the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up year after year to worship the King, the LORD of Hosts, and to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.
Kiswahili: Kisha walionusurika katika mataifa yote ambayo yaliushambulia Yerusalemu watakuwa wakipanda Yerusalemu kila mwaka kumwabudu Mfalme, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote na kuadhimisha Sikukuu ya Vibanda.
Ekegusii: Erio omonto onde bwensi oratigare ore moyo korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku abwo bachete korwania abanto ba Yerusalemu nabe ogotiira omwaka ase omwaka gochia gosasiima Omorwoti, nere Omonene bw’Emeganda, naende narende Amatuko Amanene ay’Ebigutu.

English: I looked, and behold, you had sinned against Yahweh your God. You had made yourselves a molded calf. You had quickly turned away from the way which Yahweh had commanded you.
Kiswahili: Nilipotazama, niliona kuwa mmefanya dhambi dhidi ya Bwana Mungu wenu; mmejifanyia sanamu ya kusubu katika umbo la ndama. Mmegeuka upesi kutoka njia ile Bwana aliyowaagiza.
Ekegusii: Erio 'nkarora ng'a mwakorire ebibe ase Omonene, Nyasae oino: konya mweroiseirie omogwekano bw'emori onyititoire na kobombwa, na mwaonchokire bwango, mwatigire enchera eri'Omonene abachiigete mobwatie.

English: Whoever greets such a person shares in his evil deeds. Conclusion (3 John 1:13–14)
Kiswahili: Yeyote amkaribishaye mtu wa namna hiyo anashiriki katika matendo maovu ya mtu huyo. Salamu Za Mwisho
Ekegusii: Naki ere oyoramokwanie igo obwatanire nemeremo yaye emebe. Amang’ana ogokoorera

English: But God has surely heard; He has attended to the sound of my prayer.
Kiswahili: lakini hakika Mungu amenisikiliza na amesikia sauti yangu katika maombi.
Ekegusii: Korende ekeene, Nyasae ontegereire; ee, oigure eriogi ri’ogosaba kwane.

English: They are smashed to pieces from dawn to dusk; unnoticed, they perish forever.
Kiswahili: Kati ya mawio na machweo huvunjwa vipande vipande; bila yeyote kutambua, huangamia milele.
Ekegusii: Abanto nabo baranyare koba moyo ase engaki ya mambia, korende omogoroba otaraika, kwanyora baitirwe, basirire goika kare na kare, na onde tari okobechandera.

English: While Saul was talking to the priest, the commotion in the Philistine camp continued to increase. So Saul said to the priest, “Withdraw your hand.”
Kiswahili: Wakati Sauli alipokuwa akisema na kuhani, makelele katika kambi ya Wafilisti yakaongezeka zaidi na zaidi. Hivyo Sauli akamwambia kuhani, “Rudisha mkono wako.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Saulo agendererete gokwana n’Omokuani, eburu‐buru eyareenge ase egetwori ki’Abafilisti ekamentekana kobucha. Ase ayio Saulo akamoteebia, “Tiga, tobaisa kobori’Omonene.”

English: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?
Kiswahili: Au hamjasoma katika Sheria kwamba siku ya Sabato makuhani huvunja sheria ya Sabato Hekaluni lakini hawahesabiwi kuwa na hatia?
Ekegusii: Gose timwana gosoma ase amachiiko buna ase rituko ri' Esabato abakuani be Hekalu nigo bagosaria Esabato, na barabwo tibakoba nokomocha?

English: Who is the Almighty, that we should serve Him, and what would we gain if we pray to Him?’
Kiswahili: Mwenyezi ni nani hata tumtumikie? Tutapata faida gani kumwomba?
Ekegusii: Oria Omobui ninki are goika tomokorere? Mbitoki ki toranyore ase okomosaba?

English: but if he is afraid, and encamps beyond the river, we will cross over to him, and defeat him.”
Kiswahili: lakini akiogopa, na kupiga kambi ng'ambo ya mto, tutavuka kwenda kwake, na kumshinda.
Ekegusii: Korende ere aise kwoboa na gotenena ekeng'umbu, intwe nigo tokwamboka na komogwera na komobua.”

English: The total number of the firstborn males a month old or more, listed by name, was 22,273.
Kiswahili: Jumla ya hesabu ya wazaliwa wa kwanza waume wenye umri wa mwezi mmoja au zaidi, walioorodheshwa kwa majina, walikuwa 22,273.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abasacha abatangi n’abana abamura abatangi konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, na amagana abere, na merongo etano ebere, na batato (22,273).

English: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Hawa walifuatana na Yesu na kushughulikia mahitaji yake alipokuwa Galilaya. Pia walikuwepo wanawake wengine wengi waliokuwa wamekuja pamoja naye Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo bamotuny'anete ekero arenge Galili na komokorera, amo nabande abange abakungu abatiirete amo nere goika Yerusalemu.

English: On account of this, we are encouraged. In addition to our own encouragement, we were even more delighted by the joy of Titus. For his spirit has been refreshed by all of you.
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya haya tumefarijika. Zaidi ya kule sisi kutiwa moyo, tulifurahi sana kumwona Tito alivyo na furaha, kwa sababu roho yake imeburudishwa na ninyi nyote.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio twaremiigwe. Na kobua ase okoremigwa okwo tokagookera mono omogooko o Tito, ekiagera omoyo oye otimokigwe nainwe mwensi.

English: He will say, ‘I am not a prophet; I work the land, for I was purchased as a servant in my youth. ’
Kiswahili: Atasema, ‘Mimi sio nabii. Mimi ni mkulima; ardhi imekuwa kazi yangu tangu ujana wangu.’
Ekegusii: Kera oyomo obo nigo arakane atebe: Inche tindi omobani, korende nigo inde omoremi, ekiagera korwa obwana bwane nigo nagoretwe ngakorwa omosomba.

English: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:
Kiswahili: kwa dada yetu mpendwa Afia, kwa Arkipo askari mwenzetu na kwa kanisa lile likutanalo nyumbani mwako:
Ekegusii: Na abanto b'ekanisa ekoumerana ase enyomba yao, naboigo Apia, mosubati ominto, na Arikipo, omorwani ore amo naintwe.

English: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor; he was the son of a prostitute, and Gilead was his father.
Kiswahili: Basi Yefta Mgileadi alikuwa mtu shujaa. Baba yake alikuwa Gileadi, naye mama yake alikuwa kahaba.
Ekegusii: Yefta Omogileadi nigo arenge omorwani etuoni. Ere nigo arenge omwana bw’omokuungu omotayayi, na ise Yefta nigo arenge korokwa Gileadi.

English: Because you burned incense and sinned against the LORD, and did not obey the voice of the LORD or walk in His instruction, His statutes, and His testimonies, this disaster has befallen you, as you see today.”
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu mmefukiza uvumba na kufanya dhambi dhidi ya Bwana, nanyi hamkumtii wala kufuata sheria yake au amri zake au maagizo yake, maafa haya yamekuja juu yenu, kama mnavyoona sasa.”
Ekegusii: Amabe aya nigo abanyorire goika rituko eri ria reero, ekiagera inwe mwasambete ubani, naende mogakora ebibe ase Omonene, gose timwamoigwerete gose kobwatia amachiiko aye, na emeroberio yaye echiikire, na oborori bwaye.”

English: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Tikiko atawaambia habari zangu zote. Yeye ni ndugu mpendwa, mtendakazi mwaminifu na mtumishi mwenzangu katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Tukiko oyominto omwanchwa, omosomba omwegenwa, omosomba amo nainche ase Omonene, nabamanyie amang'ana aane onsi.

English: Let no foreigner who has joined himself to the LORD say, “The LORD will utterly exclude me from His people.” And let the eunuch not say, “I am but a dry tree.”
Kiswahili: Usimwache mgeni aambatanaye na Bwana aseme, “Hakika Bwana atanitenga na watu wake.” Usimwache towashi yeyote alalamike akisema, “Mimi ni mti mkavu tu.”
Ekegusii: Omonto bw’egesaku ekeao obwatanire n’Omonene tabaisa goteeba iga: “Ekeene, Omonene nigo aranyatanane korwa ase abanto baye”, na oyo ore omogomba tateeba iga: “Rora, inche nigo inde omote omwomo.”

English: Iron is taken from the earth, and copper is smelted from ore.
Kiswahili: Chuma hupatikana ardhini, nayo shaba huyeyushwa kutoka mawe ya madini.
Ekegusii: Ebioma nigo bigokunywa korwa riroba inse, ne chitaai nigo chikonyorwa ase amagena ’ebitare anyititorwa.

English: Then the man said to me, “The north and south chambers facing the temple courtyard are the holy chambers where the priests who approach the LORD will eat the most holy offerings. There they will place the most holy offerings—the grain offerings, the sin offerings, and the guilt offerings—for the place is holy.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaniambia, “Vyumba vya upande wa kaskazini na vya upande wa kusini ambavyo vinaelekeana na ukumbi wa Hekalu ni vyumba vya makuhani, mahali ambapo wale makuhani ambao humkaribia Bwana watakula zile sadaka takatifu sana. Huko ndiko watakakoweka zile sadaka takatifu sana, yaani, sadaka za nafaka, sadaka za dhambi na sadaka za hatia, kwa kuwa mahali ni patakatifu.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria aganteebia, “Ebinyomba ebio bire ensemo ya sugusu, na ebia Irianyi, kororia aase atigire ataagachiri, ebio nebichenu. Abakuani abwo bagotenena ase obosio bw’Omonene nao barabe bakoriera ebing’wanso bire ebichenu mono; agwo nao barabeeke ebing’wanso bire ebichenu mono: okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebing’wanso bi’ebibe, na ebi’okomocha, ekiagera aase agwo naachenu.

English: From the sons of Naphtali, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Naftali: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Nafutali bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

English: Then Joseph declared, “Just as I said, you are spies!
Kiswahili: Yosefu akawaambia, “Ni sawa kabisa kama nilivyowaambia: Ninyi ni wapelelezi!
Ekegusii: Korende Yusufu akabateebia “Nabo ere buna konya naikire kobateebia, ng’a inwe nechirooti more.

English: Therefore this is what the LORD, the God of Hosts, the Lord, says: “There will be wailing in all the public squares and cries of ‘Alas! Alas!’ in all the streets. The farmer will be summoned to mourn, and the mourners to wail.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana, Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, asemalo: “Kutakuwepo maombolezo katika barabara zote na vilio vya uchungu katika njia kuu zote. Wakulima wataitwa kuja kulia, na waombolezaji waje kuomboleza.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, oyore Omonene, atebiire: “Ebirero mbibe ase chiraaro chionsi chi’omochie, na ase chinchera chiaye chionsi abanto barere bakobuga: Obee! Obee! Mbarangerie abaremi bache korera, na abamanyete kobokia amagombo bache kweng’ereria.

English: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.
Kiswahili: Anenaye kwa lugha hujijenga mwenyewe, bali atoaye unabii hulijenga kanisa.
Ekegusii: Oyogokwana ase omonwa otamanyekaneti nigo akweagacha ere omonyene; korende oyokobana nigo akoagacha ekanisa.

English: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.
Kiswahili: Lakini mtu yeyote asipokuwa na mambo haya haoni mbali, na ni kipofu, naye amesahau kule kutakaswa kutoka dhambi zake za zamani.
Ekegusii: Naki ere oyotari namang'ana ayio nomouko, takonyara korora amang'ana are bosio, na bwebire ogosibigwa kw'ebibe biaye bia kare.

English: About noon as I was approaching Damascus, suddenly a bright light from heaven flashed around me.
Kiswahili: “Nilipokuwa njiani kuelekea Dameski, yapata saa sita mchana, ghafula nuru kubwa kutoka mbinguni ikanimulika kotekote.
Ekegusii: “Erio ekero nare kogenda, konaikire ang’e na Damesiki, ekero kia mobaso gati mobosokano amasase akarwa igoro akambarera chinsemo chionsi.

English: and that their children, who have not known, may hear and learn to fear Yahweh your God, as long as you live in the land where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”
Kiswahili: Watoto wao, ambao hawaijui sheria hii, lazima waisikie na kujifunza kumcha Bwana Mungu wenu kwa muda mtakaoishi katika nchi mnayovuka Yordani kuimiliki.”
Ekegusii: Erio abana baabo konya bataramanya amachiiko aya, bayaigwe na kweorokereria komoiroka Omonene, Nyasae oino, ekero moraabe mogendererete komenya ase ense eria ng'umbu ya Yorodani, eyio mogochia koira ebe eyaino.”

English: It came to pass, when she had ceased to cry to the God of Israel, and had finished saying all these words,
Kiswahili: Ikawa, alipokwisha kumwomba Mungu wa Israeli, na kumaliza kusema maneno hayo yote,
Ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Yuditi akoorire komoreera Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli,

English: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.
Kiswahili: Siku zote za wanaoonewa ni za taabu, bali moyo mchangamfu una karamu ya kudumu.
Ekegusii: Amatuko onsi ay'omonto ochaandegete nigo are amabe, korende oyore n'enkoro y'omosasoko nigo akogeenderera koba n'omoyega o botambe.

English: With a strong hand, an outstretched arm, and outpoured wrath I will bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands to which you have been scattered.
Kiswahili: Nitawatoa toka katika mataifa na kuwakusanya kutoka nchi mlikotawanywa, kwa mkono wa nguvu na kwa mkono ulionyooshwa na kwa ghadhabu iliyomwagwa.
Ekegusii: Ee, ase okoboko kwane kore nokobua koramboire, na ase okoumora ekeririanda kiane, nimbarusie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku, mbasangererie korwa ase chinse echio mwasiareretwe gochia.

English: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.
Kiswahili: Lakini, mtoto wa mwanamke mtumwa alizaliwa kwa mapenzi ya mwili, na yule mwingine wa mwanamke huru alizaliwa kutokana na ahadi ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende omwana oria bw'omokuungu omosomba akaiborwa buna monto onde bwensi; na oria bw'omokuungu omonyuome, oyotarenge omosomba, akaiborwa ase eira.

English: God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.
Kiswahili: Mungu alitoka Temani, yeye Aliye Mtakatifu kutoka Mlima Parani. Utukufu wake ulifunika mbingu, na sifa zake zikaifunika dunia.
Ekegusii: Nyasae ngocha are korwa Temani ee, Ere oyore Omochenu ngocha are korwa ase egetunwa gia Parani. Obonene bwaye mbotube igoro chionsi, na ense neichorwe nogotogigwa kwaye.

English: I am the first to say to Zion, ‘Behold, look at them;' and I will give one who brings good news to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Nilikuwa wa kwanza kumwambia Sayuni, ‘Tazama, wako hapa!' Nilimpa Yerusalemu mjumbe wa habari njema.
Ekegusii: Ninche Omonene nigo narenge omotang'ani goteebia Sayoni: Rigereria, morore abwo! Ninche narenterete Yerusalemu abwo bararetie amang'ana amaya.

English: You took some of your garments and made colorful high places for yourself, and on them you prostituted yourself. Such things should not have happened; never should they have occurred!
Kiswahili: Ulichukua baadhi ya mavazi yako ukayatumia kupamba mahali pako pa juu pa kuabudia miungu, mahali ambapo ulifanyia ukahaba wako. Mambo ya namna hiyo hayastahili kutendeka wala kamwe kutokea.
Ekegusii: Okaira chianga chiao, ogaachabera aase aimokererete igoro akaba nebieni ao ao, na aroro agwo ogakorera obonyaka bwao. Amang’ana anga buna ayio tana gokorekana korwa kare, na tagokorekana aande nonya ng’ake.

English: With me are riches and honor, enduring wealth and righteousness.
Kiswahili: Utajiri na heshima viko kwangu, utajiri udumuo na mafanikio.
Ekegusii: Ninche ’nkorua obonda, na esiko, boigo obotenenku na oboronge bitari koera.

English: Samuel said to Saul, “Why have you disturbed me, to bring me up?” Saul answered, “I am very distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God has departed from me, and answers me no more, by prophets, or by dreams. Therefore I have called you, that you may make known to me what I shall do.”
Kiswahili: Samweli akamuuliza Sauli, “Kwa nini unanitaabisha kwa kunipandisha juu?” Sauli akasema, “Mimi ninasumbuka sana, kwa maana Wafilisti wanapigana vita dhidi yangu, naye Mungu ameniacha. Hanijibu tena wala kwa njia ya manabii wala kwa ndoto. Kwa hiyo nimekuita wewe ili unijulishe la kufanya.”
Ekegusii: Samweli akabooria Saulo: “Nase ki gwanchandire okondeta korwa ase omotimoko one.” Saulo akairaneria: “Inche nigo nchandegete mono; Abafirisiti nkondwania bare esegi, na Nyasae onyangire, tari kong'iraneria, goetera ase ababani, gose ase chindoto. Ase ayio nigo nakorangeirie, erinde onteebie eki ndakore.”

English: Absalom said to him, “Behold, your matters are good and right; but there is no man deputized by the king to hear you.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Absalomu angemwambia, “Tazama, malalamiko yako ni ya haki na sawasawa, lakini hakuna mwakilishi wa mfalme wa kukusikiliza.”
Ekegusii: Abisalomu omoteebia, “Rora, amang'ana ao namaya, naende amaronge, korende monto onde tari aa omorwoti abeegete orakoigwere.”

English: Behold, all these things God does to a man, two or even three times,
Kiswahili: “Mungu hufanya haya yote kwa mwanadamu; mara mbili hata mara tatu,
Ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae nigo agokora amang’ana ayio onsi ase omonto ara kabere, gose ara gatato,

English: but you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old, all without defect;
Kiswahili: Toeni sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya fahali mmoja mchanga, kondoo dume mmoja, na wana-kondoo saba wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari, kama harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Morue eeri ensae eyemo, na emingichi eyemo, ne chimanwa chimingichi isan'aibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo. Echio nchibe ekeng'wanso ki'ogosambwa kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.

English: so that none of the remnant of Judah, who have gone into the land of Egypt to live there, will escape or be left to return into the land of Judah, to which they have a desire to return to dwell there; for no one will return except those who will escape.'”
Kiswahili: Hakuna hata mmoja wa mabaki ya Yuda ambaye amekwenda kuishi Misri atakayeepuka au kunusurika ili kurudi katika nchi ya Yuda, ambayo wanaitamani sana kurudi na kuishi ndani yake, hakuna hata mmoja atakayerudi isipokuwa wakimbizi wachache.”
Ekegusii: Nonya nomonto oyomo ase abatigari b'Abayuda abwo bachete komenya ase ense ya Misiri tagotooreka, gose koirana gochia ase ense y'Abayuda, eyio baganetie bairane gochia komenyao. Tibakonyara koirana, otatiga abanto bake abaratooreke.”

English: “You have observed correctly,” said the LORD, “for I am watching over My word to accomplish it.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akaniambia, “Umeona vyema kwa maana ninaliangalia neno langu ili kuona kwamba limetimizwa.”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene aganteebia, “Kwarorire boronge, ekiagera inche nigo ntengerete, indore ng’a ring’ana riane riaikeranire ase ekeene.”

English: For Yahweh of Armies says: “As I thought to do evil to you when your fathers provoked me to wrath,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I didn't repent,
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Kama nilivyokuwa nimekusudia kuleta maangamizi juu yenu, wakati baba zenu waliponikasirisha na sikuonyesha huruma,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote,
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw'Emeganda agoteeba: Buna koreng'ana naroberetie kobarentera amabe, ekero chisokoro chiaino chiakorete ebibe chikagera nkaba nendamwamu, gose tinaonchorete omooroberio oyio,

English: to establish among them an annual celebration on the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month of Adar
Kiswahili: akiwataka kila mwaka washerehekee siku ya kumi na nne na ya kumi na tano ya mwezi wa Adari
Ekegusii: akabateebia ng’a barende rituko ria ikomi na kane, na eria ikomi na gatano, ase omotienyi bw’Adari, omwaka ase omwaka, abe Amatuko Amanene.

English: Do not take my soul away with sinners, or my life with men of bloodshed,
Kiswahili: Usiiondoe nafsi yangu pamoja na watenda dhambi, wala uhai wangu pamoja na wamwagao damu,
Ekegusii: Tosiria omoyo one ekero ogosiria abanyabibe; gose obogima bwane ekero ogosiria abaiti.

English: God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, wakomboe Israeli, katika shida zao zote!
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, booria Abaisraeli korwa ase emechando yabo yonsi.

English: because of the sins Jeroboam had committed and had caused Israel to commit, and because he had provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu ya dhambi alizokuwa amezitenda Yeroboamu na kusababisha Israeli kuzitenda, tena kwa sababu alimkasirisha Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Aya nigo akoregete ase engencho y’ebibe bia Yeroboamu biria akorete, naende akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe, na ase engencho y’ayi’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, akaba nendamwamu.

English: There were born to him seven sons and three daughters.
Kiswahili: Alikuwa na wana saba na binti watatu,
Ekegusii: Ere nabwate abana abamura batano na babere, na abaiseke batato.

English: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya wanafunzi kutoka Kaisaria wakafuatana nasi na kutupeleka nyumbani kwa Mnasoni, ambaye tungekaa kwake. Yeye alikuwa mtu wa Kipro, mmoja wa wanafunzi wa zamani.
Ekegusii: Abande baborokigwa ba Kaisaria bakagenda amo naintwe, bagatoira mwa Mnasoni, omonto o Kuporo, omworokigwa o kare, tokarara bwoye.

English: You are the light of the world. A city on a hill cannot be hidden.
Kiswahili: “Ninyi ni nuru ya ulimwengu. Mji uliojengwa kilimani hauwezi kufichika.
Ekegusii: Inwe noborabu bw’ense. Omochie tokobiseka koagachire ase egetunwa igoro.

English: and said, “Prophesy to us, Christ! Who hit You?” Peter Denies Jesus (Mark 14:66–72; Luke 22:54–62; John 18:15–18)
Kiswahili: na kusema, “Tutabirie, wewe Kristo! Ni nani aliyekupiga?” Petro Amkana Bwana Yesu (Marko 14:66-72; Luka 22:56-62; Yohana 18:15-18, 25-27)
Ekegusii: bakobora, “Kristo, tobanere! Ning’o ogoaka?” Petero okomokana Yeso (Mar 14:66-72; Luk 22:56-62; Yoh 18:15-18,25-27)

English: So he had the ark of the LORD carried around the city, circling it once. And the people returned to the camp and spent the night there.
Kiswahili: Basi akalipeleka Sanduku la Bwana kuzungushwa huo mji, likizungushwa mara moja. Kisha watu wakarudi kambini kulala.
Ekegusii: Esanduki eria ekabogorigwa goetanana omochie ara rimo. Erio bonsi bakairana ase batoorete, bakabeerao obotuko boria.

English: So the poor have hope, and injustice shuts its mouth.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo maskini analo tarajio, nao udhalimu hufumba kinywa chake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio abaremerwa mbabe nogosemeria, korende abakori amabe nigo barakirigwe‐kiri.

English: Magnify his name and give utterance to his praise with the songs on your lips and with harps! Say this when you utter his praise:
Kiswahili: Litukuzeni jina lake na mtamke sifa zake kwa nyimbo za midomo yenu na kwa vinubi! Semeni hivi mnapotoa sifa zake:
Ekegusii: Togia obonene bw'erieta riaye, motogie goetera ase chingeero chikomotogia, momotogie ase ebikoba biaino namakano.

English: then you shall inquire, investigate, and ask diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination was done among you,
Kiswahili: ndipo itakubidi kuuliza, kupima na kuchunguza kwa makini. Kama ni kweli, tena ikihakikishwa kwamba jambo hili lichukizalo limefanyika miongoni mwenu,
Ekegusii: Mouna‐unie mono amang'ana ayio, erio momanye buya gose nabo are. Onye okogeechia buna okwo gwakorekanire ase egati yaino,

English: The allotment for the descendants of Joseph extended from the Jordan at Jericho to the waters of Jericho on the east, through the wilderness that goes up from Jericho into the hill country of Bethel.
Kiswahili: Mgawanyo wa Yosefu ulianzia Yordani ya Yeriko, mashariki mwa miji ya Yeriko na kutoka hapo ulipanda kupitia jangwani na kuingia katika nchi ya vilima ya Betheli.
Ekegusii: Orobebe rw’orogongo roria obomera bwagwerete ororeria rwa Yusufu rogaachakera orooche rwa Yorodani, ang’e na Yeriko, moocha ye chinsoko chi’aroro goika erooro, rogatiira korwa Yeriko goetera ase erooro gochia ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Beteli.

English: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.
Kiswahili: Siku ya Pentekoste ilipowadia, waamini wote walikuwa mahali pamoja.
Ekegusii: Ekero rituko ria Pentekosti riaigete, aborokigwa ba Yeso bonsi nigo barenge aase aamo.

English: All the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.
Kiswahili: Kisha watu wote wa Yuda wakamchukua Azaria aliyekuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na sita, na kumfanya mfalme mahali pa baba yake Amazia.
Ekegusii: Erio Abayuda bonsi bakabeeka Asaria akaba omorwoti ribaga ri'Amasia ise. Asaria nigo arenge nemiaka ikomi na etano nomo ekero keria.

English: Three sons were born to Absalom, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar. She was a woman with a beautiful face.
Kiswahili: Walizaliwa wana watatu na binti mmoja kwa Absalomu. Jina la binti yake aliitwa Tamari, naye akawa mwanamke mzuri wa sura.
Ekegusii: Abisalomu nigo aiboreretwe amo n'abamura batato, na omoiseke oyomo ore korokwa Tamari. Ere nigo areenge omoiseke omonyakieni.

English: and the king declared, “Cut the living child in two and give half to one and half to the other.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo mfalme akatoa amri: “Mkate mtoto aliye hai vipande viwili; mpe huyu nusu na mwingine nusu.”
Ekegusii: agateeba, “Butorane omwana oyo ore moyo ebing’ese bibere, ekeng’ese ekemo keegwe omokungu oyomo, na ekende keegwe oyonde.”

English: “He who is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and bathe himself in water; and he shall be clean. After that he shall come into the camp, but shall dwell outside his tent seven days.
Kiswahili: “Huyo mtu atakayetakaswa ni lazima afue nguo zake, anyoe nywele zake zote, na aoge kwa maji; ndipo atakapokuwa safi kwa desturi ya ibada. Baada ya hili anaweza kuingia kambini, lakini ni lazima akae nje ya hema lake kwa siku saba.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria ogochia gochenwa goika asibie chianga chiaye, na akigite etukia yaye yonsi, naende esibie omobere namaache, erio abe oyochenegete. Magega y'ayio asoe ase egetwori, korende abeere isiko y'eema yaye ase engaki y'amatuko atano na abere,

English: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns!”
Kiswahili: Mbingu na zishangilie, nchi na ifurahi; semeni katikati ya mataifa, “Bwana anatawala!”
Ekegusii: Tiga enyancha echenge ase okoeera, amo n'ebinto bionsi bire ime yaye, na emegondo echenge amo n'ebinto bionsi bireo.

English: Already you have all you want. Already you have become rich. Without us, you have become kings. How I wish you really were kings, so that we might be kings with you!
Kiswahili: Sasa tayari mnayo yale yote mnayohitaji! Tayari mmekwisha kuwa matajiri! Mmekuwa wafalme, tena bila sisi! Laiti mngekuwa wafalme kweli ili na sisi tupate kuwa wafalme pamoja nanyi!
Ekegusii: Mwaikire koigota! Mwaikire konyora obotenenku! Mwanyorire oborwoti intwe totaiyo! Anga mbuya onye mwagambete, erinde naintwe togambe amo nainwe!

English: My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away;
Kiswahili: Lakini ndugu zangu sio wa kutegemewa, ni kama vijito vya msimu, ni kama vijito ambavyo hufurika
Ekegusii: Abaminto bakorire obong'ainereria babeire buna chintuboka chi'amaache, na buna chiooro chi'emegoko chigoeta chiaera.

English: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.
Kiswahili: Upumbavu humfurahisha mtu ambaye hana akili, bali mtu mwenye ufahamu hushika njia iliyonyooka.
Ekegusii: Oboriri nigo bore omogooko ase omonto otabwati obomanyi, korende omonto omong'aini nigo akobwatia chiinchera chi'oboronge.

English: including us, whom He has called not only from the Jews, but also from the Gentiles?
Kiswahili: yaani pamoja na sisi, ambao pia alituita, si kutoka kwa Wayahudi peke yao, bali pia kutoka kwa watu wa Mataifa? Yote Yalitabiriwa Katika Maandiko
Ekegusii: Abwo nintwe, twarangeretigwe nere, tari korwa ase Abayahudi boka, korende nonya nkorwa ase abanto b’Ebisaku boigo.

English: A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media's sighing.
Kiswahili: Nimeonyeshwa maono ya kutisha: Msaliti anasaliti, mteka nyara anateka nyara. Elamu, shambulia! Umedi, izunguke kwa jeshi! Nitakomesha huzuni zote alizosababisha.
Ekegusii: Inche norokigwe okorora kore ogokong'u mono; abaurereria nigo bagendererete kourereria, na abasaria bagendererete gosaria. Inwe Abaelamu, genda morwane! Inwe Abamedia, genda moboere! Ninsirie obororo bwonsi bwarentirwe n'Abaababeli.

English: Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition. To this end, stay alert with all perseverance in your prayers for all the saints.
Kiswahili: Mkiomba kwa Roho siku zote katika sala zote na maombi, mkikesha kila wakati mkiwaombea watakatifu wote.
Ekegusii: Mosabe botambe ase Omoika ase ogosaba gwonsi na ase okoboria kw’ogosorora, na gotagesia ase kera ring’ana. Mogenderere gosabera abachenu bonsi.

English: But Abram replied, “Lord GOD, how can I know that I will possess it?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Abramu akasema, “Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, nitawezaje kujua kwamba nitapata kuimiliki?”
Ekegusii: Aburamu akamobooria: “Inee! Aye Omonene, naki ndakore imanye ng’a nebe omwando one bori?”

English: These were heads of fathers' households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Hawa wote walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao wakuu, kama ilivyoorodheshwa katika koo zao, nao waliishi Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Aba nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo ase ebiaare biabo; nigo barenge abaraai abanene. Abwo nigo bamenyete Yerusalemu.

English: How the gold has become dim! The most pure gold has changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.
Kiswahili: Jinsi dhahabu ilivyopoteza mngʼao wake, dhahabu iliyo safi haingʼai! Vito vya thamani vimetawanywa kwenye mwanzo wa kila barabara.
Ekegusii: Naki etaabu yasiririe obomeka‐meku bwaye! Naki etaabu echenire yaonchokire! Amagena aya Aase Aachenu asiareirwe ase amatabekania e chinchera chionsi.

English: When these days were fulfilled, the king made a seven day feast for all the people who were present in Susa the palace, both great and small, in the court of the garden of the king's palace.
Kiswahili: Siku hizo zilipopita, mfalme alifanya karamu kwa muda wa siku saba, katika bustani ya ndani katika jumba la kifalme, kwa ajili ya watu wote kuanzia mdogo hadi mkubwa, waliokuwa katika ngome ya mji wa Shushani.
Ekegusii: Amatuko ayio kaerire, akaroisia omoyega omonene ase abanto bonsi, abanene na abake, abarenge agwo Susa, omochie omonene. Omoyega oyio okabeera ase eraaro y'egeticha yagiteire, yarenge ase enyomba y'omorwoti, na okagenderera ase amatuko atano na abere.

English: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.
Kiswahili: Ndipo akafungua fahamu zao ili waweze kuyaelewa Maandiko.
Ekegusii: Erio akaigora chinkoro chiabo, banyare komanya amariiko.

English: and said, “My God forbid me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?” For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Mungu apishie mbali kwamba nifanye hivi! Je kweli, niinywe damu ya watu hawa waliohatarisha maisha yao?” Kwa sababu walihatarisha maisha yao kuyaleta yale maji, Daudi hakukubali kuyanywa. Huo ndio uliokuwa ujasiri wa wale mashujaa watatu.
Ekegusii: akabora, “Omonene ontange tiyanywa. Aya nigo anga buna nkonywa amanyinga 'abaanto bataegerete obogima bwabo ase okorenta amaache aya.” Ase ayio akaanga tayanywa. Ayio naro abanto abwo chituoni batato bakorete.

English: But the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were entrusted with the rooms and the treasuries of the house of God.
Kiswahili: Lakini mabawabu wanne wakuu, waliokuwa Walawi, walikabidhiwa wajibu kwa ajili ya vyumba na hazina katika nyumba ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Abalawi baria baane abarenge abateneneri b’emeremo y’okorenda ebiita nabwo batenenerete ebinyomba ne chikungo chi’enyomba ya Nyasae.

English: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as Yahweh had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.
Kiswahili: Mose akakagua kazi na kuona kuwa walikuwa wameifanya sawasawa kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa ameagiza. Kwa hiyo Mose akawabariki.
Ekegusii: Musa akariga‐rigereria ebinto bionsi ebiakoretwe, akarora ng'a abanto babikorire boronge kegima buna Omonene konya achiikire. Erio Musa akabasesenia.

English: He who loves gold won't be justified. He who follows destruction will himself have his fill of it.
Kiswahili: Yeye apendaye dhahabu hatahesabiwa haki; Yeye afuataye uharibifu atashiba mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi bwanchete chitaabu takobarwa koba omooronge ekiagera okorigia kwaye chitaabu nigo gokomokora omomochi.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, wrote.
Kiswahili: Matukio mengine ya utawala wa Uzia, kuanzia mwanzo mpaka mwisho, yameandikwa na nabii Isaya mwana wa Amozi.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana ande onsi igoro ya Usia, korwa omochakano goika omoerio, nigo ariikire na Isaya omobani, mosinto bw'Amosi.

English: If any of it is eaten on the third day, it is tainted and will not be accepted.
Kiswahili: Kama sehemu yoyote ya sadaka hiyo italiwa siku ya tatu, itakuwa si safi, nayo haitakubaliwa.
Ekegusii: Chiise koriegwa ase rituko ria gatato, ekeng’wanso ekio inakebe okogechia, tikegwancherwa.

English: They sent to me four times like this; and I answered them the same way.
Kiswahili: Mara nne walinitumia ujumbe wa namna iyo hiyo, na kila mara niliwapa jibu lile lile.
Ekegusii: Bagatoma abanto ase 'nde chintunda inye, bagokwana amang'ana aria aria, na inche nkaba nkobairaneria amang'ana aria aria konya nabateebirie ritang'ani.

English: Enoch, the seventh from Adam, also prophesied about them: “Behold, the Lord is coming with myriads of His holy ones
Kiswahili: Enoki, mtu wa saba kuanzia Adamu alitoa unabii kuhusu watu hawa, akisema: “Tazama, Bwana anakuja pamoja na maelfu kwa maelfu ya watakatifu wake,
Ekegusii: Na Enoku, omonto o gatano na kabere korwa ase Adamu, nakwanete amang’ana obobani igoro y’abwo, ogoteeba, “Rigereria, Omonene nache nabachenu baye chilifu ne chilifu,

English: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? For as for me, immediately there remained no strength in me. There was no breath left in me.”
Kiswahili: Bwana wangu, mimi mtumishi wako nitawezaje kuzungumza na wewe? Nguvu zangu zimeniishia hata ninashindwa kupumua.”
Ekegusii: Inaki inche omosomba oo ndanyare gokwana naye, Omonene one? Chinguru chionsi chiarure asende, na tindi n'Omoika ime y'ane.”

English: For you will not leave in a hurry nor flee in haste, for the LORD goes before you, and the God of Israel is your rear guard. The Servant Exalted (Philippians 2:5–11)
Kiswahili: Lakini hamtaondoka kwa haraka, wala hamtakwenda kwa kukimbia; kwa maana Bwana atatangulia mbele yenu, Mungu wa Israeli atakuwa mlinzi nyuma yenu. Mateso Na Utukufu Wa Mtumishi
Ekegusii: Ekero morasoke korwao, timokoayerera, gose timogotama, ekiagera Omonene natang’ane bosio bwaino; ee, ere Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli nababwatie korwa magega abe obarendete. Omosomba bw’Omonene ochandegete

English: Hear, O LORD, my righteous plea; listen to my cry. Give ear to my prayer— it comes from lips free of deceit.
Kiswahili: Sikia, Ee Bwana, kusihi kwangu kwa haki, sikiliza kilio changu. Tega sikio kwa ombi langu, halitoki kwenye midomo ya udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe okogania kwane kw’ogokorerwa oboronge, igwa okorera kwane na ogosaba kwane, omonwa one tori gokwana obong’ainereria.

English: Wine drunk in season and in moderation is joy of heart and gladness of soul:
Kiswahili: Mvinyo ikinywewa kwa wakati wake na kwa kiasi ni furaha ya moyo na furaha ya roho:
Ekegusii: Okonywa Edivai ase ekerengo nechingaki chiaye nigo bikorenta omogooko ase omoyo nemosasoko ase enkoro.

English: You must not give any of your children to be sacrificed to Molech, for you must not profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Usimtoe mtoto wako yeyote awe kafara kwa mungu Moleki, kwani hutalinajisi kamwe jina la Mungu wako. Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa korua omwana onde oo abe ekeng’wanso ase enyasae Moleki, ekiagera okwo nokorentera erieta ria Nyasae oo obosooku. Inche ninche Omonene.

English: while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant Jesus.”
Kiswahili: Nyoosha mkono wako ili kuponya wagonjwa na kutenda ishara na miujiza kwa jina la Mwanao mtakatifu Yesu.”
Ekegusii: Rambora okoboko kwao, naende ancha buna ebikone binyare gokorekana goetera ase erieta ri'Omosomba oo omochenu, Yeso.

English: Cutting away the anchors, they left them in the sea as they loosened the ropes that held the rudders. Then they hoisted the foresail to the wind and made for the beach.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakatupa nanga zote na kuziacha baharini, na wakati huo huo wakalegeza kamba zilizokuwa zikishikilia usukani wa meli. Kisha wakatweka tanga la mbele lishike upepo na kuisukuma meli kuelekea pwani.
Ekegusii: Bakaruta ebirochi biria, bakabitiga nyancha ime, bakaororobia chingori chi’ebionchori, bagatiiria egetambaa kia bosio embeo ekeguserere, bakaonchora emeeri gochia engegu.

English: As the flock for sacrifice, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts, so the waste cities will be filled with flocks of men. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.'”
Kiswahili: kuwa wengi kama kundi la kondoo kwa ajili ya dhabihu huko Yerusalemu wakati wa sikukuu zao za wakati ulioamriwa. Hivyo ndivyo miji iliyokuwa magofu itajazwa na makundi ya watu. Ndipo watakapojua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Nimbamentekanie babe abange buna ching'ondi chichenegete chirabe echi'ebing'wanso agwo Yerusalemu, ase engaki y'Amatuko Amanene; barabwo mbaichore ase emechie yatigetwe ere amatombe. Erio nario baramanye ng'a inche ninche Omonene.”

English: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away, so he who goes down to Sheol will come up no more.
Kiswahili: Kama vile wingu liondokavyo na kutoweka, vivyo hivyo yeye ashukaye kaburini harudi tena.
Ekegusii: Buna koreng'ana riire rigokubakubana riasira, naboigo noyokogenda aase abakuure atakoirana korwao.

English: I will make your house like that of Jeroboam son of Nebat and like that of Baasha son of Ahijah, because you have provoked My anger and caused Israel to sin.’
Kiswahili: Nitaifanya nyumba yako kama ile ya Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati na ile ya Baasha mwana wa Ahiya, kwa sababu umenighadhibisha kwa kuwa umesababisha Israeli kutenda dhambi.’
Ekegusii: Ninkore enyomba yao ebe buna eya Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, naende ebe buna enyomba ya Baasa, mosinto bw’Ahiya, ekiagera kwangechirie goika nabeire nendamwamu, naende kwagerire Abaisraeli bakorire ebibe.

English: All Israel in the days of Zerubbabel and in the days of Nehemiah gave the portions of the singers and the gatekeepers, as every day required; and they set apart that which was for the Levites; and the Levites set apart that which was for the sons of Aaron.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo katika siku za Zerubabeli na za Nehemia, Israeli wote walitoa mafungu kila siku kwa ajili ya waimbaji na mabawabu. Pia walitenga fungu kwa ajili ya Walawi wengine, nao Walawi walitenga fungu kwa ajili ya wazao wa Aroni.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko a Serubabeli, na aya Nehemia, Abaisraeli bonsi nigo barenge korua kera rituko ebiegwa biachikeire abateri na abarendi b'ebiita. Boigo naende bakaba bakoa Abalawi ebitari ebi baatananeretwe, na Abalawi barabwo bakaa abanto b'ororeria rwa Aroni ebitari biabo.

English: Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long.
Kiswahili: hakika, amegeuza mkono wake dhidi yangu tena na tena, mchana kutwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, nigo akona‐koonchora okoboko kwaye igoro yane, ekero ase ekero omobaso boira.

English: Then the king ordered the guards at his side, “Turn and kill the priests of the LORD, because they too sided with David. For they knew he was fleeing, but they did not tell me.” But the king’s servants would not lift a hand to strike the priests of the LORD.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mfalme akawaamuru walinzi wake waliokuwa kando yake: “Geukeni na kuwaua makuhani wa Bwana, kwa sababu nao pia wamejiunga na Daudi. Walijua kuwa alikuwa anakimbia, wala hawakuniambia.” Lakini maafisa wa mfalme hawakuwa radhi kuinua mkono kuwaua makuhani wa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti agateebia abarendi abwo bamoetanaine: “Imoka, moite abakuani abwo ba Omonene, ekiagera nigo babwataine na Daudi. Boigo barabwo mbamanyete ng’a otamire na tibantebetie.” Korende abasomba b’omorwoti bakaanga korambora amaboko abo ase ogoita abakuani ba Omonene.

English: and if you give yourself to the hungry and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will go forth in the darkness, and your night will be like noonday.
Kiswahili: nanyi kama mkimkunjulia mtu mwenye njaa nafsi zenu na kutosheleza mahitaji ya walioonewa, ndipo nuru yenu itakapongʼaa gizani, nao usiku wenu utakuwa kama adhuhuri.
Ekegusii: korakonye abare nenchara na oe oyochandegete eki’aremeire, rirorio omobaso oo nobare ase omosunte, na obotuko bwao mbobe buna mobaso gati.

English: But when the Jews from Thessalonica learned that Paul was also proclaiming the word of God in Berea, they went there themselves to incite and agitate the crowds.
Kiswahili: Lakini wale Wayahudi wa Thesalonike waliposikia kuwa Paulo anahubiri neno la Mungu huko Beroya, wakaenda huko ili kuwashawishi watu na kuwachochea.
Ekegusii: Korende Abayahudi ba Tesaloniki, ekero baigwete ng’a ring’ana ria Nyasae riarandigwe na Paulo ase Beroya, bakagenda aroro bakaburukania abanto na kobarubania.

English: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.
Kiswahili: ambaye alipata kibali kwa Mungu, naye akaomba kwamba ampatie Mungu wa Yakobo maskani.
Ekegusii: oyio onyorete ogwancherwa ase obosio bwa Nyasae, agasaba ng'a anyorere Nyasae o Yakobo obomenyo.

English: Listen and hear my voice. Pay attention and hear what I say.
Kiswahili: Sikilizeni msikie sauti yangu, tegeni masikio na msikie niyasemayo.
Ekegusii: Tegerera moigwe eriogi riane; igwera amang’ana aane ngokwana!

English: “‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, blasphemes Yahweh. That soul shall be cut off from among his people.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini yeyote ambaye amefanya dhambi kwa dharau awe mzawa au mgeni, anamkufuru Bwana, naye mtu huyo ni lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.
Ekegusii: “Korende omonto orakore gento kende gionsi moeneno, karabe omobiare bw'Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino, oyio igo oramire Omonene, ere oyio naatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.

English: to which I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
Kiswahili: Nami nimewekwa kuwa mhubiri, mtume na mwalimu wa Injili hii.
Ekegusii: Inaki ase enchiri eye nkaragwa koba omoraria, na omotomwa, na omworokia.

English: Happy are your men, happy are these your servants who stand continually before you, who hear your wisdom.
Kiswahili: Heri watu wako! Heri hawa maafisa wako wasimamao mbele yako daima na kusikia hekima yako!
