Ekegusii: Abanto bao na abasomba bao aba bagotenena botambe ase obosio bwao na obong'aini bwao, mbare negesio ekenene.

English: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the other prisoners were listening to them.
Kiswahili: Ilipokaribia usiku wa manane, Paulo na Sila walikuwa wakiomba na kuimba nyimbo za kumsifu Mungu, nao wafungwa wengine walikuwa wakiwasikiliza.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero kia botuko gati Paulo na Sila nigo barenge gosaba Nyasae na komoterera amatera, na abasibwa bande nigo babategererete.

English: And Solomon offered as peace offerings to the LORD 22,000 oxen and 120,000 sheep. So the king and all the Israelites dedicated the house of the LORD.
Kiswahili: Solomoni akatoa dhabihu sadaka za amani kwa Bwana: ngʼombe 22,000, pamoja na kondoo na mbuzi 120,000. Hivyo ndivyo mfalme na Waisraeli wote walivyoweka wakfu Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Sulemani akarua ebing’wanso bi’omorembe ase Omonene, chiombe chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, ne ching’ondi chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ebere. Naboigo omorwoti amo nabaanto bonsi bagaatanana enyomba y’Omonene.

English: When the people saw that Moses delayed coming down from the mountain, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron, and said to him, “Come, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don't know what has become of him.”
Kiswahili: Watu walipoona kuwa Mose amekawia sana kushuka kutoka mlimani, walimkusanyikia Aroni na kumwambia, “Njoo, tutengenezee miungu itakayotutangulia. Kwa maana huyu jamaa yetu Mose aliyetupandisha kutoka Misri, hatujui jambo lililompata.”
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto baroche ng'a Musa otebanire goika korwa ase egetunwa, bagasangererekana amo, bagachiera Aroni, bakamoteebia, “Inchuo aa, otokorere enyasae eratotang'ane, ekiagera titomanyeti eki kiamonyorire Musa, oyo otong'anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”

English: that Your ways may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.
Kiswahili: ili njia zako zijulikane duniani, wokovu wako katikati ya mataifa yote.
Ekegusii: Tiga enchera yao emanyekane ase ense, na okobua kwao kw’ogotooria komanyekane ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi.

English: Habakkuk cried, saying, “O Daniel, Daniel, take the dinner which God has sent you.”
Kiswahili: Habakuki alilia, akisema, “Ee Danieli, Danieli, ule chakula cha jioni ambacho Mungu amekutumia.”
Ekegusii: Danieli agateeba, Aye Nyasae kwang'inyoire inche naye tori kobatiga baria bagwanchete aye. Erio Danieli akabogoria endaagera eria na koyeria.

English: He set himself to seek God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the vision of God; and as long as he sought Yahweh, God made him prosper.
Kiswahili: Akamtafuta Mungu katika siku za Zekaria, aliyemwelekeza kumcha Mungu. Wakati wote alipomtafuta Bwana, Mungu alimfanikisha.
Ekegusii: Usia akaba okorigia Nyasae nenkoro yaye ase amatuko a Zakaria, oyorenge komworokereria amoiroke Nyasae. Na ekero arenge komorigia Omonene, Nyasae akaba okomosesenia.

English: and said, “Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery.
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia Yesu, “Mwalimu, huyu mwanamke amekutwa akizini.
Ekegusii: bakamoteebia, “Omworokia, omokungu oyo nigo abwatwa kagokora obotomani.

English: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking, but of righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Ufalme wa Mungu si kula na kunywa, bali ni haki, amani na furaha katika Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Inaki oborwoti bwa Nyasae tari okoria na okonywa, korende oboronge, na omorembe, na omogooko bikorwa ase Omoika Omochenu.

English: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance. A Warning against Idleness
Kiswahili: Bwana aiongoze mioyo yenu katika upendo wa Mungu na katika saburi ya Kristo. Onyo Dhidi Ya Uvivu
Ekegusii: Omonene atang’ane chinkoro chiaino, erinde momanye obwanchani bwa Nyasae, na oboremereria bwa Kristo. Ogokuurera kw’ogokora emeremo

English: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”
Kiswahili: Kwenu ninyi mnaoamini, jiwe hili ni la thamani. Lakini kwao wasioamini, “Jiwe walilolikataa waashi limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni,”
Ekegusii: Naki ogosika oko nokwaino, inwe abamwegenire. Korende ase abwo bategeneti nigo eriikire, “Rigena erio abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri'ekoona,”

English: “As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations.
Kiswahili: “Kwa upande wangu, hili ndilo Agano langu na wewe: Wewe utakuwa baba wa mataifa mengi.
Ekegusii: “Rora, okobwatana kwane nabwatanire naye nakwo oko: Aye nobe sokoro bw'ebisaku ebinge.

English: There are losses because of glory; and there is one who has lifted up his head from a low estate.
Kiswahili: Kuna hasara kwa sababu ya utukufu; na kuna mtu ambaye ameinua kichwa chake kutoka katika hali ya chini.
Ekegusii: Nkereo ekeegwa getakoretere 'ng'eria ende yonsi, korende nkereo ekeegwa kende kerarete eng'eria ara kabere.

English: “Don't cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;
Kiswahili: “Hakikisheni kwamba koo za kabila la Wakohathi hawatengwi kutoka Walawi.
Ekegusii: “Timotiga abanto be chiamate chia Kohati basirigwe korwa ase Abalawi.

English: Some Hebrews even crossed the Jordan into the land of Gad and Gilead. Saul, however, remained at Gilgal, and all his troops were quaking in fear. Saul’s Unlawful Sacrifice
Kiswahili: Hata baadhi ya Waebrania wakavuka Yordani mpaka nchi ya Gadi na Gileadi. Sauli akabaki huko Gilgali, navyo vikosi vyote vilivyokuwa pamoja naye vilikuwa vikitetemeka kwa hofu.
Ekegusii: Abaiberania bande bakaamboka Yorodani, bakagenda ase ense ya Gadi na Gileadi. Korende Saulo ere nao atigarete agwo Giligali, na Abanto bonsi abamotunyanete baare koiguswa ase obwoba.

English: Hasn't the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”
Kiswahili: Je, Maandiko hayasemi kwamba Kristo atakuja kutoka jamaa ya Daudi na kutoka Bethlehemu, mji alioishi Daudi?”
Ekegusii: Ririko tiriri goteeba ng'a Kristo nigo ararwe ase oroiboro rwa Daudi, naende ase Bethlehemu, agachie karia Daudi amenyete?”

English: Next he measured the court. It was square, a hundred cubits long and a hundred cubits wide. And the altar was in front of the temple.
Kiswahili: Ndipo alipopima ukumbi: nao ulikuwa mraba wa dhiraa mia moja urefu na upana. Madhabahu yalikuwa mbele ya Hekalu. Hekalu
Ekegusii: Naende omonto oria akarengia eraaro ya ime; obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko rigana erimo, na obogare bwaye boigo; egesasiimero nigo kiarenge bosio bwe Hekalu.

English: O Lord, may Your ear be attentive to my prayer and to the prayers of Your servants who delight to revere Your name. Give Your servant success this day, I pray, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man.” (At that time I was the cupbearer to the king.)
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, tega sikio lako na usikie maombi ya huyu mtumishi wako, na maombi ya watumishi wako wanaofurahia kuliheshimu Jina lako. Nipe leo, mimi mtumishi wako, mafanikio kwa kunipa kibali mbele ya mtu huyu.” Kwa maana nilikuwa mnyweshaji wa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, igwa ogosaba kwane, inche omosomba oo, amo nogosaba kw’abasomba bao, abwo bare nomogooko gokoiroka aye. Insesenia inche, omosomba oo, rituko ria reero, inyore ogwancherwa ase obosio bw’omonto oyo.” Ase engaki eyio nigo narenge omobogoria bw’ebinyugwa bi’omorwoti.

English: The man did as Joseph commanded, and the man brought the men to Joseph's house.
Kiswahili: Yule Msimamizi akafanya kama Yosefu alivyomwambia na akawachukua wale watu nyumbani kwa Yosefu.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria agakora buna Yusufu amotebetie, agasoyia abanto abwo nyomba ime.

English: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”
Kiswahili: Nami nikamwona malaika mwenye nguvu akitangaza kwa sauti kuu, akisema, “Ni nani anayestahili kuzivunja hizo lakiri na kukifungua kitabu?”
Ekegusii: Naende nkarora omomalaika bw'echinguru okoraria neriogi rinene, ogoteeba, “Ning'o ogwenerete koigora egetabu, na gosansora ebimanyererio biaye?”

English: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don't forget your commandments.
Kiswahili: Nimetangatanga kama kondoo aliyepotea. Mtafute mtumishi wako, kwa kuwa sijasahau amri zako.
Ekegusii: Inche nasirire buna eng'ondi ensiru, 'ndigie inche omosomba oo, ekiagera tinyebeti amachiiko ao.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Panda uje kwangu huku mlimani na ukae hapa, nami nitakupa vibao vya mawe, vyenye sheria na amri ambazo nimeziandika ziwe mwongozo wao.”
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Tiira gocha aa ase 'nde egetunwa igoro, oganye aa, na inche nkoe chibao chi'amagena chire namachiiko onsi aya narikireo, ayio ogochia kworokereria abanto.”

English: However, because by this deed you have given great occasion to Yahweh's enemies to blaspheme, the child also who is born to you will surely die.”
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa sababu kwa kufanya hili umefanya adui za Bwana kuonyesha dharau kabisa, mwana atakayezaliwa kwako atakufa.”
Ekegusii: Korende ekiagera gwakorire ayio kwagerire ababisa ba Omonene bamochaaye, omwana oria oraiborwe goika akwe.”

English: Samaria will bear her guilt because she has rebelled against her God. They will fall by the sword; their little ones will be dashed to pieces, and their pregnant women ripped open.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Samaria ni lazima wabebe hatia yao, kwa sababu wameasi dhidi ya Mungu wao. Wataanguka kwa upanga; watoto wao wadogo watatupwa kwa nguvu ardhini, wanawake wao walio na mimba watatumbuliwa.”
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Samaria mbaegwe egesusuro, ekiagera basaririe ase Nyasae obo, mbaitwe nemioro, na abana babo banachanwe ebing’ese. Abakungu babo bare barito mbatandorwe chinda.”

English: “Run back and forth through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in its wide places, if you can find a man, if there is anyone who does justly, who seeks truth, then I will pardon her.
Kiswahili: “Pandeni na kushuka katika mitaa ya Yerusalemu, tazameni pande zote na mtafakari, tafuteni katika viwanja vyake. Kama mtaweza kumpata hata mtu mmoja tu atendaye kwa uaminifu na kutafuta kweli, nitausamehe mji huu.
Ekegusii: Minyoka gochia aaria na aaria ase chinchera chia Yerusalemu, morigererie na komanya. Moriga‐rigie ase chichiiro morore gose monyore omonto oyomo ogokora oboronge na korigia ekeene, erinde inche Omonene inyare kwabera omochie oyo.

English: Then Jeremiah the prophet said to them, “I have heard you. Behold, I will pray to Yahweh your God according to your words; and it will happen that whatever thing Yahweh answers you, I will declare it to you. I will keep nothing back from you.”
Kiswahili: Nabii Yeremia akajibu, “Nimewasikia. Kwa hakika nitamwomba Bwana Mungu wenu kama mlivyoomba. Nitawaambia kila kitu asemacho Bwana, wala sitawaficha chochote.”
Ekegusii: Yeremia omobani akairaneria, akabateebia, “Naigure amang'ana aino; inche ngochia inde kobasabera ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, buna mwamboririe, na amang'ana ande onsi Omonene arabairanerie, nimbateebie, tinkobabisa nonya nerimo timbateebia.”

English: And we urge you, brothers, to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.
Kiswahili: Nasi twawasihi, ndugu, waonyeni walio wavivu, watieni moyo waoga, wasaidieni wanyonge na kuwavumilia watu wote.
Ekegusii: Twabasoroire, baminto, mokuurere abwo bare aboro, moremie abwo berusirie moyo, mokonye abwo bare abareu, remereria nabaanto bonsi.

English: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,
Kiswahili: kwa njia mpya iliyo hai tuliyofunguliwa kwa ajili yetu kupitia kwenye lile pazia, yaani, mwili wake,
Ekegusii: ase enchera enyia ere moyo, eye atoigorerete, egoetera ase etoto, engencho yaye omobere oye.

English: But they did not understand this statement, and they were afraid to ask Him about it. The Greatest in the Kingdom (Matthew 18:1–5; Luke 9:46–50)
Kiswahili: Lakini wao hawakuelewa kile alimaanisha, nao waliogopa kumuuliza maana yake. Mabishano Kuhusu Aliye Mkuu Zaidi (Mathayo 18:1-5; Luka 9:46-48)
Ekegusii: Korende tibamanya ring’ana riria, bakairoka komoboria. Ning’o ore omonene? (Mat 18:1-5; Luk 9:46-48)

English: “If anyone commits a trespass, and sins unwittingly regarding Yahweh's holy things, then he shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation in silver by shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.
Kiswahili: “Mtu anapokiuka na kutenda dhambi pasipo kukusudia kuhusu mojawapo ya mambo matakatifu ya Bwana, huyo mtu ataleta kwa Bwana kama adhabu kondoo dume mmoja kutoka kundi lake, asiye na dosari na mwenye thamani halisi kifedha, kulingana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu. Hii ni sadaka ya hatia.
Ekegusii: “Monto onde bwensi karasarie na akore ebibe mosiabano atancheti ase ogotarua ebinto biatananirwe na gochenwa ase 'nde, goika andeetere emingichi etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ayerusie korwa ase riicho riaye ebe ekeng'wanso gi'okorongeyia okomocha kwaye. Naye oyekorere rigori rireng'aine eri'esekeli egokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu.

English: “If a man sins against his neighbor, and an oath is laid on him to cause him to swear, and he comes and swears before your altar in this house,
Kiswahili: “Mtu anapomkosea jirani yake na akatakiwa kuapa, akija na kuapa mbele ya madhabahu yako ndani ya Hekalu hili,
Ekegusii: “Omonto karakorere omonto onde bobe na aborigwe koria emuma, erio achiche arie emuma eria bosio bw'egesasiimero kiao ase enyomba eye,

English: In the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of Yahweh, and sat before me.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa saba, mwezi wa tano siku ya kumi, baadhi ya wazee wa Israeli wakaja ili kutaka ushauri kwa Bwana, wakaketi mbele yangu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi, omotienyi o gatano, omwaka o gatano na kabere, abagaaka bande b'Abaisraeli bagaacha koboria amang'ana korwa ase Omonene, bagaikaransa ase obosio bwane.

English: Don't let Hezekiah make you trust in Yahweh, saying, “Yahweh will surely deliver us. This city won't be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”'
Kiswahili: Msikubali Hezekia awashawishi kumtumaini Bwana kwa kuwaambia, ‘Hakika Bwana atatuokoa. Mji huu hautaangukia mikononi mwa mfalme wa Ashuru.'
Ekegusii: Timobaisa gwancha Hezekia abasirie ng'a mosemerie Omonene ekero agoteeba: Ekeene, Omonene natotoorie, na omochie oyo tokobekwa ase okoboko kw'omorwoti bw'Abaasuri.

English: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he was unwilling to let them go.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana akaufanya moyo wa Farao kuwa mgumu, hakuwa radhi kuwaachia waondoke.
Ekegusii: Omonene agakong’ia enkoro ya Farao, na ere tancha kobaa ribaga bagende.

English: They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment.
Kiswahili: Hizo zitatoweka, lakini wewe utadumu; zote zitachakaa kama vazi.
Ekegusii: Ebio inabisire, korende aye nigo oragenderere kobao, birobio inabigote buna chianga,

English: When the news reached Joab, who had conspired with Adonijah but not with Absalom, he fled to the tent of the LORD and took hold of the horns of the altar.
Kiswahili: Habari zilipomfikia Yoabu, ambaye alikuwa amefanya shauri baya na Adoniya, lakini sio na Absalomu, alikimbilia kwenye hema la Bwana na kushika pembe za madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yoabu aigwete amang’ana ayio, agatama gochia ase Eema y’Omonene, akabwaterera ching’unchara chi’egesasiimero. Ere igo abwatanete n’Adonia ase okomokoonya, korende tabwatanete n’Abisalomu.

English: King Demetrius heard about this, and he gathered together exceedingly great forces, and went out to meet him in battle.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Demetrio alisikia habari hizi, akakusanya jeshi kubwa sana, akatoka kwenda kumkabili vitani.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti Demeturio anyorete amang'ana ayio, ere agasangereria abarwani esegi abange, agasooka kogenda korwana na Alekisanda Epifane.

English: So Israel set out with all that he had, and when he came to Beersheba, he offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Israeli akaondoka na vyote vilivyokuwa mali yake, naye alipofika Beer-Sheba, akamtolea dhabihu Mungu wa Isaki baba yake.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Israeli akaimoka, akagenda, akaira ebinto bionsi ebi abwate, agaika Beeri‐Seba, akaruera Nyasae o Isaka ise ekeng’wanso.

English: So Esther was taken to King Ahasuerus into his royal house in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.
Kiswahili: Esta alipelekwa kwa Mfalme Ahasuero katika makao ya mfalme mwezi wa kumi, yaani mwezi wa Tebethi, katika mwaka wake wa saba wa kutawala.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, omwaka o gatano na kabere bw'okogamba kw'omorwoti Ahaswero, omotienyi o ikomi okorokwa Tebeti, Esiteri akarentwa ase omorwoti, agwo ase enyomba yaye y'oborwoti.

English: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.
Kiswahili: Watu wote waliokuwa wameketi katika baraza wakimkazia macho Stefano, wakaona uso wake unangʼaa kama uso wa malaika.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi, abaikaransete ase ekegambero eke, bakamobeta amaiso, bakarora obosio bwaye ng'a nigo bwabeire buna obosio bw'omomalaika.

English: Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, with its kings and its princes, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, a hissing, and a curse, as it is today;
Kiswahili: Yaani Yerusalemu na miji ya Yuda, wafalme wake na maafisa wake, kuwafanya magofu na kuwa kitu cha kuchukiza, cha dhihaka na laana, kama walivyo leo;
Ekegusii: Yerusalemu na emechie yonsi y'Abayuda, amo nabarwoti na abanene b'oborwoti bwabo, bakaegwa bakanywa edivai eria, erinde ense yabo esarigwe ebe bosa, na abanto bakorora ayio mbakumie baabachaye, na baragererie ase erieta riabo, buna ere goika reero iga.

English: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, put fire from the altar in it, lay incense on it, carry it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from Yahweh! The plague has begun.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akamwambia Aroni, “Chukua chetezo chako na uweke uvumba ndani yake, pamoja na moto kutoka madhabahuni, nawe uende haraka kwenye kusanyiko ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yao. Ghadhabu imekuja kutoka kwa Bwana, na tauni imeanza.”
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia Aroni, “Imokia orogio rwao rw'ogosambera ubani rusia omorero ase egesasiimero oyobeke igoro yaye, erio obeeke ubani igoro ase omorero oyio, oroimokie ogende bwango ase omoganda bw' abanto, erinde okore okobwatanigwa ase bare, ekiagera Omonene obeire nendamwamu: amaakwa achakire goita abanto.”

English: Be silent at the presence of the Lord Yahweh, for the day of Yahweh is at hand. For Yahweh has prepared a sacrifice. He has consecrated his guests.
Kiswahili: Nyamazeni mbele za Bwana Mwenyezi, kwa maana siku ya Bwana iko karibu. Bwana ameandaa dhabihu, amewaweka wakfu wale aliowaalika.
Ekegusii: Tegerera okire‐kiri ase obosio Omonene! Rituko ri'Omonene nigo rire ang'e; Omonene bwariganirie ekeng'wanso, bwatananire abwo arangeirie ase ekegeni kiaye na abasesenie.

English: Then David answered and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, saying, “Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp?” Abishai said, “I will go down with you.”
Kiswahili: Basi Daudi akamuuliza Ahimeleki Mhiti, na Abishai mwana wa Seruya, nduguye Yoabu, akisema, “Ni nani atakayeshuka pamoja nami kambini kwa Sauli?” Abishai akajibu, “Nitakwenda pamoja nawe.”
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi akabooria Ahimeleki Omohiti, na Abisai, momura omwabo Yoabu, omomura bw'omokuungu Seruya: “Ning'o oranche gotirimboka amo nainche gochia ase Saulo ase egetwori kiaye?” Abisai akamoiraneria: “Ninche ndagende amo naye.”

English: These were heads of fathers' households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men. They lived at Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Hawa wote walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa za Walawi, wakuu kama walivyoorodheshwa katika koo zao, nao waliishi Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo chi'Abalawi ase ebiare biabo. Abwo nigo barenge abaraai baria bamenyete Yerusalemu.

English: They make promises, swearing falsely in making covenants. Therefore judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field.
Kiswahili: Wanaweka ahadi nyingi, huapa viapo vya uongo wanapofanya mapatano; kwa hiyo mashtaka huchipuka kama magugu ya sumu katika shamba lililolimwa.
Ekegusii: Nigo bagokwana amang'ana atari nengencho, naende betiania ase oborimo ekero bagokora okobwatana kw'ogotianania; ase igo ekiina nigo gekobacheera buna ekemeri kere nobosongo ase emetaro ya mogondo.

English: All these were heads of Levite families, chiefs according to their genealogies, and they lived in Jerusalem. The Descendants of Saul
Kiswahili: Hawa wote walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa za Walawi, wakuu kama walivyoorodheshwa katika koo zao, nao waliishi Yerusalemu. Ukoo Wa Sauli (1 Nyakati 8:29-38)
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo chi’Abalawi ase ebiare biabo. Abwo nigo barenge abaraai baria bamenyete Yerusalemu. Chisokoro na ororeria rw’omorwoti Saulo (1 Amg 8:29-38)

English: He did that which was evil in Yahweh's sight. He didn't depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.
Kiswahili: Akafanya maovu machoni pa Bwana. Hakuziacha dhambi za Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati, ambazo alisababisha Israeli kuzitenda.
Ekegusii: Peka agakora ayare amabe ase amaiso 'Omonene. Teatananete korwa ase ebibe biria Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, akorete akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.

English: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!
Kiswahili: Kwa nini unazuia mkono wako, mkono wako wa kuume? Uutoe kutoka makunjo ya vazi lako na uwaangamize!
Ekegusii: Nase ki aye kwaringire okoboko kwao gw'okorio? Korambore korwa ase egekuba kiao, obasirie kegima.

English: The descendants of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,
Kiswahili: Wana wa Efraimu walikuwa: Shuthela, ambaye alimzaa Beredi, Beredi akamzaa Tahathi, Tahathi akazaa Eleada, Eleada akamzaa Tahathi,
Ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rw’Efraimu: Sutela omomura oye, na Beredi omomura oye, na Tahati omomura oye, na Eleada omomura oye, na Tahati omomura oye,

English: For God said, ‘Honor your father and mother’ and ‘Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.’
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu alisema, ‘Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako,’ na, ‘Yeyote amtukanaye baba yake au mama yake, na auawe.’
Ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae nigo achiigete, agateeba: Sika iso na nyoko, na: Oyorakwane bobe ase ise, gose ase ng’ina, ogokwa nakwe.

English: and the fourth row had a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. These stones were mounted in gold filigree settings.
Kiswahili: katika safu ya nne ilikuwa na krisolitho, shohamu na yaspi. Vito hivyo vilitiwa kwenye vijalizo vya dhahabu.
Ekegusii: na ase oyo o kane kurusolito, na oiniki, na berulo. Amagena ayio onsi bakayabeka ase ebikonde bie chitaabu.

English: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa sababu yenu ni muhimu zaidi mimi nikiendelea kuishi katika mwili.
Ekegusii: Korende gotigara ase omobere nkogwenerete kobua ase engencho yaino.

English: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani akaadhimisha Pasaka na kunyunyiza damu, ili yule mwenye kuwaangamiza wazaliwa wa kwanza asiwaguse wazaliwa wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena akaroisia Epasaka na kogindia amanyinga, erinde oyoraache goita abana abatangi tabakuna, ne ching'iti chintangi boigo.

English: How futile it is to spread the net where any bird can see it!
Kiswahili: Tazama ni jinsi gani ilivyo kazi bure kutandaza wavu wakati ndege wote wanakuona!
Ekegusii: Nigo ere bosa gotegera chinyoni ebisugunia ekero chibiroche.

English: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, as his fathers had done. He did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit.
Kiswahili: Akafanya maovu machoni pa Bwana, kama baba zake walivyofanya. Hakuziacha dhambi za Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati ambazo alisababisha Israeli kuzitenda.
Ekegusii: Agakora ayare amabe ase amaiso ’Omonene, buna chisokoro chiaye chiakorete. Teatananete korwa ase ebibe biria Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, akorete akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.

English: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.
Kiswahili: Asubuhi yake walipokuwa wakipita, wakauona ule mtini umenyauka kutoka juu hadi kwenye mizizi yake.
Ekegusii: Na mambia kobagoeta, bakarora omoko oria bwomire bwonsi korwa ase emeri yaye.

English: Therefore let's wait for the salvation that comes from him, and call upon him to help us. He will hear our voice, if it pleases him.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo tungojee wokovu utokao kwake, na kumwita atusaidie. Atasikia sauti yetu, kama ikimpendeza.
Ekegusii: Komenta na ayio, buna intwe tosemeretie ogotooreka korwa ase are, tiga boigo tomoreere atokoonye; keraabe okwo nakwo ogwancha kwaye, nanyaare koigwa ekerero giaito.

English: The fool delights in shameful conduct, but a man of understanding has wisdom.
Kiswahili: Mpumbavu hufurahia tabia mbaya, lakini mtu mwenye ufahamu hupendezwa na hekima.
Ekegusii: Omonto omoriri nigo agokora ebibe buna egosori, korende omonto ore nokomanya nigo agokora ayare ay’obong’aini.

English: In the same way, urge the younger men to be self-controlled.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, himiza vijana wawe na kiasi.
Ekegusii: Naboigo, obasorore abamura babe aberiti ase onsi.

English: We must make a three-day journey into the wilderness and sacrifice to the LORD our God as He commands us.”
Kiswahili: Ni lazima twende mwendo wa siku tatu mpaka tufike jangwani ili tumtolee Bwana Mungu wetu dhabihu, kama alivyotuagiza.”
Ekegusii: Goika togende orogendo rw’amatuko atato gochia ase erooro, erinde toruere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ekeng’wanso buna atochikiire.”

English: You will still be eating the old supply of grain when you need to clear it out to make room for the new.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa kuvuna mtakuwa bado mnakula mavuno ya mwaka uliopita, na itawalazimu kuyaondoa ghalani ili mpate nafasi ya mavuno mapya.
Ekegusii: Namogenderere koria endagera enkoro ere enyinge ase ebiage, na ekiagera ere enyinge mono namoyerusie aroro, erinde monyore ribaga mobeeke enyia.

English: If you want to gain a friend, get him in a time of testing, and don't be in a hurry to trust him.
Kiswahili: Ukitaka kupata rafiki, mfikishe katika wakati wa majaribu, na usiwe na haraka ya kumwamini.
Ekegusii: Koganetie gotwara omosani, karamoitona ritang'ani, toayerera komwegena.

English: This is He of whom I said, ‘A man who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me.’
Kiswahili: Huyu ndiye yule niliyewaambia kwamba, ‘Mtu anakuja baada yangu ambaye ni mkuu kuniliko mimi, kwa kuwa alikuwepo kabla yangu.’
Ekegusii: Oyo nere naare goteeba igoro yaye: Ngocha are omonto magega yane oyore omonene kombua, ekiagera nao arenge ritang’ani ase ’nde.

English: Because of the multiplication of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya kuongezeka kwa uovu upendo wa watu wengi utapoa,
Ekegusii: Nase engencho y’okomenteka kw’ebibe, obwanchani bw’abange ’nabokende.

English: After two days He will revive us; on the third day He will raise us up, that we may live in His presence.
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku mbili atatufufua; katika siku ya tatu atatuinua, ili tuweze kuishi mbele zake.
Ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko abere natokore tobe abayia. Ase rituko ria gatato natotenenie, na intwe ntogenderere koba moyo ase obosio bwaye.

English: They trample on the heads of the poor as on the dust of the earth; they push the needy out of their way. A man and his father have relations with the same girl and so profane My holy name.
Kiswahili: Wanakanyaga juu ya vichwa vya maskini, kama vile juu ya mavumbi ya nchi, na kukataa haki kwa walioonewa. Baba na mwanawe hushiriki msichana mmoja, kwa hivyo hulinajisi Jina langu takatifu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bagotiringera emetwe y’abataka nabwo batari n’echinguru ase orotu rw’ense, naende nigo bagokorekania amang’ana ’omonto omoitongo. Omomura na ise nigo bagokora obonyaka n’omosomba omoiseke oyomo, na igo bakora erieta riane riaba eritachenegeti.

English: For this is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
Kiswahili: hii ni amri kwa Israeli, agizo la Mungu wa Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Oyio nigo ore omooroberio ochikiire ase Abaisraeli, na aya Nyasae o Yakobo achiikire.

English: Six days you shall labor, but on the seventh day you shall rest; even in the seasons of plowing and harvesting, you must rest.
Kiswahili: “Kwa siku sita utafanya kazi, lakini siku ya saba utapumzika, hata ikiwa ni majira ya kulima au ya kuvuna lazima upumzike.
Ekegusii: “Okore emeremo ase amatuko atano na rimo, korende rituko ria gatano na kabere otimoke, nonya nengaki y’okorema na eye rigesa.

English: See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.
Kiswahili: Hakikisha kuwa umevitengeneza sawasawa na ule mfano ulioonyeshwa kule mlimani.
Ekegusii: Origererie buya obikore buna nakworogetie ase egetunwa.”

English: Don't move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.
Kiswahili: Usisogeze jiwe la mpaka wa zamani lililowekwa na baba zako.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gotuumana orobebe orokoro orwo chisokoro chiao chiabeegete.

English: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom.
Kiswahili: Heri watu wako! Heri hawa maafisa wako wasimamao mbele yako daima na kusikia hekima yako!
Ekegusii: Abanto bao, na abasomba bao, abagotenena botambe ase obosio bwao, na koigwa obong'aini bwao, mbare negesio ekenene.

English: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, with me from Lebanon. Look from the top of Amana, from the top of Senir and Hermon, from the lions' dens, from the mountains of the leopards.
Kiswahili: Enda nami kutoka Lebanoni, bibi arusi wangu, enda nami kutoka Lebanoni. Shuka kutoka ncha ya Amana, kutoka juu ya Seniri, kilele cha Hermoni, kutoka mapango ya simba na kutoka mlima wapendapo kukaa chui.
Ekegusii: Aye omoriakari one, togende torue aa Lebanoni, torue Lebanoni, togende komo. Otirimboke korwa ase egechuria ki'egetunwa ki'Amana, na ekia Seniri na Herimoni. Orue ase amakuruma e chindo, na ase ebitunwa chingo chimenyete.

English: for the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya ishirini na moja ikamwangukia Hothiri, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere na rimo (21) bokagwera Hotiri; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: The light of a lamp will never shine in you again, and the voices of a bride and bridegroom will never call out in you again. For your merchants were the great ones of the earth, because all the nations were deceived by your sorcery.”
Kiswahili: Mwanga wa taa hautaangaza ndani yako tena. Sauti ya bwana arusi na bibi arusi kamwe haitasikika ndani yako tena. Wafanyabiashara wako walikuwa watu maarufu wa dunia. Mataifa yote yalipotoshwa kwa uchawi wako.
Ekegusii: nonya noborabu bw’etaya tibokomoreka ime ase ore naende nonya ng’ake; nonya neriogi ri’omonywomi na eri ’omoriakari takoigugwa ime ase ore naende nonya ng’ake. Abaonchoreria bao nigo barenge abanene b’ense, na abanto b’ebisaku bionsi bang’ainetwe ase oborogi bwao.

English: The woman asked, “Why have you devised a thing like this against the people of God? When the king says this, does he not convict himself, since he has not brought back his own banished son?
Kiswahili: Huyo mwanamke akasema, “Mbona basi wewe umewaza jambo kama hili dhidi ya watu wa Mungu? Je, mfalme asemapo hili, hajitii hatiani mwenyewe, kwa maana mfalme hajamrudisha mwanawe aliyefukuziwa mbali?
Ekegusii: Ase igo omokungu oria akabora, “Inaki aye kwarobeirie amang’ana buna ayio are mamincha y’abanto ba Nyasae? Ase ogokwana ring’ana eri, aye omorwoti kwegaambirie aye omonyene, ekiagera toeti omwana oo, oria otamete, ribaga airane ’nka.

English: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: “Mose alipokuwa na umri wa miaka arobaini aliamua kuwatembelea ndugu zake Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Ekero akoorire emiaka emerongo ene, akarengereria ase enkoro yaye kogenda korora abamwabo, Abaisraeli.

English: For their princes are at Zoan, and their ambassadors have come to Hanes.
Kiswahili: Ingawa wana maafisa katika Soani na wajumbe wamewasili katika Hanesi,
Ekegusii: Nonya abagaambi baino bare ase omochie o Soani, na abatomirwe baikire ase omochie o Hanesi,

English: You must distinguish between the unclean and the clean, between animals that may be eaten and those that may not.’”
Kiswahili: Ni lazima mpambanue kati ya kilicho najisi na kilicho safi, kati ya viumbe hai vinavyoweza kuliwa na vile visivyoweza kuliwa.’ ”
Ekegusii: na igo momanye gwaatanana ebichenegete korwa ase ebitachenegeti, ne ching’iti chire moyo chiancheire koriegwa korwa ase echitancheiri koriegwa.

English: They sojourned before this in Mesopotamia, because they didn't want to follow the gods of their fathers, which were in the land of the Chaldeans.
Kiswahili: Waliishi ugenini huko Mesopotamia kabla ya hapo, kwa sababu hawakutaka kuifuata miungu ya baba zao, iliyokuwa katika nchi ya Wakaldayo.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo barenge abamenyi ense ya Mesopotamia. Ase engencho batanchete gosasiima chinyasae chia Abakalidayo,

English: Then he made the lampstand out of pure hammered gold, all of one piece: its base and shaft, its cups, and its buds and petals.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza kinara cha taa cha dhahabu safi iliyofuliwa vizuri katika kitako chake na ufito wake; vikombe vyake vilivyofanana na ua, matovu na maua vilikuwa kitu kimoja.
Ekegusii: Akaroisia ekebekerero gie chitaaya gi’etaabu echenire esunyuntire. Akayeroisia nenterekerero amo ne ritina, na emegwekano y’amamumu na ebisicha; bionsi bikaroisigwa bikaba egento ekemo.

English: he shall present the goat chosen by lot for the LORD and sacrifice it as a sin offering.
Kiswahili: Aroni atamleta yule mbuzi ambaye kura ya Bwana imemwangukia na kumtoa dhabihu kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi.
Ekegusii: Egoree eria eraabe yagwereirwe nobomera ase ’nde, Aroni ayerente ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.

English: Your wickedness affects only a man like yourself, and your righteousness only a son of man.
Kiswahili: Uovu wako unamdhuru tu mtu mwingine kama wewe, nayo haki yako inawafaa wanadamu tu.
Ekegusii: Amabe ao ogokora nigo akorenta emechando ase omonto onde onga buna aye, na oboronge bwao nabo boragere omonto onde anyore ayare amaya.

English: “Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: the burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.
Kiswahili: “Mpe Aroni na wanawe agizo hili: ‘Haya ndiyo masharti kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa: Sadaka ya kuteketezwa itabaki kwenye moto juu ya madhabahu usiku kucha, mpaka asubuhi, nao moto lazima uwe unaendelea kuwaka juu ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: “Moe Aroni amo nabamura baye ogochika oko igoro y'ekeng'wanso ki'ogosaambwa; Ekeng'wanso ki'ogosaambwa kebeere igoro ase egesasiimero obotuko bwonsi goika mambia, na omorero bw'egesasiimero orendwe ogenderere gwoka.

English: He who doesn't love doesn't know God, for God is love.
Kiswahili: Yeye asiyependa hamjui Mungu, kwa sababu Mungu ni pendo.
Ekegusii: Oyotancheti, tamomanyeti Nyasae, ekiagera Nyasae nobwanchani.

English: For this is what the LORD says: “You were sold for nothing, and without money you will be redeemed.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Mliuzwa pasipo malipo, nanyi mtakombolewa bila fedha.”
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Inwe nigo mwaoonetigwe timwaakaneretwe kende, na nigo moraboorigwe motari goakanerwa chitaabu.

English: Then the woman said, “Please, may your servant speak a word to my lord the king?” “Speak,” he replied.
Kiswahili: Ndipo huyo mwanamke akasema, “Mruhusu mtumishi wako aseme neno kwa mfalme bwana wangu.” Mfalme akajibu, “Sema.”
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria akabora, “Aye omorwoti, omonene one, ing’a inche, omosomba oo, ribaga ’nkwane ring’ana erimo ase ore.” Akamoteebia, “Aye kwana.”

English: Then the righteous man will stand in great boldness before the face of those who afflicted him, and those who make his labors of no account.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mtu mwadilifu atasimama kwa ujasiri mkubwa mbele ya wale waliomtesa, na wale wanaopuuza kazi zake.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio omonyaboronge natenene n'oboremu ase obosio bwa baria bare komochanda boigo na baria basiereretie emeremo yaye.

English: He doesn't delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
Kiswahili: Furaha yake haipo katika nguvu za farasi, wala furaha yake kwenye miguu ya mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Omonene tagokiri ne'chinguru chi'echibarasi, gose ase omoayerero bw'omonto,

English: Then Deborah said to Barak, “Arise, for this is the day that the LORD has delivered Sisera into your hand. Has not the LORD gone before you?” So Barak came down from Mount Tabor with ten thousand men following him.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Debora akamwambia Baraka, “Nenda! Hii ndiyo siku ambayo Bwana amemtia Sisera mikononi mwako. Je, Bwana hakukutangulia mbele yako?” Hivyo Baraka akashuka kutoka Mlima Tabori, akifuatwa na watu 10,000.
Ekegusii: Erio Debora akamoteebia Baraki, “Imoka, ogende! Rituko ria reero nario Omonene amobeekire Sisera ase amaboko ao. Omonene ogotang’aneire aye gochia korwana esegi.” Baraki agatirimboka korwa ase Egetunwa gia Tabori amo n’abanto chilifu ikomi baare komotunyana.

English: Yahweh said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a child when I am old?'
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Abrahamu, “Kwa nini Sara amecheka na kusema, ‘Kweli nitazaa mtoto nami sasa ni mzee?'
Ekegusii: Omonene akabooria Aburaamu: “Ninki Sara agosekera, ogoteeba: Inche amaene ninyibore omwana buna nagotire iga?

English: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
Kiswahili: wa tatu alikuwa Absalomu, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Maaka, binti Talmai mfalme wa Geshuri; wa nne, Adoniya, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Hagithi;
Ekegusii: oyo o gatato Abisalomu, oiboretwe na Maaka, mosubati o Talimai, omorwoti o Gesuri; oyo o kane Adonia, oiboretwe na Hagiti;

English: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don't those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?
Kiswahili: Waangalieni watu wa Israeli: Je, wale wote walao dhabihu si ni wale watendao kazi madhabahuni?
Ekegusii: Rigereria chingencho chi'Abaisraeli; abwo bakoria ebing'wanso ebio, Inee, tibari kobwatana negesasiimero?

English: “Go tell them, ‘Return to your tents.'
Kiswahili: “Nenda uwaambie warudi kwenye mahema yao.
Ekegusii: Genda obateebie bairane ase chiema chiabo.

English: then may You hear from heaven and act. May You judge Your servants, condemning the wicked man by bringing down on his own head what he has done, and justifying the righteous man by rewarding him according to his righteousness.
Kiswahili: basi, sikia kutoka mbinguni na ukatende. Hukumu kati ya watumishi wako, ukimhukumu yule mwenye hatia na kuleta juu ya kichwa chake yale aliyoyatenda. Umtangazie mwenye haki kwamba hana hatia, hivyo ukathibitishe kuwa haki kwake.
Ekegusii: aye oigwe korwa agwo igoro, okore ogokora kwao, onachere abasomba bao ekiina kia boronge. Tiga oria ore omomochi abogorie egesusuro gi’okomocha kwaye, na oria ore omooronge aegwe oboronge bwaye.

English: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.
Kiswahili: Kutoka Sayuni, penye uzuri mkamilifu, Mungu anaangaza.
Ekegusii: Korwa Sayoni, omochie omoikeranu bw'oboseera, Nyasae omorekire korwao.

English: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, the captain of the guard.
Kiswahili: Wakati ule ule, Wamidiani wakamuuza Yosefu huko Misri kwa Potifa, mmojawapo wa maafisa wa Farao, aliyekuwa mkuu wa ulinzi.
Ekegusii: Na Abamidiani baria bakamoonia aaria Misiri ase Potifari, omoteneneri bw'enka ya Farao na omotang'ani bw'abarendi baye bande.

English: After receiving the royal mandates, he returned bringing nothing worthy of the high priesthood, but having the passion of a cruel tyrant and the rage of a savage animal.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kupokea amri za kifalme, alirudi bila kuleta chochote kinachostahili ukuhani mkuu, ila akiwa na shauku ya mtawala mkatili na hasira ya mnyama mkali.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Menelao akairana gochia Yerusalemu ore n'amakaratasi korwa ase omorwoti ayio akomwanchera koba Omokuani omonene, korende ere tarenge obwenerete koba Omokuani omonene ekiagera nigo abwate enkoro ekobera bwango na nigo arenge omotindi mono buna enyang'au.

English: Woe to you who are well fed now, for you will hunger. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.
Kiswahili: Ole wenu ninyi mlioshiba sasa, maana mtaona njaa. Ole wenu ninyi mnaocheka sasa, maana mtaomboleza na kulia.
Ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino inwe abamoigotete bono, ekiagera namoche koba nenchara. “Obobe nobwaino inwe abamogoseka bono, ekiagera namoche goichana na korera.

English: You, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God that is in your hand, appoint magistrates and judges who may judge all the people who are beyond the River, who all know the laws of your God; and teach him who doesn't know them.
Kiswahili: Nawe Ezra, kufuatana na hekima ya Mungu wenu uliyo nayo, weka mahakimu na waamuzi wote wanaozifahamu sheria za Mungu wenu ili watoe haki kwa watu wote wa Ngʼambo ya Mto Frati. Nawe inakupasa umfundishe yeyote ambaye hazifahamu.
Ekegusii: “Bono aye Ezra kwaeirwe obong'aini na Nyasae oo. Obokorere emeremo ase ogochora abagaambi ebiina na abamanyi b'amachiiko, erinde babe bakogamba ebiina bi'abaanto bonsi ase orogongo rore bosongo y'orooche rw'Eufarati, aba bonsi bamanyete amachiiko a Nyasae oo; na abatayamanyeti oborokererie bayamanye.

English: Now men don't see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.
Kiswahili: Basi hakuna awezaye kulitazama jua, jinsi linavyongʼaa angani, upepo ukishafagia mawingu.
Ekegusii: “Abanto tibakonyara korigereria amasase 'erioba, kabarire igoro ekero amare abisirwe nomwaga.

English: But love your enemies, do good to them, and lend to them, expecting nothing in return. Then your reward will be great, and you will be sons of the Most High; for He is kind to the ungrateful and wicked.
Kiswahili: Lakini wapendeni adui zenu, watendeeni mema, wakopesheni bila kutegemea kurudishiwa mlichokopesha. Ndipo thawabu yenu itakapokuwa kubwa, nanyi mtakuwa wana wa Aliye Juu Sana, kwa sababu yeye ni mwema kwa watu wasio na shukrani na kwa wale waovu.
Ekegusii: Korende mwanche ababisa baino, bakorere amaya, na korua singo, motari korengereria konyora egento gi’okoiranerigwa, eng’eria yaino nebe enene, na inwe namobe abana b’Oyore Igoro Mono, ekiagera ere nomuya ase abanto batari nokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, nonya nase abang’iti.

English: and after taking some food, he regained his strength. And he spent several days with the disciples in Damascus. Saul Preaches at Damascus
Kiswahili: Baada ya kula chakula, akapata nguvu tena. Sauli akakaa siku kadhaa pamoja na wanafunzi huko Dameski. Sauli Ahubiri Dameski
Ekegusii: akaragera, akanyora chinguru. Akaba agwo amatuko atari make amo naborokigwa abarenge Damesiki.

English: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.'
Kiswahili: Nayo ya pili ni kama hiyo, nayo ni hii: ‘Mpende jirani yako kama nafsi yako.'
Ekegusii: Nogwa kabere gokoreng'aine noko: Mwanche omogisangio oo buna bweanchete aye omonyene.

English: Then some came who told Jehoshaphat, saying, “A great multitude is coming against you from beyond the sea from Syria. Behold, they are in Hazazon Tamar” (that is, En Gedi).
Kiswahili: Watu fulani wakaja wakamwambia Yehoshafati, “Jeshi kubwa linakuja dhidi yako kutoka Edomu tokea ngʼambo ile nyingine ya Bahari. Tayari liko Hasason-Tamari” (yaani En-Gedi).
Ekegusii: Abanto bande bagacha bagateebia Yehosafati “Omoganda omonene mono bw'abaanto korwa Edomu, ng'umbu y'enyancha ngocha ore gokorwania esegi; rora nao bare agwo Hasasoni‐Tamari” (noro Eni‐Gedi).

English: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,
Kiswahili: bali kwa ajili yetu sisi pia ambao Mungu atatupa haki, sisi tunaomwamini yeye aliyemfufua Yesu Bwana wetu kutoka kwa wafu.
Ekegusii: korende nase engencho yaito boigo. Nonya nintwe ntoche kobarerwa boigo, intwe abatwamwegenire ere oyomobogetie Yeso, Omonene oito, korwa ase abakuure,

English: On the seventh day you are to wash your clothes, and you will be clean. After that you may enter the camp.” Division of the Spoils
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya saba fueni nguo zenu, nanyi mtakuwa safi. Kisha mtaweza kuingia kambini.” Kugawanya Mateka
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere mosibie chianga chiaino, nainwe ’namobe abachenekire; magega y’ayio monyare gosoa ase ebitwori.” Ogwatananwa kw’ebisakorwa

English: including Jehoiada, leader of the house of Aaron, with 3,700 men,
Kiswahili: pamoja na Yehoyada, kiongozi wa jamaa ya Aroni, aliyekuwa pamoja na watu 3,700,
Ekegusii: amo na Yehoyada, omoteneneri bw’eamate ya Aroni, na amo nere abanto chilifu isato, na amagana atano na abere (3,700);

English: Then the LORD raised up against Solomon an adversary, Hadad the Edomite, from the royal line of Edom.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwinua adui dhidi ya Solomoni, Hadadi, Mwedomu, kutoka ukoo wa ufalme wa Edomu.
Ekegusii: Omonene akarentera Sulemani omobisa, na omobisa oyio nere Hadadi, omonto bw’enyomba y’oborwoti bwa Edomu.

English: be careful to follow all the statutes and ordinances that I am setting before you today.
Kiswahili: hakikisheni kwamba mnatii amri na sheria zote ninazoziweka mbele yenu leo.
Ekegusii: mwerende na mobwate amachiiko na emeroberio yonsi echiikire, aya nayabeekire ase amasio aino rituko ria reero.

English: So Moses stretched out his staff over the land of Egypt, and throughout that day and night the LORD sent an east wind across the land. By morning the east wind had brought the locusts.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akanyoosha fimbo yake juu ya Misri, Bwana akauleta upepo wa mashariki ukavuma katika nchi yote mchana wote na usiku kucha, kufikia asubuhi upepo ukawa umeleta nzige.
Ekegusii: Agwo Musa akaimokia enyimbo yaye igoro y’ense ya Misiri, n’Omonene akarenta omwaga korwa moocha, rituko rigima, omobaso na obotuko. Ekero bwakia omwaga oria korwa moocha konya orentire chingige.

English: Then my tongue will proclaim Your righteousness and Your praises all day long.
Kiswahili: Ulimi wangu utanena haki yako na sifa zako mchana kutwa.
Ekegusii: Erio oromeme rwane ndogenderere koraria oboronge bwao, na ogotogigwa kwao, omobaso boira.

English: The LORD will always guide you; He will satisfy you in a sun-scorched land and strengthen your frame. You will be like a well-watered garden, like a spring whose waters never fail.
Kiswahili: Bwana atakuongoza siku zote, atayatosheleza mahitaji yako katika nchi kame, naye ataitia nguvu mifupa yako. Utakuwa kama bustani iliyonyweshwa vizuri, kama chemchemi ambayo maji yake hayakauki kamwe.
Ekegusii: Igo Omonene nakoraae kogenderera botambe, nagoisanekie n’ebinto ebiya, nakong’ie amauga ’omobere oo, naye obe buna omogondo ogoitororerwa amaache, na buna ensoko y’amaache etari gokama.

English: But as I stated, you have seen Me and still you do not believe.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama nilivyowaambia, mmeniona lakini bado hamwamini.
Ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie ng’a mwandorire, ko timonyegeneti.

English: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. Yahweh will forgive her.
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa mumewe atabatilisha nadhiri hizo baada ya kuzisikia, basi hakuna nadhiri au ahadi zozote alizoziweka kwa midomo yake zitakazothibitika. Mumewe atakuwa amezibatilisha, na Bwana atamweka huru yule mwanamke.
Ekegusii: Korende onye omosacha oye okwanga eira yaye gose ogotiana kwaye, na kobikora bibe bosa ase rituko riria akoyaigwa, amang'ana yomokuungu oria akwanete tagoikeranigwa. Omonene naabere omokungu oria, ekiagera omosacha oye bwangire ng'a taikerania eira eria, gose ogotiana koria.

English: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa kwa kuwa mmemjua Mungu, au zaidi mmejulikana na Mungu, inakuwaje mnarejea tena katika zile kanuni za kwanza zenye udhaifu na upungufu? Mnataka ziwafanye tena watumwa?
Ekegusii: Korende bono, komwaikire komomanya Nyasae, gose kobua, mwamanyekanire na Nyasae, nase ki rende mokoiranera amorokererio aye ritang'ani, ayare amoro na amataka? Nase ki morigetie koyakorera naende?

English: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.
Kiswahili: Basi palikuwepo ndugu saba. Yule wa kwanza akaoa, akafa bila kuzaa mtoto.
Ekegusii: Bono mbarenge abamura ba ise omo batano na babere. Oyo bw'eritang'ani akanyuoma omokungu, agakwa, tatiga abana;

English: Naaman’s servants, however, approached him and said, “My father, if the prophet had told you to do some great thing, would you not have done it? How much more, then, when he tells you, ‘Wash and be cleansed’?”
Kiswahili: Watumishi wa Naamani wakamwendea na kumwambia, “Baba yangu, kama huyo nabii angekuambia kufanya jambo lililo kubwa, je, usingelifanya? Je, si zaidi sana basi, anapokuambia, ‘Oga na utakasike!’ ”
Ekegusii: Korende abasomba baye bakamochiera, bakamoteebia: “Tata, onye omobani oyo nagoteebia okore egento kere egekong’u, Inee, tikwarenge kogekora? Korende bono, nase ki otakomoigwera ekero agotebia: Genda bwesibie, naye nocheneke?”

English: You made Adam, and gave him Eve his wife for a helper and support. From them came the seed of men. You said, it is not good that the man should be alone. Let's make him a helper like him.
Kiswahili: Ulimfanya Adamu, ukampa Hawa mkewe awe msaidizi na mtegemezi. Kutoka kwao ulitoka uzao wa wanadamu. Ukasema, Si vema huyo mtu awe peke yake. Na tumfanyie msaidizi kama yeye.
Ekegusii: Naye gwatongete Adam na Hawa mokaye abe omokonyi oye. Mwanyabaanto bonsi nigo barwete ase aba babere, naye gwatebeete buna teri buya omosacha koba ere bweka; tiga tomokorere omonto okomokoonya onga buna ere.

English: Though my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will receive me.
Kiswahili: Hata kama baba yangu na mama wakiniacha, Bwana atanipokea.
Ekegusii: Onye tata na baba baraba bagontiga, Omonene nang’ire imbe oyoye.

English: The raiders came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned to the way that leads to Ophrah, to the land of Shual;
Kiswahili: Makundi ya wavamiaji walikuja kutoka kambi ya Wafilisti katika vikosi vitatu. Kikosi kimoja kilielekea Ofra karibu na Shuali,
Ekegusii: Ebiombe bitato bi'abarwani bikarua ase egetwori ki'Abafilisti; ekeombe ekemo gekaonchoka gochia Ofura, ase ense ya Saulo,

English: If you are Christ's, then you are Abraham's offspring and heirs according to promise.
Kiswahili: Nanyi mkiwa ni mali ya Kristo, basi ninyi ni wa uzao wa Abrahamu na warithi sawasawa na ile ahadi.
Ekegusii: Naki onye inwe naba Kristo, rirorio mwabeire oroiboro rwa Aburaamu, na abanyamwando ase eira.

English: Can I forget any longer, O house of the wicked, the treasures of wickedness and the short ephah, which is accursed?
Kiswahili: Je, bado nisahau, ee nyumba ya uovu, hazina yako uliyopata kwa udanganyifu na vipimo vilivyopunguka, ambavyo vimelaaniwa?
Ekegusii: Inee! Chinibo chi’obourereria nchigenderere kobeera ase chinyomba chi’abakori amabe? Na ebirengero bitaikeraneti biragereirie mbibeereo?

English: Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make straight Your way before me.
Kiswahili: Niongoze katika haki yako, Ee Bwana, kwa sababu ya adui zangu, nyoosha njia yako mbele yangu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo mbwate ababisa abange, ase ayio, ondaae ase oboronge bwao; roisia enchera yao ase ngoetera ebe endonge.

English: Yahweh God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu akawatengenezea Adamu na mkewe mavazi ya ngozi, akawavika.
Ekegusii: Erio Omonene Nyasae akaroiseria Adamu na mokaye chingobo chi'amasankwa, erio agwo akababoyia.

English: And if there are ten men left in one house, they too will die.
Kiswahili: Kama watu kumi watabaki katika nyumba moja, wao pia watakufa.
Ekegusii: Nebe ng’a onye abasacha ikomi batigaire ase enyomba eyemo, nabarabwo goika bakwe.

English: When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave Moses the two tablets of the covenant, stone tablets, written with God's finger.
Kiswahili: Bwana alipomaliza kusema na Mose juu ya Mlima Sinai, Mungu akampa vile vibao viwili vya Ushuhuda, vibao vya mawe vilivyoandikwa kwa kidole cha Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Omonene akoorire gokwana na Musa agwo ase egetunwa gia Sinai, akamoa chibao ibere chi'amagena chiriikire oborori nekiara kia Nyasae.

English: One shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her meat, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn.
Kiswahili: Wakati angali akitazama, mtamba huyo atateketezwa: ngozi yake, nyama yake, damu na sehemu zake za ndani.
Ekegusii: Erio chinyama chi'eng'ombe eria, chisamberwe ase obosio bwaye amo ne riiyo na amanyinga, n'esike.

English: and more cedar logs than could be counted; for the Sidonians and Tyrians had brought a large quantity of cedar logs to David.
Kiswahili: Pia akatoa magogo ya mierezi yasiyohesabika, kwa kuwa Wasidoni na Watiro walikuwa wamemletea Daudi idadi kubwa ya mierezi.
Ekegusii: Boigo akarenta chibao chi’emecharake chitare kobareka, ekiagera Abasidoni nigo barenterete Daudi emecharake emenge mono.

English: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your offspring after you.
Kiswahili: Nitalithibitisha Agano langu kama Agano la milele kati yangu na wewe na wazao wako baada yako na vizazi vijavyo niwe Mungu wako na Mungu wa wazao wako.
Ekegusii: “Ning'ikeranie okobwatana kw'ogotianania egati yane naye, na ororeeria rwao korwa magega yao, kogenderera ekiaare ase ekiaare, kobe okobwatana gwa kare na kare; imbe Nyasae oo, na oyo bw'ororeeria rwao korwa magega yao.

English: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom Yahweh's word came, saying, “Israel shall be your name.”
Kiswahili: Eliya akachukua mawe kumi na mawili, moja kwa ajili ya kila kabila la wana wa Yakobo, ambaye neno la Bwana lilimjia, likisema, “Jina lako litakuwa Israeli.”
Ekegusii: Elija akabogoria amagena ikomi na abere, koreng'ana nomobaro bw'ebisaku bi'abamura ba Yakobo, oyio ring'ana ri'Omonene riachete asare rigateeba: “Israeli nario rirabe erieta riao.”

English: Don't enter into the path of the wicked. Don't walk in the way of evil men.
Kiswahili: Usiuweke mguu wako katika njia ya waovu wala usitembee katika njia ya watu wabaya.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa kobwatia enchera y'abakori amabe, gose tobwatia chiinchera chi'abaanto ababe.

English: This is what the LORD says: “Though they are allied and numerous, yet they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, O Judah, I will afflict you no longer.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Ingawa wana muungano nao ni wengi sana, watakatiliwa mbali na kuangamia. Ingawa nimekutesa wewe, ee Yuda, sitakutesa tena.
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba ase abanto baye Abaisraeli: “Nonya Abasiria bare abakong’u naende abange ina baitwe nagosirigwa. Abanto bane ’nabakorete mogachandeka, korende inche tinkoirorera gokora ayio naende.

English: Then Omri and all the Israelites marched up from Gibbethon and besieged Tirzah.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Omri na Waisraeli wote pamoja naye wakaondoka Gibethoni na kuizingira Tirsa.
Ekegusii: Bono Omuri akaimoka korwa Gibetoni amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi, bakagenda koboera Tirisa.

English: May those who say, “Aha, aha!” retreat because of their shame.
Kiswahili: Wale waniambiao, “Aha! Aha!” warudi nyuma kwa sababu ya aibu yao.
Ekegusii: Abwo bagonchaya na goteeba: “Kiamonyorire!” Tiga bakirigwe-kiri ase obosooku bwabo.

English: even if he lives a thousand years twice over but fails to enjoy his prosperity. Do not all go to the same place?
Kiswahili: Hata kama huyo mtu ataishi miaka elfu mara mbili na zaidi, lakini akashindwa kufurahia mafanikio yake, je, wote hawaendi sehemu moja?
Ekegusii: nonya omonto oria ogochia komenya emiaka chilifu ibere, korende tanyora omogooko ase obogima bwaye. Inee! Abwo bonsi babere tibakogenda aase amo?

English: But it shall not be this way among you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
Kiswahili: Lakini isiwe hivyo kwenu. Badala yake, yeyote anayetaka kuwa mkuu miongoni mwenu hana budi kuwa mtumishi wenu,
Ekegusii: Korende takoba bo ase more. Omonto origetie koba omonene ase more, nabe omokoreri oino.

English: Abi-albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
Kiswahili: Abi-Alboni, Mwaribathi; Azmawethi, Mbarhumi;
Ekegusii: Abi‐Aliboni korwa Araba na Asimaweti korwa Bahurimu;

English: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. Yahweh is gracious and merciful.
Kiswahili: Amefanya maajabu yake yakumbukwe, Bwana ni mwenye neema na huruma.
Ekegusii: Omonene okorire ogokora kwaye kw'ogokumia kobe gokoinyorwa, ere nigo are n'obuya na amaabera.

English: and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself to Yahweh, and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valor.
Kiswahili: aliyefuata ni Amasia mwana wa Zikri, ambaye alijitolea kwa ajili ya kazi ya Bwana, akiwa na askari 200,000.
Ekegusii: na oyo o gatato Amasia, mosinto o Sikiri, oyo bweruete ase ogwancha gokora emeremo y'Omonene; ere nigo abwate abarwani chituoni chilifu amagana abere (200,000).

English: those registered to the tribe of Ephraim numbered 40,500.
Kiswahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Efraimu walikuwa watu 40,500.
Ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene, n’amagana atano (40,500).

English: The LORD will turn the rain of your land into dust and powder; it will descend on you from the sky until you are destroyed.
Kiswahili: Bwana atafanya mvua ya nchi yako kuwa mavumbi na mchanga; vitakujia kutoka angani mpaka uangamie.
Ekegusii: Ribaga ri’embura egotwa ase riroba riaino, Omonene narente ebuse na omokenye bibatwere korwa igoro na kobasiria kegima.

English: God sent a spirit of animosity between Abimelech and the leaders of Shechem and caused them to treat Abimelech deceitfully,
Kiswahili: Mungu akaruhusu roho mbaya kati ya Abimeleki na watu wa Shekemu, nao watu wa Shekemu wakamtendea Abimeleki kwa hila.
Ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agatoma omoika omobe ase ogwatanan’Abimeleki n’abanto ba Sekemu, n’abanto aba bagakorera Abimeleki obong’ainereria.

English: Then David rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David.
Kiswahili: Kisha Daudi akapumzika pamoja na baba zake naye akazikwa katika Mji wa Daudi.
Ekegusii: Daudi akaraara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, erio agatindekwa ase Omochie o Daudi.

English: For it is testified: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana imeshuhudiwa kwamba: “Wewe ni kuhani milele, kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki.”
Ekegusii: Naki obereirwe kirori ng’a. “Aye n’Omokuani o kare na kare, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.”

English: But if he cannot obtain enough to repay him, what he sold will remain in possession of the buyer until the Year of Jubilee. In the Jubilee, however, it is to be released, so that he may return to his property.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama hatapata njia ya kumlipa mnunuzi, ile mali aliyouza itabaki kumilikiwa na mnunuzi mpaka Mwaka wa Yubile. Mali hiyo itarudishwa mwaka wa Yubile, naye ataweza kuirudia mali yake.
Ekegusii: Korende onye omonyene oria tabwati enibo eisaine akobooria omwando oye, nabo omwando oyio oratigare ase okoboko kw’omonto oria oyogorete goika Omwaka bw’Omochengo. Korende ase omwaka oria omwando oyio noiranigwe, na ere omonyene airane ase omwando oye.

English: He said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” So they saddled the donkey for him; and he rode on it.
Kiswahili: Hivyo akawaambia wanawe, “Nitandikieni punda.” Walipokwisha kumtandikia punda, akampanda
Ekegusii: Omobani oria omogotu agateebia abamura baye: “Imbeekere etigere egeikaransero.” Erio bakabeekera etigere egeikaransero, na omobani oria akariina etigere eria,

English: As for the court on the west, there were four at the highway and two at the court.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu ukumbi kuelekea magharibi, kulikuwa na wanne barabarani na wawili kwenye ukumbi wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ase akanyomba kaagachire ensemo ya bosongo, abarendi baane nigo barenge agwo ase enchera, na babere ase akanyomba karia.

English: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ,
Kiswahili: Neema iwe nanyi na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo,
Ekegusii: Obuya bobe ase more na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo,

English: for riches are not forever, nor does the crown endure to all generations.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa utajiri haudumu milele, nayo taji haidumu vizazi vyote.
Ekegusii: Obonda tibori kogeenderera kobao botambe, na eguutwa y'obogambi teri kogeenderera kobao ekiaare ase ekiaare.

English: To Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord. Faithfulness under Persecution (Matthew 10:16–25)
Kiswahili: Kwa Timotheo, mwanangu mpendwa: Neema, rehema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba, na kwa Kristo Yesu Bwana wetu. Shukrani Na Kutiwa Moyo
Ekegusii: gocha ase Timotheo, omwana one omwanchwa: Obuya na amaabera, na omorembe, bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata, na ase Kristo Yeso, Omonene oito. Ogoaka mbuya na kobeka omokia

English: Hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood, overlaid with gold and standing on four silver bases.
Kiswahili: Litundike kwa kulabu za dhahabu kwenye nguzo nne za mti wa mshita ambazo zimefunikwa kwa dhahabu, zikiwa zimesimamishwa kwenye vitako vinne vya fedha.
Ekegusii: Osunge etoto eria y’egetambaa ase chisiiro inye chi’emekonge chioomire netaabu, chire nebigobanio bie chitaabu, chiratenene ase chinterekerero inye chi’echifeta.

English: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews who lived in the land of Egypt, who lived at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Memphis, and in the country of Pathros, saying,
Kiswahili: Neno hili lilimjia Yeremia kuhusu Wayahudi wote waishio Misri, huko Migdoli, Tahpanhesi na Memfisi, katika nchi ya Pathrosi kusema:
Ekegusii: Ring'ana ri'Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia igoro y'Abayahudi bonsi bamenyete ase ense ya Misiri, agwo ase emechie ya Migidoli, na Tapenesi, na Memifisi, na ase orogongo rwa Patirosi, rigateba:

English: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa wote wametenda dhambi na kupungukiwa na utukufu wa Mungu,
Ekegusii: ekiagera bonsi bakorire ebibe, na baremeirwe n’obonene bwa Nyasae;

English: Many have undertaken to compose an account of the things that have been fulfilled among us,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa watu wengi wamekaa ili kuandika habari za mambo yaliyotukia katikati yetu,
Ekegusii: Abanto abange beruete koriika ebirage bi’amang’ana aria aikeranetigwe egati yaito.

English: For when you eat the fruit of your labor, blessings and prosperity will be yours.
Kiswahili: Utakula matunda ya kazi yako; baraka na mafanikio vitakuwa vyako.
Ekegusii: Aye nobe gokonyora okwama kw’emeremo y’amaboko ao; nosesenigwe, na amang’ana onsi nigo arabe buya asore.

English: Your righteousness is everlasting and Your law is true.
Kiswahili: Haki yako ni ya milele, na sheria yako ni kweli.
Ekegusii: Oboronge bwao nigo bore obwa kare na kare, n’amachiiko ao nigo are ay’ekeene.

English: We moreover write on our part to you, that your livestock and goods are ours, and ours are yours. We do command therefore that they make report to you accordingly.”
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo tunakuandikia wewe, kwamba mifugo yako na mali yako ni yetu, na yetu ni yako. Kwa hivyo tunaamuru wakuambie ipasavyo.
Ekegusii: Naintwe nigo tokobariikera kobamanyia buna intwe ntore ang'e gosanga nainwe chinibo chiaito amo ne chitugo chiaito ekero nainwe morakore boigo. Twabachiikire abatomwa baito babamanyie amange kobua ase amang'ana ayio.”

English: He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East. Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, defy Israel.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Balaamu akasema ujumbe wake: “Balaki amenileta kutoka Aramu, mfalme wa Moabu kutoka milima ya mashariki. Akasema, ‘Njoo, unilaanie Yakobo; njoo unishutumie Israeli.'
Ekegusii: Baalamu agakwana obobani bwaye, agateeba: “Balaki, omorwoti o Moabu, ondetire korwa Siiria, korwa ase ebitunwa bia Moocha, oteebire: Inchuo, ondagererie abanto ba Yakobo, inchwo ogambie Abaisraeli.

English: He will set his children under her shelter, and will rest under her branches.
Kiswahili: Atawaweka watoto wake chini ya kimbilio lake, na kupumzika chini ya matawi yake.
Ekegusii: Nigo akobeka abana baye

English: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the gate of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatever shall be done with them. They shall serve in there.
Kiswahili: mapazia ya ua unaozunguka Maskani na madhabahu, pazia la maingilio, kamba na vifaa vyote vinavyotumika katika huduma yake. Wagershoni watafanya yote yatakiwayo kufanyika na vitu hivi.
Ekegusii: na ebitambaa bi'eraaro eetanaine Obomenyo boria na egesasiimero, na ebitambaa bi'egesoero ki'eraaro, ne chingori chionsi chireo amo nebikorero bigokorerwao. Barabwo bakore emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie gokorwa ase ebinto ebio.

English: “You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God, for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.
Kiswahili: Usilitaje bure jina la Bwana Mungu wako, kwa kuwa Bwana hataacha kumhesabia hatia yeye alitajaye jina lake bure.
Ekegusii: “Toriatora bosa na korikorera bobe erieta ria Nyasae Omonene, ekiagera Omonene tagotiga komoa egesusuro omonto oria okoriatora bosa na korikorera bobe erieta riaye.

English: He rained down manna for them to eat; He gave them grain from heaven.
Kiswahili: akawanyeshea mana ili watu wale; aliwapa nafaka ya mbinguni.
Ekegusii: akabatweria endagera ekorokwa mana, bakaba bakoyeria; ee, akabaa endagera korwa igoro.

English: That night the LORD said to Gideon, “Get up and go down against the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand.
Kiswahili: Usiku ule ule Bwana akamwambia Gideoni, “Ondoka, ushuke kambini, kwa kuwa nimeitia mkononi mwako.
Ekegusii: Ase obotuko bori’Omonene agateebia Gidioni, “Imoka, otirimboke gochia ase egetwori kiabo okeumokere, ekiagera nababeekire ase amaboko ao.

English: Concerning Damascus: “Hamath and Arpad are put to shame, for they have heard a bad report; they are agitated like the sea; their anxiety cannot be calmed.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu Dameski: “Hamathi na Arpadi imetahayarika, kwa kuwa wamesikia habari mbaya. Wamevunjika moyo na wametaabika kama bahari iliyochafuka.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana igoro ya Damesiki naro aya: “Abanto ba Hamati na ab’Aripadi basookire, ekiagera baigure amang’ana amabe; chinkoro chiabo chiabeire nobwoba. Nigo bachandegete babeire buna enyancha yaburukanigwe etanyare gotoerera.

English: All the men who went out of the city gate listened to Hamor and his son Shechem, and every male of the city was circumcised.
Kiswahili: Wanaume wote waliotoka nje ya lango la mji walikubaliana na Hamori na Shekemu mwanawe na kila mwanaume katika mji ule akatahiriwa.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abamenyete ase omochie oria, bakaigwera Hamori na omomura oye Sekemu, na kera omosacha oyomenyeteo akaarokigwa. Abamura ba Yakobo bagoakana abanto ba Sekemu egesiomba

English: The waters of Nimrim are dried up, and the grass is withered; the vegetation is gone, and the greenery is no more.
Kiswahili: Maji ya Nimrimu yamekauka na majani yamenyauka; mimea imekauka wala hakuna kitu chochote kibichi kilichobaki.
Ekegusii: Orooche rwa Nimurimu rwakamire amaache; obonyansi bwomire, na bonde tibori komera, ekemeri kende ekebese tikeri aroro.

English: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward.
Kiswahili: Huu ndio urithi alioupeana Mose wakati alipokuwa katika tambarare za Moabu, ngʼambo ya Yordani mashariki mwa Yeriko.
Ekegusii: Eyio nero emiando Musa aatananete agwo ase ebirubo ebiomo bia Moabu, moocha ya Yorodani, kororia Yeriko.

English: By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.” Jesus Predicts Peter’s Denial (Matthew 26:31–35; Mark 14:27–31; Luke 22:31–38)
Kiswahili: Kama mkipendana ninyi kwa ninyi, kwa njia hii, watu wote watajua kuwa ninyi ni wanafunzi wangu.”
Ekegusii: Igo abanto bonsi nabamanye ng’a naborokigwa baane more, komorabe nobwanchani inwe ase inwe.” Ogokana gwa Petero gokobanwa (Mat 26:31-35; Mar 14:27-31; Luk 22:31-34)

English: My heart grew hot within me; as I mused, the fire burned. Then I spoke with my tongue:
Kiswahili: Moyo wangu ulipata moto ndani yangu, nilipotafakari, moto uliwaka, ndipo nikasema kwa ulimi wangu:
Ekegusii: enkoro yane ekaba ekoyia omorero ime yane. Ekero naare ndengereretie aya, omorero ogoka, tinare konyara gwetanga ogokwana kwane.

English: Is there still seed in the barn? The vine, the fig, the pomegranate, and the olive tree have not yet yielded fruit. But from this day on, I will bless you.” Zerubbabel the LORD’s Signet Ring
Kiswahili: Je, bado kuna mbegu iliyobakia ghalani? Mpaka sasa, hakuna mzabibu au mtini, mkomamanga wala mzeituni uliozaa tunda. “ ‘Kuanzia leo na kuendelea, nitawabariki.’ ” Zerubabeli Pete Ya Muhuri Ya Bwana
Ekegusii: Inee! Chimbusuro nchire ase ebiage? Inee! Emesabibu, na emeko, na emekomomanga, na emezeituni tiyangeti kwama? Korende korwa rituko ria reero nimbasesenie.” Eira y’Omonene ase Serubabeli

English: So Elisha turned back from him, took his pair of oxen, and slaughtered them. With the oxen’s equipment, he cooked the meat and gave it to the people, and they ate. Then he set out to follow and serve Elijah.
Kiswahili: Basi Elisha akamwacha Eliya, naye akarudi. Akachukua ile jozi yake ya maksai na kuwachinja. Akaipika ile nyama kwa kutumia miti ya nira kama kuni na kuwapa watu, nao wakala. Kisha akaondoka, akamfuata Eliya, akamtumikia.
Ekegusii: Erio agatiga Elija, akairana, akanyenya chiombe chiaye ibere, akaiyeka chinyama ase omorero bw’amakorogoto aria, akaa abanto chinyama chiria, nabarabwo bakaria. Erio akaimoka akabwatia Elija, akaba okomokorera.

English: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.
Kiswahili: Hivyo mkamuua aliye chanzo cha uzima, lakini Mungu akamfufua kutoka kwa wafu. Sisi tu mashahidi wa mambo haya.
Ekegusii: Mogaita Omotongi bw'obogima. Korende Nyasae akamobokia korwa ase abakuure, na ase ayio intwe nigo tore kirori.

English: You will have olive trees throughout your territory but will never anoint yourself with oil, because the olives will drop off.
Kiswahili: Utakuwa na mizeituni katika nchi yako yote, lakini hutatumia hayo mafuta yake, kwa sababu zeituni zitapukutika.
Ekegusii: Inamosimeke emezeituni ase orogongo rwaino rwonsi, korende timokweaka amaguta aye, ekiagera amazeituni nigo araaroroke atarama.

English: Greet all the saints in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me send you greetings.
Kiswahili: Msalimuni kila mtakatifu katika Kristo Yesu. Ndugu walioko pamoja nami wanawasalimu.
Ekegusii: Monkwanerie kera omochenu ase Kristo Yeso. Abaminto abare amo nainche baabakwanirie.

English: Behold, he will come up and fly as the eagle, and spread out his wings against Bozrah. The heart of the mighty men of Edom at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
Kiswahili: Tazama! Tai atapaa juu angani na kuruka chini kwa ghafula, akitandaza mabawa yake juu ya Bosra. Katika siku hiyo, mioyo ya mashujaa wa Edomu itakuwa kama moyo wa mwanamke katika utungu wa kuzaa.
Ekegusii: Naama! Egesaku gete nkeimokerere igoro keiruruke bwango buna ekeongo, kerambore chimbaaba chiaye igoro y'omochie o Bosira. Ase rituko erio chinkoro chi'abasikari b'Edomu bare chituoni nachiondoke, na barabwo babe buna omokungu okobina ase okoibora.”

English: So Moses took the blood, sprinkled it on the people, and said, “This is the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akachukua ile damu, akawanyunyizia wale watu, akasema, “Hii ni damu ya agano ambalo Bwana amelifanya nanyi kufuatana na maneno haya yote.”
Ekegusii: Musa akaimokia amanyinga aria arenge egetaabo ime, akanyororokeria abanto, akabora, “Aya n’amanyinga okobwatana okw’Omonene akorire ase ogotianania nainwe ase okobaa amachiiko aya onsi.”

English: Bring two loaves of bread from your dwellings as a wave offering, each made from two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour, baked with leaven, as the firstfruits to the LORD.
Kiswahili: Kutoka popote mnapoishi, mtaleta mikate miwili ya unga laini, sehemu mbili za kumi za efa, uliookwa kwa chachu, kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa ya malimbuko kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase kera enka morente emegati ebere eroisirie korwa ase obosie obonuke ebimunu bine amo n’ememera eraabe okoruegwa kw’endagera entang’ani y’okwama, kogosungusigwa ase Omonene.

English: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.
Kiswahili: Mwana mwenye hekima huleta furaha kwa baba yake, bali mtu mpumbavu humdharau mama yake.
Ekegusii: Omwana omong'aini nigo akogokia ise, korende oyore omoriri nigo agochaaya ng'ina.

English: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”
Kiswahili: kwa sababu analipenda taifa letu tena ametujengea sinagogi.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera nanchete abanto baito, naende natoagacherete esinagogi yaito.”

English: They inquired and searched for the friends of Judas, and brought them to Bacchides, and he took vengeance on them and used them spitefully.
Kiswahili: Wakawatafuta na kuwatafuta marafiki wa Yuda, wakawaleta kwa Bakide, naye akawalipiza kisasi na kuwatumia kwa ukali.
Ekegusii: Erio bakabarigia abasani ba Yuda na kobaira ase obosio bwa Bakide. Bakide akabachaanda na kobairania inse kegima.

English: came behind him and touched the fringe of his cloak. Immediately the flow of her blood stopped.
Kiswahili: Huyo mwanamke akaja kwa nyuma ya Yesu na kugusa upindo wa vazi lake. Mara kutokwa damu kwake kukakoma.
Ekegusii: Ere agatunyana Yeso korwa magega, agakuna omokoba bw'eanga yaye; erio kegima amanyinga aye agakama.

English: A wise saying is in the treasures of wisdom; but godliness is an abomination to a sinner.
Kiswahili: Msemo wa hekima upo katika hazina za hekima; lakini utauwa ni chukizo kwa mwenye dhambi.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo agotanga amang'ana are gochia komonyora goika engaki egwenerete, erio nario abanto abange baratogie chisemi chiaye.

English: That evening an old man from the hill country of Ephraim, who was residing in Gibeah (the men of that place were Benjamites), came in from his work in the field.
Kiswahili: Jioni ile mtu mmoja mzee toka nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu, aliyekuwa anaishi huko Gibea (watu wa sehemu ile walikuwa Wabenyamini), akarudi kutoka kwenye kazi za shamba.
Ekegusii: Ekero baikaranseteo, omogaka oyomo agacha, orenge korwa mogondo. Ere nigo arenge omonto bw’ense y’ebitunwa ya Efraimu, na bono nigo arenge omomenyi bw’omochie o Gibea. (Abanto b’aase aria nigo barenge Ababenjamini).

English: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place in Yahweh of Armies' wrath, and in the day of his fierce anger.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nitazifanya mbingu zitetemeke, nayo dunia itatikisika kutoka mahali pake katika ghadhabu ya Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, katika siku ya hasira yake iwakayo.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ri'ekeririanda kiane inche Omonene bw'Emeganda nintengechie igoro chionsi na inyegerie ense erue aase aye goetera ase endamwamu yane ekobera.

English: Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might.”
Kiswahili: Ninyi mlio mbali sana, sikieni lile nililofanya; ninyi mlio karibu, tambueni uweza wangu!
Ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete aare, igwa aya nakorire; nainwe abamomenyete ang'e ancha na koorokia okobua kwane.

English: With power You redeemed Your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah
Kiswahili: Kwa mkono wako wenye nguvu umewakomboa watu wako, uzao wa Yakobo na Yosefu.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo gwatooretie abanto bao nokoboko kwao koramboire. Abanto abwo nigo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo na orwa Yusufu.

English: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.
Kiswahili: Sitawaacha ninyi yatima, naja kwenu.
Ekegusii: “Tinkobatiga inwe buna chintakana; ninchiche ase more.

English: “I know your works, your love, faith, service, patient endurance, and that your last works are more than the first.
Kiswahili: Nayajua matendo yako, upendo wako na imani yako, huduma na saburi yako na kwamba matendo yako ya sasa yamezidi yale ya kwanza.
Ekegusii: “Namanyire ogokora kwao, na obwanchani bwao, na obwegenwa bwao, na obokoreri bwao, na okoremereria kwao. Naende namanyire ng'a ogokora kwao kw'omoerio kwabuire koria kw'eritang'ani.

English: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—
Kiswahili: Watoto wangu wapendwa, ambao kwa mara nyingine ninawaonea utungu, ninatamani kwamba Kristo aumbike ndani yenu.
Ekegusii: Abana baane abake, ninde nokoromwa gw'okobina gw'okobaibora naende, goika Kristo arorekane ime yaino.

English: You are to take the Levites for Me—I am the LORD—in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the livestock of the Israelites.”
Kiswahili: Nitwalie Walawi badala ya wazaliwa wa kwanza wa Waisraeli, nayo mifugo ya Walawi badala ya wazaliwa wa mifugo ya Waisraeli. Mimi ndimi Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene. Ase ayio Abalawi ’mbabe abaane. Obanyatananere ribaga ri’abatangi bonsi b’Abaisraeli. Naboigo ne ribaga rie ching’iti chintangi chi’Abaisraeli onyatananere ching’iti chi’Abalawi.”

English: Abraham stepped forward and said, “Will You really sweep away the righteous with the wicked?
Kiswahili: Ndipo Abrahamu akamsogelea akasema: “Je, utawaangamiza wenye haki na waovu?
Ekegusii: Aburaamu agasuka gochia ase Omonene, akamobooria: “Inee! Amaene, nigo orasirie abanyene oboronge amo nabakori amabe?

English: But you must not eat meat with its lifeblood still in it.
Kiswahili: “Lakini kamwe msile nyama ambayo bado ina damu ya uhai wake, kwa maana damu ni uhai.
Ekegusii: Korende timoria chinyama chire nobomoyo, engencho yaye echire namanyinga ime yabo.

English: A third of mankind was killed by the three plagues of fire, smoke, and sulfur that proceeded from their mouths.
