Kiswahili: Theluthi ya wanadamu wakauawa kwa mapigo hayo matatu, yaani, huo moto, moshi na kiberiti, vilivyotoka kwenye vinywa vya hao farasi.
Ekegusii: Ase amaakwa, ayio atato, omorero, na erioki, na ekebiriti, ebi biaruete korwa ase emenwa yabo, ensemo ya gatato ya Mwanyabaanto bagaitwa.

English: I am speaking in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh. Just as you used to offer the parts of your body in slavery to impurity and to escalating wickedness, so now offer them in slavery to righteousness leading to holiness.
Kiswahili: Ninasema kwa namna ya kibinadamu kwa sababu ya udhaifu wenu wa hali ya asili. Kama vile mlivyokuwa mkivitoa viungo vya miili yenu kama watumwa wa mambo machafu na uovu uliokuwa ukiongezeka zaidi, hivyo sasa vitoeni viungo vyenu kama watumwa wa haki inayowaelekeza mpate kutakaswa.
Ekegusii: Nigo ngokwana buna engencho ya Mwanyabaanto ase engencho y’oboreu bwaino bwa Mwanyabaanto, Inaki koreng’ana buna inwe ritang’ani mwaruete ebiimo biaino bibe ebisomba bi’obonyaka na ase ogosaria okonene mono, naboigo na bono karue ebiimo biaino bikorere oboronge, monyare gokorwa koba abachenu.

English: then Yahweh will drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourselves.
Kiswahili: ndipo Bwana atawafukuza mataifa haya yote mbele yako, nawe utawafukuza mataifa yaliyo makubwa na yenye nguvu kukuliko wewe.
Ekegusii: eri'Omonene naseerie ebisaku ebi bionsi bire ase amasio aino, na inwe 'namonyaare koira ense y'ebisaku bire ebinene, naende bire ne chinguru kobabua inwe.

English: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut into the rock. Then he rolled a great stone across the entrance to the tomb and went away.
Kiswahili: na kuuweka katika kaburi lake mwenyewe jipya, alilokuwa amelichonga kwenye mwamba. Kisha akavingirisha jiwe kubwa katika ingilio la kaburi, akaenda zake.

English: Now therefore, arise, O LORD God, and enter Your resting place, You and the ark of Your might. May Your priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and may Your godly ones rejoice in goodness.
Kiswahili: “Sasa inuka, Ee Bwana Mungu, na uje mahali pako pa kupumzikia, wewe na Sanduku la nguvu zako. Makuhani wako, Ee Bwana Mungu, na wavikwe wokovu, watakatifu wako na wafurahi katika wema wako.
Ekegusii: Na bono, aye Omonene Nyasae, imoka ogende goika aase ao ase ogotimokera, aye amo n’Esanduki eria y’okobua kwao. Omonene, tiga abakuani bao basiberanigwe nogotooreka; na abachenu bao tiga bagokere obuya bwao.

English: The king replied, “I know for sure that you are stalling for time, because you see that my word is final.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mfalme akajibu, “Nina hakika kuwa mnajaribu kupata muda zaidi, kwa sababu mnatambua kuwa nimeamua hivi kwa uthabiti:
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akairaneria, akabateebia, “Ekeene, namanyire ng’a nigo moganetie koegwa chingaki, ekiagera mwamanyire ng’a amang’ana ane tari koonchoka.

English: Then you will eat the fruit of your womb, the flesh of the sons and daughters whom the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you.
Kiswahili: Utakula uzao wa tumbo lako, nyama ya wana wako na binti zako ambao Bwana Mungu wako amekupa, kwa sababu ya mateso yale adui zako watakayokuletea wakati wa kukuzingira.
Ekegusii: “Ekero ababisa baino barabamige na kobasiongororokana, nigo moraabe n’emechando emenene, goika morie emebere y’abana baino, bari’Omonene Nyasae oino, abaeire.

English: The Law and the Prophets were proclaimed until John. Since that time, the gospel of the kingdom of God is being preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
Kiswahili: “Sheria na Manabii vilihubiriwa mpaka kuja kwa Yohana Mbatizaji. Tangu wakati huo habari njema za Ufalme wa Mungu zinahubiriwa, na kila mmoja hujiingiza kwa nguvu.
Ekegusii: “Amachiiko narengeo, na ababani boigo, goika ekero kia Yohana. Korwa ekero keria amang’ana amaya ay’oborwoti bwa Nyasae nkorandigwa are, na kera omonto nigo akobosoa ne chinguru.

English: to the Canaanites in the east and west; to the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, and Jebusites in the hill country; and to the Hivites at the foot of Hermon in the land of Mizpah.
Kiswahili: kwa Wakanaani upande wa mashariki na magharibi; kwa Waamori, Wahiti, Waperizi na Wayebusi katika nchi ya vilima; na kwa Wahivi chini ya Hermoni katika eneo ya Mispa.
Ekegusii: Naboigo agatoma amang’ana ase Abakanaani ba moocha na bosongo, ase Abaamori na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abayebusi ase ense y’ebitunwa, amo n’Abahivi abamenyete ang’e na Herimoni, egetunwa gi’ense ya Misipa.

English: The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them,
Kiswahili: Waovu hula njama dhidi ya wenye haki na kuwasagia meno,
Ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agokora omooroberio bw’ogoita oyore omooronge, na komoriananeria amaino.

English: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.
Kiswahili: Yeye anayemdharau jirani yake hutenda dhambi, bali amebarikiwa yeye aliye na huruma kwa mhitaji.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogochaaya omonto onde nigo agokora ebibe, korende oyokororera abachaandegete amaabera 'nasesenigwe.

English: “‘Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters. It was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Mama yako alikuwa kama mzabibu katika shamba lako la mizabibu uliopandwa kando ya maji, ukiwa unazaa sana na wenye matawi mengi kwa sababu ya wingi wa maji.
Ekegusii: “Nyoko nigo arenge buna omosabibu ase egati y'emesabibu, osimekire ase amaache mbarabare, Okaba okwama mono na okaba ne chinsagia chinyinge, ekiagera osimegetwe ase amaache amaange are.

English: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.
Kiswahili: Atawaokoa kutoka uonevu na ukatili, kwani damu yao ni ya thamani machoni pake.
Ekegusii: Nigo akobooria emioyo yabo korwa ase abachandi babo na korwa ase obotindi. Amanyinga abo nigo are nengencho enene asare.

English: All these were descendants of Obed-edom; they and their sons and brothers were capable men with strength to do the work—62 in all from Obed-edom.
Kiswahili: Hawa wote walikuwa wazao wa Obed-Edomu; wao na wana wao na jamaa zao walikuwa watu wenye uwezo pamoja na nguvu za kufanya kazi. Wazao wa Obed-Edomu jumla yao walikuwa sitini na wawili.
Ekegusii: Aba bonsi nigo barenge b’ororeria rw’Obedi‐Edomu. Barabwo amo nabana babo abamura na abanto bamwabo nigo barenge abanto abakong’u, bamanyete gokora emeremo yabo. Bonsi abwo b’Obedi‐Edomu nigo barenge emerongo etano nomo na babere.

English: The LORD your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants, and you will love Him with all your heart and with all your soul, so that you may live.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wako ataitahiri mioyo yenu na mioyo ya wazao wenu ili mweze kumpenda kwa moyo wako wote na kwa roho yako yote ukaishi.
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, narokie chinkoro chiaino, ne chinkoro chi’ororeeria rwaino, nabae inwe ne chinderia chiaino chinkoro chi’okoigwera; erio nario moramwanche ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, na emioyo yaino yonsi, mogenderere koba moyo.

English: he will dwell in ruined cities, in abandoned houses destined to become rubble.
Kiswahili: ataishi katika miji ya magofu, na katika nyumba ambazo haziishi mwanadamu yeyote, nyumba zinazokuwa vifusi.
Ekegusii: “Oyio obeire omenyete ase emechie yasaretigwe agwo ase chinyomba chitamenyiri nonde, echio konya chiarurwe ase ogosarigwa chibe amatombe.

English: If you do not listen, and if you do not take it to heart to honor My name,” says the LORD of Hosts, “I will send a curse among you, and I will curse your blessings. Yes, I have already begun to curse them, because you are not taking it to heart.
Kiswahili: Kama hamtasikiliza, na kama hamtaki kuielekeza mioyo yenu kuheshimu Jina langu, nitatuma laana juu yenu, nami nitalaani baraka zenu. Naam, nimekwisha kuzilaani, kwa sababu hamkuielekeza mioyo yenu kuniheshimu mimi,” Asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: Onye timogotegerera amang’ana ayio na koyabeka ase chinkoro chiaino ime, erinde mosike erieta riane, rirorio nindete okoragererigwa ase more, ndagererie ogosesenigwa kwaino. Ee, naikire koragereria ogosesenigwa okwo, ekiagera timori kobeeka amang’ana ayio ase chinkoro chiaino.

English: After several days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice came down to Caesarea to pay their respects to Festus.
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku kadhaa Mfalme Agripa na Bernike wakapanda kuja Kaisaria kumsalimu Festo.
Ekegusii: Amatuko atai make gaetire, Agripa omorwoti na Bereniki bagaika Kaisaria gokwania Festo.

English: David gathered all the people together and went to Rabbah, and fought against it and took it.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Daudi akakusanya jeshi lote akaenda Raba, akaushambulia na kuuteka.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi agasangereria abanto bonsi, akageenda Raba, akayorwania, akayobua na koyoira.

English: this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “In your own name you have sent out letters to all the people of Jerusalem, to the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, and to all the priests. You said to Zephaniah:
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa Israeli, asemalo: Ulituma barua kwa jina lako mwenyewe kwa watu wote wa Yerusalemu, kwa Sefania mwana wa kuhani Maaseya na kwa makuhani wengine wote. Ulimwambia Sefania,
Ekegusii: “Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Aye gwatomire riruube ase erieta riao gochia ase abanto bonsi bare Yerusalemu, na ase Sefania, mosinto o Maaseya Omokuani, na ase abakuani bonsi. Ase riruube erio kwarikire iga:

English: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.
Kiswahili: Basi Yesu alikuwa akifundisha katika sinagogi mojawapo siku ya Sabato.
Ekegusii: Akaba okworokereria ase esinagogi eyemo ase rituko ri'Esabato.

English: After him was Shammah the son of Agee, a Hararite. The Philistines had gathered together into a troop where there was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.
Kiswahili: Aliyefuata alikuwa Shama mwana wa Agee, Mharari. Wafilisti walipokusanyika pamoja mahali palipokuwa shamba lililojaa dengu, vikosi vya Israeli viliwakimbia.
Ekegusii: Na oyo o gatato ase abwo nere Sama, mosinto bw'Agee korwa Harari. Abafirisiti konya basangererekanire agwo, Lehi, ase omogondo orenge oichire ne ching'ende chi'egatani. Abaisraeli bagatama korwa ase Abafirisiti,

English: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
Kiswahili: Hakumruhusu mtu mwingine yeyote amfuate isipokuwa Petro, Yakobo na Yohana, nduguye Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Gose tanchete monto onde amotuny'ane, otatiga Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana momura omwabo Yakobo.

English: Then he brought me to the north gate and measured it. It had the same measurements as the others,
Kiswahili: Kisha akanileta mpaka kwenye lango la kaskazini na kulipima. Lilikuwa na vipimo sawa na yale mengine,
Ekegusii: Erio akang’ira ase oboagacho bware geita ase ensemo ya sugusu, akaborengia; naborobwo nigo bwareng’aine nayande.

English: If a man is found lying with another man’s wife, both the man who slept with her and the woman must die. You must purge the evil from Israel.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mwanaume atakutwa akizini na mke wa mtu mwingine, wote wawili, mwanaume na mwanamke aliyezini naye, lazima wauawe. Lazima mwondoe uovu katika Israeli.
Ekegusii: “Omonto omosacha aise konyorekana oraire n’omokuungu bw’omonto onde, bonsi babere, omosacha oria amo n’omokuungu oria, goika baitwe bakwe. Goika morusie obobe borue ase Abaisraeli.

English: For as the earth brings forth its growth, and as a garden enables seed to spring up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama vile ardhi ifanyavyo chipukizi kuota, na bustani isababishavyo mbegu kuota, ndivyo Bwana Mwenyezi atafanya haki na sifa zichipuke mbele ya mataifa yote.
Ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana ebimeri bikomera korwa riroba ime, na buna ebisimekire ase omogondo bigokina, naboigo Omonene araarente oboronge na ogotogia, bibe ase amasio ’abaanto b’ebisaku bionsi.

English: Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”
Kiswahili: Wekeni mikakati yenu, lakini itashindwa; fanyeni mipango yenu, lakini haitafanikiwa, kwa maana Mungu yu pamoja nasi.
Ekegusii: Inchuo amo mosemanie, korende nigo korabe bosa; kwana ring'ana riaino, korende tirikoba, ekiagera Nyasae nigo are amo naintwe.

English: that has come to you. All over the world this gospel is bearing fruit and growing, just as it has been doing among you since the day you heard it and truly understood the grace of God.
Kiswahili: iliyowafikia ninyi. Duniani kote Injili hii inazaa matunda na kuenea kama ilivyokuwa kwenu tangu siku ile mlipoisikia na kuielewa neema ya Mungu katika kweli yote.
Ekegusii: Echili nigo ekorenta ogosesenigwa na nigo agendererete koranda ense yonsi, buna koreng’ana yabeire ase more korwa rituko riria inwe mwaigwete igoro yobuya bwa Nyasae na mokabwenekia buna bore.

English: If anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone desires to harm them, he must be killed in this way.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote akitaka kuwadhuru, moto hutoka vinywani mwao na kuwateketeza adui zao. Hivi ndivyo impasavyo kufa mtu yeyote atakayetaka kuwadhuru.
Ekegusii: Na omonto kararigie kobachanda, omorero norue ase emenwa yabo, orie ababisa babo. Omonto kararigie kobachanda, nemogwenerete aitwe.

English: My soul refuses to touch them; they are loathsome food to me.
Kiswahili: Ninakataa kuvigusa; vyakula vya aina hii hunichukiza.
Ekegusii: Chindagera echio omoyo one ochiangire, chiabeire chindagera chikongechia.

English: For, behold, I will stir up and cause to come up against Babylon a company of great nations from the north country; and they will set themselves in array against her. She will be taken from there. Their arrows will be as of an expert mighty man. None of them will return in vain.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nitaamsha na kuleta dhidi ya Babeli muungano wa mataifa makubwa kutoka nchi ya kaskazini. Watashika nafasi zao dhidi yake, naye kutokea kaskazini atatekwa. Mishale yao itakuwa kama mishale ya mashujaa walio hodari, ambao hawawezi kurudi mikono mitupu.
Ekegusii: Naama! Inche ngoseegeta nde omoganda bw'ebisaku ebinene, korwa ase ense ya sugusu, na barabwo bebeke ang'e korwania Babiloni bayobue korwa ensemo eria ya sugusu. Chinsara chiabo nigo chinga buna omorwani omong'aini ore neganga otari koirana bosa.

English: Salt is good, but if the salt loses its savor, with what will it be seasoned?
Kiswahili: “Chumvi ni nzuri, lakini chumvi ikiwa imepoteza ladha yake, itafanywaje ili iweze kukolea tena?
Ekegusii: “Omonyo nomuya, korende omonyoo korasirie obwansu bwaye, ninki orabekwe bwanse?

English: Then it went down to the foot of the hill that faces the Valley of Hinnom at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim and ran down the Valley of Hinnom toward the southern slope of the Jebusites and downward to En-rogel.
Kiswahili: Mpaka ukateremka hadi shefela inayotazamana na Bonde la Ben-Hinomu, kaskazini mwa Bonde la Refaimu. Ukaendelea chini kwenye Bonde la Hinomu sambamba na mteremko wa kusini mwa mji mkubwa wa Wayebusi na kisha hadi En-Rogeli.
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo rogatirimboka rogaika ensinyo y’egetunwa kerochie Rikura ria Beni‐Hinomu, rire ensemo ya sugusu y’ense omweremo ya Refaimu. Erio rokagenda gochia Irianyi goetera Rikura ria Hinomu, Irianyi y’esagamo y’Abayebusi gochia Eni‐Rogeli.

English: Of all my sons (for Yahweh has given me many sons), he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of Yahweh's kingdom over Israel.
Kiswahili: Miongoni mwa wanangu wote, naye Bwana amenipa wengi, amemchagua Solomoni mwanangu ili kukikalia kiti cha enzi cha ufalme wa Bwana juu ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Omonene ong'eire abamura abange, na ase abwo bonsi ochorire Sulemani aikaranse ase ekerogo ki'oborwoti ki'Abaisraeli abw'Omonene akogambera.

English: Samson said, “Let me die with the Philistines.” Then he pushed with all his might, and the temple fell on the lords and all the people in it. So in his death he killed more than he had killed in his life.
Kiswahili: Samsoni akasema, “Nife pamoja na Wafilisti!” Ndipo akazisukuma zile nguzo kwa nguvu zake zote, lile jengo likaanguka juu ya viongozi na watu wote waliokuwamo mle ndani yake. Hivyo akawaua watu wengi wakati wa kufa kwake kuliko siku za uhai wake.
Ekegusii: Erio agateeba, “Tiga ’nkwe amo n’Abafilisti aba.” Naende agekumba ne chinguru chiaye chionsi, na enyomba eria ekagwera abatang’ani b’Abafilisti amo n’abanto bande bonsi abarengeo. Abanto baria Samusoni aitete ekero akwete omonyene nigo barenge abange kobua baria bonsi abaitete ekero arenge moyo.

English: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.
Kiswahili: Hizi pia zilikuwa koo za Walawi: ukoo wa Walibni; ukoo wa Wahebroni; ukoo wa Wamahli; ukoo wa Wamushi; ukoo wa wana wa Kora. (Kohathi alikuwa baba aliyemzaa Amramu;
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi'egesaku kia Lawi: Eamate y'Abalibini, na ey'Abaheburoni, na ey'Abamali na ey'Abamusi, na ey'Abakora. Kohati nere orenge ise Amuramu.

English: A Psalm by David. The earth is Yahweh's, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Dunia ni mali ya Bwana, na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake, ulimwengu, na wote waishio ndani yake,
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Ense na ebinto bire aroro nebia Omonene; oboiko bwonsi nobwaye, amo nabaanto bamenyeteo.

English: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.
Kiswahili: Wote walio wa Kristo Yesu wameusulubisha mwili na shauku zake pamoja na tamaa zake.
Ekegusii: Abwo bare abakristo Yeso baabambire chingencho chiabo chi'ebibe amo nokogania okobe na okorengereria kwabo.

English: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.
Kiswahili: wenye vyeo wakanyamazishwa, nazo ndimi zao zikagandamana na makaakaa ya vinywa vyao.
Ekegusii: Amariogi 'abagaambi nigo arenge gokea, chimeme chiabo chiabwatana namang'ang'ura abo.

English: Cretans and Arabians—we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”
Kiswahili: Wayahudi na waongofu, Wakrete na Waarabu, sote tunawasikia watu hawa wakisema mambo makuu ya ajabu ya Mungu katika lugha zetu wenyewe.”
Ekegusii: Abayahudi na abanto b'ebisaku binde abaonchogete, Abakirete na Abaarabu, intwe twensi twaigure aba iga bagokwana ase emenwa yaito igoro y'ogokora gwe chinguru kwa Nyasae.”

English: The older was named Oholah, and her sister was named Oholibah. They became Mine and gave birth to sons and daughters. As for their identities, Oholah is Samaria, and Oholibah is Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Mkubwa aliitwa Ohola na mdogo wake Oholiba. Walikuwa wangu nao wakazaa wavulana na msichana. Ohola ni Samaria, Oholiba ni Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Oria omonene nigo arenge korokwa Ohola, na oria omoke Oholiba. Abwo bakaba abaane, bakaibora abana, abamura na abaiseke. Engencho y’amarieta abo nero ere: Ohola nere Samaria, na Oholiba nere Yerusalemu.

English: like men wielding axes in a thicket of trees
Kiswahili: Walifanya kama watu wanaotumia mashoka kukata kichaka cha miti.
Ekegusii: Nigo yarorekanete buna nabaanto bakogecha emete, bakaimokia ebisire kogecha rinani rinoru.

English: But the servant who had received the one talent went off, dug a hole in the ground, and hid his master’s money.
Kiswahili: Lakini yule mtumishi aliyekuwa amepokea talanta moja, alikwenda akachimba shimo ardhini na kuificha ile fedha ya bwana wake.
Ekegusii: Korende oria oetwe etalanta eyeemo akagenda, agakuunya inse, akabisa ebesa y’omonene oye.

English: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.
Kiswahili: “Nimekuja kuleta moto duniani; laiti kama ungekuwa tayari umewashwa!
Ekegusii: “Nigo nachire gotongia omorero ase ense; onye ngwoka ore, anga ninki ndigetie naende?

English: and two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl, and the other on the left side of it.”
Kiswahili: Pia kuna mizeituni miwili karibu yake, mmoja upande wa kuume wa bakuli na mwingine upande wa kushoto.”
Ekegusii: Mbarabare ase ekebekerero keria gie chitaaya nereo emezeituni ebere, oyomo ensemo y'okorio na oyonde ensemo y'okobee.”

English: She brought up one of her cubs, and he became a young lion. After learning to tear his prey, he devoured men.
Kiswahili: Alimlea mmoja wa watoto wake, naye akawa simba mwenye nguvu. Akajifunza kurarua mawindo naye akala watu.
Ekegusii: Endo eria eaberi egakiinia emanwa yaye eyemo, ero ekaba endo ere ne chinguru, ekeorokereria gotwara, ekaba ekoria abanto.

English: Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of Yahweh of Armies, their God,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana akachochea roho ya Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli, mtawala wa Yuda, na roho ya kuhani mkuu Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, pamoja na roho za mabaki yote ya watu. Walikuja wakaanza kufanya kazi katika nyumba ya Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wao,
Ekegusii: Erio Omonene agasukia omoika o Serubabeli mosinto o Sealitieli, oyorenge omogabana bw'Abayuda, na oyo o Yoshua Omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, na oyo bw'abatigari bonsi b'abaanto. Bonsi amo bagacha bagakora emeremo ase enyomba y'Omonene bw'Emeganda, Nyasae obo.

English: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
Kiswahili: Jiwe walilolikataa waashi, limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni.
Ekegusii: Rigena riria abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona.

English: and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.
Kiswahili: Mimi ni Yeye Aliye Hai, niliyekuwa nimekufa, na tazama, ni hai milele na milele! Nami ninazo funguo za mauti na kuzimu.
Ekegusii: na oyore moyo. Inche konya nakuure, na rigereria, nigo inde moyo goika kare na kare, ninde nebigorero bi'amakweri na ebi'aase abakuure.

English: Now we pray to God that you will not do anything wrong—not that we will appear to have stood the test, but that you will do what is right, even if we appear to have failed.
Kiswahili: Lakini tunamwomba Mungu msije mkatenda kosa lolote, si ili sisi tuonekane kuwa tumeshinda hilo jaribio, bali ili ninyi mtende lililo haki, hata kama tutaonekana kuwa tumeshindwa.
Ekegusii: Korende twasabire Nyasae, timokora rinde rire riibe, tari ng’a intwe tororekane twancheirwe, korende inwe mokore erire rigiya, natoisa koba intwe buna abangirwe.

English: And there they found Adoni-bezek and fought against him, striking down the Canaanites and Perizzites.
Kiswahili: Huko ndiko walipomkuta huyo Adoni-Bezeki, nao wakapigana naye na kuwafanya Wakanaani na Waperizi wakimbie.
Ekegusii: Bakababua Abakaanani n’Abaperisi; bakanyora Adoni‐Bezeki agwo, erio bakamorwania.

English: And Pharaoh declared to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh, but without your permission, no one in all the land of Egypt shall lift his hand or foot.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Farao akamwambia Yosefu, “Mimi ni Farao, lakini pasipo neno lako, hakuna mtu mwenye ruhusa kuinua mkono au mguu katika nchi yote ya Misri.”
Ekegusii: Naende Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Ninche Farao. Otancheti aye, onde takoba ase ense yonsi ya Misiri oraimoke gokora gento.”

English: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples and found them sleeping because of grief,
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuomba, akawarudia wanafunzi wake akawakuta wamelala, wakiwa wamechoka kutokana na huzuni.
Ekegusii: Agachia koimoka korwa ase ogosaba agachiera aborokigwa baye, akabanyora bararire ase ogoichana.

English: At that instant, something like scales fell from Saul’s eyes, and his sight was restored. He got up and was baptized,
Kiswahili: Ghafula vitu kama magamba vikaanguka chini, kutoka machoni mwa Sauli, akapata kuona tena. Akasimama, akabatizwa.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima ebinto buna amasabo bikagwa korwa ase amaiso aye, akanyora okorora, agatenena, akabatiswa,

English: Do good, Yahweh, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, watendee mema walio wema, wale walio wanyofu wa moyo.
Ekegusii: Omonene, bakorere amaya abanto abwo bare abaya, abwo bare ne chinkoro chinyegenwa!

English: Seeing their faith, he said to him, “Man, your sins are forgiven you.”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipoiona imani yao, akamwambia yule mgonjwa, “Rafiki, dhambi zako zimesamehewa.”
Ekegusii: Agachia korora okwegena kwabo, akamoteebia, “Mosani, ebibe biao biabeirwe.”

English: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.
Kiswahili: Hili likahesabiwa kwake haki, kwa vizazi visivyo na mwisho vijavyo.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y'ogokora okwo Finehasi akabarwa ng'a nomonyene oboronge aare, ebiaare ase ebiaare kogenderera botambe.

English: The one who quarries stones may be injured by them, and he who splits logs endangers himself.
Kiswahili: Yeyote apasuaye mawe inawezekana yakamuumiza, yeyote apasuaye magogo inawezekana yakamuumiza.
Ekegusii: Oyo ogwatia amagena nigo araakwe naro, na oyo ogwatia emete, ande nanyore obokong’u asero.

English: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.
Kiswahili: Pasaka ya Wayahudi ilikuwa imekaribia.
Ekegusii: Na Epasaka, rituko rinene ri'Abayahudi, nigo yarenge ang'e.

English: When she has departed out of his house, she may go and be another man's wife.
Kiswahili: ikiwa baada ya kuondoka nyumbani kwake atakuwa mke wa mtu mwingine,
Ekegusii: Naende nenyaare koba ng'a omokungu oyio gatigire omosacha oria, agende anyuomwe n'omosaacha omoao,

English: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.
Kiswahili: Ewe usikiaye maombi, kwako wewe watu wote watakuja.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okoigwa ogosaba, ase ayio abanto bonsi mbache asore.

English: So she laughed to herself, saying, “After I am worn out and my master is old, will I now have this pleasure?”
Kiswahili: Hivyo Sara akacheka kimoyomoyo alipokuwa akiwaza, “Baada ya mimi kuwa mkongwe hivi na bwana wangu amezeeka, je, nitaweza kufurahia jambo hili?”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, Sara agaseka ase omoyo oye ime, ogoteeba: “Buna inde omogotu iga, na omosacha one nere ogotire, naki eranyarekane inyore omogooko oyio?”

English: Moses replied, “If you will do this—if you will arm yourselves before the LORD for battle,
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akawaambia, “Kama mtafanya jambo hili, kama mtajivika silaha mbele za Bwana kwa ajili ya vita,
Ekegusii: Musa akabairaneria, agateeba, “Onye mogochia gokora bo, rirorio bogoria ebirwanero biaino bi’eseegi ase obosio bw’Omonene, erio mogende korwana esegi.

English: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
Kiswahili: Wao wakamjibu, “Yesu wa Nazareti.” Yesu akawajibu, “Mimi ndiye.” Yuda, yule aliyemsaliti alikuwa amesimama pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Yeso Omonazareti.” Yeso akabateebia, “Ninche ere.” Yudasi nere oyomoruete nigo ateneine amo nabarabwo.

English: Solomon offered sacrifices there before the LORD on the bronze altar in the Tent of Meeting, where he offered a thousand burnt offerings.
Kiswahili: Solomoni akapanda huko yalikokuwa madhabahu ya shaba mbele za Bwana katika Hema la Kukutania, na kutoa dhabihu 1,000 za sadaka za kuteketezwa juu yake.
Ekegusii: Agwo Sulemani agatiira gochia ase egesasiimero keria kiarenge agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, na igoro yaye akaruera Omonene ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa elifu eyemo.

English: Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kwa hiyo, ninyi wachungaji, lisikieni neno la Bwana:
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio, inwe abarisia, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.

English: If they wish to inquire about something, they are to ask their own husbands at home; for it is dishonorable for a woman to speak in the church.
Kiswahili: Kama wakitaka kuuliza kuhusu jambo lolote, wawaulize waume zao nyumbani. Kwa maana ni aibu kwa mwanamke kuzungumza kanisani.
Ekegusii: Onye barigetie kweorokereria ring’ana, tiga baborie abasacha babo inka. Naki nobosooku omokungu gokwana ase ekanisa.

English: The magicians of Egypt did the same thing with their enchantments. So Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he didn't listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.
Kiswahili: Lakini waganga wa Misri kwa kutumia siri ya uganga wao wakafanya vivyo hivyo, nao moyo wa Farao ukawa mgumu, hakuwasikiliza Mose na Aroni, kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa amesema.
Ekegusii: Erio abaringoria ba Misiri bagakora boigo ase oborogi bwabo. Farao akagenderera gokong'ia enkoro yaye, na buna Omonene konya atebiire, tabaigwa.

English: David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites; for those were the inhabitants of the land who were of old, on the way to Shur, even to the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Basi Daudi na watu wake wakapanda na kuwashambulia Wageshuri, Wagirizi na Waamaleki. (Tangu zamani haya mataifa yalikuwa yameishi kwenye eneo lililotanda kuanzia Telemu katika njia iteremkayo Shuri hadi kufikia nchi ya Misri.)
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Daudi na abanto baye bakaba bakogenda korwania Abagesuri, na Abagirisi, na Abaameleki. Abwo nigo baarenge ababiare b'ense eyio korwa kare; nigo bamenyete goika Suri na goika orobebe rw'ense ya Misiri.

English: He wrote the same things to King Demetrius, to Attalus, to Arathes, to Arsaces,
Kiswahili: Aliandika mambo yaleyale kwa Mfalme Demetrio, kwa Attalus, kwa Arathes, kwa Arsaces,
Ekegusii: Lukio akamoriikera riruube erio erio omorwoti Demeturio, Atalo, Ariarathe na Arisake,

English: You shall allot it as an inheritance for yourselves and for the foreigners who dwell among you and who have children. You are to treat them as native-born Israelites; along with you, they shall be allotted an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.
Kiswahili: Mtaigawanya kuwa urithi kwa ajili yenu na kwa ajili ya wageni wanaoishi miongoni mwenu na ambao wana watoto. Wao watakuwa kwenu kama wenyeji wazawa wa Israeli, pamoja na ninyi watagawiwa urithi miongoni mwa makabila ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Moyiaterane ase ogoaka obomera, ebe emiando yaino na ey’abamenyi bare ase egati yaino baiborerete abana ase egati yaino. Abwo babe ase more buna ababiare b’Abaisraeli, baegwe emiando ase egati y’ebisaku biaino inwe Abaisraeli.

English: Hanani, one of my brothers, arrived with men from Judah. So I questioned them about the remnant of the Jews who had survived the exile, and also about Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Hanani, mmoja wa ndugu zangu, alikuja kutoka Yuda akiwa na watu wengine, nami nikawauliza kuhusu mabaki ya Wayahudi wale walionusurika kwenda uhamishoni na pia kuhusu Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Hanani, oyomo bw’abaminto, agacha amo nabaanto bande korwa ase ense y’Abayuda. Nkababooria igoro y’Abayahudi bande batigarete aroro bare moyo, abwo konya batoorekire korwa ase obosomba, naende nkababoria amang’ana igoro ya Yerusalemu.

English: When they were near Jebus and the day was almost gone, the servant said to his master, “Please, let us stop at this Jebusite city and spend the night here.”
Kiswahili: Alipokaribia Yebusi na usiku ukiwa umekaribia, mtumishi akamwambia bwana wake, “Haya sasa natuingie katika mji huu wa Wayebusi tulale humo.”
Ekegusii: Bagaika ensemo erochie Yebusi, na konya bwairire, omosomba agateebia omonene oye, “Inchuo, togobere gochia ase omochie oyo bw’Abayebusi, erio toraare aroro ase obotuko obo.”

English: Better one handful with tranquility than two handfuls with toil and pursuit of the wind.
Kiswahili: Afadhali konzi moja pamoja na utulivu kuliko konzi mbili pamoja na taabu na kukimbiza upepo.
Ekegusii: Mbuya koba negento geichire oroe oromo na koba nomorembe, kobua koba n’ebinto biichire chindoe ibere na koba nogwechanda na kominyokera konyora ebire buna embeo bosa.

English: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age, and he made him a tunic of many colors.
Kiswahili: Basi, Israeli akampenda Yosefu kuliko yeyote miongoni mwa kaka zake, kwani ni mwanawe wa uzeeni, akamshonea joho lililorembwa vizuri sana.
Ekegusii: Bono Israeli nigo anchete Yusufu kobua abana baye bande bonsi, ekiagera nigo areenge omwana oye bw'obogotu. Akamoroiseria eanga engiya entambe.

English: Then all your sons will be taught by the LORD, and great will be their prosperity.
Kiswahili: Watoto wako wote watafundishwa na Bwana, nayo amani ya watoto wako itakuwa kuu.
Ekegusii: “Abana bao bonsi mbabe bakworokererigwa n’Omonene, na omorembe omonge nobe amo nabarabwo.

English: This is what the LORD says: “Heaven is My throne, and earth is My footstool. What kind of house will you build for Me? Or where will My place of repose be?
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, “Mbingu ni kiti changu cha enzi, nayo dunia ni mahali pa kuweka miguu yangu. Iko wapi nyumba mtakayoijenga kwa ajili yangu? Mahali pangu pa kupumzikia patakuwa wapi?
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Igoro nero ekerogo kiane ki’obonene, na ense negeteni kiane ki’amagoro; inyomba ki moranyare kong’agachera? Gose ng’ai aase are ndanyare gotimokera?

English: For in Christ Jesus the law of the Spirit of life set you free from the law of sin and death.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu sheria ya Roho wa uzima katika Kristo Yesu imeniweka huru mbali na sheria ya dhambi na mauti.
Ekegusii: Inaki ogochika kw’Omoika bw’obogima boria bore ime ase Kristo Yeso gwansiboire korwa ase ogochika kw’ebibe na amakweri.

English: With the 1,775 shekels of silver he made the hooks for the posts, overlaid their tops, and supplied bands for them.
Kiswahili: Akatumia zile shekeli hizo 1,775 kutengeneza kulabu za nguzo, kufunika ncha za nguzo na kutengeneza vitanzi vyake.
Ekegusii: Ase chifeta chikiro emerongo etato na isano chiatigarete chiakoreretwe ase okoroisia ebigobanio bie chisiiro na ase okooma ebisure biabo, na koroisia chinuga chiabo.

English: Shemaiah’s sons were Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad; his brothers were Elihu and Semachiah, also capable men.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Shemaya ni: Othni, Refaeli, Obedi na Elizabadi; jamaa zake Elihu na Semakia walikuwa pia watu wenye uwezo.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Semaya nabwo aba: Otini na Refaeli, na Obedi, na Elisabadi; boigo Elihu na Semakia, abamura bamwabo Semaya, nigo barenge abamura abakong’u mono ase emeremo yabo.

English: I will praise your name continually. I will sing praise with thanksgiving. My prayer was heard.
Kiswahili: Nitalisifu jina lako daima. Nitaimba sifa kwa shukrani. Sala yangu ilisikiwa.
Ekegusii: Nintogie erieta riao goika kare na kare, ningotererie ogoteera kw'ogogwakera buya” Ogosaba kwane ng'a koigweke ase ore;

English: O LORD God, do not reject Your anointed one. Remember Your loving devotion to Your servant David.”
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mungu, usimkatae mpakwa mafuta wako. Kumbuka upendo mkuu uliomwahidia Daudi mtumishi wako.”
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene Nyasae, torusia obosio bwao korwa ase omoakwa amaguta oo! Inyora obwanchani bwao botari koera ase omosomba oo Daudi.”

English: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.
Kiswahili: Sikiliza! Sikiliza ngurumo ya sauti yake, sauti ya ngurumo itokayo kinywani mwake.
Ekegusii: Tegerera oigwe okogukura kw'eriogi riaye, na okoruma gokorwa ase omonwa oye.

English: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?
Kiswahili: Au mwadhani kwamba Andiko lasema bure kuwa huyo Roho ambaye Mungu amemweka ndani yetu hututamani kiasi cha kuona wivu?
Ekegusii: Gose nigo mokagete ng'a namang'ana abosa, ekero amariiko agoteeba iga, “Omoika oyomenyete ime yaito nigo okogania ore ne risemi.”

English: Consider the work of God, for who can make that straight which he has made crooked?
Kiswahili: Tafakari kile Mungu alichokitenda: Nani awezaye kunyoosha kile ambacho yeye amekipinda?
Ekegusii: Rengereria emeremo ya Nyasae! Ning'o oranyare korongeyia egento Omonene akorire borogochi?

English: You shall not wrong one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: Mmoja asimpunje mwingine, bali utamcha Mungu wako. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wako.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa gokorerana oborianania, korende moiroke Nyasae oino, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.

English: He will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he has sinned, and with which he has made Israel to sin.”
Kiswahili: Naye atawaacha Israeli kwa ajili ya makosa ya Yeroboamu aliyoyatenda na kusababisha Israeli kuyatenda.”
Ekegusii: Ere natige Abaisraeli ase engencho y'ebibe ebi Yeroboamu akorete, akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.”

English: But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akamwambia, “Rafiki, ni nani aliyeniweka mimi kuwa hakimu wenu au msuluhishi juu yenu?”
Ekegusii: Akamoboria, “Omonto oyo, ning'o ombekire koba omogambi gose omwatanani igoro ase more?”

English: Noah built an altar to Yahweh, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
Kiswahili: Kisha Noa akamjengea Bwana madhabahu, akachukua baadhi ya wale wanyama na ndege wote walio safi, akatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Erio Nuhu akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero, akarusia eyemo ase kera eng'iti, na ase kera enyoni echenegete, agachirua buna ekeng'wanso ki'ogosaambwa igoro ase egesasiimero keria.

English: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers' houses.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Waisraeli wakafanya kila kitu Bwana alichomwamuru Mose. Hivyo ndivyo walivyopiga kambi chini ya alama zao, pia hivyo ndivyo walivyoondoka, kila mmoja akiwa na ukoo wake na jamaa yake.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora onsi buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa. Bagatoora inse ye chibendera chiabo, naende kobakogeenda orogeendo, bakageenda kera oyomo amo neamate yaye, n'enyomba yaye.

English: They shall eat those things with which atonement was made, to consecrate and sanctify them; but a stranger shall not eat of it, because they are holy.
Kiswahili: Watakula sadaka hizi ambazo upatanisho ulifanywa kwazo kwa ajili ya kuwaweka wakfu na kuwatakasa. Lakini hakuna mtu mwingine yeyote anayeruhusiwa kuvila, kwa sababu ni vitakatifu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo barie ebinto ebi biarurwe ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ekero baatananetwe ase emeremo emechenu. Monto onde omoao takoba ne ribaga ri'okobiria, ekiagera ebinto ebi nebichenu.

English: Of those men who had gone to spy out the land, only Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh remained alive.
Kiswahili: Miongoni mwa watu waliokwenda kuipeleleza hiyo nchi, ni Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, na Kalebu mwana wa Yefune peke yao waliosalia.
Ekegusii: Korende Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, barabwo boka bagatigwa bare moyo korwa ase abanto baria bagendete koroota ense eria. Abaisraeli bagoteema gosoa Kaanani engaki entang’ani (Okoir 1:41-46)

English: One said, “Please be pleased to go with your servants.” He answered, “I will go.”
Kiswahili: Kisha mmoja wao akasema, “Je, tafadhali, huwezi kufuatana na watumishi wako?” Elisha akajibu, “Nitakuja.”
Ekegusii: Oyomo obo akamoteebia: “Koranche, ogende amo naintwe abasomba bao.” Elisha akamoiraneria: “Ee, ningende amo nainwe.”

English: In those days I saw people in Judah treading winepresses on the Sabbath and bringing in grain and loading it on donkeys, along with wine, grapes, and figs. All kinds of goods were being brought into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day. So I warned them against selling food on that day.
Kiswahili: Siku hizo nikaona watu katika Yuda wakikanyaga mashinikizo ya divai siku ya Sabato na kuleta nafaka wakiwapakiza punda, pamoja na divai, zabibu, tini na aina nyingine za mizigo. Nao walikuwa wakileta haya yote Yerusalemu siku ya Sabato. Kwa hiyo niliwaonya dhidi ya kuuza vyakula siku hiyo.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio nkarora agwo ase ense y’Abayuda abanto barenge komita edivai ase rituko ri’Esabato. Boigo bakarenta endagera na bakabeekera chitigere chigurube; naende nigo barenge korenta edivai, na amasabibu, na amako, ne chigurube chinde ao ao ase Yerusalemu ase rituko ri’Esabato. Nkabakuurera bokong’u tibaabaisa koonia endagera ase rituko erio.

English: Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”
Kiswahili: Tazama, leo nimekuweka juu ya mataifa na falme ili kungʼoa na kubomoa, kuharibu na kuangamiza, kujenga na kupanda.”
Ekegusii: Naama! Rituko ria reero nakoeire okobua igoro y'ebisaku, na igoro y'amarwoti, obe kogosimora na gotagora, kogosaria na koonchorana, koagacha na gosimeka.”

English: He captured Agag king of Amalek alive, but devoted all the others to destruction with the sword.
Kiswahili: Akamchukua Agagi, mfalme wa Waamaleki akiwa hai, nao watu wake wote akawaangamiza kabisa kwa upanga.
Ekegusii: Akabwata Agagi, omorwoti bw’Abaameleki, akamotiga ore moyo, korende abande bonsi pi akabaita n’emioro.

English: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Mika walikuwa: Pithoni, Meleki, Tarea, na Ahazi.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Mika nabwo aba: Pitoni na Meleki, Tarea na Ahasi.

English: But Hamor said to them, “My son Shechem longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as his wife.
Kiswahili: Lakini Hamori akawaambia, “Moyo wa mwanangu Shekemu umeelekea kwa binti yenu. Tafadhali mpeni awe mke wake.
Ekegusii: Hamori agakwana nabarabwo, akabora: “Omomura one Sekemu omwanchire omoiseke oino, bono komoranche, momomoe amonyuome.

English: Instead, we should write and tell them to abstain from food polluted by idols, from sexual immorality, from the meat of strangled animals, and from blood.
Kiswahili: Badala yake, tuwaandikie kwamba wajiepushe na vyakula vilivyonajisiwa kwa kutolewa sanamu, wajiepushe na uasherati, au kula mnyama aliyenyongwa, na damu.
Ekegusii: korende tobarikere riruube ng’a beatanane korwa ase ebinto bitachenegeti bi’emegwekano y’ogosaasimwa, na obotomani, na enyama ende yonsi y’eng’iti eng’entire, na korwa ase amanyinga.

English: The men of Judah said, “Why have you come up against us?” They said, “We have come up to bind Samson, to do to him as he has done to us.”
Kiswahili: Watu wa Yuda wakawauliza, “Kwa nini mmekuja kupigana nasi?” Wakawajibu, “Tumekuja ili kumkamata Samsoni na kumtenda kama alivyotutendea.”
Ekegusii: Abayuda bakababoria, “Nase ki mwachire gotorwania?” Barabwo bakairaneria, “Nigo twachire gosiba Samusoni, tomokorere ere buna atokorera intwe.”

English: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”
Kiswahili: Basi msaliti alikuwa amewapa hao watu ishara, kwamba: “Yule nitakayembusu ndiye. Mkamateni, mkamchukue chini ya ulinzi.”
Ekegusii: Ere oyokomorua konya obaeire ekemanyererio, ogoteeba, “Oyo ndanyunyunte, oyio nere, momobwate, momoire momorendete.”

English: and reconciling both of them to God in one body through the cross, by which He extinguished their hostility.
Kiswahili: naye katika mwili huu mmoja awapatanishe wote wawili na Mungu kupitia msalaba, ili kwa huo msalaba akaangamiza uadui wao.
Ekegusii: na kobwatania baria babere na Nyasae ase omobere oyoomo, ase omosalaba, aase aiterete obobisa boria.

English: See that you don't refuse him who speaks. For if they didn't escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,
Kiswahili: Angalieni, msije mkamkataa yeye anenaye. Ikiwa wao hawakuepuka adhabu walipomkataa yeye aliyewaonya hapa duniani, sisi je, tutaokokaje tusipomsikiliza yeye anayetuonya kutoka mbinguni?
Ekegusii: Rigereria, timomwanga ere oyogokwana. Naki onye baria tibetooretie baria bamwangete ere oyobakuurerete ase ense, kobua mono intwe titogwetooria onye tokomwanga ere oyogotokuurera korwa igoro.

English: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?
Kiswahili: Nafsi yangu inamwonea Mungu kiu, Mungu aliye hai. Ni lini nitaweza kwenda kukutana na Mungu?
Ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo ore nerang'o asore aye Nyasae ore moyo. Ndiriri ndachiche ndore obosio bwao, aye Nyasae?

English: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo neno lililomjia Yeremia kutoka kwa Bwana:
Ekegusii: Ring’ana rikarua ase Omonene rigacha ase ’nde inche Yeremia,

English: When Mahalalel was 65 years old, he became the father of Jared.
Kiswahili: Mahalaleli alipokuwa ameishi miaka sitini na mitano, akamzaa Yaredi.
Ekegusii: Ekero Mahalaleli emenyire emiaka emerongo etano nomo, na etano (65), akaibora Yaredi.

English: he gave this command to the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD:
Kiswahili: akawapa Walawi wale waliolibeba Sanduku la Agano la Bwana agizo hili, akawaambia:
Ekegusii: Erio agachiika Abalawi baria barenge kobogoria Esanduki eria y’Omonene, ere ne’chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’ogotianania, agateeba,

English: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Lotani walikuwa wawili: Hori na Homamu. Lotani alikuwa na dada yake aliyeitwa Timna.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Lotani nabwo Hori na Homamu; omosubati omwabo Lotani nigo arenge korokwa Timuna.

English: May this heap be a witness, and the pillar be a witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and that you will not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.
Kiswahili: Lundo hili ni shahidi na nguzo hii ni shahidi, kwamba sitavuka lundo hili kuja upande wako kukudhuru, nawe kwamba hutavuka lundo hili na nguzo hii kuja upande wangu kunidhuru.
Ekegusii: Etui eye ebe kirori, na esiiro eye ebe kirori boigo, ng'a tingotamboka etui eye inchiche bwoo, gose aye togoetania etui eye na esiiro eye ochiche bwone, tokorerane amabe.

English: And whoever welcomes a little child like this in My name welcomes Me. Temptations and Trespasses (Mark 9:42–48; Luke 17:1–4)
Kiswahili: “Yeyote amkaribishaye mtoto mdogo kama huyu kwa Jina langu, anikaribisha mimi.
Ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oraariganie omwana oyomo buna oyo ase erieta riane, oyio onyariganirie inche. Ogotemwa gokora ebibe (Mar 9:42-48; Luk 17:1-2)

English: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
Kiswahili: kwa maana yeye humtosheleza mwenye kiu, na kumshibisha mwenye njaa kwa vitu vyema.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoisanekia oyore n'erang'o, na oyore n'enchara omoigotia n'ebinto ebiya.

English: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for Yahweh sustains me.
Kiswahili: Ninajilaza na kupata usingizi; naamka tena, kwa maana Bwana hunitegemeza.
Ekegusii: Nigo ngwetoora na korara chitoro, erio naboka naende, ekiagera Omonene nigo agendererete kondenda.

English: Then I answered them, and said to them, “The God of heaven will prosper us. Therefore we, his servants, will arise and build; but you have no portion, nor right, nor memorial in Jerusalem.”
Kiswahili: Nikawajibu kwa kusema, “Mungu wa mbinguni atatufanikisha. Sisi watumishi wake tutaanza kujenga upya, lakini kwenu ninyi, hamna sehemu wala dai lolote wala kumbukumbu la haki katika Yerusalemu.”
Ekegusii: Erio nkairaneria, nkabateebia, “Nyasae o igoro nere oratoe obobui; ase ayio intwe, abasomba baye, ngochaka tore nkoagacha. Korende inwe timobwati egetari kende gionsi aiga, gose timobwati oboronge gose okoinyorwa konde gwonsi ase Yerusalemu.”

English: Charm is deceptive and beauty is fleeting, but a woman who fears the LORD is to be praised.
Kiswahili: Kujipamba ili kuvutia ni udanganyifu na uzuri unapita upesi, bali mwanamke anayemcha Bwana atasifiwa.
Ekegusii: Obonyakieni nigo bokong’ainereria, na ekieni ekiya nigo kere bosa, korende omokungu omoirogete Omonene, oyio nere oranyaare gotogigwa.

English: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
Kiswahili: Ndoa na iheshimiwe na watu wote, nayo malazi yawe safi, kwa kuwa Mungu atawahukumu wazinzi na waasherati wote.
Ekegusii: Okonyuomana gosikwe nabaanto bonsi, na ebiraarero bibe bitari nobosooku, naki abanyaka na abatomani Nyasae nabagaambie ekiina.

English: This phrase, “Yet once more” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.
Kiswahili: Maneno haya “kwa mara moja tena” yanaonyesha kuondoshwa kwa vile vitu vinavyoweza kutetemeshwa, yaani vile vitu vilivyoumbwa, kwa kusudi vile tu visivyoweza kutetemeshwa vibaki.
Ekegusii: Korende ring'ana eri, “Ara rimo naende”, nigo rikoorokia, ng'a ebinto biria bigotengechigwa nigo birang'anyigwe ekiagera biatongetwe, erinde ebitanyare gotengechigwa bibeo.

English: Yahweh said to Moses on Mount Sinai,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose katika Mlima Sinai,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, akamoteebia,

English: as water wears away the stones and torrents wash away the soil, so You destroy a man’s hope.
Kiswahili: kama maji yamalizavyo mawe, na mafuriko yachukuavyo udongo, ndivyo unavyoharibu tegemeo la mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: buna amaache agwata amagena asamunyokana, ne chiooro chiaira amaroba aera, naboigo aye ogosiria ogosemeria kwa Mwanyabaanto.

English: “What do You want with us, Son of God?” they shouted. “Have You come here to torture us before the appointed time?”
Kiswahili: Wakapiga kelele, “Una nini nasi, Mwana wa Mungu? Umekuja hapa kututesa kabla ya wakati ulioamriwa?”
Ekegusii: Na rora, barabwo bagaaka eriogi bakaboora, “Inki obwate naintwe, Omwana o Nyasae? Inee! Ngwachire aiga gotoita ekero engaki etaraika?”

English: Who knows whether God will not turn and relent, and turn away from his fierce anger, so that we might not perish?”
Kiswahili: Ni nani ajuaye? Huenda Mungu akaghairi kwa huruma yake akaacha hasira yake kali ili tusiangamie.”
Ekegusii: Kero kende Nyasae nabo abaise koonchoreria ebirengererio biaye; kero kende nabaise gotiga koba n'ekeririanda, naitwe titogokwa!”

English: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.
Kiswahili: Msishiriki matendo ya giza yasiyofaa, bali yafichueni.
Ekegusii: Timosaanga n'ogokora kw'omosuunte ogotakwama, korende ribaga ri'ayio mokoorokie,

English: Whereas my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.’”
Kiswahili: Baba yangu aliweka nira nzito juu yenu, mimi nitaifanya hata iwe nzito zaidi. Baba yangu aliwachapa kwa mijeledi, mimi nitawachapa kwa nge.’ ”
Ekegusii: Na bono rikorogoto riria rikong’u tata ababeekerete, inche nigo ndarimente ribe ririto goetania. Tata nigo arenge kobang’wania ebiranya, korende inche nigo ndabe nkobang’wania ne chinkini chichomire chibonyi mesia.”

English: Curse the whisperer and double-tongued, for he has destroyed many who were at peace.
Kiswahili: Mlaani mnong'onezi na mwenye lugha mbili, kwa maana amewaangamiza wengi waliokuwa na amani.
Ekegusii: Oragererigwe omonto ore omogenki naende omorimo, ekiagera osiririe abanto abange abwo bamenyete are okwegena.

English: Righteous Father, although the world has not known You, I know You, and they know that You sent Me.
Kiswahili: “Baba Mwenye Haki, ingawa ulimwengu haukujui, mimi ninakujua, nao wanajua ya kuwa umenituma.
Ekegusii: Tata omonyene oboronge, ense tiyakomanyete, korende inche nakomanyete; na aba bamanyire ng’a naye gwantomete.

English: They performed the duty of their God and the duty of the purification, and so did the singers and the gatekeepers, according to the commandment of David and of Solomon his son.
Kiswahili: Walifanya ibada ya Mungu wao na ibada ya utakaso, nao waimbaji na walinzi wa lango wakafanya hivyo pia, kufuatana na amri za Daudi na Solomoni mwanawe.
Ekegusii: Abakuani na Abalawi bagakora emeremo ya Nyasae obo, na ey'ogochena. Abateri na abarendi b'ebiita bakaba bagokora emeremo yabo buna Daudi na Sulemani, omomura oye, bachigete.

English: And I establish My covenant with you: Never again will all life be cut off by the waters of a flood; never again will there be a flood to destroy the earth.”
Kiswahili: Ninaweka Agano nanyi: Kamwe uhai hautafutwa tena kwa gharika, kamwe haitakuwepo tena gharika ya kuangamiza dunia.”
Ekegusii: Ngokora nde okobwatana kw’ogotianania nainwe, ng’a kende gionsi kere moyo tigekomerwa naende n’amaache y’etoigo, gose etoigo tegocha koba naende egosaria ense magega y’ayio.”

English: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.
Kiswahili: wa kiume na wa kike, walikuja kwa Noa wakaingia katika safina kama Mungu alivyomwamuru Noa.
Ekegusii: chigasoa ase obwato amo na Nuhu ibere ibere, chinsacha ne chinkuungu, buna Nyasae achiigete Nuhu.

English: So David commanded his young men, and they killed Rechab and Baanah. They cut off their hands and feet and hung their bodies by the pool in Hebron, but they took the head of Ish-bosheth and buried it in Abner’s tomb in Hebron.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Daudi akawaamuru watu wake, wakawaua. Wakakata mikono yao na miguu, na kutundika viwiliwili vyao kando ya dimbwi huko Hebroni. Lakini wakakichukua kichwa cha Ish-Boshethi na kukizika katika kaburi la Abneri huko Hebroni.
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi agachiika abanto baye, barabwo bagaita Rekabu na Baana, bakababutora amaboko na amagoro, bakabasunga ang’e ne ritibo agwo Heburoni. Korende omotwe o Isi‐Boseti bakayoira, bakayotindeka ase embeera y’Abineri agwo Heburoni.

English: After John’s messengers had left, Jesus began to speak to the crowds about John: “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed swaying in the wind?
Kiswahili: Wajumbe wa Yohana walipoondoka, Yesu akaanza kusema na makutano kuhusu Yohana Mbatizaji. Akawauliza, “Mlipokwenda kule nyikani, mlikwenda kuona nini? Je, ni unyasi ukipeperushwa na upepo?
Ekegusii: Na abatomwa baria ba Yohana bachia kogenda, agachaaka goteebia omoganda igoro ya Yohana, “Inki mwachiete korora aria ase erooro? Egetonto gekonyegerigwa nembeo?

English: One will say to him, ‘What are these wounds between your arms?' Then he will answer, ‘Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.'
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu atamuuliza, ‘Majeraha haya yaliyo mwilini mwako ni ya nini?' Atajibu, ‘Ni majeraha niliyoyapata katika nyumba ya rafiki zangu.'
Ekegusii: Omonto karamoborie, “Ng'ai kwanyorete ebimanyererio ebi bie chingoma bire ase amaboko ao?” Ere nairanerie, “Ebi nigo nabinyorete korwa ase enyomba y'abwo inyanchete.”

English: Their whole body, including their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around, even the wheels that the four of them had.
Kiswahili: Miili yao yote, pamoja na migongo yao, mikono na mabawa yao yote yalikuwa yamejaa macho kabisa kama yalivyokuwa yale magurudumu yao manne.
Ekegusii: Emebere y'ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria, na emegongo yabo, na amaboko abo, ne chimbaaba chiabo, amo namagoro aria ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria baane babwate, nigo biaichire namaiso ase chinsemo chionsi.

English: Halhul, Beth-zur, Gedor,
Kiswahili: Halhuli, Beth-Suri, Gedori,
Ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Halihuli, na Beti‐Suri, na Gedori,

English: This is the first and great commandment.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo amri iliyo kuu, tena ni ya kwanza.
Ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika okonene, naende nakwo kw'eritang'ani.

English: When those tending the pigs saw what had happened, they ran off and reported this in the town and countryside.
Kiswahili: Wale watu waliokuwa wakichunga lile kundi la nguruwe walipoona yaliyotukia, wakakimbia, wakaeneza habari hizi mjini na mashambani.
Ekegusii: Abarisia bagachia korora ayio, bagatama, bakararia amang’ana ase omochie na ebichie.

English: that you may enter into the covenant of Yahweh your God, and into his oath, which Yahweh your God makes with you today,
Kiswahili: Mnasimama hapa ili kufanya Agano na Bwana Mungu wenu, Agano ambalo Mungu analifanya nanyi siku hii ya leo na kulitia muhuri kwa kiapo,
Ekegusii: Na boono 'monyaare gosoa ase okobwatana kw'ogotianania okw'Omonene Nyasae oino, agokora amo nainwe rituko ria reero,

English: Don't envy the success of a sinner; for you don't know what his end will be.
Kiswahili: Usimwonee wivu mwenye dhambi kwa mafanikio yake; kwa maana hujui mwisho wake utakuwaje.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koreera omonto otari omooronge endamwamu ekero are n'obuya, ekiagera tokomanya ng'a obuya obwo 'mechando ki boramoretere.

English: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Sukothi na kupiga kambi huko Ethamu, pembeni mwa jangwa.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Sukoti, bakageenda Etamu, ase ensinyo y'erooro, bagatoora aroro.

English: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
Kiswahili: Lakini ulituponda na kutufanya makao ya mbweha, na ukatufunika kwa giza nene.
Ekegusii: erinde otoake na gototuguta ase chisese chi'orosana chimenyete, gose gototuba ekiriri ki'amakweri.

English: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices.
Kiswahili: Lakini baadhi ya makuhani walifanya kazi ya kuchanganya vikolezo.
Ekegusii: Abande b'abamura b'abakuani nigo babegetwe kwearigania na gwochogania ebinsari.

English: When evening came, the disciples came to Him and said, “This is a desolate place, and the hour is already late. Dismiss the crowds so they can go to the villages and buy themselves some food.”
Kiswahili: Ilipofika jioni, wanafunzi wake walienda kwake, wakamwambia, “Mahali hapa ni nyikani, na muda sasa umekwisha. Waage makutano ili waende zao vijijini wakajinunulie chakula.”
Ekegusii: Ekero riachia koba mogoroba, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera, bakaboora, “Aase aa negesomo, ngochia koira bore, batige abanto bagende ebinyoro begorere endagera.”

English: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.
Kiswahili: Kuanzisha ugomvi ni kama kutoboa bwawa la maji; kwa hiyo acha jambo hilo kabla mabishano hayajaanza.
Ekegusii: Ogochaaka eriomana nigo konga buna amaache aigoreirwe, ase ayio tiga amang'ana y'eriomana atarabucha.

English: I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for a heritage: I am Yahweh.'”
Kiswahili: Nami nitawaleta mpaka nchi niliyoapa kwa mkono ulioinuliwa kumpa Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo. Nitawapa iwe milki yenu. Mimi ndimi Bwana.' ”
Ekegusii: Nimbaire goika ense eria nariete eira koa Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo. Nimbayee ebe omwando oino. Inche ninche Omonene.”

English: Before he had finished speaking, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher on her shoulder.
Kiswahili: Ikawa kabla hajamaliza kuomba, Rebeka akatokea akiwa na mtungi begani mwake. Alikuwa binti wa Bethueli. Bethueli alikuwa mwana wa Milka aliyekuwa mke wa Nahori ndugu wa Abrahamu.
Ekegusii: Ritang'ani atarakoora ogosaba kwaye, akarora Rebeka ogocha obogoretie enyongo yaye mareko. Ere nomoiseke o Betueli, na Betueli nomwana o Milka, moka Nahori, momura omwabo Aburaamu.

English: And: “In the beginning, O Lord, You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
Kiswahili: Pia asema, “Hapo mwanzo, Ee Bwana, uliweka misingi ya dunia, nazo mbingu ni kazi ya mikono yako.
Ekegusii: Naende agateeba. “Naye Omonene, kwabegete oboroso bw’ense korwa omochakano, na igoro chionsi nemeremo y’amaboko ao.

English: Yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.
Kiswahili: Bado kitambo kidogo, nao waovu hawataonekana, ingawa utawatafuta, hawataonekana.
Ekegusii: Netigarete engaki ensinini, na omokori amabe asirigwe; nobe gokorigereria mono aase aye, takonyorekana oreo.

English: As He approached the town gate, He saw a dead man being carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. And a large crowd from the town was with her.
Kiswahili: Alipokaribia lango la mji, alikutana na watu waliokuwa wamebeba maiti wakitoka nje ya mji. Huyu aliyekufa alikuwa mwana pekee wa mwanamke mjane. Umati mkubwa wa watu wa mji ule ulikuwa pamoja na huyo mwanamke.
Ekegusii: Nabo, agachia goika ang’e ase egeita ki’omochie, rora, agwo nkiarengeo egetondo kebogoirie gocha isiko, omwana omomoima ase ng’ina, na ng’ina nomoboraka orenge, na abanto abange b’omochie mbarenge amo nere.

English: Three days after his arrival in the province, Festus went up from Caesarea to Jerusalem,
Kiswahili: Siku tatu baada ya Festo kuwasili Kaisaria kuchukua wajibu wake mpya, alipanda kwenda Yerusalemu,
Ekegusii: Bono Festo gasoire ase obogambi bwaye, magega y’amatuko atato agatiira gochia Yerusalemu korwa Kaisaria.

English: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, “A man of God came to me, and his face was like the face of the angel of God, very awesome. I didn't ask him where he was from, neither did he tell me his name;
Kiswahili: Ndipo huyo mwanamke akamwendea mumewe na kumweleza kuwa, “Mtu wa Mungu alinijia. Kule kuonekana kwake kulikuwa kama kwa malaika wa Mungu, wa kutisha sana. Sikumuuliza alikotoka wala hakuniambia jina lake.
Ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria akageenda agateebia omosacha oye, “Omonto o Nyasae nachicha ase 'nde: nigo arenge kororekana buna omomalaika o Nyasae, nigo arenge bw'okoondokia mono. Tinamoboretie ase are korwa, nere tanteebeti erieta riaye.

English: Yet more I will utter, which I have thought about. I am filled like the full moon.
Kiswahili: Nitasema zaidi, ambayo nimeyafikiria. Nimejaa kama mwezi mpevu.
Ekegusii: Ninde nayande amange ayio inche narengereirie ndakwane koreng'ana buna omotienyi orabire kegima.

English: saying: “Naked I came from my mother’s womb, and naked I will return. The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away. Blessed be the name of the LORD.”
Kiswahili: na kusema: “Nilitoka tumboni mwa mama yangu uchi, nami nitaondoka uchi, Bwana alinipa, naye Bwana ameviondoa, jina la Bwana litukuzwe.”
Ekegusii: agateeba, “Nigo narwete ase enda ya baba inde getirianda, naende nigo ndairane korwa ase ense inde getirianda. Omonene nere oruete, naende oirire. Erieta riaye ritogigwe.”

English: Israel is swallowed up. Now they are among the nations like a worthless thing.
Kiswahili: Israeli amemezwa; sasa yupo miongoni mwa mataifa kama kitu kisicho na thamani.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bamerirwe. Bono nigo bare ase egati y'ebisaku baabarire koba buna egekorero getagwenereti kende.

English: A bud was under the first pair of branches that extended from the lampstand, a bud under the second pair, and a bud under the third pair.
Kiswahili: Tovu moja lilikuwa chini ya jozi ya kwanza ya matawi yaliyotokeza kwenye kinara cha taa, tovu la pili chini ya jozi ya pili, nalo tovu la tatu chini ya jozi ya tatu, yaani, matawi sita kwa jumla.
Ekegusii: Rimumu erimo rikaba inse ya kera chinsagia ibere chigosoka korwa ase ritina. Ase ayio rikaba rimumu erimo inse ya kera orosagia rw’echio isano nemo chiroisirie chikaba egento ekemo ne ritina.

English: O LORD, the king rejoices in Your strength. How greatly he exults in Your salvation!
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, mfalme huzifurahia nguvu zako. Tazama jinsi ilivyo kuu furaha yake kwa ushindi unaompa!
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, omorwoti nigo agokerete chinguru chiao, na gochengera obobui kwamoeire.

English: and said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your supplication before him, says:
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, ambaye mlinituma kuwasilisha maombi yenu:
Ekegusii: akabateebia, “Aya nar'Omonene, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, oyio ase mwantomete erinde ng'ire ogosaba kwaino ase obosio bwaye, agoteeba:

English: Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, uwe radhi kuniokoa; Ee Bwana, njoo hima unisaidie.
Ekegusii: Omonene, koranche ontoorie! Omonene, oche bwango onkonye!

English: Meanwhile, Gaal son of Ebed came with his brothers and crossed into Shechem, and the leaders of Shechem put their confidence in him.
Kiswahili: Basi Gaali mwana wa Ebedi akaenda pamoja na ndugu zake wakaingia Shekemu, nao watu wa huko wakamtumainia yeye.
Ekegusii: Gaali, mosinto bw’Ebedi, agacha Sekemu amo n’abamura bamwabo, n’abanto ba Sekemu bakamwegena na komosemeria.

English: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
Kiswahili: walitangatanga kutoka taifa moja hadi jingine, kutoka ufalme mmoja hadi mwingine.
Ekegusii: Bakaba bagoetanana korwa ase egesaku ekemo gochia ase ekende, na korwa ase oborwoti obomo gochia ase obonde.

English: They kept the feast of booths, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the ordinance, as the duty of every day required;
Kiswahili: Kisha kulingana na kile kilichoandikwa, wakaiadhimisha Sikukuu ya Vibanda wakitoa idadi ya sadaka za kuteketezwa kama ilivyohitajika kila siku sawasawa na ilivyoagizwa.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba bagochengera Rituko Rinene ri'Ebigutu, koreng'ana buna riachigetwe, na kera rituko bakaba bakorua ebing'wanso bi'ogosambwa ase omobaro ochikiire o kera rituko.

English: If you do what is right, will you not be accepted? But if you refuse to do what is right, sin is crouching at your door; it desires you, but you must master it.”
Kiswahili: Ukifanya lililo sawa, je, hutakubalika? Lakini usipofanya lililo sawa, dhambi inakuvizia mlangoni mwako, inakutamani wewe, lakini inakupasa uishinde.”
Ekegusii: “Onye ndiria gwakora buya anga nigo agogete; korende bono aye gwakorire ebibe, ebibe nigo bikoganyererete gesieri; na birobio nigo bikoganetie. Korende nekogwenerete obibue kegima.”

English: Jesus replied, “You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Hivi sasa hutambui lile ninalofanya, lakini baadaye utaelewa.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, akamoteebia, “Aya ngokora inche, tokoyamanya bono, korende noyamanye magega.”

English: Although a sinner does evil a hundred times and still lives long, yet I also know that it will go well with those who fear God, who are reverent in His presence.
Kiswahili: Ingawa mtu mwovu hufanya maovu mia moja na akaendelea kuishi maisha marefu, najua kwamba itakuwa bora zaidi kwa watu wanaomwogopa Mungu, wamchao Mungu.
Ekegusii: Omonyabibe nakora ebibe ara rigana, naende agenderere koba moyo ase engaki entambe; nonya naboigo, nimanyete ng’a nigo erabe buya ase abwo bamoirogete Nyasae, ekiagera bamoirogete.

English: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “Come here, and hear the words of Yahweh your God.”
Kiswahili: Yoshua akawaambia Waisraeli, “Njooni hapa msikilize maneno ya Bwana Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: Erio Yoshua agateebia Abaisraeli, “Inchuo ang'e aiga, motegerere amang'ana ay'Omonene, Nyasae oino, akobateebia.”

English: You are to give them the firstfruits of your grain, new wine, and oil, and the first wool sheared from your flock.
Kiswahili: Mtawapa malimbuko ya nafaka zenu, divai mpya, mafuta na sufu ya kwanza kutoka manyoya ya kondoo zenu,
Ekegusii: Moe abakuani ogotongora kwaino kw’endagera, na edivai, na amaguta, na amarionya amatang’ani mokonacha korwa ase ching’ondi chiaino.

English: They didn't thirst when he led them through the deserts. He caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them. He also split the rock and the waters gushed out.
Kiswahili: Hawakuona kiu alipowaongoza kupita jangwani; alifanya maji yatiririke kutoka kwenye mwamba kwa ajili yao; akapasua mwamba na maji yakatoka kwa nguvu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Omonene aetetie abanto baye ase erooro, tibabete nerang'o, nigo abatubokeretie amaache korwa ase egetare, akabochora egetare, na amaache agatimboka gocha isiko.

English: So Yahweh turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akawaonea huruma, wala hakuleta juu ya watu wake maafa aliyokuwa amekusudia.
Ekegusii: Eri'Omonene akaonchoka, tabakorera amabe aria konya arengereirie gokorera abanto baye.

English: He gives power to the faint and increases the strength of the weak.
Kiswahili: Huwapa nguvu waliolegea na huongeza nguvu za wadhaifu.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akoa omonto oyo ogoyire chinguru, na oyo otari na nguru nigo akomomentera chinguru.

English: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.
Kiswahili: Wanamchinja mjane na mgeni, na kuwaua yatima.
Ekegusii: Nigo bagoita ababoraka na abamenyi, ne chintakana nigo bagochiita;

English: Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.
Kiswahili: Ndipo akamwambia yule mtu, “Nyoosha mkono wako.” Akaunyoosha, nao ukaponywa ukawa mzima kama ule mwingine.
Ekegusii: Erio agateebia omonto oria, “Rambora okoboko kwao.” Agakorambora; gokagwena, gokaba okogima buna okonde.

English: for his soul was pleasing to the Lord. Therefore he hurried out of the midst of wickedness.
Kiswahili: kwa maana roho yake ilimpendeza Bwana. Kwa hivyo alikimbia kutoka katikati ya uovu.
Ekegusii: Omoyo oye nigo omogogetie Omonene erio akamwayereria akamorusia ase ense y'obobe. Abanto bakarora ring'ana eri korende tibamanya engencho yaye; tibamanya ring'ana eri erimo;

English: For you hate My instruction and cast My words behind you.
Kiswahili: Unachukia mafundisho yangu na kuyatupa maneno yangu nyuma yako.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ogechete amorokererio ay’okorongeyia, gwatugutire amang’ana aane gochia magega.

English: a man to whom God gives riches, wealth, and honor, so that he lacks nothing for his soul of all that he desires, yet God gives him no power to eat of it, but an alien eats it. This is vanity, and it is an evil disease.
Kiswahili: Mungu humpa mwanadamu utajiri, mali na heshima, hivyo hakukosa chochote moyo wake unachokitamani. Lakini Mungu hamwezeshi kuvifurahia, badala yake mgeni ndiye anayevifurahia. Hili ni ubatili, ni ubaya unaosikitisha.
Ekegusii: Nyasae oeire omonto obotenenku, ne chinibo, na ogosikwa, na omonto oyio taremeiri gento kende ase ebio bionsi aganetie, korende Nyasae tamoeti okobua gw'okwegokia ase ebinto ebio; omonto omoao nigo akobiira bwegokia nabirobio. Ayio naro mbosa, naende nogwechanda okobe.

English: So the demons begged Jesus, “Send us to the pigs, so that we may enter them.”
Kiswahili: Wale pepo wachafu wakamsihi Yesu wakisema, “Tuamuru twende kwenye wale nguruwe. Turuhusu tuwaingie.”
Ekegusii: Ebirecha bionsi bikamosorora, bikaboora, “Toire ase chimbeche, tonyare gosoa ase chirochio.”

English: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
Kiswahili: mwana wa Mikaeli, mwana wa Baaseya, mwana wa Malkiya,
Ekegusii: o Mikaeli, o Baseya, o Malikia,

English: Who can count the dust of Jacob or number even a fourth of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous; let my end be like theirs!”
Kiswahili: Ni nani awezaye kuhesabu mavumbi ya Yakobo, au kuhesabu robo ya Israeli? Mimi na nife kifo cha mtu mwenye haki, na mwisho wangu na uwe kama wao!”
Ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare kobara ororeria rwa Yakobo, abwo bare abange buna orotu rw’amaroba? Gose ning’o oranyare kobara nonya nenseemo ya inye y’Abaisraeli? Tiga inkwe buna oyomo bw’abanyene oboronge, na omoerio bw’amatuko ane obe buna oyoobo.”

English: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don't count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.
Kiswahili: Kisha Aroni akamwambia Mose, “Tafadhali, bwana wangu, usituhesabie dhambi hii ambayo tumeifanya kwa upumbavu.
Ekegusii: Erio Aroni agateebia Musa, “Aye omonene one, koranche, tobaisa gotoa egesusuro, ekiagera intwe nigo twakorire egento ki'oboriri, na twakorire ebibe.

English: You will wipe their descendants from the earth, and their offspring from the sons of men.
Kiswahili: Utawaangamiza wazao wao kutoka duniani, uzao wao kutoka wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Aye noite abana babo, obasirie korwa ase ense, na ororeria rwabo orosirie kegima korwa ase Mwanyabaanto.

English: They have sent some to Jerusalem, because they also that dwell there have done this thing, to bring them permission from the council of elders.
Kiswahili: Wametuma baadhi Yerusalemu, kwa sababu wale wanaoishi huko pia wamefanya jambo hili, ili wapate ruhusa kutoka kwa baraza la wazee.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho abanto b'omochie o Yerusalemu basaririe ogochika okwo abanto b'omochie oito batomire amang'ana gochia ase omochie o Yerusalemu erio basabe ribaga riogokora buna ayio barabwo bakorire goetera ase egeikaranso ekenene kia abagaaka.

English: Yahweh is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana ni mwenye haki; amenifungua toka kamba za waovu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonyene oboronge, ere obutoire chingori chi'abakori amabe.

English: When he returned from procuring his kingship, he summoned the servants to whom he had given the money, to find out what each one had earned.
Kiswahili: “Hata hivyo alirudi akiwa amekwisha kupokea mamlaka ya ufalme, akawaita wale watumishi wake aliokuwa amewaachia fedha, ili afahamu ni faida kiasi gani kila mmoja wao aliyopata kwa kufanya biashara.
Ekegusii: “Ekero achia koirana, kanyorire oborwoti, agachiika abasomba baria aete chiropia barangerigwe, erinde anyare komanya ebitoki banyorire ase okoonchoreria kwabo.

English: O house of David, this is what the LORD says: ‘Administer justice every morning, and rescue the victim of robbery from the hand of his oppressor, or My wrath will go forth like fire and burn with no one to extinguish it because of their evil deeds.
Kiswahili: Ewe nyumba ya Daudi, hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: “ ‘Hukumuni kwa haki kila asubuhi, mwokoeni mikononi mwa mdhalimu yeye aliyetekwa nyara, la sivyo ghadhabu yangu italipuka na kuwaka kama moto kwa sababu ya uovu mlioufanya: itawaka na hakuna wa kuizima.
Ekegusii: inwe abanto b’ororeria rwa Daudi. Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Mobe mokonacha ekiina kia boronge kera emambia; omonto oria ourererigwe momorusie ase okoboko kw’omochandi oye. Motakoreti bo, endamwamu yane enga buna omorero ogosamba nayoke, na onde takoyerimia. Ayio nakoreke ase engencho y’ogokora kwaino okobe.

English: which the clouds pour out and shower abundantly on mankind.
Kiswahili: mawingu huangusha chini maji yake, nayo mvua nyingi huwanyeshea wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Embura eyio nigo egotwa gocha ase ense, yatwera Mwanyabaanto ase obonge.

English: He said, “Come with me, and see my zeal for Yahweh.” So they made him ride in his chariot.
Kiswahili: Yehu akasema, “Twende pamoja ukaone wivu wangu kwa ajili ya Bwana.” Hivyo wakasafiri pamoja kwenye gari lake.
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia: “Inchuo amo nainche, orore risemi riane na omokia one ase Omonene!” Erio bakagenda komo ase egari ya Yehu.

English: The descendants of His servants will inherit it, and those who love His name will settle in it.
Kiswahili: watoto wa watumishi wake watairithi na wale wote walipendao jina lake wataishi humo.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rw’abasomba b’Omonene mbayeire ebe eyabo, boigo nabaanto baria banchete erieta ri’Omonene mbamenye aroro.

English: They stayed around God's house, because that was their duty; and it was their duty to open it morning by morning.
Kiswahili: Walikesha mahali walipowekwa kuizunguka nyumba ya Mungu, kwa sababu iliwapasa kuilinda. Pia walitunza funguo kwa ajili ya kufungua mlango kila siku asubuhi.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba bakobeera isiko bagaetanana enyomba ya Nyasae, ekiagera emeremo y'oborendi nigo yabegetwe igoro ase bare, naende nabwo barenge koigora enyomba eria kera emambia.

English: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,
Kiswahili: ambaye anakonyeza kwa jicho lake, anayetoa ishara kwa miguu yake na kuashiria kwa vidole vyake,
Ekegusii: Nigo agosumera ebioge bi'amaiso aye, naende nigo agosumera amagoro, na okworokia ebimanyererio n'amaboko aye.

English: God raised him up the third day and gave him to be revealed,
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu siku ya tatu na akamwezesha kuonekana na watu.
Ekegusii: korende Nyasae akamobokia ase rituko ria gatato, akamwanchera kooroka,

English: One of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite; therefore I chased him from me.
Kiswahili: Mmoja wa wana wa Yoyada mwana wa Eliashibu kuhani mkuu alikuwa mkwewe Sanbalati Mhoroni. Nami nilimfukuza mbele yangu.
Ekegusii: Oyomo bw'abamura ba Yoyada, mosinto bw'Eliasibu, Omokuani omonene, konya onyuomire omoiseke o Sanibalati Omohoroni; ase ayio nkamoseria korwa ase 'nde.

English: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa hulinda mwenendo wa mwenye haki na kuhifadhi njia ya waaminifu wake.
Ekegusii: Nigo arendete chiinchera chi'abagokora ekeene, naende orenda chiinchera chi'abamoirogete.

English: I said, “In the prime of my life I must go through the gates of Sheol and be deprived of the remainder of my years.”
Kiswahili: Nilisema, “Katika ustawi wa maisha yangu, je, ni lazima nipite katika malango ya mauti, na kupokonywa miaka yangu iliyobaki?”
Ekegusii: Nigo narengereretie ng’a ngochia gokwa inde ase emiaka y’oboke bwane; ningende ase ebiita bi’aase abakuure, naurirwe emiaka yane yatigarete.

English: Why do you cry over your injury? Your pain is incurable. For the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins have increased, I have done these things to you.
Kiswahili: Kwa nini unalia kwa ajili ya jeraha lako, yale maumivu yako yasiyoponyeka? Kwa sababu ya uovu wako mkubwa na dhambi zako nyingi nimekufanyia mambo haya.
Ekegusii: Nase ki mokorera ase engencho y'emechando yaino? Obororo bwaino tibokogwenigwa. Ogosaria kwaino nokonene, na ebibe biaino biamentekanire. Ayio naro agerire nabakoreire igo.

English: Because you saw that a stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it broke in pieces the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver, and the gold. The great God has made known to the king what will happen hereafter. The dream is certain, and its interpretation sure.”
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu uliona jiwe lilichongwa kutoka mlimani bila kazi ya mikono, na kwamba lilivunja vipande vipande chuma, shaba, udongo, fedha, na dhahabu. Mungu Mkuu amemjulisha mfalme mambo yatakayokuwa baadaye. Ndoto hiyo ni ya hakika, na tafsiri yake ni thabiti.
Ekegusii: buna koreng'ana kwarooche rigena rigotegoka rinyene korwa ase egetunwa, ritategoiri namaboko ya Mwanyabaanto, ne rigena riria rigaaka na gosamunyora ekioma, na etai, na amaroba, na efeta, na etaabu. Nyasae ore omonene okomanyirie aye omorwoti amang'ana agochi‐gocha. Chindoto chiao nechi'ekeene, na engencho yaye nagotebirie ney'ekeene.”

English: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.'”
Kiswahili: Kisha mpaka utashuka kuelekea Mto Yordani na kuishia katika Bahari ya Chumvi. “ ‘Hii itakuwa nchi yenu, ikiwa na mipaka yake kila upande.' ”
Ekegusii: Erio rotirimboke robwatie orooche rwa Yorodani rotwomere Enyancha y'omonyoo. Eye nero erabe ense yaino, ne chimbebe chiaye chietanaineo.”

English: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”
Kiswahili: Waage watu ili waende mashambani na vijijini jirani, wakajinunulie chakula.”
Ekegusii: Kae abanto aba ribaga, erinde bagende emechie na ebinyoro, aria na aaria, begorere endagera.”

English: ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? He is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”
