Kiswahili: ‘Mimi ni Mungu wa Abrahamu, Mungu wa Isaki, na Mungu wa Yakobo’? Yeye si Mungu wa wafu, bali ni Mungu wa walio hai.”
Ekegusii: Inche ninche Nyasae o Aburaamu, na Nyasae o Isaka, na Nyasae o Yakobo? Ere tari Nyasae bw’abakuure, korende Nyasae bw’abare moyo.”

English: You counted the houses of Jerusalem and tore them down to strengthen the wall.
Kiswahili: Mlihesabu majengo katika Yerusalemu nanyi mkabomoa nyumba ili kuimarisha ukuta.
Ekegusii: Mokabara chinyomba chia Yerusalemu, na mogachitagora ase okoroisia orwaki robe orokong’u.

English: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name's sake.”
Kiswahili: Nami nitamwonyesha jinsi impasavyo kuteseka kwa ajili ya Jina langu.”
Ekegusii: Inche nimworokie onsi ayaramogwenere gochandwa ase engencho y'erieta riane.”

English: the priest is to examine him, and if the scaly outbreak has spread on the skin, the priest need not look for yellow hair; the person is unclean.
Kiswahili: kuhani atamchunguza, na kama upele umeenea kwenye ngozi, kuhani hana haja ya kutazama kama kuna nywele za manjano, mtu huyo ni najisi.
Ekegusii: Omokuani amorenge naende, na kararore ng’a richoncho riria riesiareire, takorigia korora gose amarionya are monuri nareo, omonto oyio tachenegeti.

English: Now a river flowed out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it branched into four headwaters:
Kiswahili: Mto wa kunyeshea bustani ulitiririka toka Edeni, kuanzia hapa ukagawanyika kuwa mito minne.
Ekegusii: Orooche rogatuboka korwa ase omogondo o Edeni na rokayobekera amaache. Korwa agwo rokagabekana, rokaba chindooche inye.

English: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Adamu akawapa majina wanyama wote wa kufugwa, ndege wa angani, na wanyama wote wa porini. Lakini kwa Adamu hakupatikana msaidizi wa kumfaa.
Ekegusii: Ase igo omonto oyio akaroka chinyoni chionsi n'echingiti chionsi; korende ase ebio bionsi ebiatongetwe, tarorekana mokonyi onde oye.

English: I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants.”'
Kiswahili: Sistahili tena kuitwa mwanao; nifanye kama mmoja wa watumishi wako.'
Ekegusii: tingwenereti naende ndokwe omwana oo, tiga imbe buna oyomo bw'abasomba bao b'eng'eria.

English: By her he will be covered from heat, and will lodge in her glory.
Kiswahili: Atafunikwa na joto lake, na ataishi katika utukufu wake.
Ekegusii: ekiriri eki gekomokengera omogaso, nere oikaransa n'obotoereru bwaye.

English: We don't control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.
Kiswahili: Si kwamba tunatawala imani yenu, bali twatenda kazi pamoja nanyi kwa ajili ya furaha yenu, kwa sababu ni kwa imani mwasimama imara.
Ekegusii: Tari ng'a nkogambera tore okwegena kwaino; korende nigo togokora emeremo amo nainwe ase omogooko oino, ekiagera moteneine bokong'u ase okwegena.

English: Now among these of the children of Judah were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya hawa vijana walitoka Yuda: nao ni Danieli, Hanania, Mishaeli na Azaria.
Ekegusii: Ase egati y'abwo bachoretwe, korwa ase Abayuda nabwo aba: Danieli, na Hanania, na Mishaeli, na Asaria.

English: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: “My servants will eat, but you will go hungry; My servants will drink, but you will go thirsty; My servants will rejoice, but you will be put to shame.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenyezi: “Watumishi wangu watakula, lakini ninyi mtaona njaa; watumishi wangu watakunywa lakini ninyi mtaona kiu; watumishi wangu watafurahi, lakini ninyi mtaona haya.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Naama! Abasomba baane mbabe bakonyora endagera bakoria, korende inwe mobe nenchara. Rora, abasomba baane mbanyore ekenyugwa bakonywa, korende inwe mobe nerang’o. Naama! Abasomba baane mbagoke, korende inwe mosooke.

English: Then Hananiah the prophet took the bar from off the prophet Jeremiah's neck, and broke it.
Kiswahili: Kisha nabii Hanania akaiondoa nira iliyokuwa shingoni mwa Yeremia na kuivunja,
Ekegusii: Erio Hanania, omobani oria, akarusia rikorogoto riria korwa ase rigoti ria Yeremia omobani, akaribuna.

English: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.
Kiswahili: Baada ya sauti hiyo kusema, walimkuta Yesu akiwa peke yake. Wale wanafunzi wakalihifadhi jambo hili, wala kwa wakati huo hawakumwambia mtu yeyote yale waliyokuwa wameyaona.
Ekegusii: Ekero eriogi riakwanire, Yeso akarorekana ore bweka. Na barabwo bagakira, tibateebia monto ase amatuko aria ring'ana rinde rionsi ri'ayio baroche.

English: You have perseverance and have endured for my name's sake, and have not grown weary.
Kiswahili: Umevumilia na kustahimili taabu kwa ajili ya Jina langu, wala hukuchoka.
Ekegusii: Naende okaremereria na kwebogoreria amange ase engencho y'erieta riane, na toroseti.

English: I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, four horns.
Kiswahili: Kisha nikatazama juu, na pale mbele yangu nikaona pembe nne!
Ekegusii: Naende nkarigereria, nkarora ching'unchara inye.

English: Thus you were decked with gold and silver. Your clothing was of fine linen, silk, and embroidered work. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and you prospered to royal estate.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo ulipambwa kwa dhahabu na fedha, nguo zako zilikuwa za kitani safi, hariri na nguo iliyokuwa imetariziwa. Chakula chako kilikuwa unga laini, asali na mafuta ya zeituni. Ukawa mzuri sana ukainuka kuwa malkia.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye ogaachaberwa ne chitaabu, ne chifeta, ne chianga chiao nigo chiarenge echi'egatani engiya, na echi'ariri, na echiroisirie chire nebieni ao ao. Boigo okaria endagera yaroiseretigwe nobosie obonuke, na okaria obooke, na amaguta. Erio okaba omonyakieni mono, ogasesenigwa, ogaikera ekerengo ki'oborwoti.

English: But the LORD’s portion is His people, Jacob His allotted inheritance.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa fungu la Bwana ni watu wake, Yakobo kura yake ya urithi.
Ekegusii: Omonene bwechooreire abanto baye babe egetari kiaye, abanto ba Yakobo nabwo barurwe babe omwando oye.

English: I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
Kiswahili: Ninampenda Bwana kwa maana amesikia sauti yangu; amesikia kilio changu ili anihurumie.
Ekegusii: Nigo inyanchete Omonene, ekiagera ere oiguure eriogi riane na ogosaba kwane.

English: The sons of Josiah: Johanan was the firstborn, Jehoiakim the second, Zedekiah the third, and Shallum the fourth.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Yosia walikuwa: Yohanani mzaliwa wake wa kwanza, Yehoyakimu mwanawe wa pili, wa tatu Sedekia, wa nne Shalumu.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yosia nabwo aba: Yohanani, omwana oye omotangi na Yehoyakimu, oyo o kabere, na Zedekia, oyo o gatato, na Salumu, oyo o kane.

English: The form of their faces was that of a man, and each of the four had the face of a lion on the right side, the face of an ox on the left side, and also the face of an eagle.
Kiswahili: Kuonekana kwa nyuso zao kulikuwa hivi: Kila mmoja wa wale wanne alikuwa na uso wa mwanadamu na kwa upande wa kulia kila mmoja alikuwa na uso wa simba, upande wa kushoto alikuwa na uso wa ngʼombe pia kila mmoja alikuwa na uso wa tai.
Ekegusii: Okororekana kw’amasio a kera ekemo ki’ebitongwa ebio bine nigo kwarenge iga: Amasio abo a bosio nigo arenge buna aya Mwanyabaanto, na aya a borio nigo arenge buna aye chindo, na aya a bomosi nigo arenge buna aye chiombe; boigo kera ekemo nigo kiabwate obosio buna obw’ebiongo.

English: But just as every good thing the LORD your God promised you has come to pass, likewise the LORD will bring upon you the calamity He has threatened, until He has destroyed you from this good land He has given you.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama vile kila ahadi njema ya Bwana Mungu wenu imekuwa kweli, vivyo hivyo Bwana ataleta maovu yote kama alivyo onya, mpaka awe amewaangamiza kutoka nchi hii nzuri aliyowapa.
Ekegusii: Bun’Omonene, Nyasae oino aikeranetie amaya onsi aya abarierete eira ng’a nakore, naboigo araikeranie amabe onsi goika abasirie korwa ase ense eye engiya abaeire.

English: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.
Kiswahili: Basi siku hiyo Yesu alipotengeneza tope na kuyafungua macho ya huyo mtu ilikuwa Sabato.
Ekegusii: Nigo riarenge rituko ri'Esabato ekero Yeso akorete etintira na komoramokia amaiso.

English: As for the rest of the acts of Elah, along with all his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel? Zimri Reigns in Israel
Kiswahili: Kwa matukio mengine ya utawala wa Ela, na yote aliyoyafanya, je, hayakuandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Israeli? Zimri Mfalme Wa Israeli
Ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Ela, na aya onsi akorete, nigo ariikire ime ase Egetabu ki’ogokora kw’Abarwoti b’Abaisraeli. Simuri omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli

English: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ameniokoa katika shida zangu zote, na macho yangu yamewatazama adui zangu kwa ushindi.
Ekegusii: Aye gwantooririe ase emechando yonsi, na amaiso aane nigo arigereretie ababisa baane inde nomochengo.

English: Later, by the Sea of Tiberias, Jesus again revealed Himself to the disciples. He made Himself known in this way:
Kiswahili: Baada ya haya Yesu akawatokea tena wanafunzi wake kando ya Bahari ya Tiberia. Yeye alijionyesha kwao hivi:
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso akeorokia naende ase aborokigwa baye ase enyancha ya Tiberia. Ayio nigo akorekanete iga:

English: Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was the likeness of an awesome expanse, gleaming like crystal.
Kiswahili: Juu ya vichwa vya hao viumbe hai palikuwa na kitu mfano wa eneo lililokuwa wazi, lililokuwa angavu kabisa na lenye kutisha.
Ekegusii: Igoro ase emetwe y’ebitongwa biria, egento nkiarengeo kenga buna eaanga igoro yaroiseirie ebirore bikomekameka na komesa, na kerokio nigo kiaarire igoro ase emetwe yabo.

English: My heritage has become to me as a lion in the forest. She has uttered her voice against me. Therefore I have hated her.
Kiswahili: Urithi wangu umekuwa kwangu kama simba wa msituni. Huningurumia mimi, kwa hiyo ninamchukia.
Ekegusii: Abanto bare omwando one babeire buna endo ere ase rinani. Baakire amariogi abo mamincha yane. Ase engencho eyio nabagechire.

English: “I am a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but raised in this city. I was educated at the feet of Gamaliel in strict conformity to the law of our fathers. I am just as zealous for God as any of you here today.
Kiswahili: “Mimi ni Myahudi, niliyezaliwa Tarso huko Kilikia, lakini nimelelewa katika mji huu. Miguuni mwa Gamalieli, nilifundishwa kikamilifu katika sheria ya baba zetu, na nikawa mwenye juhudi kwa ajili ya Mungu kama kila mmoja wenu alivyo leo.
Ekegusii: “Inche n’Omoyahudi, naiboreretwe Tariso, omochie o Kilikia, nkarererwa ase omochie oyo ase amagoro a Gamalieli, nkorokererigwa bokong’u amachiiko ye chisokoro chiaito. Nkaba omonto oyore nomokia ase Nyasae, buna inwe mwensi more reero iga.

English: You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain.
Kiswahili: Unawakataa wote wanaoyaasi maagizo yako, kwa maana udanganyifu wao ni bure.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okwanga abwo bagotantana korwa ase emeroberio yao echiikire; ee, obong’ainereria bwabo nigo bore bosa.

English: If a wise man goes to court with a fool, there will be raving and laughing with no resolution.
Kiswahili: Kama mwenye hekima akienda mahakamani na mpumbavu, mpumbavu hukasirika na kudhihaki, wala hakuna amani.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto omong’aini akoamererania nomoriri, oria omoriri nigo akogechigwa na goseka, tari gokira-kiri.

English: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
Kiswahili: kwa maana mkiishi kwa kuufuata mwili, mtakufa, lakini kama mkiyaua matendo ya mwili kwa Roho, mtaishi.
Ekegusii: inaki komoratunyane chingencho chi'ebibe, nigo morakwe, korende komoraite ogokora kw'omobere ase chinguru chi'Omoika, inamobe moyo.

English: Yet all this avails me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king's gate.”
Kiswahili: Lakini haya yote hayanipi kuridhika iwapo ninaendelea kumwona yule Myahudi Mordekai akiketi kwenye lango la mfalme.”
Ekegusii: Korende amang'ana ayio onsi tabwati engencho ase inde ekero nkorora Moredekai, Omoyahudi oria, oikaransete ase egeita ki'omorwoti.”

English: the ark with its poles and mercy seat, and the veil to shield it;
Kiswahili: Sanduku la Agano pamoja na mipiko yake, kifuniko cha kiti cha rehema na pazia linalokizuia;
Ekegusii: Esanduki na emiaro yaye, na Oboikaranso bw’amaabera, na etoto eria erabeekwe ebokenge;

English: I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.'” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow with them.”
Kiswahili: Kisha nikasikia sauti kutoka mbinguni ikisema, “Andika: Wamebarikiwa wafu wafao katika Bwana tangu sasa.” “Naam,” asema Roho, “watapumzika kutoka taabu zao, kwa kuwa matendo yao yatawafuata.”
Ekegusii: Erio nkaigwa eriogi rikorwa igoro rigoteeba, “Riika aya: Mbasesenirie abagokwa korwa bono, bamwegenete Omonene. Ee, nabo, Omoika ogoteeba, tiga batimoke korwa ase emeremo yabo, ekiagera okwama kw'ogokora kwabo nigo gokobatunyana.”

English: of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah; of Naphtali, Jeremoth the son of Azriel;
Kiswahili: kwa Wazabuloni: Ishmaya mwana wa Obadia; kwa Wanaftali: Yeremothi mwana wa Azrieli;
Ekegusii: Isimaya, mosinto bw'Obadia, ase Abasabuloni; Yerimoti, mosinto bw'Asirieli, ase Abanafutali;

English: for he who despises wisdom and discipline is miserable. Their hope is void and their toils unprofitable. Their works are useless.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yeye anayedharau hekima na nidhamu ni mnyonge. Matumaini yao ni batili na kazi zao hazina faida. Kazi zao hazina faida.
Ekegusii: Bonsi baria bagochaaya obosemia gose chisemi nigo bakomenya obogima obobe; tibabwati gosemeria konde, ogwechanda kwabo tigokobakonya kende boigo n'ogokora kwabo n'okwabosa.

English: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.
Kiswahili: Basi mfalme na Hamani wakaenda kula chakula pamoja na Malkia Esta.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, omorwoti na Hamani bakagenda koria endagera amo n'Esiteri eting'ana.

English: He sent others to take possession of Jerusalem and the temple hill.
Kiswahili: Aliwatuma wengine kumiliki Yerusalemu na kilima cha hekalu.
Ekegusii: na abande kogenda kobwata omochie o Yerusalemu na egetunwa gie Hekalu.

English: You grumbled in your tents and said, “Because the LORD hates us, He has brought us out of the land of Egypt to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to be annihilated.
Kiswahili: Mkanungʼunika ndani ya mahema yenu na kusema, “ Bwana anatuchukia, kwa hiyo alitutoa Misri ili kututia mikononi mwa Waamori kutuangamiza.
Ekegusii: Mokemurungania ekero mwamenyete ase chiema chiaino, mogateeba: Omonene nigo atogeechete, nakio kiagerete agatorusia korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde atobeeke ase amaboko ya Abaamori, nabarabwo batoite na gotosiria.

English: the triumph of the wicked has been brief and the joy of the godless momentary?
Kiswahili: macheko ya mtu mwovu ni ya muda mfupi, nayo furaha ya wasiomcha Mungu hudumu kwa kitambo tu.
Ekegusii: omochengo bw’abakori amabe noyo bw’engaki enke, na omogooko bw’abatamoirogeti Nyasae nomweng’e?

English: I went to the prophetess, and she conceived, and bore a son. Then Yahweh said to me, “Call his name ‘Maher Shalal Hash Baz.'
Kiswahili: Kisha nikaenda kwa nabii mke, naye akapata mimba, akazaa mwana. Kisha Bwana akaniambia, “Mwite huyo mtoto Maher-Shalal-Hash-Bazi.
Ekegusii: Erio nkaba nomokuungu one orenge omobani, na ere akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, n'Omonene aganteebia, “Moroke Maheri‐Salali Hasi‐Basi.

English: “What do you want Me to do for you?” “Lord,” he said, “let me see again.”
Kiswahili: “Unataka nikufanyie nini?” Akajibu, “Bwana, nataka kuona.”
Ekegusii: “Ninki origetie ngokorere?” Akamoiraneria, “Omonene, inyare korora.”

English: For your iniquity instructs your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
Kiswahili: Dhambi yako inasukuma kinywa chako, nawe umechagua ulimi wa hila.
Ekegusii: Ebibe biao biorokereirie omonwa oo amang’ana ogokwana, aye gwachorire gokwana amang’ana y’obong’ainereria.

English: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you have forgotten me and cast me behind your back, therefore you also bear your lewdness and your prostitution.'”
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Kwa kuwa tangu uliponisahau mimi na kunitupa nyuma yako, lazima ubebe matokeo ya uasherati wako na ukahaba wako.”
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Ekiagera kwanyebire inche, naende kwaonchokire, kwang'eire amagega, goika obogorie egesusuro ekio ase engencho y'obosooku na obonyaka bwao.”

English: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”
Kiswahili: Siku ya kwanza ya Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, wanafunzi walimjia Yesu wakamuuliza, “Unataka twende wapi ili tukuandalie mahali pa kula Pasaka?”
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang'ani ri'Emegati etabekiri memera aborokigwa bagachiera Yeso, bakamobooria, “Ng'ai origetie tokoroisie oriere Epasaka?”

English: A copy of the letter, that the decree should be given out in every province, was published to all the peoples, that the Jews should be ready for that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.
Kiswahili: Nakala ya tangazo ilikuwa itolewe kama sheria katika kila jimbo na iweze kujulikana kwa watu wa kila taifa, ili kwamba Wayahudi wawe tayari siku hiyo kulipiza kisasi kwa adui zao.
Ekegusii: Nigo ariikire ng'a ase kera orogongo ogochika okwo kw'omorwoti korarigwe maiso marore ase abanto bonsi ng'a, Abayahudi bebeeke ang'e ase rituko erio erio korusia egesiomba ase ababisa babo.

English: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
Kiswahili: Yehosadaki alihamishwa wakati Bwana aliwapeleka uhamishoni watu wa Yuda na Yerusalemu kwa mkono wa Mfalme Nebukadneza.
Ekegusii: Yehosadaki agooswa akairwa ense eng’ao, ekero Omonene aruete Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu bagooswa, bakairwa na Nebukadinesaro. Ororeria ronde rwa Lawi

English: Moreover the altar that was at Bethel and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, even that altar and the high place he broke down; and he burned the high place and beat it to dust, and burned the Asherah.
Kiswahili: Hata madhabahu yaliyokuwa huko Betheli, mahali pa juu pa kuabudia miungu palipokuwa pamejengwa na Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati, ambaye aliwafanya Israeli watende dhambi, alibomoa hata hayo madhabahu na mahali pa juu pa kuabudia miungu. Alipateketeza kwa moto hapo mahali pa juu pa kuabudia miungu na kupasaga hadi pakawa vumbi, na kuichoma hiyo nguzo ya Ashera pia.
Ekegusii: Boigo agatagora egesasiimero kiarenge agwo Beteli igoro y'aase aria aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa aria aroisetigwe na Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, oria ogerete Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe. Agasaria aase aria aimokererete igoro na agatagora egesasiimero keria akagesenyenta gekaba orotu; agasamba omote bw'Asera.

English: But seat two scoundrels opposite him and have them testify, ‘You have cursed both God and the king!’ Then take him out and stone him to death.”
Kiswahili: Lakini waketisheni watu wawili wabaya kabisa mkabala naye, nao washuhudie kuwa yeye amemlaani Mungu na mfalme. Kisha mtoeni nje na kumpiga kwa mawe hadi afe.”
Ekegusii: Naende mobeke abanto babere abatagwenereti, bamosoere oborimo, bateebe ng’a oragereirie Nyasae na omorwoti. Erio momosokie isiko, momoake amagena goika akwe.”

English: There is a man all alone, without even a son or brother. And though there is no end to his labor, his eyes are still not content with his wealth: “For whom do I toil and bereave my soul of enjoyment?” This too is futile—a miserable task.
Kiswahili: Kulikuwepo mwanadamu aliye peke yake, hakuwa na mwana wala ndugu. Hapakuwa na mwisho wa kazi yake, hata hivyo macho yake hayakutosheka na utajiri wake. Aliuliza, “Ninajitaabisha hivi kwa ajili ya nani, nami kwa nini ninajinyima kufurahia?” Hili pia ni ubatili, ni shughuli yenye taabu!
Ekegusii: Nare omonto otabwate omwana gose omwabo; ere nigo agendererete gwechanda gokora emeremo emekong’u, na amaiso aye tari goisaneka ne chinibo; omonto oyio tana kweboria, “Ning’o ngochandekera gokorera na kwerina omogooko bwonsi?” Aya naro mbosa, na ogwechanda gotari nomogooko.

English: But they mocked the messengers of God, despising His words and scoffing at His prophets, until the wrath of the LORD against His people was stirred up beyond remedy.
Kiswahili: Lakini waliwadhihaki wajumbe wa Bwana wakayadharau maneno yake na kuwacheka manabii wake mpaka ghadhabu ya Bwana ikawa kubwa dhidi ya watu wake na hakukuwa na namna ya kuituliza.
Ekegusii: Korende bakagenderera gochecheria abatomwa ba Nyasae, bagachaya amang’ana aye, na bagachecheria ababani baye. Ase igo endamwamu y’Omonene ekaba enene igoro ase abanto baye, na gotooreka tikwanyorekana ase bare.

English: Joseph remembered his dreams about them and said, “You are spies! You have come to see if our land is vulnerable.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yosefu alipokumbuka ndoto zake kuwahusu wao, akawaambia, “Ninyi ni wapelelezi! Mmekuja kuangalia mahali ambapo nchi yetu haina ulinzi.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akainyora chindoto chiria areenge kobarootera, akabateebia: “Inwe nechirooti more, nigo mwachire koroota ense eye, na korora ase ere bosa etari na getango.”

English: While Ezra prayed and made this confession, weeping and falling facedown before the house of God, a very large assembly of Israelites—men, women, and children—gathered around him, and the people wept bitterly as well.
Kiswahili: Wakati Ezra alipokuwa anaomba na kuungama, huku akilia na kujitupa chini mbele ya nyumba ya Mungu, umati mkubwa wa Waisraeli, wanaume, wanawake na watoto walikusanyika kumzunguka. Nao pia wakalia sana.
Ekegusii: Bono ekero Ezra agendererete gosaba na koorokia amamocho, okorera na oramaime inse bosio bw’enyomba ya Nyasae, omosangererekano omonene mono bw’Abaisraeli, abasacha na abakungu, na abana, bagacha asare. Abanto abwo bonsi nigo babete bakorera bare nobororo obonge.

English: They said to one another, “We are certainly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he begged us, and we wouldn't listen. Therefore this distress has come upon us.”
Kiswahili: Wakaambiana wao kwa wao, “Hakika tunaadhibiwa kwa sababu ya ndugu yetu. Tuliona jinsi alivyohuzunika alipokuwa anatusihi kuponya maisha yake, lakini hatukumsikiliza, hiyo ndiyo sababu dhiki hii imetupata.”
Ekegusii: Erio bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo: “Amaene, ntwamocherete oyominto. Nigo twarooche ogochandeka kw'omoyo oye, na ekero atosororete titwamoigwete. Ase ayio nakio kiagerire obokong'u obo bwatonyorire.”

English: Therefore you shall with all diligence buy with this money bulls, rams, and lambs with their meal offerings and their drink offerings, and shall offer them on the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Hakikisha kwamba fedha hizi zimetumika kununua mafahali, kondoo dume na wana-kondoo pamoja na sadaka za nafaka na sadaka za vinywaji, uvitoe dhabihu juu ya madhabahu ya Hekalu la Mungu wenu katika Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: “Obe omwegenwa, na ase chitaabu echio ogore chieri, ne chimingichi, ne chimanwa chi'eching'ondi, na okoruegwa kw'endagera, na okw'ebinyugwa bikoruegwa amo nebing'wanso ebio. Orue ebinto ebio ase egesasiimero ki'enyomba ya Nyasae oo ere agwo Yerusalemu.

English: But to sit at My right or left is not Mine to grant. These seats belong to those for whom they have been prepared.”
Kiswahili: lakini kuketi mkono wangu wa kuume au wa kushoto si juu yangu mimi kuwapa. Nafasi hizi ni kwa ajili ya wale walioandaliwa.”
Ekegusii: korende ribaga ri’ogoikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kw’ane gw’okorio na okoboko nogw’okobee tinkonyara kobaa, otatiga abwo bagacheire barariegwe.” Obonene bw’ekeene (Mat 20:24-28; Luk 22:24-27)

English: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yehoyakini akayavua mavazi yake ya mfungwa, na siku zote za maisha yake zilizobaki alikula mezani mwa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Yehoyakini akaonchoreria chianga chiaye chi'obosibwa, na kera rituko ase obogima bwaye bwonsi akaba okoragera nomorwoti.

English: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
Kiswahili: Atroth-Shofani, Yazeri, Yogbeha,
Ekegusii: na Ataroti‐Shofani, na Yaeseri, ne Yogibea,

English: Don't let your heart turn to her ways. Don't go astray in her paths,
Kiswahili: Usiruhusu moyo wako ugeukie njia za huyo mwanamke, wala usitangetange katika mapito yake.
Ekegusii: Chinkoro chiaino tichibaisa koonchorwa na kobwatia chingencho chi'omokuungu buna oyio; gose orogendo rw'aye tirobaisa gosiria obogima bwaino.

English: Far from the noise of archers, in the places of drawing water, there they will rehearse Yahweh's righteous acts, the righteous acts of his rule in Israel. “Then Yahweh's people went down to the gates.
Kiswahili: juu ya sauti za waimbaji mahali pa kunyweshea maji. Wanasimulia matendo ya haki ya Bwana, matendo ya haki ya mashujaa wake katika Israeli. “Ndipo watu wa Bwana walipoteremka malangoni pa mji.
Ekegusii: Tegerera! Abwo bagoaka amariogi ase bagosangererekana kobuucha amaache, nigo bagokwana igoro y'obobui Omonene, ee, igoro y'ogokora kwaye okoronge gokogambera Abaisraeli. Erio abanto b'Omonene bagatirimboka gochia ase ebiita.

English: Then he brought the ark into the tabernacle, put up the veil for the screen, and shielded off the ark of the Testimony, just as the LORD had commanded him.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akalileta Sanduku ndani ya Maskani ya Mungu, akatundika pazia ili kulifunika Sanduku la Ushuhuda, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.
Ekegusii: Akabeeka esanduki eria ime y’obomenyo, agasunga etoto eria y’egetambaa ase ogokenga esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, buna Omonene konya amochikiire.

English: a wind too strong for that comes from Me. Now I also pronounce judgments against them.”
Kiswahili: upepo wenye nguvu sana kuliko wa kupepeta na kutakasa utakuja kwa amri yangu. Sasa natangaza hukumu zangu dhidi yao.”
Ekegusii: korende omwaga oyio ninyotome obe omotindi mono goetania. Bono ninche ndabanachere ekiina.” Abayuda bagoetananwa nababisa

English: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword.
Kiswahili: nao watu wote wa nchi wakafurahi. Mji ukatulia kwa sababu Athalia alikuwa ameuawa kwa upanga.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b'ense eria bakaba nomogooko, na omochie okaba omotoereru ekiagera Atalia konya aitirwe n'omoro.

English: “For it is written in the book of Psalms: ‘May his place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in it,’ and, ‘May another take his position.’
Kiswahili: “Kama vile ilivyoandikwa katika kitabu cha Zaburi, “ ‘Mahali pake na pawe ukiwa, wala asiwepo yeyote atakayeishi humo,’ na, “ ‘Mtu mwingine aichukue nafasi yake ya uongozi.’
Ekegusii: Naki nariikire ase egetabu gia Zaburi: Obomenyo bwaye botigare bosa, nonya monto onde tabaisa komenyao; naende nerikiire: Oboteneneri bwaye omoao aboire.

English: And from that day a long time passed, twenty years in all, as the ark remained at Kiriath-jearim. And all the house of Israel mourned and sought after the LORD.
Kiswahili: Sanduku la Bwana lilibakia huko Kiriath-Yearimu kwa muda mrefu, yaani jumla ya miaka ishirini, nao watu wa Israeli wakaomboleza na kumtafuta Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korwa engaki eyio Esanduki eria y’Omonene ekabeera agwo Kiriati-Yearimu ase engaki entaambe, emiaka emerongo ebere. Ase engaki eyio yonsi, Abaisraeli bonsi bakaba bakorera ase Omonene ng’a abakoonye.

English: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God. But Zedekiah stiffened his neck and hardened his heart against turning to the LORD, the God of Israel.
Kiswahili: Pia alimwasi Mfalme Nebukadneza, ambaye alikuwa amemwapisha kwa jina la Mungu. Akashupaza shingo na akafanya moyo wake kuwa mgumu wala hakutaka kumgeukia Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Zedekia akaanga koigwera Nebukadinesaro omorwoti, oria omoboretie gotiana ase erieta ria Nyasae. Agekora omonyabigoti bikong’u, na enkoro yaye ekaenena, tancha komoiranera Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.

English: The descendants of the servants of Solomon: the descendants of Sotai, the descendants of Sophereth, the descendants of Perida,
Kiswahili: Wazao wa watumishi wa Solomoni: wazao wa Sotai, Soferethi, Perida,
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rw’abasomba ba Sulemani nabwo aba: Chiamate chia Sotai, na Sofereti, na Perida;

English: And this is the promise that He Himself made to us: eternal life.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo ahadi yake kwetu, yaani, uzima wa milele.
Ekegusii: Eye nero eira atorierete intwe, ng’a tonyore obogima bwa kare na kare.

English: In the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses proclaimed to the Israelites all that the LORD had commanded him concerning them.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa arobaini, siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kumi na moja, Mose aliwatangazia Waisraeli yale yote Bwana aliyomwamuru kuwahusu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o ikomi nomo, omwaka bw’emerongo ene, korwa barwete Misiri, Musa akabateebia amang’ana onsi ayi’Omonene amochiigete abateebie.

English: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;
Kiswahili: Kifuko hicho kilipambwa kwa safu nne za vito vya thamani. Safu ya kwanza ilikuwa na akiki, yakuti manjano na zabarajadi;
Ekegusii: Bagakebeekera emeng'ororia ene y'amagena e rigori. Ase omong'ororia bw'eritang'ani bakabeeka saridio, na topasio, na sumaridi;

English: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.
Kiswahili: Je, wao ni Waebrania? Mimi pia ni Mwebrania. Je, wao ni Waisraeli? Mimi pia ni Mwisraeli. Je, wao ni wazao wa Abrahamu? Mimi pia ni mzao wa Abrahamu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo n'Abaiberania? Nainche boigo. Barabwo n'Abaisraeli? Nainche boigo. Barabwo noroiboro rwa Aburaamu? Nainche boigo.

English: Saul's servants said to him, “See now, an evil spirit from God troubles you.
Kiswahili: Watumishi wa Sauli wakamwambia, “Angalia, roho mbaya imeachiwa nafasi na Bwana nayo inakutesa.
Ekegusii: Abasomba baye bakamoteebia: “Rigereria bono, Omoika omobe okorwa ase Nyasae nkogochaanda ore.

English: So is the potter sitting at his work and turning the wheel around with his feet, who is always anxiously set at his work. He produces his handiwork in quantity.
Kiswahili: Ndivyo alivyo mfinyanzi anayeketi kazini mwake na kuzungusha gurudumu kwa miguu yake, ambaye huwa na hamu ya kufanya kazi yake kwa bidii kila wakati. Hutengeneza kazi yake ya mikono kwa wingi.
Ekegusii: Boigo omoroisia chinyongo ase emeremo yaye, ere nigo akorirundia rigari ase okogoro kwaye, ere nigo arendete emeremo yaye goika ogeesa erio aikeranie ekerengo giechinyongo keria keganeirie.

English: Four things on earth are small, yet they are exceedingly wise:
Kiswahili: “Vitu vinne duniani vilivyo vidogo, lakini vina akili nyingi sana:
Ekegusii: Mbire ebinto bine ebisinini mono ase ense, korende bire n’obong’aini obonge, nabio ebi:

English: We are all one man's sons; we are honest men. Your servants are not spies.”
Kiswahili: Sisi sote ni wana wa baba mmoja. Watumishi wako ni watu waaminifu, wala sio wapelelezi.”
Ekegusii: Intwe twensi nabana b'omonto oyomo. Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abanto abaronge, titori chirooti.”

English: You called out in distress, and I rescued you; I answered you from the cloud of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah
Kiswahili: Katika shida yako uliniita nami nikakuokoa, nilikujibu katika mawingu yenye ngurumo; nilikujaribu katika maji ya Meriba.
Ekegusii: Ekero mwarenge nemechando nigo mwandangeretie, na inche nkabatooria, nigo nabairaneretie korwa ime y’enkoba ase nebisete, nkabateema agwo ase amaache a Meriba.

English: When I brought them into the land that I swore to give them and they saw any high hill or leafy tree, there they offered their sacrifices, presented offerings that provoked Me, sent up their fragrant incense, and poured out their drink offerings.
Kiswahili: Nilipowaleta katika nchi ile ambayo nilikuwa nimeapa kuwapa na kuona kilima chochote kirefu au mti wowote wenye majani mengi, huko walitoa dhabihu zao, wakatoa sadaka ambazo zilichochea hasira yangu, wakafukiza uvumba wenye harufu nzuri na kumimina sadaka zao za kinywaji.
Ekegusii: Nkabarenta ase ense eyio nabarierete eira ng’a nimbayee. Na aase aande onsi barooche aimokererete igoro, gose emete yabwate chinsagia chinyinge, nao barenge koruera ebing’wanso biabo na okoruegwa konde, ebio biarenge okogechia asende. Aroro agwo bakaruera ebing’wanso bire ne rimisu rigiya, na bakaumora okoruegwa kwabo kw’ebinyugwa.

English: “I will bring you out of the middle of it, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.
Kiswahili: Nitawaondoa mtoke katika mji na kuwatia mikononi mwa wageni nami nitawaadhibu.
Ekegusii: Nimbarusie ase omochie oyo, mbabeeke ase amaboko y' abanto abaao, na 'mbanachere ekiina.

English: Then don't let your good be slandered,
Kiswahili: Usiruhusu kile ambacho unakiona kuwa chema kisemwe kuwa ni kiovu.
Ekegusii: Timotiga ayare amaya ase more atorwe ng'a n'amabe.

English: By this God's love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo Mungu alivyoonyesha pendo lake kwetu: Mungu alimtuma Mwanawe wa pekee ulimwenguni, ili tupate uzima kupitia kwake.
Ekegusii: Ase eri obwanchani bwa Nyasae bwarorekanire ase tore: Nyasae otomire Omwana oye omomoima ase ense, erinde tonyore obogima asare.

English: and I delivered the deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the presence of Hanamel my uncle's son, and in the presence of the witnesses who signed the deed of the purchase, before all the Jews who sat in the court of the guard.
Kiswahili: nami nikampa Baruku mwana wa Neria, mwana wa Maaseya, hati hii mbele ya binamu yangu Hanameli, na mbele ya mashahidi waliokuwa wameweka sahihi kwenye hati hii na mbele ya Wayahudi wote waliokuwa wameketi katika ua wa walinzi.
Ekegusii: Erio nkaa Baruku, mosinto o Neria, o Maseya, okobwatana koria agwo ase obosio bwa Hanameli, momura o tata moke, na ase amasio a birori baria konya barikire amarieta abo ase okobwatana okwo, boigo nase amasio 'Abayahudi bonsi abwo baikaransete ase egoora y'enyomba y'abasibwa.

English: David reigned over all Israel; and David executed justice and righteousness for all his people.
Kiswahili: Daudi akatawala Israeli yote, akitenda lililo haki na sawa kwa watu wake wote.
Ekegusii: Bono Daudi akaba okogaambera Abaisraeli bonsi, akaba ogokorera abanto baye bonsi oboronge na ekeene.

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and take rods from them, one for each fathers' house, of all their princes according to their fathers' houses, twelve rods. Write each man's name on his rod.
Kiswahili: “Sema na Waisraeli, na ujipatie fimbo kumi na mbili kutoka kwao, moja kutoka kwa kila mmoja wa viongozi wa kabila za baba zao. Andika jina la kila mtu kwenye fimbo yake.
Ekegusii: “Kwana n'Abaisraeli, obateebie ng'a bakoe chinyimbo chiabo, eyemo ase kera omotang'ani o kera egesaku kiabo, chinyimbo ikomi na ibere, Oriike erieta ria kera oyomo ase enyimbo yaye.

English: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Number every firstborn male of the Israelites a month old or more, and list their names.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Wahesabu wazaliwa wa kwanza wa kiume wote wa Waisraeli wenye umri wa mwezi mmoja au zaidi na uorodheshe majina yao.
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia, “Bara abanto abasacha abatangi, n’abana abamura abatangi bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, obariike.

English: Those who eat from his provisions will seek to destroy him; his army will be swept away, and many will fall slain.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaokula kutoka kwenye ruzuku za mfalme watajaribu kumwangamiza; jeshi lake litafagiliwa mbali, nao wengi watakufa vitani.
Ekegusii: Abanto baria bakoria endagera amo nere mbamosirie, na abarwani baye b’esegi mbaserebekane, na abange mbaitwe bakwe.

English: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious and his food is good.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo anatoa kafara kwa wavu wake, na kuchoma uvumba kwa juya lake, kwa kuwa kwa wavu wake anaishi kwa starehe, na anafurahia chakula kizuri.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nigo bakorua ebing'wanso ase ekeonga kiabo na kogesambera ubani, ekiagera ebinto ebio nabio bikobanyorera ebinoru na endagera enyinge.

English: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya kuja kwa Yesu, Yohana alihubiri toba na ubatizo kwa watu wote wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ritang'ani ere ataraacha, Yohana konya obarandeirie abanto bonsi ba Israeli ebatiso y'okoonchoka.

English: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons' wives with him.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Noa akatoka nje pamoja na mkewe, wanawe na wake zao.
Ekegusii: Erio Nuhu agasoka amo na bamura baye, na mokaye, na baka bamura baye.

English: Or don't you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?
Kiswahili: Au hamjui ya kuwa sisi sote tuliobatizwa katika Kristo Yesu tulibatizwa katika mauti yake?
Ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng'a intwe twensi abatwabatisetwe ase Kristo Yeso nigo twabatisetwe ase amakweri aye?

English: because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa Mungu hakumjalia hekima, wala hakumpa fungu la akili njema.
Ekegusii: ekiagera Nyasae nigo ayerinete obong'aini, gose tayeete okomanya.

English: You must not offer to Yahweh that which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut. You must not do this in your land.
Kiswahili: Kamwe usimtolee Bwana mnyama ambaye mapumbu yake yamejeruhiwa, au kuhasiwa, au kuraruliwa au kukatwa. Kamwe usifanye hivi katika nchi yako mwenyewe,
Ekegusii: Eng'iti ende yonsi chingetia chiaye chisaregete ase ogosunyuntwa, gose ase okomiorigwa, gose ase okobutorwa, gose ase okonatwa, timobaisa koyerua ebe ekeng'wanso ase 'nde. Timokora igo ase ense yaino.

English: “You shall bring the bull before the Tent of Meeting; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.
Kiswahili: “Mlete yule fahali mbele ya Hema la Kukutania, naye Aroni na wanawe wataweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.
Ekegusii: “Orente eeri bosio bw'Eema y'Omosangererekano; Aroni na abamura baye babeeke amaboko abo ase omotwe bw'eeri eyio.

English: and said, “We have done our best to buy back our Jewish brothers who were sold to foreigners, but now you are selling your own brothers, that they may be sold back to us!” But they remained silent, for they could find nothing to say.
Kiswahili: na kusema: “Kulingana na uwezo wetu, tumewakomboa ndugu zetu Wayahudi waliokuwa wameuzwa kwa watu wasioamini. Sasa mnawauza ndugu zenu, ili wauzwe tena kwetu!” Walinyamaza kimya, kwa sababu hawakupata chochote cha kusema.
Ekegusii: nkayoteebia, “Intwe ase okonyara gwaito twabooririe Abayahudi baminto tokabairania korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku ebio ase baoonetigwe gochia, korende inwe nigo mokoonia abanto bamino, erinde intwe tobaboorie korwa ase more tobairanie.” Abaanene baria tibabwate nonya nering’ana erimo baare kobairaneria, korende nigo bakirete-kiri.

English: But when the crowd was sent out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.
Kiswahili: Lakini watu walipokwisha kutolewa nje, akaingia mle ndani na kumshika yule binti mkono, naye akaamka.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero baria basangererekanete amo basogetigwe isiko, agasoa ime, akamobwata okoboko, na omoiseke oria akaimoka.

English: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.
Kiswahili: Hekima hukaa katika moyo wa mwenye ufahamu bali haijulikani miongoni mwa wapumbavu.
Ekegusii: Obong'aini nigo bomenyete ase enkoro y'omonto ore n'okomanya, korende ase enkoro y'omoriri tibomanyekaneti nonya 'ng'ake.

English: “When the princes take the lead in Israel, when the people volunteer, bless the LORD.
Kiswahili: “Wakuu katika Israeli wanapoongoza, wakati watu wanapojitoa kwa hiari yao wenyewe: mhimidini Bwana!
Ekegusii: Motogie Omonene, ekiagera abaraai batang’anete Abaisraeli, n’abanto beruete ase ogwancha kwabo!

English: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.
Kiswahili: Serugi alipokuwa na miaka thelathini, akamzaa Nahori.
Ekegusii: Ekero konya Serugi aikire emiaka emerongo etato (30) akaibora Nahori.

English: Yes, better than them both is him who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
Kiswahili: Lakini aliye bora kuliko hao wawili ni yule ambaye hajazaliwa bado, ambaye hajaona ule uovu unaofanyika chini ya jua.
Ekegusii: Korende ase oyo otaraiborwa, oyio otararora ogokora okobe kore aiga inse y'erioba, nigo ere buya asare kobua ase abwo bonsi bare moyo na abakuure.

English: God dealt well with the midwives, and the people multiplied, and grew very mighty.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu akawatendea mema wakunga hao. Waisraeli wakaongezeka na kuendelea kuwa wengi zaidi.
Ekegusii: Nyasae agakorera abaiboria baria amaya, na Abaisraeli bakagenderera komenteka na koba ne chinguru mono.

English: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,
Kiswahili: Lakini Paulo aliona si vyema kwa sababu aliwahi kuwaacha walipokuwa huko Pamfilia, hakutaka kuendelea kufanya kazi naye.
Ekegusii: Korende Paulo tarora buya bairane oyio obatigete aaria Pamfulia, na tagendete amo nabarabwo gokora emeremo eria.

English: Jesus knew that the Father had delivered all things into His hands, and that He had come from God and was returning to God.
Kiswahili: Yesu akijua ya kwamba Baba ameweka vitu vyote chini ya mamlaka yake na kwamba yeye alitoka kwa Mungu na alikuwa anarudi kwa Mungu,
Ekegusii: Yeso omanyete ng’a Ise omoeire bionsi ase amaboko aye, naende ng’a nigo arwete ase Nyasae, naende nkoirana are ase Nyasae.

English: I remembered You, O God, and I groaned; I mused and my spirit grew faint. Selah
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, nilikukumbuka wewe, nikalia kwa huzuni; nikatafakari, roho yangu ikadhoofika.
Ekegusii: Ekero nkoinyora Nyasae, nigo nkorera, na ekero nkomorengereria, nigo ngokwa omoyo.

English: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.
Kiswahili: “Lakini atakapokuja huyo Msaidizi nitakayemtuma kwenu kutoka kwa Baba, yaani, huyo Roho wa kweli atokaye kwa Baba, yeye atanishuhudia mimi.
Ekegusii: Korende karache Omokonyi, oyo ndabatomere korwa ase Tata, Omoika bw'Ekeene okorwa ase Tata, ere nambere kirori.

English: along with Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,
Kiswahili: pamoja na Azaria, Ezra, Meshulamu,
Ekegusii: Asaria, na Ezra, na Mesulamu;

English: Didn't I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to go up to my altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? Didn't I give to the house of your father all the offerings of the children of Israel made by fire?
Kiswahili: Nilimchagua baba yako kati ya makabila yote ya Israeli kuwa kuhani wangu, kukwea kwenye madhabahu yangu, kufukiza uvumba na kuvaa kisibau mbele yangu. Pia niliwapa nyumba ya baba yako sadaka zote zilizotolewa kwa moto na Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Tinabachorete inwe korwa ase ebisaku bi'Abaisraeli mobe abakuani baane, na morue ebing'wanso ase egesasiimero kiane, naende mosambe ubani na mobe mokobeeka egesibao ki'obokuani komogocha ase obosio bwane? Tinaete Abanto b'ororeeria rwa sokororia yao baire ebing'wanso bionsi Abaisraeli baare gosaamba n'omorero?

English: and that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor their memory perish from their offspring.
Kiswahili: Siku hizi zinapasa zikumbukwe na kuadhimishwa katika kila kizazi, kila jamaa na katika kila jimbo na kila jiji. Nazo siku hizi za Purimu kamwe zisikome kusherehekewa na Wayahudi, wala kumbukumbu zake zisipotee miongoni mwa wazao wake.
Ekegusii: Amatuko ayio abe akoinyorwa na kobwatwa ebiaare ase ebiaare, ase kera eamate na ase kera orogongo, na kera omochie. Amatuko ayio a Purimu tabaisa gotigwa korendwa ase egati y'Abayahudi, gose ekeinyorio ki'amatuko ayio tikemocha koba ase chinderia chiabo.

English: It came to pass afterward that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.
Kiswahili: Baada ya hayo akampenda mwanamke mmoja katika Bonde la Soreki aliyeitwa Delila.
Ekegusii: Naende magega y'ayio Samusoni akaba ogwancha omokungu ore korokwa Delila, omenyete ase ense omweya ya Soreki.

English: When a man finds his enemy, does he let him go away unharmed? May the LORD reward you with good for what you have done for me this day.
Kiswahili: Je, mtu ampatapo adui yake, humwacha aende zake bila kumdhuru? Bwana na akulipe mema kwa jinsi ulivyonitenda leo.
Ekegusii: Inee! Onye omonto onyorire omobisa oye, nanyare komotiga ore moyo? Ase ayio Omonene tiga akoe eng’eria yao ase amaya aya gwankoreire ase rituko ria reero.

English: These shall be its measurements: the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.
Kiswahili: nao utakuwa na vipimo hivi: upande wa kaskazini dhiraa 4,500, upande wa kusini dhiraa 4,500, upande wa mashariki dhiraa 4,500 na upande wa magharibi dhiraa 4,500.
Ekegusii: Ekerengo ki'omochie oyio nigo kerabe iga: Ensemo ya sugusu chimoti chilifu inye, na amagana atano (4,500), na ensemo ya Irianyi chilifu inye, na amagana atano (4,500), na ensemo ya moocha chilifu inye, na amagana atano (4,500), na ensemo ya bosongo chilifu inye, na amagana atano (4,500).

English: The priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before Yahweh for the uncleanness of her discharge.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atatoa dhabihu, mmoja kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, na huyo mwingine kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Kwa njia hii, atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake mbele za Bwana kwa sababu ya unajisi wa kutokwa damu kwake.
Ekegusii: Omokuani arue erimo ribe ekeng'wanso ki'ebibe, na erinde eki'ogosaambwa. Ase enchera eyio nakore okobwatanigwa ase omokungu oria ase obosio bwane, ase engencho y'ogotacheneka kwaye kw'ogoiteka kw'amanyinga.

English: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.
Kiswahili: Nguvu hukaa katika shingo yake; utisho hutangulia mbele yake.
Ekegusii: Rigoti riaye nigo ribwate chinguru, na okoondokia nigo kore bosio bwaye.

English: Remember what Amalek did to you by the way as you came out of Egypt,
Kiswahili: Kumbuka kile Waamaleki walichowatendea mlipokuwa njiani mkitoka Misri.
Ekegusii: “Moinyore aya Abaameleki baabakorerete ekero mwarenge ase orogeendo korwa Misiri.

English: “Not so, my father!” Joseph said. “This one is the firstborn; put your right hand on his head.”
Kiswahili: Yosefu akamwambia, “Hapana, baba yangu, huyu ndiye mzaliwa wa kwanza; uweke mkono wako wa kuume juu ya kichwa chake.”
Ekegusii: Yusufu agateebia ise: “Taibo, tata, naki oyo nere omotangi; beeka okoboko kwao gw’okorio ase omotwe oye.”

English: For whenever I speak, I cry out; I proclaim violence and destruction. For the word of the LORD has become to me a reproach and derision all day long.
Kiswahili: Kila ninenapo, ninapiga kelele nikitangaza ukatili na uharibifu. Kwa hiyo neno la Bwana limeniletea matukano na mashutumu mchana kutwa.
Ekegusii: Ekero kende gionsi ngokwana, nigo nkorera, nigo ngoaka eriogi nteba, “Obotindi na ogosaria!” Botambe nigo ngochecherigwa na gosekererigwa ase engencho ye ring’ana riao, aye Omonene.

English: Saul said, “Bring the burnt offering to me here, and the peace offerings.” He offered the burnt offering.
Kiswahili: Basi akasema, “Nileteeni hapa sadaka ya kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani.” Naye Sauli akatoa sadaka ya kuteketezwa.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Saulo agateeba: “Ndetere aa ekeng'wanso ki'ogosaambwa na eki'omorembe.” Erio akarua ekeng'wanso keria ki'ogosaambwa.

English: And Tobias began to say, “Blessed are you, O God of our fathers, and blessed is your holy and glorious name forever. Let the heavens bless you, and all your creatures.
Kiswahili: Tobia akaanza kusema, “Ubarikiwe, Ee Mungu wa baba zetu, na jina lako takatifu na tukufu libarikiwe milele. Mbingu na zikubariki, na viumbe vyako vyote.
Ekegusii: Sara akaimoka erio Tobia agachaaka gosaba ogoteeba “Otogigwe aye Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito, erieta riao ritogigwe kare na kare, igoro ekoimokererie igoro boigo nebitongwa biao bionsi bigotogie goika kare na kare.

English: yes, Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says concerning the vessels that are left in Yahweh's house, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem:
Kiswahili: Naam, hili ndilo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa Israeli, asemalo kuhusu vitu ambavyo vimebaki ndani ya nyumba ya Bwana, na ndani ya jumba la kifalme la mfalme wa Yuda, na katika Yerusalemu:
Ekegusii: Aya naro Nyasae bw'Emeganda, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, agoteeba igoro y'ebikorero biria biatigarete ase enyomba y'Omonene, na ase enyomba y'omorwoti bw'Abayuda na ase Yerusalemu:

English: Or if he asks for an egg, he won't give him a scorpion, will he?
Kiswahili: Au mtoto akimwomba yai atampa nge?
Ekegusii: Gose karamosabe rigena ri'engoko namoe riagaga?

English: Therefore you shall make images of your tumors and images of your mice that mar the land; and you shall give glory to the God of Israel. Perhaps he will release his hand from you, from your gods, and from your land.
Kiswahili: Tengenezeni mifano ya majipu na ya panya wale wanaoharibu nchi yenu, nanyi mheshimuni Mungu wa Israeli. Labda ataondoa mkono wake kutoka kwenu na kwa miungu yenu na nchi yenu.
Ekegusii: Goika moroisie emegwekano y'amagumba, na eye chimbeba, ebio bigosaria ense yaino; erio motogie Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli. Ande nabo arakore emechando yaino ebe emegusu ase more, na ase chinyasae chiaino, na ase ense yaino.

English: For the sake of Jacob My servant and Israel My chosen one, I call you by name; I have given you a title of honor, though you have not known Me.
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya Yakobo mtumishi wangu, Israeli niliyemchagua, nimekuita wewe kwa jina lako, na kukupa jina la heshima, ingawa wewe hunitambui.
Ekegusii: Nigo ngokorangeria ase erieta riao ase engencho ya Yakobo, omosomba one, ee, ase engencho ya Israeli, omochore one. Nakoeire erieta ri’amasikani, nonya aye tomanyeti inche.

English: But you are to take a few strands of hair and secure them in the folds of your garment.
Kiswahili: Lakini chukua nywele chache uzifungie ndani ya pindo la vazi lako.
Ekegusii: Oimokie etukia inke igo, oyesiberanie ase omokoba bw’eganchwa yao.

English: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
Kiswahili: “Ndugu zangu Waisraeli, nataka niwaambie kwa uhakika kwamba baba yetu Daudi alikufa na kuzikwa, nalo kaburi lake lipo hapa mpaka leo.
Ekegusii: Abaminto, ninyare gokwana nainwe maiso marore igoro y'omogaka oito o kare, Daudi, ng'a nigo akwete, naende agatindekwa, na embeera yaye nao ere aiga goika reero.

English: if you have acted faithfully and honestly toward Jerubbaal and his house this day, then may you rejoice in Abimelech, and he in you.
Kiswahili: nanyi kama basi mmemtendea Yerub-Baali na jamaa yake kwa heshima na uaminifu, basi Abimeleki na awe furaha yenu, nanyi mwe furaha yake pia!
Ekegusii: Onye reero mwakoreire Yerubi‐Baali amo nab’enyomba yaye ayaare boronge nay’obwegenwa, rirorio gookera Abimeleki, nere tiga abagookere.

English: “How the mighty has fallen, the savior of Israel!”
Kiswahili: "Jinsi mashujaa walivyoanguka, Mwokozi wa Israeli!"
Ekegusii: “Inaki omonyanguru agwa ere orenge omotooria bwa Abaisraeli!”

English: Then Simon brought forward his army and joined battle with the phalanx (for the cavalry were exhausted), and they were defeated by him and fled.
Kiswahili: Kisha Simoni akaleta mbele jeshi lake na kujiunga na vita na phalanx (maana wapanda farasi walikuwa wamechoka), nao wakashindwa naye na kukimbia.
Ekegusii: Goika ekero abariini chibaarasi abwo bagoya kegima, Simioni akaoroka ase egetii gieseegi ore ne ebiombe bia abarwani baye be esegi. Ere akabagwera rimo rioka na kobabua abarwani be esegi ba amagoro ababisa erio barabwo bakang'ea gotama chimbero.

English: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him; then he vanished out of their sight.
Kiswahili: Ndipo macho yao yakafumbuliwa, nao wakamtambua, naye akatoweka machoni pao. Hawakumwona tena.
Ekegusii: Erio amaiso abo akaramokigwa, bakamomanya; na agwo kegima agasira, tarorekana ase bare.

English: so that I may return safely to my father’s house, then the LORD will be my God.
Kiswahili: na nirudi salama nyumbani kwa baba yangu, hapo ndipo Bwana atakuwa Mungu wangu,
Ekegusii: na inche kondairane ase omochie o Tata nomorembe, eri’Omonene nabe Nyasae one;

English: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.
Kiswahili: Mara tano nimechapwa na Wayahudi viboko arobaini kasoro kimoja.
Ekegusii: Ase Abayahudi ara gatano nkanyora ogoakwa emerongo ene otatiga okomo.

English: This is according to all that you desired of Yahweh your God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, “Let me not hear again Yahweh my God's voice, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I not die.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hivi ndivyo mlivyomwomba Bwana Mungu wenu kule Horebu siku ile ya kusanyiko, wakati mliposema, “Na tusiisikie sauti ya Bwana Mungu wetu, wala kuuona moto huu mkubwa tena, ama sivyo tutakufa.”
Ekegusii: “Nigo er'abe buna mwaboretie Omonene Nyasae oino, ase rituko riria mwasangererekanete agwo Horebu, mogakwana: Tototiga toigwe eriogi ri'Omonene Nyasae oito, kagokwana, gose titogenderera korora omorero oyio omonene. Toise koriigwa na koyorora, nigo torakwe.

English: “The tribe of Gad: the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
Kiswahili: Kabila la Gadi litafuata. Kiongozi wa watu wa Gadi ni Eliasafu mwana wa Deueli.
Ekegusii: Naende abaratoore ensemo yabo n'Abagadi. Eliasafu, mosinto o Reueli, nere oraabe omotang'ani obo,

English: He overlaid it with pure gold and made a gold molding around it.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaifunika kwa dhahabu safi, na kuitengenezea ukingo wa dhahabu kuizunguka pande zote.
Ekegusii: Akayeoma netaabu echenire, akayeetanania omong’ororia bw’etaabu.

English: After an alliance is made with him, he will act deceitfully; for he will rise to power with only a few people.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kufanya mapatano naye, atatenda kwa udanganyifu, na akitumia watu wachache tu ataingia madarakani.
Ekegusii: Nyuma okobwatana kogwakorirwe nere, nakore obong’ainereria, anyore okobua nonya obwate abanto abake boka.

English: His kingdom began in Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
Kiswahili: Vituo vyake vya kwanza katika ufalme wake vilikuwa Babeli, Ereki, Akadi na Kalne katika Shinari.
Ekegusii: Omochakano bw’obogaambi bwaye nigo bware Babiloni, na Ereku, na Akadi, (na Kaline); eyio yonsi nigo yaare ase ense ya Sinari.

English: Do not let Hezekiah mislead you when he says, ‘The LORD will deliver us.’ Has the god of any nation ever delivered his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?
Kiswahili: “Msikubali Hezekia awapotoshe asemapo, ‘ Bwana atatuokoa.’ Je, yuko mungu wa taifa lolote aliyewahi kuokoa nchi yake kutoka mkononi mwa mfalme wa Ashuru?
Ekegusii: Morende mono, ekero Hezekia akobang’aina, ogoteeba: Omonene natotoorie. Inee! Enyasae ende yonsi y’ebisaku yatooririe ense yaye korwa ase okoboko kwane inche omorwoti bw’Abaasuri?

English: Judah became God’s sanctuary, and Israel His dominion.
Kiswahili: Yuda alifanywa makao matakatifu ya Mungu, Israeli akawa milki yake.
Ekegusii: Abayuda bakaba aase aachenu a Omonene, na Abaisraeli bakaba ab’obogaambi bwaye.

English: Then he said to me, “These waters flow out toward the eastern region and will go down into the Arabah. Then they will go toward the sea and flow into the sea which will be made to flow out; and the waters will be healed.
Kiswahili: Akaniambia, “Haya maji yanatiririka kuelekea nchi ya mashariki na kushuka mpaka Araba, ambapo huingia Baharini. Yanapomwagikia kwenye hiyo Bahari, maji yaliyoko humo huponywa na kuwa safi.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria aganteebia, “Amache aya nigo akogenda ase ensemo ya moocha gochia riranya ria Yorodani, na ekero arasoe ase enyancha ere namaache are nomonyoo nansie amaache ayio abe amaya.

English: Once you have presented the best part of it, you will not incur guilt because of it. But you must not defile the sacred offerings of the Israelites, or else you will die.’”
Kiswahili: Kwa kutoa sehemu zake zilizo bora sana, hamtakuwa na hatia katika jambo hili; ndipo hamtatia unajisi sadaka takatifu za Waisraeli, nanyi hamtakufa.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ekero mwarure ensemo engiya kobua korwa ase okoruegwa okwo, timokoba nokomocha ase okoria eria entigari. Timobaisa gokora ebinto ebichenu bi’Abaisraeli bibe ebitachenegeti, erinde timokwa.”

English: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.'
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa anasema, ‘Haimfaidi mwanadamu kitu chochote anapojitahidi kumpendeza Mungu.'
Ekegusii: Naende ere oteebire ng'a kobwatana na Nyasae, ayio tari komokonya gento kende.

English: Then Jesus declared, “For judgment I have come into this world, so that the blind may see and those who see may become blind.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akasema, “Nimekuja ulimwenguni humu kwa ajili ya kuhukumu, ili wale walio vipofu wapate kuona, nao wale wanaoona, wawe vipofu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Inche nigo nachire ase ense eye ase ekiina, erinde abatari korora barore, na barabwo abakorora babe emeuko.”

English: “What is your occupation?” Pharaoh asked Joseph’s brothers. “Your servants are shepherds,” they replied, “both we and our fathers.”
Kiswahili: Farao akawauliza hao ndugu zake, “Kazi yenu ni nini?” Wakamjibu, “Watumishi wako ni wachunga mifugo, kama vile baba zetu walivyokuwa.”
Ekegusii: Farao akababooria: “Emeremo yaino nereri?” Bakamoiraneria, “Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abarisia be chitugo, buna nechisokooro chiaito chiareenge.”

English: Those who were counted of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.
Kiswahili: waliohesabiwa kwa koo zao, walikuwa 2,750.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo barigetwe ase chiamate chiabo nigo barenge chilifu ibere, amagana atano abere, nemerongo etano (2,750).

English: and they gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord commanded me.”
Kiswahili: wakanunulia shamba la mfinyanzi, kama vile Bwana alivyoniagiza.”
Ekegusii: bagachiira ase okogora omogondo bw'omokori chinyongo, buna Omonene achigeete.”

English: As soon as she saw them, she lusted after them and sent messengers to them into Chaldea.
Kiswahili: Mara tu alipowaona, aliwatamani, akatuma wajumbe kwao huko Ukaldayo.
Ekegusii: akaba nokogania okobe ase bare, agatoma abanto ase ense ya Kalidayo ase abanene abwo konya arorire emegwekano yabo.

English: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni mwamba wangu, ngome yangu na mwokozi wangu, Mungu wangu ni mwamba, ambaye kwake ninakimbilia. Yeye ni ngao yangu na pembe ya wokovu wangu, ngome yangu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nere egetare kiane na eburi yane y'ogokumia, nere Omotooria one, na Nyasae one, Nyasae one nere egetare kiane 'ndatamere; nere enguba egonkengera, na Omotooria one bw'echinguru, oyo ogonkengera bokong'u.

English: Their descendants are established around them, and their offspring before their eyes.
Kiswahili: Huwaona watoto wao wakithibitika wakiwa wamewazunguka, wazao wao mbele za macho yao.
Ekegusii: Abana babo nigo bakoba nokogenderera okuya amo nabarabwo, na ororeria rwabo boigo.

English: On the north side their border began at the Jordan, went up past the northern slope of Jericho, headed west through the hill country, and came out at the wilderness of Beth-aven.
Kiswahili: Upande wa kaskazini mpaka wao ulianzia pale Yordani, kupitia kaskazini ya mteremko wa Yeriko na kuendelea magharibi kuingia katika nchi ya vilima, ukitokea kwenye jangwa la Beth-Aveni.
Ekegusii: Ensemo ya sugusu orobebe rwabo rogaachakera orooche rwa Yorodani, rogatiira gochia egetirimboko sugusu ya Yeriko, naende gochia bosongo goetera ense y’ebitunwa, rogaika erooro ya Beti‐Aveni.

English: And Michal the daughter of Saul had no children to the day of her death.
Kiswahili: Naye Mikali binti Sauli hakuwa na watoto mpaka siku ya kufa kwake.
Ekegusii: Na Mikali, mosubati o Saulo, taiborete mwana nonya noyomo goika ogokwa kwaye.

English: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.
Kiswahili: itawale usiku na mchana, na ikatenganishe nuru na giza. Mungu akaona kuwa hili ni jema.
Ekegusii: egaambere omobaso na obotuko, na gwatanana oborabu korwa ase omosunte. Nyasae akarora ayio ng'a namaya.

English: May he rule from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.
Kiswahili: Atatawala kutoka bahari hadi bahari na kutoka Mto mpaka miisho ya dunia.
Ekegusii: Tiga omorwoti abe okogamba korwa ase enyancha eyemo goika eyende, na korwa ase orooche rw’Eufarati goika ase ensinyo y’ense.

English: He said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondservants the things which must happen soon.”
Kiswahili: Kisha yule malaika akaniambia, “Maneno haya ni ya kuaminika na kweli. Bwana, Mungu wa roho za manabii, alimtuma malaika wake kuwaonyesha watumishi wake yale ambayo hayana budi kutukia upesi.”
Ekegusii: Erio aganteebia, “Aya namang'ana 'obwegeni na ay'ekeene, n'Omonene Nyasae, oyogotang'ana ababani n'Omoika oye, agatoma omomalaika oye, erinde aorokerie abasomba baye ayagwenerete gokoreka bwango.

English: Bordering the territory of the priests, the Levites shall have an area 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide. The whole length will be 25,000 cubits, and the width 10,000 cubits.
Kiswahili: “Kando ya nchi ya makuhani, Walawi watakuwa na mgawo wa urefu wa dhiraa 25,000 na upana wa dhiraa 10,000. Urefu wake utakuwa jumla dhiraa 25,000 na upana wa dhiraa 10,000.
Ekegusii: Abalawi baegwe orogongo robebekane norw’abakuani; nigo rorabe nobotambe bwe chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), na obogare chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000). Obotambe bwe chingongo chionsi nigo borabe chimoti chilifu, emerongo ebere na isano (25,000) na obogare chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000).

English: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.' “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?'
Kiswahili: “Akawajibu, ‘Adui ndiye alifanya jambo hili.' “Wale watumishi wakamuuliza, ‘Je, unataka twende tukayangʼoe?'
Ekegusii: Akabateebia: Nomobisa okorete ayio. Abasomba bakamobooria: Inee! Norigetie tochie toyasimore?

English: “The man, the lord of the land, spoke roughly with us, and took us for spies of the country.
Kiswahili: “Huyo mtu ambaye ndiye bwana katika nchi hiyo alisema nasi kwa ukali, akatutendea kana kwamba sisi tulikuwa tunaipeleleza nchi.
Ekegusii: “Omonto oria omonene bw'ense eria nigo akwanete naintwe amang'ana amakong'u agatoroka ng'a intwe nechirooti, tokoroota ense.

English: The governor read the letter and asked what province Paul was from. Learning that he was from Cilicia,
Kiswahili: Mtawala alipokwisha kuisoma ile barua alimuuliza Paulo alikuwa mtu wa jimbo gani. Alipojua kuwa anatoka Kilikia,
Ekegusii: Ekero arisomire, akaboria: “Omonto oyo noyo bw’ense ki?” Ekero aigwete ng’a nomonto o Kilikia, agateeba,

English: Stay with him for a while, until your brother’s fury subsides—
Kiswahili: Ukae naye kwa muda mpaka ghadhabu ya ndugu yako itulie.
Ekegusii: Omenye aroro ase engaki enke, goika ekeririanda kia momura omino gekende.

English: Then Saul said to Samuel, “I have sinned; I have transgressed the LORD’s commandment and your instructions, because I feared the people and obeyed their voice.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Sauli akamwambia Samweli, “Nimetenda dhambi. Nimevunja amri ya Bwana na maagizo yako. Niliwaogopa watu na kwa hiyo nikafanya walivyotaka.
Ekegusii: Erio Saulo agateebia Samweli, “Nakorire ebibe, ekiagera nasaririe ogochika kw’Omonene na amang’ana ao gwantebeetie. Nigo nairogete Abanto, nkaba nkoigwera okogania kwabo.

English: Plague went before Him, and fever followed in His steps.
Kiswahili: Tauni ilimtangulia; maradhi ya kuambukiza yalifuata nyayo zake.
Ekegusii: Amarwaire agoita nigo atang’aine bosio bwaye, na amaakwa nigo akobwatia chimbaratero chiaye.

English: When he stands up, his kingdom will be broken and will be divided toward the four winds of the sky, but not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion with which he ruled; for his kingdom will be plucked up, even for others besides these.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kujitokeza, milki yake itavunjwa na kugawanyika katika pande nne za mbinguni. Hautakwenda kwa wazao wake, wala hautakuwa na nguvu alizotumia, kwa sababu milki yake itangʼolewa na kupewa wengine.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero omorwoti oyio aranyore chinguru chinene, oborwoti bwaye mbosareke bwatananeke ase chinsemo inye chi'ense, tibokoegwa abanto b'ororeria rw'aye, tibokoba nokobua buna koria ere abwate. Oborwoti bwaye mbotegorwe boegwe abanto abaao.

English: King Jehoiakim and all his mighty men and officials heard his words, and the king sought to put him to death. But when Uriah found out about it, he fled in fear and went to Egypt.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Yehoyakimu na wakuu wake wote na maafisa waliposikia maneno yake, mfalme alitafuta kumuua. Lakini Uria alipata habari, na kwa kuogopa akakimbilia Misri.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yehoyakimu omorwoti, amo nabarwani baye b’esegi, na abanene b’oborwoti, baigwete amang’ana a Uria, akarigia komoita, korende ekero Uria aigwete ayio akairoka agatama gochia ase Misiri.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah and his good deeds, according to that which is written in Yahweh's law,
Kiswahili: Matukio mengine ya utawala wa Yosia na matendo yake mema, kulingana na yale yaliyoandikwa katika sheria ya Bwana:
Ekegusii: Bono amang'ana ande onsi ay'ogokora kwa Yosia, na amaya aya akorete koreng'ana naya ariikire ase amachiiko 'Omonene,

English: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.
Kiswahili: Mungu akafanya mianga miwili mikubwa: mwanga mkubwa utawale mchana, na mwanga mdogo utawale usiku. Pia Mungu akafanya nyota.
Ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agakora emebaso ebere emenene, Risase rigaambere ekero kia mobaso n'omotienyi ogaambere ekero kia botuko; agakora ne ching'enang'eni boigo.

English: For this reason God will send them a powerful delusion so that they believe the lie,
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii, Mungu ameruhusu watawaliwe na nguvu ya udanganyifu, ili waendelee kuamini uongo,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, Nyasae nabatomere obotantanu bw’echinguru, abakore begene ayare ay’oborimo,

English: When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven.”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipoiona imani yao, alimwambia yule mtu aliyepooza, “Mwanangu, dhambi zako zimesamehewa.”
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia korora okwegena kwabo agateebia oria orenge rigata, “Omwana one, ebibe biao biabeirwe.”

English: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of Yahweh. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
Kiswahili: Nafsi yangu inatamani sana, naam, hata kuona shauku, kwa ajili ya nyua za Bwana; moyo wangu na mwili wangu vinamlilia Mungu Aliye Hai.
Ekegusii: Omoyo one nore namaiga amange kobeera ase chigoora chia Omonene; enkoro yane na omobere one nigo bigoterera Nyasae ore moyo nomogooko omonene.

English: And there you will serve man-made gods of wood and stone, which cannot see or hear or eat or smell.
Kiswahili: Huko mtaabudu miungu ya miti na mawe iliyotengenezwa na watu, ambayo haiwezi kuona au kusikia wala kula au kunusa.
Ekegusii: Agwo ase morasiarerwe gochia, ’namobe mogosasiima chinyasae chiroisirie korwa ase emete na amagena, emeremo y’amaboko a Mwanyabaanto, echio chitari korora, gose koigwa, gose koragera, gose konyonka.

English: Stay with me; do not be afraid, for he who seeks your life is seeking mine as well. You will be safe with me.”
Kiswahili: Kaa pamoja nami; usiogope. Mtu anayeutafuta uhai wako anautafuta uhai wangu pia. Ukiwa pamoja nami utakuwa salama.”
Ekegusii: Menya aiga amo nainche, tibwoboa. Saulo nigo akorigia obogima bwane, na obwao boigo. Aye koramenye ase ’nde, tokonyorwa na bobe bonde.”

English: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
Kiswahili: Siku zangu ni kama kivuli cha jioni, ninanyauka kama jani.
Ekegusii: Amatuko aane nigo agoeta buna omorengari o mogoroba; nasusanire buna obonyansi.

English: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,
Kiswahili: Lakini ninawaambia: Wapendeni adui zenu na waombeeni wanaowatesa ninyi,
Ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie: Ancha ababisa baino, mobasabere abakobachanda,

English: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.
Kiswahili: Tuma hima nuru yako na kweli yako na viniongoze; vinilete mpaka mlima wako mtakatifu, mpaka mahali unapoishi.
Ekegusii: Ntomere oborabu bwao, na ekeene kiao, binyare kondaa, na kong'ikia ase egetunwa kiao egechenu kere obomenyo bwao.

English: Because the brilliance of the light had blinded me, my companions led me by the hand into Damascus.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa nilikuwa siwezi kuona kwa ajili ya mngʼao wa ile nuru, wenzangu wakanishika mkono wakaniongoza kuingia Dameski.
Ekegusii: Na ekero nasinyetwe korora ase engencho y’oborabu bw’amasase aria, nkaraagwa namaboko abo abarenge amo nainche, ngaika Damesiki.

English: So they said to the messengers who had come, “Tell the men of Jabesh-gilead: ‘Deliverance will be yours tomorrow by the time the sun is hot.’” And when the messengers relayed this to the men of Jabesh, they rejoiced.
Kiswahili: Wakawaambia wale wajumbe waliokuwa wamekuja, “Waambieni watu wa Yabeshi-Gileadi, ‘Kesho kabla jua halijawa kali, mtaokolewa.’ ” Wajumbe walipokwenda na kutoa taarifa hii kwa watu wa Yabeshi, wakafurahi.
Ekegusii: Agateebia Abanto baria batometwe: “Motebie Abanto ba Yabesi o Gileadi: Ankio mobaso gati namonyore obosibore.” Abatomwa baria bakairana, bagateebia Abanto ba Yabesi amang’ana ayio, na barabwo bakaba nomogooko omonene,

English: Regarding any holy thing he has harmed, he must make restitution by adding a fifth of its value to it and giving it to the priest, who will make atonement on his behalf with the ram as a guilt offering, and he will be forgiven.
Kiswahili: Ni lazima alipe kwa yale aliyoshindwa kufanya kuhusu vitu vitakatifu, kwa kuongeza sehemu ya tano ya thamani ile na kuitoa yote kwa kuhani, ambaye atamfanyia upatanisho kwa huyo kondoo dume kama sadaka ya dhambi, naye atasamehewa.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria naakane egento keria egechenu ataruete, naende goika ameente ensemo ya isano ye rigori ri’egento ekio, ayee Omokuani. Erio Omokuani arue emingichi eyio y’ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha na akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria, na omonto oria naaberwe.

English: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away.
Kiswahili: Mizoga yenu itakuwa chakula cha ndege wa angani na wanyama wa nchi, wala hapatakuwepo mtu yeyote wa kuwafukuza.
Ekegusii: Ebitondo biaino 'mbibe endagera ye chinyoni chia igoro, na eye ching'iti chi'orosana, na onde tari orachiseerie achioboyie.

English: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build him a house. Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you.
Kiswahili: “Wewe, Mungu wangu, umemfunulia mtumishi wako Daudi kwamba utamjengea yeye nyumba. Hivyo mtumishi wako amekuwa na ujasiri wa kukuomba maombi haya.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one kwang'orokeirie inche omosomba oo, ng'a nong'agachere enyomba. Ase ayio inche, omosomba oo, nabeire noboremu ase enkoro yane kogosaba ogosaba oko.

English: You shall not deprive the foreigner or the fatherless of justice, nor take a widow's clothing in pledge;
Kiswahili: Usipotoshe hukumu ya mgeni au yatima, au kuchukua vazi la mjane kama rehani.
Ekegusii: “Tobaisa korina omonto omomenyi, gose entakaana, oboronge bwaye, na toira eanga y' omoboraka ebe intenenera.

English: Out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its pasture lands, Jahaz with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Reubeni walipewa Bezeri, Yahasa,
Ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Rubeni bakaegwa Beseri, na Yahasi,

English: From the descendants of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Bani: Meshulamu, Maluki, Adaya, Yashubu, Sheali na Yeremothi.
Ekegusii: abeamate ya Bani: Mesulamu na Maluku, Adaya na Yasubu, Seali na Yeremoti;

English: The angel who spoke with me had a golden measuring rod to measure the city and its gates and walls.
Kiswahili: Huyo malaika aliyesema nami alikuwa na ufito wa dhahabu wa kupimia huo mji, malango yake na kuta zake.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika oria okwanete nainche nigo arenge nemoti y’okorenga y’etaabu, anyare korenga omochie na ebiita biaye, na orwaki rwaye.

English: That is why we boast among God’s churches about your perseverance and faith in the face of all the persecution and affliction you are enduring. Christ’s Coming
Kiswahili: Ndiyo sababu miongoni mwa makanisa ya Mungu, tunajivuna kuhusu saburi yenu na imani mliyo nayo katika mateso yote na dhiki mnazostahimili.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, na intwe abanyene nigo togwetogia ase engencho yaino ase chikanisa chia Nyasae, ase engencho y’oboremereria bwaino, na okwegena more nakwo ase ogochandwa kwaino gwonsi, na emechando eye moremereretie.

English: For they do not speak peace, but they devise deceitful schemes against those who live quietly in the land.
Kiswahili: Hawazungumzi kwa amani, bali wanatunga mashtaka ya uongo dhidi ya wale wanaoishi kwa utulivu katika nchi.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibari gokwana amang’ana akorenta omorembe; nigo bakona-korigia amang’ana yobong’ainereria igoro y’abanto abwo bare abatoereru ase ense.

English: If you build a new house, you are to construct a railing around your roof, so that you do not bring bloodguilt on your house if someone falls from it.
Kiswahili: Wakati unapojenga nyumba mpya, fanya ukuta wa kuzuia kandokando ya dari ili usijiletee hatia ya kumwaga damu juu ya nyumba yako ikiwa yeyote ataanguka kutoka humo.
Ekegusii: “Ekero okoagaacha enyomba enyia, goika oagache egetango ase ekerama insinyo, erio nario omonto atagwe korwao akwe; okomocha kw’ogokwa kw’omonto oragwe korwao tigokobarerwa enyomba yao.

English: Turn to me and show me mercy, as You do to those who love Your name.
Kiswahili: Nigeukie na unihurumie, kama uwafanyiavyo siku zote wale wanaolipenda jina lako.
Ekegusii: Ndigererie, ondorere amaabera buna egwenerete abwo banchete erieta riao.

English: Those in the citadel released the hostages to Jonathan, and he restored them to their parents.
Kiswahili: Wale waliokuwa katika ngome waliwaachilia mateka kwa Yonathani, naye akawarudisha kwa wazazi wao.
Ekegusii: Bakamoa Yonathani abasibwa nere akabairania gochia ase abaibori baabo.

English: The sons of Shelah son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah and the clans of the linen workers at Beth-ashbea,
Kiswahili: Wana wa Shela, mwana wa Yuda, walikuwa: Eri baba yake Leka, Laada baba yake Maresha na jamaa za wafumaji nguo za kitani safi waliokuwa wakiishi huko Beth-Ashbea,
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Sela, mosinto o Yuda, nabwo aba: Eri, ise abanto ba Leka, na Laada, ise abanto ba Maresa, na aba echiamate chi’abaroisia ebitambaa bi’egatani agwo Beti‐Asibea;

English: In the thirty ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem the son of Gadi began to reign over Israel for ten years in Samaria.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa thelathini na tisa wa utawala wa Azaria mfalme wa Yuda, Menahemu mwana wa Gadi akawa mfalme wa Israeli, akatawala huko Samaria kwa miaka kumi.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw'emerongo etato, na kianda, bw'okogaamba gw'Asaria, omorwoti bw'Abayuda, Menahemu, mosinto o Gadi, agachaaka kogaambera Abaisraeli, akagaamba emiaka ikomi agwo Samaria.

English: Then David said to the whole assembly, “Blessed be the LORD your God.” So the whole assembly blessed the LORD, the God of their fathers. They bowed down and paid homage to the LORD and to the king. Solomon Anointed King (1 Kings 1:32–40)
Kiswahili: Ndipo Daudi akaliambia kusanyiko lote, “Mhimidini Bwana Mungu wenu.” Hivyo wote wakamhimidi Bwana, Mungu wa baba zao. Wakasujudu na kuanguka kifudifudi mbele za Bwana na mfalme. Solomoni Akubalika Kuwa Mfalme
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi agateebia omosangererekano bwonsi, “Togia Omonene, Nyasae oino!” Na omosangererekano bwonsi ogatogia Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, na agwo abanto baria bagatureka emetwe yabo, bagasasiima Omonene naende bakaorokia amasikani ase omorwoti.

English: He exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence. He makes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.
Kiswahili: Akatumia mamlaka yote ya yule mnyama wa kwanza kwa niaba yake, naye akawafanya wote wakaao duniani kumwabudu yule mnyama wa kwanza, ambaye jeraha lake la mauti lilipona.
Ekegusii: Nigo ekwenaria okobua gwonsi kw'eng'iti eria ye ritang'ani ase obosio bwaye, na kogera ense na bonsi abamenyete aroro basasime eng'iti eria ye ritang'ani, ero eyio orogoma rwaye rw'amakweri rwagwenetigwe.

English: I find then the law that, while I desire to do good, evil is present.
Kiswahili: Hivyo naiona sheria ikitenda kazi. Ninapotaka kutenda jema, jambo baya liko papo hapo.
Ekegusii: Narorire ogochika oko, ng'a kondigetie gokora ekere ekiya, ekere ekebe nigo kenyesungetie.

English: Moses laid up the rods before Yahweh in the Tent of the Testimony.
Kiswahili: Mose akaziweka hizo fimbo mbele za Bwana ndani ya Hema la Ushuhuda.
Ekegusii: Musa akaira chinyimbo chiria ime ase Eema y'Oborori, agachibekao ase obosio bw'Omonene.

English: When Jesus had again crossed by boat to the other side, a large crowd gathered around Him beside the sea.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokwisha kuvuka tena na kufika ngʼambo, umati mkubwa wa watu ukamzunguka yeye akiwa hapo kando ya bahari.
Ekegusii: Yeso kambokire naende koirana ng’umbu nobwato boria, omoganda omonene okamosangererekanera; ere nigo arenge ensemo y’enyancha.

English: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother's wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,
Kiswahili: Lakini Yohana alipomkemea Mfalme Herode kuhusu uhusiano wake na Herodia, mke wa ndugu yake, na maovu mengine aliyokuwa amefanya,
Ekegusii: Korende Yohana agatogonyera Herode omorwoti, ase engencho y'okonyuoma Herodia, moka momura omwabo, na ase engencho y'amabe onsi Herode akorire,
