English: The sons of Leah were Reuben the firstborn of Jacob, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Lea walikuwa: Reubeni mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Yakobo, Simeoni, Lawi, Yuda, Isakari na Zabuloni.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Lea nabwo aba: Rubeni, omwana omotangi o Yakobo, na Simioni, na Lawi, na Yuda, na Isakaru, na Sabuloni.

English: For six days work may be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day must surely be put to death.
Kiswahili: Kwa siku sita, mtafanya kazi, lakini siku ya saba ni Sabato ya kupumzika, takatifu kwa Bwana. Yeyote afanyaye kazi yoyote siku ya Sabato ni lazima auawe.
Ekegusii: Mokore emeremo amatuko atano na rimo, korende rituko ria gatano na kabere n’Esabato Enchenu, rituko ri’ogotimoka, richenu ase Omonene. Onde bwensi aise gokora emeremo ase rituko erio goika aitwe akwe.

English: Because you have kept My command to persevere, I will also keep you from the hour of testing that is about to come upon the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa umeshika amri yangu ya kuvumilia katika saburi, nitakulinda katika saa ya kujaribiwa inayokuja ulimwenguni pote, ili kuwajaribu wote wakaao duniani.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera obwatete ring’ana riane ri’oboremereria, inche ninkorende korwa ase engaki y’ogoteemwa eyere ang’e gochera ense yonsi goteema abwo bamenyete ase ense.

English: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wanamfungua yule mwana-punda, wenyewe wakawauliza, “Mbona mnamfungua huyo mwana-punda?”
Ekegusii: Ekero baare gosibora emori eria y'etigere, abanyene bakababoria, “Nase ki mogosibora emori?”

English: Then the king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim and settled them in the towns of Samaria to replace the Israelites. They took possession of Samaria and lived in its towns.
Kiswahili: Mfalme wa Ashuru akawaleta watu kutoka Babeli, Kutha, Ava, Hamathi na Sefarvaimu na kuwaweka katika miji ya Samaria badala ya Waisraeli. Wakaimiliki Samaria na kuishi katika miji yake.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti bw’Abaasuri akarenta abanto korwa Babiloni, na Kuta, na Awa, na Hamati, na Sefariwaimu, akababeeka ase emechie ya Samaria bayemenye ribaga ri’Abaisraeli. Ase igo abanto abwo bakaira ense ya Samaria, bakamenya ase emechie y’aroro.

English: Be courageous, and let's be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. May Yahweh do that which seems good to him.”
Kiswahili: Uwe hodari na tupigane kwa ujasiri kwa ajili ya watu wetu na miji ya Mungu wetu. Bwana atafanya lile lililo jema machoni pake.”
Ekegusii: Otenene bokong'u, obe omoremu! Torwanere abanto baito na emechie ya Nyasae oito. Na ig'Omonene akore ayaroche are amaya.”

English: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite who vows and of his offering to Yahweh for his separation, in addition to that which he is able to afford. According to his vow which he vows, so he must do after the law of his separation.'”
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hii ndiyo sheria ya Mnadhiri ambaye anaweka nadhiri kwa matoleo yake kwa Bwana kufuatana na kujitenga kwake, zaidi ya chochote kile anachoweza kupata. Ni lazima atimize nadhiri aliyoiweka kufuatana na sheria ya Mnadhiri.' ”
Ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika ase oyoriete eira ng'a abe Omwerwa Omonene, goika arue ase Omonene aya amorierete eira akorua ore Omwerwa oye, korende onye oriire eira arue goetania, goika ayeikeranie kegima koreng'ana nogochika gw'okwerwa.

English: Wake up and strengthen what remains, which was about to die; for I have found your deeds incomplete in the sight of My God.
Kiswahili: Amka! Nawe uyaimarishe yale yaliyosalia na yaliyo karibu kufa, kwa maana sikuona kwamba kazi zako zimekamilika machoni pa Mungu wangu.
Ekegusii: Obe omorendi, oyabeeke chinguru ayatigarete, ayare ang’e gokwa. Naki tindochi ng’a ogokora kwao ngoikeranete ase obosio bwa Nyasae one.

English: “What is this that we have done, that Alexander has gotten ahead of us in establishing friendship with the Jews to strengthen himself?
Kiswahili: "Tumefanya nini, hata Aleksanda ametutangulia katika kujenga urafiki na Wayahudi ili kujiimarisha?"
Ekegusii: “Ninki togokora bono? Twamotigire Alekisanda gototang'anera na gokong'a ase okoroisia obosaani na Abayahudi!

English: That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus and questioned Him.
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo hiyo Masadukayo, wale wasemao kwamba hakuna ufufuo wa wafu, wakamjia Yesu na kumuuliza swali, wakisema,
Ekegusii: Rituko erio erio Abasadukai bakamochiera, baria bagoteeba ng’a okobokigwa tikoiyo, bakamobooria,

English: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo baba zenu walivyofanya wakati nilipowatuma kutoka Kadesh-Barnea kuipeleleza nchi.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana aya naro chisokoro chiaino chiakorete ekero nabatomete korwa Kadeshi-Barinea gochia koroota ense eyio.

English: He feels only the pain of his own body and mourns only for himself.”
Kiswahili: Yeye hasikii kingine isipokuwa maumivu ya mwili wake mwenyewe, naye huomboleza kwa ajili yake mwenyewe.”
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akoigwa obororo ase omobere oye, na oba okona‐kwereera omonyene.”

English: but it is God who judges; He brings down one and exalts another.
Kiswahili: Bali Mungu ndiye ahukumuye: Humshusha huyu na kumkweza mwingine.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nere okonacha ekiina, okeyia oyomo, na oimokereria oyonde igoro.

English: He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and becomes a servant doing forced labor.
Kiswahili: Aonapo palivyo pazuri mahali pake pa kupumzika na jinsi nchi yake inavyopendeza, atainamisha bega lake kwenye mzigo na kujitolea kwa ajili ya kazi ngumu.
Ekegusii: Akarora ng'a aase agotimokera naagiya, na ense eria nero ekomogwenera. Ase igo, agekumba abogorie egurube, akerua kogenderera nemeremo emekong'u.

English: he sent that lord of pollutions Apollonius with an army of twenty-two thousand, commanding him to kill all those who were of full age, and to sell the women and the boys as slaves.
Kiswahili: Alimtuma yule bwana wa uchafuzi Apolonio pamoja na jeshi la watu ishirini na mbili elfu, akamwamuru awaue wote waliokuwa wazee, na kuwauza wanawake na wavulana kama watumwa.
Ekegusii: goika akaira omoganda bw'abarwani esegi chilifu 22,000 korwa Misiri gochia Yerusalemu abwo bare goakanwa, aba nigo barenge inse y'oboteneneri bw'omonto orenge korokwa Apolonio. Oyo nigo achigete abarwani baye b'esegi baite abanto bonsi na koira abakungu n'abana obosomba.

English: Go to your people, the exiles; speak to them and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says,’ whether they listen or refuse to listen.”
Kiswahili: Kisha nenda kwa watu wa taifa lako walio uhamishoni, ukaseme nao. Waambie, ‘Hivi ndivyo Bwana Mwenyezi asemavyo,’ kwamba watasikiliza au hawatasikiliza.”
Ekegusii: Oimoke ogende ase abanto bamino abwo boosetwe, obateebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba, kobaragotegerere gose bange kogotegerera.”

English: and they saw some of His disciples eating with hands that were defiled—that is, unwashed.
Kiswahili: Wakawaona baadhi ya wanafunzi wake wakila chakula kwa mikono iliyo najisi, yaani, bila kunawa kama ilivyotakiwa na sheria ya dini ya Wayahudi.
Ekegusii: Bakarora abande baborokigwa baye bakoragera namaboko are neriko, engencho yaye ataisabiri.

English: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.
Kiswahili: Bali Mungu ndiye ahukumuye: Humshusha huyu na kumkweza mwingine.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nere okonacha ekiina, okeyia oyomo, na oimokereria oyonde igoro.

English: Micaiah said, “As Yahweh lives, I will say what my God says.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mikaya akasema, “Hakika kama Bwana aishivyo, nitamwambia kile tu Bwana atakachoniambia.”
Ekegusii: Korende Mikaya agateeba, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, ring'ana Nyasae arantebie, nario ndakwane.”

English: A jar of sour wine was sitting there. So they soaked a sponge in the wine, put it on a stalk of hyssop, and lifted it to His mouth.
Kiswahili: Hapo palikuwa na bakuli lililojaa siki. Kwa hiyo wakachovya sifongo kwenye hiyo siki, wakaiweka kwenye ufito wa mti wa hisopo, wakampelekea mdomoni.
Ekegusii: Nkiarenge aroro egetaabo giaichire chinkama, erio bakabeeka esifunchi eichire chinkama igoro ase egetonto, bakamobekera monwa.

English: Eat like a human being those things which are set before you. Don't eat greedily, lest you be hated.
Kiswahili: Kula kama mwanadamu vitu vilivyowekwa mbele yako. Usile kwa pupa, usije ukachukiwa.
Ekegusii: Karie kera egento okoegwa buna omonto ore na amasikani gose tobaisa gotakuna-takuna obaise kwangwa.

English: Behold, the day of Yahweh comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy its sinners out of it.
Kiswahili: Tazameni, siku ya Bwana inakuja, siku katili, yenye ghadhabu na hasira kali, kuifanya nchi kuwa ukiwa na kuwaangamiza wenye dhambi waliomo ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Rora, rituko ri'Omonene ngocha rire; nigo rire ritindi ri'ekeririanda na endamwamu ekobera, ndisarie ense ebe bosa na gosiria kegima abanyabibe bamenyeteo.

English: This is what the LORD says: “Where is your mother’s certificate of divorce with which I sent her away? Or to which of My creditors did I sell you? Look, you were sold for your iniquities, and for your transgressions your mother was sent away.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Iko wapi hati ya talaka ya mama yako ambayo kwayo niliachana naye? Au nimewauza ninyi kwa nani miongoni mwa watu wanaonidai? Kwa ajili ya dhambi zenu mliuzwa, kwa sababu ya makosa, mama yenu aliachwa.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene akoboria: “Ng’ai riruube ri’ogotigana rire, riria naete nyoko ng’a totigane? Gose monto ki nabwate esira yaye nkabaoonia inwe asare? Taibo! Ebibe nabio biagerete mokaoonigwa, na ogosaria kwaino nakwo kwagerete nyoko agaserigwa.

English: Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
Kiswahili: Waliwagawanya bila upendeleo kwa kupiga kura, kwa kuwa kulikuwa na maafisa wa mahali patakatifu na maafisa wa Mungu miongoni mwa wazao wale wa Eleazari na wale wa Ithamari.
Ekegusii: Igo baatananetwe ase ogoakerwa obomera, bonsi ase enchera eyemo, ekiagera abateneneri abwo b'Aase Aachenu na abwo ba Nyasae nigo bachoretwe korwa ase ororeria rw'Eleazari amo norwa Itamari.

English: He will consume the glory of his forest and of his fruitful field, both soul and body. It will be as when a standard bearer faints.
Kiswahili: Fahari ya misitu yake na mashamba yenye rutuba utateketeza kabisa, kama vile mtu mgonjwa adhoofikavyo.
Ekegusii: Buna koreng'ana oborwaire bokoria omobere bw'omonto bwayokoora, naboigo obonene bwe rinani ri'Abaisraeli amo nemegondo yabo ekwama birasirigwe kegima. Omonene nigo arasirie omoyo amo nomobere.

English: Yahweh appointed a set time, saying, “Tomorrow Yahweh shall do this thing in the land.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akaweka wakati na kusema, “Kesho Bwana atalitenda hili katika nchi.”
Ekegusii: Omonene agachora engaki, akabora, “Ankio inche Omonene ninchiche nkore ayio ase ense eye.”

English: You shall dedicate all the firstborn males that are born of your herd and of your flock to Yahweh your God. You shall do no work with the firstborn of your herd, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.
Kiswahili: Wekeni wakfu kwa Bwana Mungu wenu kila mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kiume wa makundi yenu ya ngʼombe na ya mbuzi na kondoo. Maksai walio wazaliwa wa kwanza msiwafanyize kazi, wala msinyoe manyoya ya wazaliwa wa kwanza wa kondoo.
Ekegusii: “Mwatananere Omonene Nyasae oino, chintangi chionsi chie chieri, n'echiechimingichi, n'echiechigoree. Timobaisa gokorera chieri echio chintangi emeremo ende yonsi, gose timobaisa konacha amarionya ye chimingichi echio.

English: It went up westward to Maralah, reached Dabbesheth, and met the brook east of Jokneam.
Kiswahili: Kuelekea upande wa magharibi ukafika Marala, ukagusa Dabeshethi, na kuendelea mpaka kwenye bonde karibu na Yokneamu.
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo orobebe rwabo rogatiira gochia bosongo, rogaika Marala, rogatwomera Dabeseti ne rigoko rire moocha ya Yokinamu.

English: Some seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.
Kiswahili: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka penye miamba, nazo zilipoota, hiyo mimea ikakauka kwa kukosa unyevu.
Ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase egetare, chikamera, chikooma ase okomocha amaache.

English: So the LORD let him alone. (When she said, “bridegroom of blood,” she was referring to the circumcision.) The People Believe Moses and Aaron
Kiswahili: Sipora alipomwita Mose, “Bwana arusi wa damu,” alikuwa anamaanisha ile tohara. Baada ya hayo Bwana akamwacha.
Ekegusii: Agw’Omonene agatiga Musa, tamoita. Erio omokungu oyio agateeba, “Omonyuomi bw’amanyinga ase engencho y’okwaroka.”

English: Menahem exacted the money from Israel, even from all the mighty men of wealth, from each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and didn't stay there in the land.
Kiswahili: Menahemu akatoza fedha hizi kwa nguvu kutoka kwa Israeli. Kila mtu tajiri alilazimika kuchanga shekeli hamsini za fedha ambazo alipewa mfalme wa Ashuru. Basi mfalme wa Ashuru akajiondoa na hakuendelea kuikalia nchi.
Ekegusii: Menahemu akarusia chitaabu echio buna ebango korwa ase Abaisraeli abaarenge abanda; kera oyomo obo akarua chisekeli chi'echifeta emerongo etano. Chibesa echi akaa omorwoti bw'Abaasuri. Ase ayio omorwoti bw'Abaasuri akairana tamenya ase ense eria.

English: Furthermore, who can understand how the clouds spread out, how the thunder roars from His pavilion?
Kiswahili: Ni nani ajuaye jinsi ayatandazavyo mawingu, jinsi angurumavyo kutoka hemani mwake.
Ekegusii: Inee! Monto onde nanyare komanya buna amare agwesiarera, gose buna okogukura gw’enkoba gokorua ase obomenyo bwa Nyasae?

English: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers' households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu wana wa Hebroni, Yeria alikuwa mkuu wao kufuatana na orodha ya jamaa yao. Katika mwaka wa arobaini wa utawala wa Daudi uchunguzi ulifanyika katika kumbukumbu, nao watu wenye uwezo miongoni mwa wana wa Hebroni wakapatikana huko Yazeri katika Gileadi.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaheburoni, Yeria nere otenenerete abanto be chiamate chionsi chi'ororeria rwa Heburoni. (Ase omwaka bw'emerongo ene bw'okogamba gwa Daudi, obotuki bogakorwa, na abanto be chiamate echio abamanyete korwana esegi buya bakanyorekana agwo Yaeseri ya Gileadi).

English: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kusema mambo haya, walipokuwa wanatazama, akachukuliwa juu mbinguni mbele ya macho yao na wingu likampokea wasimwone tena.
Ekegusii: Ekero akwanete aya, kobarigereretie, akabogorigwa gochia igoro, riire rikamoira korwa ase amaiso abo.

English: But they will maintain the fabric of the age. Their prayer is in the handiwork of their craft.
Kiswahili: Lakini watadumisha muundo wa enzi hii. Sala yao iko katika kazi ya mikono ya ufundi wao.
Ekegusii: Tibakonyara gotebereria okonachwa ebiina okwo gose tibana kororekana bagokwana emereng'anio.

English: Then the men of Israel turned back on them, and the men of Benjamin were terrified when they realized that disaster had come upon them.
Kiswahili: Ndipo watu wa Israeli wakawageukia, nao Wabenyamini wakatiwa hofu, kwa kuwa walitambua kwamba maafa yamewajia.
Ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bakaonchoka, bakairana, n’Ababenjamini bagasogwa nomoondoko, ekiagera nigo barooche ng’a ogosirigwa kwabo kwabaacheire ang’e.

English: At daybreak the apostles entered the temple courts as they had been told and began to teach the people. When the high priest and his associates arrived, they convened the Sanhedrin —the full assembly of the elders of Israel—and sent to the jail for the apostles.
Kiswahili: Waliposikia haya wakaenda Hekaluni alfajiri wakaendelea kufundisha watu. Kuhani mkuu na wale waliokuwa pamoja nao walipowasili, alikusanya baraza na wazee wote wa Israeli wakatuma wale mitume waletwe kutoka gerezani.
Ekegusii: Abatomwa bakaigwera, mambia kobogokiamoka bagasoa Hekalu ime bagachaaka kworokereria. Omokuani omonene n’ababwatani baye bakarangeria abanene b’Abayahudi goika ase omosangererekano goika ase ekegambero ki’abaanto bonsi; erio bagatoma ogochika gochia ase echela erinde barente abatomwa baria ase ekegambero.

English: But Naboth replied, “The LORD forbid that I should give you the inheritance of my fathers.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Nabothi akamjibu, “ Bwana na apishe mbali kukupa wewe urithi wa baba zangu.”
Ekegusii: Korende Naboti akamoteebia: “Tiga Omonene atange amang’ana ayio, timbaisa gokoa omwando one naetwe ne chisokoro chiane.”

English: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa tena ndani ya nyumba, wanafunzi wake wakamuuliza kuhusu jambo hili.
Ekegusii: Naende nyomba ime aborokigwa bakabooria Yeso engencho ye ring'ana erio.

English: Therefore, my brothers, whom I love and long for, my joy and crown, that is how you must stand firm in the Lord, my beloved.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu, ninaowapenda na ambao ninawaonea shauku, ninyi mlio furaha yangu na taji yangu, hivi ndivyo iwapasavyo kusimama imara katika Bwana, ninyi wapenzi wangu. Mausia
Ekegusii: Gaki baminto, inwe abanyanchete, abwo amaiga andiereire, omogooko one na egutwa yane, tenena bokong’u ase Omonene, abanchi baane. Ogosorora

English: No longer will a fool be called noble, nor a scoundrel be respected.
Kiswahili: Mpumbavu hataitwa tena muungwana, wala mtu mbaya kabisa kupewa heshima ya juu.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio omonto omoriri takorokwa omosike, gose omong’ainereria takorokwa omonto omwegenwa.

English: In the resurrection, people will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa ufufuo, watu hawataoa wala kuolewa, bali watakuwa kama malaika wa mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Inaki ase okobokigwa tibakonyuoma gose tibakonyuomwa, korende nigo barabe buna abamalaika ba Nyasae bare igoro.

English: As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, with a strong hand, an outstretched arm, and outpoured wrath I will rule over you.
Kiswahili: Hakika kama niishivyo asema Bwana Mwenyezi, nitatawala juu yenu kwa mkono wa nguvu na kwa mkono ulionyooshwa na kwa ghadhabu iliyomwagwa.
Ekegusii: “Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteeba iga: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, nindambore okoboko kwane kore nokobua na ning’umore ekeririanda kiane, nimbe nkobagambera inwe.

English: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;
Kiswahili: Elihorefu na Ahiya, wana wa Shisha: waandishi; Yehoshafati mwana wa Ahiludi: karani;
Ekegusii: Elihorefu na Ahiya, basinto ba Sisa, nabwo baarenge abariki. Yehosafati, mosinto bw'Ahiludi, nere orenge omoriki bw'amang'ana are gokoreka.

English: They can't show signs in the heavens among the nations, or shine as the sun, or give light as the moon.
Kiswahili: Hawawezi kuonyesha ishara mbinguni miongoni mwa mataifa, wala kung'aa kama jua, wala kutoa nuru kama mwezi.
Ekegusii: Nonya n'eching'iti chi'orosana nigo chire buya goetania emegwekano eye; chirochio nabo chigotama korwa ase amakueri erio gwetoria.

English: But you will be called Yahweh's priests. Men will call you the servants of our God. You will eat the wealth of the nations. You will boast in their glory.
Kiswahili: Nanyi mtaitwa makuhani wa Bwana, mtaitwa watumishi wa Mungu wetu. Mtakula utajiri wa mataifa, nanyi katika utajiri wao mtajisifu.
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo morarokwe abakuani ba Omonene; abanto mbaabaroke abakoreri ba Nyasae oito, moegwe morie obotenenku bw'abaanto b'ebisaku, na gwetogeria obonene obwo bwabo.

English: How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and Yahweh had delivered them up?
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja angewezaje kufukuza elfu moja, au wawili kufukuza elfu kumi, kama si kwamba Mwamba wao amewauza, kama si kwamba Bwana amewaacha?
Ekegusii: Naki omonto oyomo arakore aseerie abanto elifu eyemo, na abanto babere baseerie abanto chilifu ikomi, onye oria ore egetare kiabo atabaoonetie na kobarua, naende onye Omonene tabatigete?

English: If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu yeyote atamjeruhi jirani yake, chochote alichomtenda naye atatendewa:
Ekegusii: “Omonto karaake omonto onde asarie omobere oye, buna omonto oria akorera oyonde, nere naboigo arakorerwe.

English: On the seventh day the priest is to reexamine him, and if he sees that the infection is unchanged and has not spread on the skin, the priest must isolate him for another seven days.
Kiswahili: Siku ya saba, kuhani atamchunguza, na kama hakuona badiliko kwenye kile kidonda na hakijaenea juu ya ngozi, atamtenga kwa siku nyingine saba.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere Omokuani amorenge naende, na kararore ng’a oborwaire boria tibwesiarereti ase risankwa, erio amobeeke naende ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko ande atano na abere.

English: I say this so that no one will deceive you by smooth rhetoric.
Kiswahili: Nawaambia mambo haya ili mtu yeyote asiwadanganye kwa maneno ya kuwashawishi.
Ekegusii: Nigo ngokwana ring’ana eri, ng’a monto onde tacha kobang’aina ase amang’ana okoebereria neisa koba nigo bare abaya.

English: Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen that he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Solomoni akakusanya magari ya vita na farasi. Alikuwa na magari 1,400 na farasi 12,000, ambayo aliyaweka katika miji ya magari na mengine akawa nayo huko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Sulemani agasangereria amo chigari ne chibarasi chikoriinwa; nigo abwate chigari elifu eyemo, na amagana ane (1,400), ne chibarasi chikoriinwa chilifu ikomi na ibere (12,000). Echinde ase echio nigo chiabegetwe ase emechie ye chigari, na echinde chikabekwa Yerusalemu, ang'e nase omorwoti amenyete.

English: Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.
Kiswahili: Bwana na awahukumu kabila za watu. Nihukumu Ee Bwana, kwa kadiri ya haki yangu, kwa kadiri ya uadilifu wangu, Ewe Uliye Juu Sana.
Ekegusii: Omonene, naye okogamba na konachera abanto bonsi ekiina. Aye Omonene, onachere inche ekiina koreng'ana noboronge bwane, na buna ntari na komocha.

English: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.
Kiswahili: Wewe ndiwe Mungu utendaye miujiza, umeonyesha uwezo wako katikati ya mataifa.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ore Nyasae ogokora amakumia; kwaorokirie okobua kwao ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto.

English: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo, mtu aliyeitwa Baraba alikuwa amefungwa gerezani pamoja na waasi wengine waliokuwa wametekeleza uuaji wakati wa maasi.
Ekegusii: Narengeo omonto ore korokwa Baraba, osibetwe amo nabaanto abakorete eburuburu, na gokora oboiti ase eburuburu.

English: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.
Kiswahili: Watu husogeza mawe ya mpaka; huchunga makundi ya wanyama waliyonyangʼanya kwa nguvu.
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagotigeria chimbebe, baira amaicho e chitugo nechinguru, bachia koyarisia aba ayabo.

English: Yahweh's word came to Jeremiah, saying,
Kiswahili: Neno la Bwana likamjia Yeremia kusema:
Ekegusii: Ring'ana ri'Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia, rikamoteebia,

English: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.
Kiswahili: Wote wakajazwa na Roho Mtakatifu, wakaanza kunena kwa lugha nyingine, kama Roho alivyowajalia.
Ekegusii: Bonsi bagaichorwa n'Omoika Omochenu, bagachaaka gokwana ase emenwa emeao, buna Omoika obaete gwatora.

English: ‘Because the LORD was unable to bring this people into the land He swore to give them, He has slaughtered them in the wilderness.’
Kiswahili: ‘ Bwana alishindwa kuwaingiza watu hawa katika nchi aliyowaahidi kwa kiapo; hivyo akawaua jangwani.’
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo asinyetwe koira abanto aba ase ense eria konya arire eira akobaa; ase ayio obaiteire ase erooro.

English: When Jesus had finished saying these things, He left Galilee and went into the region of Judea beyond the Jordan.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipomaliza kusema maneno haya, aliondoka Galilaya, akaenda sehemu za Uyahudi, ngʼambo ya Mto Yordani.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia gokoora gokwana amang’ana ayio, akarua Galili, agasoa ensemo ya Boyahudi ng’umbu ya Yorodani;

English: You marched across the earth with fury; You threshed the nations in wrath.
Kiswahili: Kwa ghadhabu ulipita juu ya dunia, na katika hasira ulikanyaga mataifa.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo gwaetete ase ense kore nekeririanda, okamionogorera abanto b’ebisaku inse kore nendamwamu.

English: They were very afraid when they heard that the king had given him authority to gather together an army.
Kiswahili: Waliogopa sana waliposikia kwamba mfalme alikuwa amempa mamlaka ya kukusanya jeshi.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakairoka mono ekero baigwete buna omorwoti omoeire Yonathani okobua gwokoroisia ekeombe kia abarwani be esegi.

English: However I sent to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, “Oh, don't do this abominable thing that I hate.”
Kiswahili: Tena na tena, niliwatuma watumishi wangu manabii ambao walisema, ‘Msifanye jambo hili la kuchukiza ambalo nalichukia!'
Ekegusii: “Korende nonya naboigo, inche nigo nagendererete gotoma abasomba baane ababani kobateebia: Timobaisa gokora amang'ana 'okogechia aya inche Omonene ngechete.

English: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Your dominion endures through all generations. The LORD is faithful in all His words and kind in all His actions.
Kiswahili: Ufalme wako ni ufalme wa milele, mamlaka yako hudumu vizazi vyote. Bwana ni mwaminifu kwa ahadi zake zote na mwenye upendo kwa vyote alivyovifanya.
Ekegusii: Oborwoti bwao nobwa kare na kare, na okogambera kwao nigo kogendererete ase ebiaare bionsi. Omonene nigo are omwegenwa ase amang’ana aye onsi, na oichire nobuya ase ogokora kwaye gwonsi.

English: Leaning back against Jesus, he asked, “Lord, who is it?”
Kiswahili: Yule mwanafunzi akamwegemea Yesu, akamuuliza, “Bwana, tuambie, ni nani?”
Ekegusii: Ere oria akamweegeka buna arenge ase egekuba kia Yeso, akamobooria, “Omonene, ning’o?”

English: For the enemy has pursued my soul, crushing my life to the ground, making me dwell in darkness like those long since dead.
Kiswahili: Adui hunifuatilia, hunipondaponda chini; hunifanya niishi gizani kama wale waliokufa zamani.
Ekegusii: Omobisa one obeire okorigia omoyo one; obeire ogontiringera inse ase amaroba, ong’ikaransirie ase omosunte, nabeire buna omonto okwete kare.

English: They dress the wound of My people with very little care, saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ when there is no peace at all.
Kiswahili: Wanafunga majeraha ya watu wangu bila uangalifu. Wanasema, ‘Amani, amani,’ wakati hakuna amani.
Ekegusii: Batubire amaote ’abaanto baane rioka, bagoteeba: Omorembe, omorembe, na omorembe tori aande.

English: Now Naaman, captain of the army of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honorable, because by him Yahweh had given victory to Syria; he was also a mighty man of valor, but he was a leper.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu, Naamani alikuwa jemadari wa jeshi la mfalme wa Aramu. Alikuwa mtu mkuu mbele ya bwana wake na aliyeheshimiwa sana, kwa sababu kupitia kwake, Bwana alikuwa amewapa Aramu ushindi. Alikuwa askari shujaa, lakini alikuwa na ukoma.
Ekegusii: Naamani, omochiki bw'abasikari b'omorwoti bw'Abasiiria, nigo arenge omonto bw'engencho enene ase obosio bw'omonene oye, na omonene oye nigo amosigete mono, ekiagera ase engencho ya Naamani Omonene aete Abasiiria obobui. Ere nigo arenge omonto etuoni y'esegi, korende oborwaire bwa ukoma mbwamoriete.

English: Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Eliya akaenda kujionyesha kwa Ahabu. Wakati huu njaa ilikuwa kali sana katika Samaria,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Elija akagenda kweorokia ase Ahabu. Engaki eria enchara nigo yarenge endoro se agwo Samaria.

English: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:
Kiswahili: Kisha huwakemea katika hasira yake na kuwaogopesha katika ghadhabu yake, akisema,
Ekegusii: Erio nabatogonyere ase endamwamu yaye, abagose ase ekeririanda kiaye, ogoteeba:

English: For his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him by the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
Kiswahili: Siku kwa siku mfalme wa Babeli alimpa Yehoyakini posho siku zote za maisha yake, hadi siku ya kifo chake.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akamoa endagera yaye botambe na kera egento arenge kogania ase kera rituko ase obogima bwaye bwonsi goika ekero ki'ogokwa kwaye.

English: They worshiped the dragon who had given authority to the beast, and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast, and who can wage war against it?”
Kiswahili: Watu wakaliabudu lile joka kwa sababu lilikuwa limempa huyo mnyama mamlaka yake, pia wakamwabudu huyo mnyama na kuuliza, “Ni nani aliye kama huyu mnyama? Ni nani awezaye kupigana vita naye?”
Ekegusii: Abanto bagasasiima enchoka eria, ekiagera yaete eng’iti eria okobua. Naende bagasasiima eng’iti eria bagoteeba, “Ning’o oreng’aine neng’iti eye? Ning’o oranyare koyerwania?”

English: A wicked man writhes in pain all his days; only a few years are reserved for the ruthless.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwovu siku zake zote hupata mateso, miaka yote aliwekewa mkorofi.
Ekegusii: “Omokori amabe nigo akogenderera gochandeka nobororo ase amatuko aye onsi, na omochandi boigo ase emiaka ere achikeretwe.

English: The Chaldeans broke the pillars of bronze that were in Yahweh's house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in Yahweh's house in pieces, and carried all of their bronze to Babylon.
Kiswahili: Wakaldayo walivunja vipande zile nguzo za shaba, vile vishikilio vya shaba vilivyohamishika, na ile Bahari ya shaba, ambavyo vyote vilikuwa katika Hekalu la Bwana. Hivyo wakaichukua hiyo shaba yote na kuipeleka Babeli.
Ekegusii: Abakalidayo bakabuna chisiiro chie chitaai chiria chiarenge ime ase enyomba y'Omonene, na ebibekerero bi'ebituba, na egetuba keria ekenene mono kiaroisirie korwa ase etai ebiarenge ase enyomba y'Omonene. Kobabibunire bikaba ebing'ese, bakaira etai eria yonsi Babiloni.

English: Solomon composed three thousand proverbs, and his songs numbered a thousand and five.
Kiswahili: Akanena mithali 3,000 na nyimbo zake zilikuwa 1,005.
Ekegusii: Boigo nakwanete emereng’anio chilifu isato; na amatera aye nigo areenge elifu eyemo, na atano.

English: Another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.
Kiswahili: Malaika mwingine akatoka katika hekalu lililoko mbinguni, naye pia alikuwa na mundu mkali.
Ekegusii: Na omomalaika onde agasoka korwa ase Hekalu ya igoro, nere boigo narenge nomoyio okogesa.

English: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.”
Kiswahili: ili achukue nafasi ya huduma ya utume ambayo Yuda aliiacha ili aende mahali pake mwenyewe.”
Ekegusii: abogorie ensemo y'ogokora oko na obotomwa obo Yudasi atigete, akagenda aase aye.”

English: “Skin for skin!” Satan replied. “A man will give up all he owns in exchange for his life.
Kiswahili: Shetani akamjibu Bwana, “Ngozi kwa ngozi! Mwanadamu atatoa vyote alivyo navyo kwa ajili ya uhai wake.
Ekegusii: Erio Saitani akairaneri’Omonene, akamoteebia, “Risankwa ase risankwa; omonto nigo ararue gento kende gionsi abwate ase ogotooria obogima bwaye.

English: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.
Kiswahili: “Amin, nawaambia, kizazi hiki hakitapita hadi mambo haya yote yawe yametimia.
Ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie: Ekegori eke tikegoeta nonya ng'ake goika aya onsi aikeranire.

English: Behold, I will bring a nation on you from far away, house of Israel,” says Yahweh. “It is a mighty nation. It is an ancient nation, a nation whose language you don't know and don't understand what they say.
Kiswahili: Ee nyumba ya Israeli,” asema Bwana, “Ninaleta taifa toka mbali dhidi yako, taifa la kale na linaloendelea kudumu, taifa ambalo lugha yao huijui, wala msemo wao huwezi kuuelewa.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Inwe abanto b'enyomba ya Israeli, nkorenta nde egesaku kerue ense y'aare, kere nechinguru, naende kiarengeo korwa chingaki chia kare, ekio motamanyeti omonwa obo, gose timokomanya ogokwana kw'omonwa obo.

English: The singers also praised him with their voices. There was a sweet melody in the whole house.
Kiswahili: Waimbaji pia walimsifu kwa sauti zao. Kulikuwa na wimbo mtamu katika nyumba nzima.
Ekegusii: Abateeri boigo bakamotogia ase amariogi abo, ase chingeero chingiya na amariogi areng'anaine buya.

English: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up and slipped out to a solitary place to pray.
Kiswahili: Alfajiri na mapema sana kulipokuwa bado kuna giza, Yesu akaamka, akaondoka, akaenda mahali pa faragha ili kuomba.
Ekegusii: Mambia, botarakiamoka, akaimoka, agasooka, akagenda aase atari nabaanto, agasabera aroro.

English: For Jozacar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in David's city; and Amaziah his son reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Maafisa waliomuua walikuwa Yozabadi mwana wa Shimeathi, na Yehozabadi mwana wa Shomeri. Akafa na akazikwa pamoja na baba zake katika Mji wa Daudi. Naye Amazia mwanawe akawa mfalme baada yake.
Ekegusii: Abasomba baye, Yosakari, mosinto o Simeati, na Yehosabadi, mosinto o Someri, aba nabwo bamoitete agakwa. Yoashi agatindekwa ase chisokoro chiaye chiatindegetwe agwo ase Omochie o Daudi, na Amasia, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

English: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?
Kiswahili: Je, wote ni mitume? Je, wote ni manabii? Je, wote ni walimu? Je, wote wanatenda miujiza?
Ekegusii: Inee! Bonsi nabatomwa? Bonsi nababani? Bonsi naborokia? Bonsi ngokora bare ebikone bie chinguru?

English: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren't Caesar's friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”
Kiswahili: Tangu wakati huo, Pilato akajitahidi kutafuta njia ya kumfungua Yesu, lakini Wayahudi wakazidi kupiga kelele wakisema, “Ukimwachia huyu mtu, wewe si rafiki wa Kaisari. Mtu yeyote anayedai kuwa mfalme anampinga Kaisari.”
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo Pilato akarigia komosibora, korende Abayahudi bagaaka eriogi, bakaboora, “Koramosibore, aye tori omosani o Kaisari; kera oyogwekora koba omorwoti nigo are mamincha ase Kaisari.”

English: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, maandamano yako yameonekana, maandamano ya Mungu wangu, Mfalme wangu, yakielekea patakatifu pake.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, omoganda oo ogotaara ororekanire; ee, aye Nyasae one, na omorwoti one, omoganda oria oo ogosoa ase obomenyo bwao obochenu.

English: and raised their voices, shouting, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”
Kiswahili: wakapaza sauti, wakasema, “Yesu, Bwana, tuhurumie!”
Ekegusii: na barabwo bagaaka eriogi bakaboora, “Yeso, Omonene, tororere amaabera!”

English: He said, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of God's Kingdom, but to the rest it is given in parables, that ‘seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.'
Kiswahili: Naye akasema, “Ninyi mmepewa kufahamu siri za Ufalme wa Mungu, lakini kwa wengine nazungumza kwa mifano, ili, “ ‘ingawa wanatazama, wasione; ingawa wanasikiliza, wasielewe.'
Ekegusii: Agateeba, “Inwe mwaeirwe komanya obobisi bw'oborwoti bwa Nyasae; korende abande nabateebigwe ase emereng'anio, erinde okong'ereria bariingererie, korende tibarora, naende ogotegerera bategerere, korende tibaigwa.

English: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
Kiswahili: Ninyi mabwana, watendeeni watumwa wenu yaliyo haki na yanayostahili, mkitambua ya kwamba ninyi pia mnaye Bwana mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanene, kae abasomba baino ekere kia boronge, mokomanya ng'a nainwe more n'Omonene igoro.

English: When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am clean. From now on, I will go to the Gentiles!”
Kiswahili: Wayahudi walipompinga Paulo na kukufuru, yeye aliyakungʼuta mavazi yake, akawaambia, “Damu yenu na iwe juu ya vichwa vyenu! Mimi sina hatia, nimetimiza wajibu wangu. Kuanzia sasa nitawaendea watu wa Mataifa.”
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia koamererania nere na komorama, agasamusa chianga chiaye, akabateebia: “Amanyinga aino nabe igoro ase emetwe yaino! Inche tindi na komocha. Korwa bono ningende ase abanto b'Ebisaku.”

English: He went and encamped against Bethbasi and fought against it many days, and made engines of war.
Kiswahili: Akaenda akapiga kambi dhidi ya Bethbasi, akapigana nayo kwa siku nyingi, akatengeneza mitambo ya vita.
Ekegusii: Erio ere akageenda na koyogwera omochie o Beth-basi korwa chinsemo chionsi. Akaagacha etinga ye esegi. Ekero esegi yagenderera ase amatuko amange,

English: Then they cried out to the LORD and said, ‘We have sinned, for we have forsaken the LORD and served the Baals and Ashtoreths. Now deliver us from the hands of our enemies, that we may serve You.’
Kiswahili: Wakamlilia Bwana na kusema, ‘Tumetenda dhambi; tumemwacha Bwana na kutumikia Mabaali na Maashtorethi. Lakini sasa tuokoe kutoka mikono ya adui zetu, nasi tutakutumikia.’
Ekegusii: Ase igo bakarera ase Omonene, bakaboora; Twakorire ebibe, ekiagera twatigire Omonene; twakoreire chinyasae chiria chikorokwa Baali na Asitaroti. Bono totoorie korwa ase amaboko yababisa baito, naintwe ntogokorere aye.

English: Then one of the Twelve, the one called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests
Kiswahili: Kisha mmojawapo wa wale kumi na wawili, aitwaye Yuda Iskariote, alikwenda kwa viongozi wa makuhani
Ekegusii: Na ekero ekio oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, nere, oyokorokwa Yudasi Iskariota, agachiera abakuani abanene,

English: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don't need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.
Kiswahili: Nanyi, upako mlioupata kutoka kwake unakaa ndani yenu, wala ninyi hamna haja ya mtu yeyote kuwafundisha. Lakini kama vile upako wake unavyowafundisha kuhusu mambo yote nayo ni kweli wala si uongo, basi kama ulivyowafundisha kaeni ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Korende ogoakwa kw'amaguta okwo mwanyorete korwa ase Kristo nigo goikaransete ime yaino, na inwe timogwenereti monto onde aborokererie, ekiagera ogoakwa kw'amaguta okwo mwanyorire nkoborokererie amang'ana onsi, naende kore ogw'ekeene, gose tari oborimo. Na buna aborokereretie, menya ime ya Kristo.

English: Consider, then, the parable of the sower:
Kiswahili: “Sikilizeni basi maana ya ule mfano wa mpanzi:
Ekegusii: “Gaki, igwa omobayeeno bw’omobusuri.

English: He measured the length and width of the gate of the outer court which faces toward the north.
Kiswahili: Kisha akapima urefu na upana wa lango linaloelekea kaskazini, kukabili ukumbi wa nje.
Ekegusii: Naende akagenda ase oboagacho bware geita ki'eraaro ya isiko kiarochie sugusu, na akarengia obotambe na obogare bwaye.

English: But rebels and sinners will together be shattered, and those who forsake the LORD will perish.
Kiswahili: Lakini waasi na wenye dhambi wote wataangamizwa, nao wanaomwacha Bwana wataangamia.
Ekegusii: Korende abasaria na abanyabibe nigo barasirigwe amo; na abwo batigire Omonene mbasirigwe boigo.

English: Then Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jehoiakim and bound him with bronze shackles to take him to Babylon.
Kiswahili: Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli akamshambulia na kumfunga kwa pingu za shaba akampeleka Babeli.
Ekegusii: Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, agacha akarwana nere, akamobwata akamosiba ne chingataare, akamoira Babiloni.

English: Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let's exalt his name together.
Kiswahili: Mtukuzeni Bwana pamoja nami, naam, na tulitukuze jina lake pamoja.
Ekegusii: Raria obonene bw'Omonene amo nainche totogie erieta riaye twensi amo.

English: By David. I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Nitakusifu wewe, Ee Bwana, kwa moyo wangu wote, mbele ya “miungu” nitaimba sifa zako.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, nigo 'nkogoakera ng'a mbuya mono n'enkoro yane yonsi, ningoterere na kogotogia ase obosio bwe chinyasae.

English: Aren't you from everlasting, Yahweh my God, my Holy One? We will not die. Yahweh, you have appointed them for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, je, wewe sio wa tangu milele? Mungu wangu, Uliye Mtakatifu wangu, hatutakufa. Ee Bwana, umewachagua wao ili watekeleze hukumu; Ee Mwamba, umewaamuru watuadhibu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, Omochenu one, tari aye oreo korwa kare na kare? Ase ayio titogokwa. Aye Omonene, egetare giaito, aye kwabachikiire batogambie ekiina, kwababekire batoe egesusuro ki'ogotorongeyia.

English: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.
Kiswahili: Mtawala dhalimu hana akili, bali yeye achukiaye mapato ya udhalimu atafurahia maisha marefu.
Ekegusii: Omogambi otari n'obong'aini nigo are omochaandi omotindi, korende oria ogechete okonyora ebitooki bitari bi'oboronge, nigo akogeenderera kogamba ase amatuko amaange.

English: They swarmed around me like bees, but they were extinguished like burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
Kiswahili: Walinizunguka kama kundi la nyuki, lakini walikufa haraka kama miiba iteketeayo; kwa jina la Bwana naliwakatilia mbali.
Ekegusii: Nigo bang’umokerete buna chinchoke, korende bakarima buna omorero bw’amagwa; ase erieta ri’Omonene ’nkabasiria.

English: (now the congregation's half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
Kiswahili: nusu iliyokuwa ya jumuiya, ilikuwa kondoo 337,500,
Ekegusii: nigo kiarenge ching'ondi chilifu amagana atato, emerongo etato na isano na ibere, na amagana atano (337,500),

English: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,'
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu rafiki yangu amekuja kutoka safarini, nami sina kitu cha kumpa.'
Ekegusii: ekiagera omosani one ochire ase 'nde korwa orogendo, na inche tindi na gento nkomoa;

English: However, from the beginning of creation, ‘God made them male and female.’
Kiswahili: Lakini tangu mwanzo wa uumbaji, ‘Mungu aliwaumba mwanaume na mwanamke.
Ekegusii: Korende korwa omochakano bw’ogotongwa gw’ense Nyasae nigo atongete omosacha na omokungu.

English: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,
Kiswahili: Yesu alikuwa na umri wa miaka thelathini alipoanza huduma yake. Alikuwa akidhaniwa kuwa mwana wa Yosefu, Yosefu alikuwa mwana wa Eli,
Ekegusii: Yeso nere ekero achagete kworokereria, emiaka yaye igo yarenge ang'e emerongo etato, agakagwa ng'a mosinto o Yusufu, o Eli,

English: You have granted me life and loving devotion, and Your care has preserved my spirit.
Kiswahili: Umenipa uhai na kunitendea wema, katika uangalizi wako umeilinda roho yangu.
Ekegusii: Aye kwang’eire obogima na konyorokia obwanchani bwao botari koera; na oborendi bwao nigo borendete omoika one.

English: So it was, at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they didn't fear Yahweh. Therefore Yahweh sent lions among them, which killed some of them.
Kiswahili: Wakati walianza kuishi humo, hawakumwabudu Bwana, kwa hiyo akatuma simba miongoni mwao, wakawaua baadhi ya watu.
Ekegusii: Na ekaba ase omochakano obo bw'okomenya aroro tibamoirogete Omonene; ase ayio Omonene agatoma chindo ase egati yabo, chigaita abanto bande babo.

English: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering, as its memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.
Kiswahili: Kisha kuhani atachota sadaka ya nafaka mkono uliojaa kama sehemu ya kumbukumbu na kuiteketeza juu ya madhabahu, baada ya hayo, atamtaka huyo mwanamke anywe yale maji.
Ekegusii: Naende korwa ase okoruegwa okwo aimokie goke, goichire roe, kobe ekeinyorio ng'a okoruegwa okwo nokwa Omonene, na kogosambera ase egesasiimero, na magega y'ayio ae omokungu oria amaache aria anywe.

English: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo wakamjia ili kumjaribu, wakamuuliza, “Ni halali mtu kumwacha mke wake kwa sababu yoyote?”
Ekegusii: Abafarisai bakamochiera, bakamoteema ase okomoboria, “Inee! Mboronge omonto atige mok'aye ase ring'ana rinde rionsi?”

English: And the people to whom they prophesy will be thrown into the streets of Jerusalem because of famine and sword. There will be no one to bury them or their wives, their sons or their daughters. I will pour out their own evil upon them.
Kiswahili: Nao watu hao wanaowatabiria watatupwa nje katika barabara za Yerusalemu kwa sababu ya njaa na upanga. Hapatakuwepo yeyote wa kuwazika wao au wake zao, wana wao au binti zao. Nitawamwagia maafa wanayostahili.
Ekegusii: Abanto baabaaneirwe nababani abwo, mbakwe nenchara, nabaitwe nemioro, batugutwe ase chinchera chia Yerusalemu, na monto onde tari orabatindeke. Abakungu babo, na abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, nabakorwe boigo. Naboigo ndabairanerie amabe abo.”

English: You are to weave the tunic with fine linen, make the turban of fine linen, and fashion an embroidered sash.
Kiswahili: “Fuma koti la kitani safi na ufanye kilemba cha kitani safi. Mshipi uwe ni kazi ya mtarizi.
Ekegusii: “Oroisie eganchwa entambe amo nekegogwa korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani engiya, na orokini rwe chiusi chire ne chirangi ao ao.

English: So Isaac sent Jacob to Paddan-aram, to Laban son of Bethuel the Aramean, the brother of Rebekah, who was the mother of Jacob and Esau. Esau Marries Mahalath
Kiswahili: Kisha Isaki akamuaga Yakobo, naye akaenda Padan-Aramu, kwa Labani mwana wa Bethueli Mwaramu, ndugu wa Rebeka, aliyekuwa mama wa Yakobo na Esau.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Isaka agateebia Yakobo agende, na ere akagenda Padan‐Aramu ase Labani, mosinto o Betueli Omoaramu, Labani nere momura omwabo Rebeka, ng’ina Yakobo na Esau. Esau okonyuoma omokungu onde

English: And Joash did what was right in the eyes of the LORD all the days he was instructed by Jehoiada the priest.
Kiswahili: Yoashi akafanya yaliyo mema machoni pa Bwana miaka yote ambayo Yehoyada kuhani alikuwa akimwelekeza.
Ekegusii: Yoashi agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene ase amatuko aye onsi, ekiagera Yehoyada Omokuani abeete okomosemia.

English: If you lend money to one of My people among you who is poor, you must not act as a creditor to him; you are not to charge him interest.
Kiswahili: “Kama ukimkopesha mmojawapo wa watu wangu fedha ambaye ni mhitaji, usiwe kama mtu mkopesha fedha; usimtoze riba.
Ekegusii: “Oise komoa singo omonto onde one omotaka ore ase egati yaino, tobaisa gokora buna abwo bakoa abanto singo na koboria ebitoki ebinge; tobaisa komoboria ebitoki.

English: After the priests and Levites had purified themselves, they purified the people, the gates, and the wall.
Kiswahili: Wakati makuhani na Walawi walipokuwa wamekwisha kujitakasa kwa kufuatana na desturi, waliwatakasa watu, malango na ukuta.
Ekegusii: Abakuani na Abalawi bagechena abanyene, bagachena nabaanto bonsi amo nebiita, na orwaki roria.

English: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Basi Kuzaliwa kwake Yesu Kristo kulikuwa hivi: Maria mama yake alikuwa ameposwa na Yosefu, lakini kabla hawajakutana kimwili, Maria alionekana kuwa na mimba kwa uweza wa Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Okoiborwa kwa Yeso Kristo nigo kwarenge iga: Ekero Mariamu ng'ina konya ariereirwe boko na Yusufu, na konya bataramenyana buna omosacha n'omokuungu, Mariamu akarorekana ore morito ase chinguru chi'Omoika Omochenu.

English: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?
Kiswahili: Ni nani ampaye kunguru chakula wakati makinda yake yanamlilia Mungu, yakizungukazunguka kwa ajili ya kukosa chakula?
Ekegusii: Ning'o okoa ekegonkoru endagera yaye, ekero amage aye akorera ase Nyasae na goetanana onsi korigia endagera?

English: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers' houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before Yahweh, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing the land.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo maeneo ambayo kuhani Eleazari, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, na viongozi wa koo za kabila za Israeli waliyoyagawanya kwa kura huko Shilo mbele za Bwana penye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania. Hivyo wakamaliza kuigawanya nchi.
Ekegusii: Eyio nero emiando Eleazari, Omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, amo nabateneneri be chiamate chi'ebisaku bi'Abaisraeli, baatananete ase ogoaka obomera aria Silo, ase okobori'Omonene, ase egesoero ki'Eema y'Omosangererekano. Nabo bagakoora emeremo y'ogwatanana ense eria.

English: The one crag rose up on the north in front of Michmash, and the other on the south in front of Geba.
Kiswahili: Jabali moja lilisimama kaskazini kuelekea Mikmashi na jingine upande wa kusini kuelekea Geba.
Ekegusii: Egetare ekemo nigo giachongororogete ensemo ya sugusu kororia Mikimasi, na ekende ensemo ya Irianyi kororia Geba.

English: On the seventh day, the king came to mourn for Daniel. When he came to the den, he looked in, and, behold, Daniel was sitting.
Kiswahili: Siku ya saba, mfalme alikuja kumwombolezea Danieli. Alipofika kwenye tundu, akatazama ndani, na tazama, Danieli alikuwa ameketi.
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti agaaka eriogi okobora; Aye Omonene Nyasae o Danieli, aye naye Nyasae Omonene naende onde taiyo Omonene gokobua aye.

English: And Jeroboam rested with his fathers, the kings of Israel. And his son Zechariah reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Yeroboamu akalala pamoja na baba zake, wafalme wa Israeli. Naye Zekaria mwanawe akawa mfalme baada yake.
Ekegusii: Yeroboamu akaraara ase chisokoro chiaye chiarenge abarwoti b’Abaisraeli chiararete. Na Zakaria, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

English: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Moab, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime;
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kwa dhambi tatu za Moabu, hata kwa dhambi nne, sitaizuia ghadhabu yangu. Kwa sababu alichoma mifupa ya mfalme wa Edomu, ikawa kama chokaa.
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene ateebire: “Ase engencho y'ogosaria kw' abanto ba Moabu ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo basambete amauga 'omorwoti o Edomu akaba ribu.

English: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwagiza akisema, “Usimwambie mtu yeyote, bali nenda ukajionyeshe kwa kuhani na ukatoe sadaka alizoagiza Mose kwa utakaso wako, ili kuwa ushuhuda kwao.”
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Toteebia monto onde ing'ana, korende genda, bweorokie ase Omokuani, orue ekeng'wanso ase ogosibeka kwao buna Musa achiigete, kebe kirori ase abanto.”

English: “Son of man,” He said to me, “now lift up your eyes to the north.” So I lifted up my eyes to the north, and in the entrance north of the Altar Gate I saw this idol of jealousy.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaniambia, “Mwanadamu, tazama kuelekea kaskazini.” Hivyo nikatazama na kwenye ingilio upande wa kaskazini wa lango la madhabahu, nikaona sanamu hii ya wivu.
Ekegusii: Erio Omonene aganteebia, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, imokia amaiso ao igoro, origererie gochia sugusu.” Ase ayio nkarigereria gochia sugusu, nkarora omogwekano bw’ogosasiimwa, oria obogetie risemi ria Nyasae oteneine ensemo ya sugusu y’egesoero ki’egeita kegochia ase egesasiimero.

English: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
Kiswahili: Tera alipokuwa na miaka sabini, akamzaa Abramu, Nahori na Harani.
Ekegusii: Ekero konya Tera aikire emiaka emerongo etano na ebere (70), akaibora Aburamu, na Nahori, na Harani.

English: He humbles Himself to behold the heavens and the earth.
Kiswahili: ambaye huinama atazame chini aone mbingu na nchi?
Ekegusii: na origereretie goocha inse aa arore igoro na ense.

English: Zedekiah king of Judah will not escape from the hands of the Chaldeans, but he will surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and will speak with him face to face and see him eye to eye.
Kiswahili: Sedekia mfalme wa Yuda hataweza kuponyoka mikononi mwa Wakaldayo, lakini kwa hakika atatiwa mikononi mwa mfalme wa Babeli, naye atazungumza naye ana kwa ana na kumwona kwa macho yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Na Zedekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, tagotooreka korwa ase amaboko ’Abakalidayo, korende ekeene, goika abekwe ase okoboko kw’omorwoti o Babiloni, akwane nere obosio ase obosio, na kororana nere amaiso ase amaiso.

English: But Amaziah would not listen. So Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, Amazia hakusikia, hivyo Yehoashi mfalme wa Israeli akashambulia. Yeye na Amazia mfalme wa Yuda wakakutana uso kwa uso huko Beth-Shemeshi katika Yuda.
Ekegusii: Korende Amasia tanchete gotegerera. Ase ayio Yehoasi, omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli, akagenda koumerana nere, na igo ere na Amasia, omorwoti bw'Abayuda, bakarigererania obosio ase obosio ase okorwana esegi agwo Beti‐Semesi, omochie bw'Abayuda.

English: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.
Kiswahili: Saa tatu baadaye mkewe Anania akaingia, naye hana habari ya mambo yaliyotukia.
Ekegusii: Magega ye chinsa isato mokaye agasoa, ere tamanyete aya akoregete.

English: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu ninayemtumikia kwa moyo wangu wote katika kuhubiri Injili ya Mwanawe, ni shahidi wangu jinsi ninavyowakumbuka
Ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae, oyo 'ngokorera ase omoika one korandia enchiri y'Omwana oye, nere kirori one ng'a tintigeti kobaatora botambe ase ogosaba kwane.

English: When Micaiah son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, heard all the words of the LORD from the scroll,
Kiswahili: Basi Mikaya mwana wa Gemaria, mwana wa Shafani, aliposikia maneno yote ya Bwana kutoka kwenye kile kitabu,
Ekegusii: Ekero Mikaya mosinto o Gema ria, omochokoro o Safani, aigwete amang’ana ayio onsi ay’Omonene ariikire ase egetabu eria,

English: So he went with them. When they came to the Jordan, they cut down wood.
Kiswahili: Naye akaenda pamoja nao. Basi wakaenda Yordani, nao wakaanza kukata miti.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio akagenda amo nabarabwo, na ekero baigete Yorodani, bakagecha emete.

English: Yahweh said to me, “Go again, love a woman loved by another, and an adulteress, even as Yahweh loves the children of Israel, though they turn to other gods, and love cakes of raisins.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akaniambia, “Nenda, ukaonyeshe upendo wako kwa mke wako tena, ingawa amependwa na mwingine naye ni mzinzi. Mpende kama Bwana apendavyo Waisraeli, ingawa wanageukia miungu mingine na kupenda mikate mitamu ya zabibu kavu iliyowekwa wakfu.”
Ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia, “Genda omwanche naende omokungu oyio nonya ogokora obotomani nomwanchi oye, omwanche buna Omonene anchete Abaisraeli, nonya baonchokeire chinyasae ching'ao, naende babeire n'okogania kwa amasabibu amomo.”

English: For if you remain silent now, then relief and deliverance will come to the Jews from another place, but you and your father's house will perish. Who knows if you haven't come to the kingdom for such a time as this?”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa kama utakaa kimya wakati huu, msaada na ukombozi kwa Wayahudi utatoka mahali pengine, lakini wewe na jamaa ya baba yako mtaangamia. Nani ajuaye kwamba hukuja kwenye nafasi ya mamlaka kwa ajili ya wakati kama huu?”
Ekegusii: Naki onye aye kogokira‐kiri kegima ase engaki eye, ogokonywa na ogotooreka nigo korache ase Abayahudi korwa ensemo ende, korende aye na abanto b'enyomba ya iso mosirigwe. Ande, ning'o omanyete gose nase engencho y'engaki buna eye kwabeire eting'ana y'omorwoti?”

English: Jerusalem, Idumea, the region beyond the Jordan, and the vicinity of Tyre and Sidon. The large crowd came to Him when they heard what great things He was doing.
Kiswahili: Waliposikia mambo yote aliyokuwa akiyafanya, umati mkubwa wa watu ukamjia kutoka Uyahudi, Yerusalemu, Idumaya, na ngʼambo ya Yordani, pamoja na wale wa sehemu za karibu na Tiro na Sidoni.
Ekegusii: na Yerusalemu, na Idumea, na ng’umbu ya Yorodani, ne chinsemo chia Turo na Sidoni okabatunyana. Ochia koigwa ebirage bi’amang’ana onsi arenge gokora, omoganda oyio omonene, okamochiera.

English: “Because he loves Me, I will deliver him; because he knows My name, I will protect him.
Kiswahili: Bwana asema, “Kwa kuwa ananipenda, nitamwokoa; nitamlinda, kwa kuwa analikiri Jina langu.
Ekegusii: Naki oyo obwatanire nainche ase obwanchani nimotoorie, nimorende, ekiagera namanyete erieta riane.

English: In a congregation of sinners, a fire will be kindled. In a disobedient nation, wrath is kindled.
Kiswahili: Katika kusanyiko la wenye dhambi, moto utawaka. Katika taifa lisilotii, ghadhabu itawaka.
Ekegusii: Omorero n'outwe gati y'erisango ri'abaanto abanyabibe, gose obororo ng'a boitekere abaenenu.

English: Would you show Him partiality or argue in His defense?
Kiswahili: Mtamwonyesha upendeleo? Mtamtetea Mungu kwenye mashtaka yake?
Ekegusii: Inee! Inwe nigo more nogwanchereria asare? Nigo moganetie korwanerera Nyasae ase ekegambero?

English: He counted them in Bezek; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.
Kiswahili: Sauli alipowakusanya huko Bezeki, watu wa Israeli walikuwa 300,000 na watu wa Yuda 30,000.
Ekegusii: Ekero Saulo abarete Abaisraeli agwo Bezeki, nigo baarenge chilifu amagana atato (300,000), na Abayuda chilifu emerongo etato (30,000).

English: He does not eat at the mountain or look to the idols of the house of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor’s wife.
Kiswahili: “Hakula katika mahali pa ibada za miungu kwenye milima, wala hainulii macho sanamu za nyumba ya Israeli. Hakumtia unajisi mke wa jirani yake.
Ekegusii: Ere taria ebing’wanso bikoruerwa ase ebitunwa igoro, gose tarigereria emegwekano y’Abaisraeli bagosasiima, gose takora obonyaka n’omokuungu bw’omonto onde;

English: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,
Kiswahili: aliwaleta wenye njaa wakaishi humo, nao wakajenga mji wangeweza kuishi.
Ekegusii: Aroro agwo nigo arentete abanto bare n'enchara; barabwo bakaagaacha omochie aroro bakamenyao.

English: The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
Kiswahili: Wana waliozaliwa na Ketura suria wa Abrahamu walikuwa: Zimrani, Yokshani, Medani, Midiani, Ishbaki na Shua. Wana wa Yokshani walikuwa: Sheba na Dedani.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Ketura, omokungu o sere‐sere o Aburaamu, nabwo aba: Simurani na Yokisani, Medani na Midiani, Isibaki na Sua. Abana abamura ba Yokisani nabwo Seba na Dedani.

English: Joseph placed his father and his brothers, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawakalisha baba yake na ndugu zake katika nchi ya Misri na kuwapa milki katika sehemu bora sana ya nchi, wilaya ya Ramesesi, kama Farao alivyoelekeza.
Ekegusii: Yusufu akaa ise amo na bamura bamwabo aase bakomenya, akabaa Ramesesi, orogongo oruya, ensemo engiya mono y'ense eria, buna Farao achiigete.

English: from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba to Dibon;
Kiswahili: Eneo lao lilienea toka Aroeri, iliyoko ukingoni mwa Bonde la Arnoni kuanzia mji ulio katikati ya bonde, likijumlisha nchi ya uwanda wa juu wote wa Medeba mpaka Diboni,
Ekegusii: Ense yabo nigo yachakerete korwa Aroeri, ang'e ne rigoko ri'Arinoni, na omochie ore gati‐gati ye rigoko riria, ekabwaterania nense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu, korwa Medeba goika Diboni,

English: They went out of the prison and entered into Lydia's house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, then departed.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Paulo na Sila kutoka gerezani walikwenda nyumbani kwa Lidia, ambapo walikutana na wale ndugu walioamini, wakawatia moyo, ndipo wakaondoka.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo bagasooka korwa ase echela, bagasoa nyomba mwa Lidia. Aroro bakanyorana nabamwabo, bakabaremia. Erio bakaimoka, bakagenda.

English: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying:
Kiswahili: Ndipo neno la Bwana lilipomjia Eliya Mtishbi kusema,
Ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Elija, Omotisibi, rigateeba,

English: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.
Kiswahili: Mungu wangu unipendaye. Mungu atanitangulia, naye atanifanya niwachekelee wale wanaonisingizia.
Ekegusii: Nyasae one nigo agonchichera nobwanchani bwaye botari koera, Nyasae one nankore nchenge igoro y'ababisa baane.

English: He sent fire from on high, and it overpowered my bones. He spread a net for my feet and turned me back. He made me desolate, faint all the day long.
Kiswahili: “Kutoka juu alipeleka moto, akaushusha katika mifupa yangu. Aliitandia wavu miguu yangu na akanirudisha nyuma. Akanifanya mkiwa, na mdhaifu mchana kutwa.
Ekegusii: “Otomire omorero korwa igoro osambire amauga aane oyabuire, otegire oboreba ase amagoro aane; ong’iranirie magega; ontigire inde bosa, ntari ne chinguru nde n’obororo omobaso boira.

English: I will feed them in good pasture, and the lofty mountains of Israel will be their grazing land. There they will lie down in a good grazing land; they will feed in rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
Kiswahili: Nitawachunga kwenye malisho mazuri na miinuko ya mlima wa Israeli patakuwa mahali pao pa malisho. Huko watajipumzisha kwa amani katika nchi ya malisho mazuri, nao watajilisha huko katika malisho tele katika milima ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ninchirisie ase oborisia obuya. Ee, nchibe chikorisia ase oborisia obonoru bw’ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli.

English: And the prayer offered in faith will restore the one who is sick. The Lord will raise him up. If he has sinned, he will be forgiven.
Kiswahili: Kule kuomba kwa imani kutamwokoa huyo mgonjwa, naye Bwana atamwinua na kama ametenda dhambi, atasamehewa.
Ekegusii: Na ogosaba koria gw’okwegena nagotoorie omorwaire oria, n’Omonene namogwenie. Onye omonto oria okorire ebibe naaberwe.

English: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
Kiswahili: alinyakuliwa hadi Paradiso. Huko alisikia mambo yasiyoelezeka, mambo ambayo binadamu hana ruhusa ya kuyasimulia.
Ekegusii: igo abogoretigwe goika Paradiso ya Nyasae, akaigwa amang'ana atagwatoreka, ayatagwenerete Mwanyabaanto ayakwane.

English: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands;
Kiswahili: Wagershoni walipokea miji ifuatayo pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho: Katika nusu ya kabila la Manase: walipewa Golani katika Bashani na pia Ashtarothi.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase ekeng'ese ki'egesaku kia Manase Abagerisomu bakaegwa Golani agwo Basani, na Asitaroti, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

English: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,
Kiswahili: Mwana ni mngʼao wa utukufu wa Mungu na mfano halisi wa nafsi yake, akivihifadhi vitu vyote kwa neno lake lenye uweza. Akiisha kufanya utakaso kwa ajili ya dhambi, aliketi mkono wa kuume wa Aliye Mkuu huko mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agotobareria obonene bwa Nyasae, na buna Nyasae are, nere naboigo are, naende nigo akobogoria ebinto bionsi ne ring'ana riaye ri'okobua. Gaikire gokora ogosibigwa kw'ebibe, agaikaransa ensemo y'okoboko gw'okorio kw'Obonene igoro.

English: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.
Kiswahili: Nitakushukuru, kwa kuwa ulinijibu, umekuwa wokovu wangu.
Ekegusii: Nagoakeire ng'a mbuya mono, ekiagera kwanyiguure, naende kwabeire ogotooreka kwane.

English: And when Saul had finished prophesying, he went up to the high place.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Sauli kumaliza kutoa unabii, alikwenda mahali pa juu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Saulo akoorire kobaboka ase okobana, agatiira gochia ase ekegoro aase ebing’wanso biare koruerwa.

English: Malluch, Harim, and Baanah. The Vows of the Covenant
Kiswahili: Maluki, Harimu na Baana.
Ekegusii: Maluku, na Harimu, na Baana. Okobwatana

English: In disquieting visions in the night, when deep sleep falls on men,
Kiswahili: Katikati ya ndoto za kutia wasiwasi wakati wa usiku, hapo usingizi mzito uwapatapo wanadamu,
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto bararire chitoro chindito na inche narenge nebirengererio na korora amaroro,

English: For the Most High also hates sinners, and will repay vengeance to the ungodly.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Aliye Juu Zaidi pia huwachukia wenye dhambi, naye atawalipiza kisasi wasiomcha Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nonya 'Omonene nigo agechete abanyabibe. Nere n'abae egesusuro abatamoirogetie.

English: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered, “Shouldn't Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed Yahweh's anointed?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Abishai mwana wa Seruya akasema, “Je, Shimei hapaswi kuuawa kwa ajili ya hili? Alimlaani mpakwa mafuta wa Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Abisai, omomura bw'omokuungu Seruya, akabora, “Inee! Simei tagoitwa akwe, ekiagera amoragereretie omoakwa amaguta bw'Omonene?”

English: So she went down to the threshing floor and did everything her mother-in-law had instructed her to do.
Kiswahili: Basi akashuka mpaka kwenye sakafu ya kupuria, akafanya kila kitu mama mkwe wake alichomwambia kufanya.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Rutu agatirimboka gochia ase ekeooreri, agakora buna ng’ina biara konya amotebirie.

English: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.
Kiswahili: niliteuliwa tangu milele, tangu mwanzoni, kabla ya dunia kuumbwa.
Ekegusii: nao narenge korwa agwo kare na kare, nonya nense konya etarabao.

English: and had no regard for his statutes. They didn't walk in the ways of God's commandments or tread in the paths of discipline in his righteousness.
Kiswahili: Hawakufuata njia za amri za Mungu wala hawakufuata njia za nidhamu katika haki yake.
Ekegusii: Tibabwate masikani ase ebirage bia Nyasae nakomenya koreng'ana nokogania kwa Nyasae. Bakanga koraagwa n'oboronge bwa Nyasae.

English: Behold, Rebekah is before you. Take her, and go, and let her be your master's son's wife, as Yahweh has spoken.”
Kiswahili: Rebeka yuko hapa, mchukue na uende, awe mke wa mwana wa bwana wako, sawasawa na Bwana alivyoongoza.”
Ekegusii: Ekero omosomba o Aburaamu aigwete amang'ana abo, agatugama inse ase obosio bw'Omonene.

English: For she leaves her eggs on the earth, warms them in the dust,
Kiswahili: Huyataga mayai yake juu ya ardhi, na kuyaacha yapate joto mchangani,
Ekegusii: Esagero eaberi nigo egotiga amagena aye ase amaroba ime anyora riberera korwao.

English: “Get up! Get up! Flee from the land of the north,” declares the LORD, “for I have scattered you like the four winds of heaven,” declares the LORD.
Kiswahili: “Njooni! Njooni! Kimbieni mtoke katika nchi ya kaskazini,” asema Bwana, “Kwa kuwa nimewatawanya kwenye pande nne za mbingu,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Imoka! Imoka motame, morue ase ense ya sugusu, ekiagera ninche nabasiarerete buna ngosiarera chimbeo inye chia igoro.” Nab’Omonene agoteeba.

English: God is to us a God of deliverance. To Yahweh, the Lord, belongs escape from death.
Kiswahili: Mungu wetu ni Mungu aokoaye, Bwana Mwenyezi hutuokoa na kifo.
Ekegusii: Nyasae oito nigo are Nyasae ogotooria. Nyasae oito, Omonene nigo agototooria korwa ase amakweri.

English: He hung the king of Ai on a tree until evening, and at sunset Joshua commanded that they take down the body from the tree and throw it down at the entrance of the city gate. And over it they raised a large pile of rocks, which remains to this day. Joshua Renews the Covenant (Deuteronomy 27:1–10)
Kiswahili: Akamwangika mfalme wa Ai kwenye mti na kumwacha hapo mpaka jioni. Wakati wa jua kutua, Yoshua akawaamuru wautoe mwili wake kwenye mti na kuutupa kwenye ingilio la lango la mji. Kisha wakalundika mawe makubwa mengi juu yake, ambayo yamesalia mpaka leo. Agano Linafanywa Upya Katika Mlima Ebali
Ekegusii: Agatonga omorwoti o Ai ase omote igoro, akamotigao goika mogoroba. Ekero erioba rikogwa Yoshua agachiika ng’a egetondo gesungorwe, getugutwe ase egeita ki’omochie; na abanto bagakora bo. Erio bakagetuba amagena, akaba etui eyereo goika reero iga. Amachiiko a Nyasae agosomwa ase egetunwa ki’Ebali

English: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus declared, “this very night, before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Amin, nakuambia, usiku huu, kabla jogoo hajawika, utanikana mara tatu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ekeene nagoteebirie: Ase obotuko obo, ekero etuoni etarabuga, nonkane ara gatato.”

English: and the master of the banquet tasted the water that had been turned into wine. He did not know where it was from, but the servants who had drawn the water knew. Then he called the bridegroom aside
Kiswahili: Yule mkuu wa meza akayaonja yale maji ambayo yalikuwa yamebadilika kuwa divai. Hakujua divai hiyo ilikotoka ingawa wale watumishi waliochota yale maji wao walifahamu. Basi akamwita bwana arusi kando
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’omoyega agachia koigwa amaache aria aonchoretwe koba edivai, tamanya aase yarwa, (korende abasomba ababuuchete amaache mbamanyete). Omonene oria bw’omoyega akarangeria omonywomi,

English: Fire resides in his tent; burning sulfur rains down on his dwelling.
Kiswahili: Moto utakaa katika hema lake; moto wa kiberiti utamwagwa juu ya makao yake.
Ekegusii: Enka yaye nebe bosa abanto abaao mbabe bakomenya aroro; amagena omorero nasiarerwe ase enka yaye.

English: The water in the container was spent, and she put the child under one of the shrubs.
Kiswahili: Maji yalipokwisha kwenye kiriba, akamwacha kijana chini ya mojawapo ya vichaka.
Ekegusii: Ekero amaache aria areenge ebirandi ime aerire, akaareria omwana inse y'egetutu.

English: Then Saul said to his servants, “Listen, men of Benjamin! Is the son of Jesse giving all of you fields and vineyards and making you commanders of thousands or hundreds?
Kiswahili: Sauli akawaambia, “Sikilizeni enyi watu wa Benyamini! Je, mwana wa Yese atawapa ninyi nyote mashamba na mashamba ya mizabibu? Je, atawafanya ninyi nyote majemadari wa maelfu na majemadari wa mamia?
Ekegusii: Saulo agakwana nabasomba baye, akabora: “Igwa inwe Ababenjamini! Inee! Mosinto o Yese nae kera oyomo oino emegondo y’endagera amo ney’emesabibu? Nakore inwe mwensi mobe abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu na ab’amagana?

English: The crowd replied, “We have heard from the Law that the Christ will remain forever. So how can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?”
Kiswahili: Ule umati wa watu ukapiga kelele ukasema, “Tumesikia kutoka Sheria kwamba ‘Kristo adumu milele,’ wewe wawezaje kusema, ‘Mwana wa Adamu hana budi kuinuliwa juu’? Huyu ‘Mwana wa Adamu’ ni nani?”
Ekegusii: Erio omoganda okamoiraneria, “Nigo tokoigwa ase amachiiko ng’a Kristo nigo arabeo goika kare na kare, na aye naki okobora ng’a nemogwenerete Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto aimokererigwe igoro? Oyo Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nere ng’o?”

English: He laid his body in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, “Alas, my brother!”
Kiswahili: Kisha akailaza ile maiti katika kaburi lake huyo nabii mzee, nao wakaomboleza juu yake na kusema, “Ee ndugu yangu!”
Ekegusii: Ere akabeeka omobere oria ase embeera yaye omonyene, na barabwo bakamoreera, na kera oyomo agateeba: “Obee! Momura ominto!”

English: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nikiomba kwa lugha, roho yangu inaomba, lakini akili yangu haina matunda.
Ekegusii: Naki kondasabe ase omonwa otamanyekaneti omoika one nigo ogosaba, korende obong’aini bwane tibori kwama.

English: He who digs a pit may fall into it, and he who breaches a wall may be bitten by a snake.
Kiswahili: Yeye achimbaye shimo aweza kutumbukia ndani yake, yeyote abomoaye ukuta anaweza kuumwa na nyoka.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogokunya engoro, nere oragwe imeo, na oyo okobochora enyasi, eng’iti engenda inse nemorome.

English: When you gather the grapes of your vineyard, you must not go over the vines again. What remains will be for the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow.
Kiswahili: Unapochuma zabibu katika shamba lako la mizabibu usirudie tena. Acha zinazobaki kwa ajili ya mgeni, yatima na mjane.
Ekegusii: Ekero mwatorire amasabibu aino, timoirana naende gochia gosangereria ayatigaire, korende moyatigere abamenyi, ne’chintakana, n’ababoraka.

English: Whatever seems good to you and to your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, do that according to the will of your God.
Kiswahili: Kisha wewe na Wayahudi ndugu zako mnaweza kufanya lolote linaloonekana jema sana kwa fedha na dhahabu zilizosalia, kulingana na mapenzi ya Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: Emeremo ende yonsi aye amo nabaanto bamino morarore ere buya, chifeta n'echitaabu chiratigare mochiyekorere, korende mokore igo kobwatekana nogwancha kwa Nyasae oino.

English: Gideon said to God, “If you will save Israel by my hand, as you have spoken,
Kiswahili: Gideoni akamwambia Mungu, “Kama utawaokoa Waisraeli kwa mkono wangu, kama ulivyoahidi:
Ekegusii: Gidioni agateebia Nyasae, “Aye gwateebire ng'a norigetie gotooria Abaisraeli goetera ase okoboko kwane. Onye ere boigo,

English: Yahweh says: “If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, then I will also cast off all the offspring of Israel for all that they have done,” says Yahweh.

English: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana zamani ninyi mlikuwa giza, lakini sasa ninyi ni nuru katika Bwana. Enendeni kama watoto wa nuru
Ekegusii: Inaki kare nigo mwareenge omosunte, korende bono mwabeire omobaso ase Omonene. Mogeenderere buna abana b'omobaso

English: I took my concubine and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel; for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.

English: you must not leave the body on the tree overnight, but you must be sure to bury him that day, because anyone who is hung on a tree is under God’s curse. You must not defile the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.
Kiswahili: kamwe msiuache mwili wake mtini usiku kucha. Hakikisheni mnauzika mwili wake siku ile ile, kwa sababu kila mtu anayeangikwa mtini yupo chini ya laana ya Mungu. Msiinajisi nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa kama urithi wenu.
Ekegusii: Omobere oye totigwa ore ase omote igoro obotuko obogima, korende otindekwe ase rituko erio erio, ekiagera omonto oitirwe ase ogosungwa nigo aragereirie na Nyasae. Timobaisa gotiga ense yaino ebe n’obobe, ense eyi’Omonene Nyasae oino, abaeire ebe omwando oino.

English: He left all that he had in Joseph's hand. He didn't concern himself with anything, except for the food which he ate. Joseph was well-built and handsome.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Potifa akamwachia Yosefu uangalizi wa kila kitu alichokuwa nacho, Yosefu alipokuwa katika uongozi, Potifa hakuwa na sababu ya kujishughulisha na kitu chochote isipokuwa chakula alichokula. Yosefu alikuwa mwenye umbo zuri na sura ya kuvutia;
Ekegusii: Ase igo, agatiga bionsi ebiareenge nabio ase amaboko a Yusufu; gose taba ogwechandera gento kende gionsi otatiga endagera yoka eria areenge koria. Yusufu nigo areenge omonto omerete buya, naende omonyakieni.

English: So Heliodorus set out on his journey at once, ostensibly to visit the cities of Coelesyria and Phoenicia, but in fact to execute the king's purpose.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo Heliodoro alianza safari yake mara moja, akionekana kutembelea miji ya Coelesyria na Foinike, lakini kwa kweli ili kutekeleza kusudi la mfalme.
Ekegusii: Heliodoro akaimoka kogenda ase atometwe korende agekora buna oria ogotaarera omochie o Siria enene.

English: Yahweh listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. The name of the place was called Hormah.
Kiswahili: Bwana akasikiliza ombi la Waisraeli, naye akawapa ushindi juu ya Wakanaani. Wakawaangamiza kabisa na miji yao; hivyo mahali pale pakaitwa Horma.
Ekegusii: Omonene akaigwa ogosaba kw'Abaisraeli, akabaa obobui igoro y'Abakaanani. Abaisraeli bakabasiria kegima, bagasaria emechie yabo. Ase ogokora oko, aase aria akarokwa Horima.

English: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.
Kiswahili: Ishini kama watu huru, lakini msitumie uhuru wenu kama kisingizio cha kutenda uovu, bali ishini kama watumishi wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Mobe abanto abasibore, korende timokorera obosibore bwaino ase okobiserera obobe, korende mobe norogendo rogwenerete abasomba ba Nyasae.

English: I will judge you as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy.
Kiswahili: Nitakuhukumia adhabu wanayopewa wanawake wafanyao uasherati na hao wamwagao damu, nitaleta juu yenu kisasi cha damu cha ghadhabu yangu na wivu wa hasira yangu.
Ekegusii: Ninkonachere ekiina buna abakungu basaririe chiira chi'okonyuomana kwabo na buna abaiteri amanyinga bakonacherwa ekiina; amanyinga ao ninyaitere inde nendamwamu ne risemi.

English: And the Amorites were determined to dwell in Mount Heres, Aijalon, and Shaalbim. But when the house of Joseph grew in strength, they pressed the Amorites into forced labor.
Kiswahili: Waamori pia wakaendelea kukaa katika Mlima Heresi, katika Aiyaloni na Shaalbimu, lakini mkono wa nyumba ya Yosefu ukawalemea, nao wakashindwa hata wakalazimika kuingia katika kazi ya kulazimishwa.
Ekegusii: Abaamori bakabwaterera ensemo yabo y’egetunwa kia Heresi, n’Ayaloni, na Shaalabimu, korende abanto b’eamate ya Yusufu bakabaengera, bakababetereria babakorere emeremo emekong’u.
