English: Pharaoh with his mighty army and vast horde will not help him in battle, when ramps are built and siege walls constructed to destroy many lives.
Kiswahili: Farao na jeshi lake kubwa, na wingi wake wa watu hawataweza kusaidia chochote katika vita, wakati watakapozungukwa na jeshi ili kukatilia mbali maisha ya watu wengi.
Ekegusii: Farao na abarwani baye b’esegi abange tibakonyara gokonya omorwoti oyio ase esegi, ekero chiburi chiraagachwe, amo ne chindwaki chi’okoboera ase ogosiria abanto abange.

English: And everyone who lives and believes in Me will never die. Do you believe this?”
Kiswahili: na yeyote aishiye na kuniamini hatakufa kabisa hata milele. Je, unasadiki haya?”
Ekegusii: Na onde bwensi ore moyo na onyegenire, tagokwa nonya ng’ake. Inee! Kwegenire aya?”

English: In the eighteenth year of Josiah’s reign, this Passover was observed. The Death of Josiah (2 Kings 23:28–30)
Kiswahili: Pasaka iliadhimishwa katika mwaka wa kumi na nane wa utawala wa Mfalme Yosia. Kifo Cha Yosia (2 Wafalme 23:28-30)
Ekegusii: Epasaka eyio enene nigo yarendetwe ase omwaka o ikomi, na gatano na gatato, bw’okogamba kwa Yosia. Omoerio bw’okogamba kwa Yosia (2 Abar 23:28-30)

English: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel; for it is a wave offering. It shall be a wave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, even their wave offering to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Siku zote hili litakuwa fungu la kawaida kutoka kwa Waisraeli kwa ajili ya Aroni na wanawe. Hili ni toleo la Waisraeli watakalotoa kwa Bwana kutoka sadaka zao za amani.
Ekegusii: Ebi nigo birabe bitungetie Abakuani kogenderera botambe korwa ase Abaisraeli, bibe ekeegwa ki'Omonene korwa ase bare, ekeng'wanso kiabo ki'omorembe.

English: A revelation. Yahweh's word is against the land of Hadrach, and will rest upon Damascus— for the eye of man and of all the tribes of Israel is toward Yahweh—
Kiswahili: Neno: Neno la Bwana liko kinyume na nchi ya Hadraki na Dameski itakuwa mahali pa kupumzika, kwa kuwa macho ya watu na ya kabila zote za Israeli yako kwa Bwana,
Ekegusii: Eri nering'ana rikong'u riakwanetwe n'Omonene igoro y'ense ya Hadaraki, riikere nonya nomochie o Damesiki. Amaiso 'abaanto b'ebisaku amo nay'Abaisraeli nigo arigereretie Omonene.

English: So Shechem told his father Hamor, “Get me this girl as a wife.”
Kiswahili: Shekemu akamwambia baba yake Hamori, “Nipatie msichana huyu awe mke wangu.”
Ekegusii: Sekemu agakwana na Hamori ise, akamoteebia: “Mborerie omoiseke oyo abe mokane!”

English: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?
Kiswahili: Pia, kama wawili wakilala pamoja watapashana joto. Lakini ni vipi mtu aweza kujipasha joto mwenyewe?
Ekegusii: Abanto babere kobararaare amo mbaigwe riberera korende naki oyomo arakore aigwe riberera kare bweka?

English: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.
Kiswahili: Hivyo tangu siku hiyo wakawa wanafanya mipango ili wamuue Yesu.
Ekegusii: Nabo korwa rituko riria bakarengereria buna baranyare komoita.

English: “We are going to die,” he said to his wife, “for we have seen God!”
Kiswahili: Manoa akamwambia mkewe, “Hakika tutakufa, kwa kuwa tumemwona Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Manoa agateebia mokaaye, “Amaene goika tokwe, ekiagera twarorire Nyasae.”

English: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,
Kiswahili: Basi ikiwa tulikufa pamoja na Kristo, tunaamini kwamba pia tutaishi pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Korende onye twakwete amo na Kristo, twegenire ng'a inatobe moyo amo nere.

English: The same day the king made the middle of the court holy that was before Yahweh's house; for there he offered the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar that was before Yahweh was too little to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings.
Kiswahili: Siku iyo hiyo mfalme akaweka wakfu sehemu ya katikati ya ua uliokuwa mbele ya Hekalu la Bwana na hapo akatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa, sadaka za nafaka na mafuta ya sadaka za amani, kwa sababu madhabahu ya shaba iliyokuwa mbele za Bwana ilikuwa ndogo sana kuweza kubeba sadaka hizo za kuteketezwa, sadaka za nafaka na mafuta ya sadaka ya amani.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria omorwoti agaatanana na gochena obogati‐gati bw'eraaro eria yarenge bosio bw'enyomba y'Omonene. Agwo nao aruerete ebing'wanso bi'ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw'endagera, na ebitinya bi'ebing'wanso bi'omorembe, ekiagera egesasiimero gi'etai ekiarenge ase obosio bw'Omonene nigo kiarenge egeke mono, tikiare goisana koira ebing'wanso bi'ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw'endagera, na ebitinya bi'ebing'wanso bi'omorembe.

English: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,' for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
Kiswahili: Nendeni mkajifunze maana ya maneno haya: ‘Nataka rehema, wala si dhabihu.' Kwa maana sikuja kuwaita wenye haki, bali wenye dhambi.”
Ekegusii: Genda mweorokererie engencho yaye ninki: Inche nigo ndigetie amaabera, gose tari ekeng'wanso. Inaki tincheti korangeria abanyaboronge, korende abanyabibe.”

English: The king said to his servants, “Don't you know that a prince and a great man has fallen today in Israel?
Kiswahili: Kisha mfalme akawaambia watu wake, “Je, hamfahamu kwamba mkuu na mtu mashuhuri ameanguka katika Israeli leo?
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti agateebia abasomba baye, “Timomanyeti ng'a reero omonto omonene, omogambi bw'Abaisraeli, okuure?

English: But I replied, “Should a man like me run away? Should one like me go into the temple to save his own life? I will not go!”
Kiswahili: Lakini nikasema, “Je, mtu kama mimi akimbie? Au mtu kama mimi aende Hekaluni kuokoa maisha yake? Sitakwenda!”
Ekegusii: Korende nkamoteebia, “Inee! Omonto onga buna inche ningwenerete gotama? Omonto onga buna inche ninyare gotama gochia ase Hekalu ime, ase ogotooria obogima bwane? Tinkonyara kogenda aroro.”

English: For many are called, but few are chosen.” Paying Taxes to Caesar (Mark 12:13–17; Luke 20:19–26)
Kiswahili: “Kwa maana walioitwa ni wengi, lakini walioteuliwa ni wachache.” Kulipa Kodi Kwa Kaisari (Marko 12:13-17; Luka 20:20-26)
Ekegusii: Inaki abarangerigwe nabaange, korende abachorirwe nabake.” Riborio igoro y’okoa Kaisari ebango (Mar 12:13-17; Luk 20:20-26)

English: “They will be Mine,” says the LORD of Hosts, “on the day when I prepare My treasured possession. And I will spare them as a man spares his own son who serves him.
Kiswahili: “Nao watakuwa watu wangu,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, “katika siku ile nitakapowafanya watu kuwa hazina yangu. Nitawahurumia, kama vile kwa huruma mtu amhurumiavyo mwanawe anayemtumikia.
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: “Abanto aba mbabe abanto bane bori ase rituko erio ndakore ring’ana, nimbarorere amaabera buna omonto akorora amaabera ase omwana oye okomokorera.

English: So when this agreement had been made, Lysias departed to the king, and the Jews went about their farming.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, baada ya makubaliano haya kufanywa, Lisia akaenda kwa mfalme, na Wayahudi wakaanza kazi zao za kilimo.
Ekegusii: Ekero okobwatana kw'omorembe gati y'Abayahudi na Abasiria kwaerete, Lisia akairana ase omorwoti n'Abayahudi bakairana gochia ase emeremo yabo ya mogondo.

English: Will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You?
Kiswahili: Je, hutatuhuisha tena, ili watu wako wakufurahie?
Ekegusii: Inee! Togotokora abayia naende, erinde intwe abanto bao tobe nomogooko asore?

English: The Levite replied, “We are traveling from Bethlehem in Judah to the remote hill country of Ephraim, where I am from. I went to Bethlehem in Judah, and now I am going to the house of the LORD; but no one has taken me into his home,
Kiswahili: Akamwambia, “Tumepita kutoka Bethlehemu ya Yuda, tunaelekea katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu, ambako ndiko ninakoishi. Nilikwenda Bethlehemu ya Yuda na sasa ninakwenda katika nyumba ya Bwana. Hakuna mtu yeyote aliyenikaribisha katika nyumba yake.
Ekegusii: Omogendi oria akamoiraneria, “Igo tokorwa Bethlehemu o Yuda, tokogeenda rogoro kegima ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Efraimu, nao seito. Igo nageenda Bethlehemu o Yuda, na bono nkogeenda inde ase enyomba ya Nyasae. Onde tari bwanchire gonsoyia nyomba mwaye.

English: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him; and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;
Kiswahili: Naye Apolo alipotaka kwenda Akaya, ndugu wa Efeso walimtia moyo, wakawaandikia wanafunzi huko ili wamkaribishe. Alipofika huko, aliwasaidia sana wale ambao, kwa neema ya Mungu, walikuwa wameamini.
Ekegusii: Ekero arigia kwamboka enyancha gochia Akaya, abaminto bakamoremia, bakariikera aborokigwa b'aroro riruube bamoroisie. Ere gaikire aroro agakonya mono baria abegenete goetera ase obuya bwa Nyasae,

English: Then they dug another well and quarreled over that one also; so he named it Sitnah.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakachimba kisima kingine, lakini hata hicho pia wakakigombania, akakiita Sitna.
Ekegusii: Naende bakarema, bakanyora entuboka ende, nero bakayiomanera. Ase igo, akayeroka Sitina.

English: It will happen that when anyone still prophesies, then his father and his mother who bore him will tell him, ‘You must die, because you speak lies in Yahweh's name;' and his father and his mother who bore him will stab him when he prophesies.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa yupo yeyote atakayeendelea kutabiri, baba yake na mama yake waliomzaa watamwambia, ‘Ni lazima ufe, kwa sababu umesema uongo kwa jina la Bwana.' Atakapotabiri, wazazi wake mwenyewe watampasua tumbo.
Ekegusii: Nigo erabe ng'a omonto aise kooroka kobana, ng'ina na ise abwo bamoiborete bamoteebie, “Aye tokonyara koba moyo, ekiagera nigo okobana oborimo ase erieta ri'Omonene.” Ekero omonto oyio agendererete kobana, abaibori abwo baye mbamobete ritimo.

English: And he who swears by heaven swears by God’s throne and by the One who sits on it.
Kiswahili: Naye aapaye kwa mbingu, huapa kwa kiti cha enzi cha Mungu na kwa yeye aketiye juu ya kiti hicho.
Ekegusii: Na oyo orarie emuma ase igoro, nigo ararie ase ekerogo ki’obonene kia Nyasae na ase oria ogeikaranserete.

English: or in like manner, the six hundred thousand footmen who were gathered together in the hardness of their hearts.
Kiswahili: au vivyo hivyo, askari wa miguu mia sita elfu waliokuwa wamekusanyika pamoja katika ugumu wa mioyo yao.
Ekegusii: nonya omoganda oria bw'abasikari chielifu amagana atano narimo b'amagoro abwo basangererekanete ase aamo, bakaenenera Nyasae ase obwerori bwabo.

English: Every man has become brutish and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his engraved image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja ni mjinga na hana maarifa, kila sonara ameaibishwa na sanamu zake. Vinyago vyake ni vya udanganyifu, havina pumzi ndani yavyo.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto nigo are omoriri ase obong'aini bwaye, na kera omoturi nigo agosookigwa nemegwekano y'ogosasimwa aroisirie, ekiagera emegwekano yaye ney'obong'ainereria, tebwati omoika ime yabo.

English: The inhabitants of Samaria will be in terror for the calves of Beth Aven, for its people will mourn over it, along with its priests who rejoiced over it, for its glory, because it has departed from it.
Kiswahili: Watu wanaoishi Samaria huogopa kwa ajili ya sanamu ya ndama ya Beth-Aveni. Watu wake wataiombolezea, vivyo hivyo kuhani wake wa kuabudu sanamu, wale waliokuwa wamefurahia fahari yake, kwa sababu itaondolewa kutoka kwao kwenda uhamishoni.
Ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete Samaria mbatengechigwe ase engencho y'omogwekano bw'emori bagosasiima agwo Beti‐Aveni. Abwo bakoyosasiima mbarere, na abakuani baye mbeng'ererie, ekiagera obonene bwaye bwasirigwe.

English: Now in those days a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that a census should be taken of the whole empire.
Kiswahili: Siku zile Kaisari Augusto alitoa amri kwamba watu wote waandikishwe katika ulimwengu wa Kirumi.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria, ogochika gokarua ase Kaisari Augusto, ng’a omobaro bw’abaanto oriikwe ase ense yonsi.

English: Then Pilate asked Him, “Do You not hear how many charges they are bringing against You?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Pilato akamuuliza, “Je, husikii ni mambo mangapi wanayokushtaki nayo?”
Ekegusii: Erio Pilato akamoteebia, “Toigweti amang’ana aya amange bakona‐goteeba igoro yao?”

English: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.
Kiswahili: Nao wale Mungu aliotangulia kuwachagua, akawaita, wale aliowaita pia akawahesabia haki, nao wale aliowahesabia haki, pia akawatukuza.
Ekegusii: Na baria achorete korwa kare, abwo akabarangeria boigo; na baria arangeretie, abwo akabaa oboronge boigo; na baria aete oboronge akabaa obonene boigo.

English: Then the young man said to the angel, “Brother Azarias, I have heard that this maid has been given to seven men, and that they all perished in the bride-chamber.
Kiswahili: Kisha kijana akamwambia malaika, “Ndugu Azaria, nimesikia kwamba mjakazi huyu amepewa wanaume saba, na kwamba wote waliangamia katika chumba cha bibi harusi.”
Ekegusii: Tobia agateebia Rafaeli, “Inche naigure ayio abanyorete abasacha batano na babere abwo barigetie komonywoma Sara na buna kera oyomo akwete mobasokano ase rituko ri'enywuomo; kera oyomo nigo akwete magega batarara nere.

English: For we don't stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn't reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hatukuwa tunavuka mipaka katika kujisifu kwetu, kama vile ambavyo ingekuwa kama hatukuwa tumekuja kwenu. Kwa maana sisi ndio tuliokuwa wa kwanza kuja kwenu na Injili ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naki titori gwekinia intwe abanyene goetania ekerengo giaito buna ntotari kobaikera inwe. Naki intwe nabatang'ani tore b'okobarentera inwe enchiri ya Kristo.

English: Or it is like when a bird flies through the air, no evidence of its passage is found, but the light wind, lashed with the stroke of its pinions, and torn apart with the violent rush of the moving wings, is passed through. Afterwards no sign of its coming remains.
Kiswahili: Au ni kama ndege anaporuka angani, hakuna ushahidi wa kupita kwake unaopatikana, lakini upepo mwepesi, unaopigwa kwa mapigo ya mabawa yake, na kupasuka kwa mshindo mkali wa mabawa yanayotembea, hupitishwa. Baadaye hakuna dalili ya kuja kwake iliyobaki.
Ekegusii: Gose buna enyoni ekoiruruka ase embeo etari gotiga kemanyererio kende gionsi ase egoetera; ero nigo egoaka aka embeo inke inke ase chimbaba chiaye, ero nigo egoeta ase embeo korende teri gotiga kemanyererio ase yaetire.

English: The whole assembly who had returned from exile made booths and lived in them. From the days of Joshua son of Nun until that day, the Israelites had not celebrated like this. And there was great rejoicing.
Kiswahili: Jamii yote ya watu waliorudi kutoka utumwani wakajenga vibanda na kuishi ndani yake. Tangu wakati wa Yoshua mwana wa Nuni mpaka siku ile, Waisraeli hawakuwahi kuiadhimisha namna hii. Furaha yao ilikuwa kubwa sana.
Ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi bw’abaanto bairanete korwa ase obosomba bakaagacha ebigutu bamenye imeo, ekiagera korwa ase engaki ya Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, goika ase engaki eyio, Abaisraeli konya tibana gokora bo. Na bono bakaba nomogooko omonene.

English: God thunders wondrously with His voice; He does great things we cannot comprehend.
Kiswahili: Sauti ya Mungu hunguruma kwa namna za ajabu; yeye hutenda mambo makuu kupita ufahamu wetu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akogukura neriogi riaye ase enchera y’ogokumia mono, nigo agokora amang’ana amanene, ayio totanyare komanya.

English: So the disciples went and did as Jesus had directed them.
Kiswahili: Wale wanafunzi wakaenda, wakafanya kama Yesu alivyokuwa amewaagiza.
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa bakagenda, bagakora buna Yeso abachiigete.

English: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.
Kiswahili: Yeye ni mfano wa Mungu asiyeonekana, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa viumbe vyote.
Ekegusii: Kristo nomogwekano o Nyasae oyotari kororekana, omoiborwa bw'eritang'ani bw'ebitongwa bionsi.

English: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza kisibau cha dhahabu, na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na nyekundu na kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri.
Ekegusii: Bagakora egesibao ki'obokuani korwa ase chiusi chi'etaabu, na echi'amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi'egatani engiya chisisire.

English: I was glad when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”
Kiswahili: Nilishangilia pamoja na wale walioniambia, “Twende nyumbani ya Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Nigo nagogete na baria banteebetie, “Inchuo, togende ase enyomba y’Omonene!”

English: Regarding the gospel, they are enemies on your account; but regarding election, they are loved on account of the patriarchs.
Kiswahili: Kwa habari ya Injili, wao ni adui wa Mungu kwa ajili yenu, lakini kuhusu kule kuteuliwa kwao ni wapendwa, kwa ajili ya mababa zao wa zamani,
Ekegusii: Naboigo ase amanag’ana y’enchiri babeire ababisa ba Nyasae ase engencho yaino; korende ase ogochoorwa babeire abanchwa ase engencho ye chisokoro chiabo.

English: and his wife was given to one of the men who had accompanied him.
Kiswahili: Lakini huyo mke wa Samsoni akakabidhiwa kwa rafiki yake Samsoni ambaye alikuwa rafiki yake msaidizi siku ya arusi.
Ekegusii: Erio moga Samusoni akaegwa omonto oria orenge omong’wansi o Samusoni, akaba mokaaye.

English: Year after year Elkanah would go up from his city to worship and sacrifice to the LORD of Hosts at Shiloh, where Eli’s two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, were priests to the LORD.
Kiswahili: Kila mwaka mtu huyu alikwea kutoka mji wake ili kuabudu na kutoa dhabihu kwa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote huko Shilo, ambapo Hofni na Finehasi, wana wawili wa Eli, walikuwa makuhani wa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Kera omwaka omonto oyio nigo areenge gotiira korwa ase omochie oye, ogenda gosasiima na korua ebing’wanso ase Omonene bw’Emeganda agwo Silo. Aroro agwo Ofini na Finehasi, abamura babere ba Eli, nigo baarenge abakuani ba Omonene.

English: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!
Kiswahili: Midomo yangu itapaza sauti kwa furaha ninapokuimbia sifa, mimi, ambaye umenikomboa.
Ekegusii: Ning'ake eriogi rinene ri'omogooko nomonwa one, ekero ndabe ngotera amatera akogotogia. Nintere nomoyo one boigo, ekiagera aye gwantooririe.

English: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.
Kiswahili: unapandwa katika aibu, unafufuliwa katika utukufu, unapandwa katika udhaifu, unafufuliwa katika nguvu,
Ekegusii: Osimekwa ase obosooku, obokigwa ase obonene; osimekwa ase oboreu, obokigwa ase chinguru.

English: Now summon all Israel to meet me on Mount Carmel, along with the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred prophets of Asherah who eat at Jezebel’s table.”
Kiswahili: Sasa waite watu kutoka Israeli yote tukutane nao juu ya Mlima Karmeli. Nawe uwalete hao manabii wa Baali mia nne na hamsini na hao manabii mia nne wa Ashera, walao chakula mezani mwa Yezebeli.”
Ekegusii: Bono toma amang’ana, orangerie Abaisraeli bonsi, erinde baumerane nainche igoro ase egetunwa gia Karimeli. Orangerie na ababani ba Baali amagana ane, na emerongo etano, na ababani b’Asera, enyasae eria enkuungu, amagana ane, abwo bakoragera amo na Yesebeli.”

English: Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself. We also testify for him, and you know that our testimony is true. Conclusion (2 John 1:12–13)
Kiswahili: Kila mtu ameshuhudia mema kuhusu Demetrio, vivyo hivyo hata na hiyo kweli yenyewe. Sisi pia twashuhudia mema juu yake, nanyi mwajua kwamba ushuhuda wetu ni kweli. Salamu Za Mwisho
Ekegusii: Demeturio obereirwe kirori nabaanto bonsi, naende nekeene ekenyene, ng’a nomuya are. Na intwe boigo twarorire, na aye kwamanyire ng’a oborori bwaito nobw’ekeene. Amakwania ogokoorera

English: About ten days later, Yahweh struck Nabal, so that he died.
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku kumi, Bwana akampiga Nabali, naye akafa.
Ekegusii: Naende magega y'amatuko ikomi kaerire Omonene agaaka Nabali, na ere agakwa.

English: Samuel died; and all Israel gathered themselves together and mourned for him, and buried him at his house at Ramah. Then David arose and went down to the wilderness of Paran.
Kiswahili: Basi Samweli akafa, nao Israeli wote wakakusanyika na kumwombolezea; wakamzika nyumbani kwake huko Rama. Kisha Daudi akateremka kwenye Jangwa la Maoni.
Ekegusii: Samweli agakwa, na Abaisraeli bagasangererekana, bakagenda komoreera; bakamotindeka ase enka yaye agwo Rama. Erio Daudi akaimoka, agatirimboka gochia ase erooro ya Parani.

English: When Israel had finished killing all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness in which they pursued them, and they had all fallen by the edge of the sword until they were consumed, all Israel returned to Ai and struck it with the edge of the sword.
Kiswahili: Israeli ilipomaliza kuwaua wanaume wote wa Ai katika mashamba na jangwani walipokuwa wamewafukuzia, na baada ya kila mmoja wao kuuawa kwa upanga, Waisraeli wote wakarudi Ai na kuwaua wale waliokuwa wamebakia mjini.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bakoorire goita abanto bonsi ba Ai abarenge agwo aase aarabu, na ase erooro, ase baabaseretie gochia, bakairana Ai, bagaita nemioro bonsi abarenge aroro.

English: And Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called upon the name of the LORD, the Eternal God.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akapanda mti wa mkwaju huko Beer-Sheba, na hapo akaliitia jina la Bwana, Mungu wa milele.
Ekegusii: Aburaamu agasimeka omote onga buna ekerachuoki aria Beeri‐Seba, na agwo akarangeria erieta ria Nyasae Omonene o kare na kare ase okomosasiima.

English: Indeed, I waited while you spoke; I listened to your reasoning; as you searched for words,
Kiswahili: Nilingojea mlipokuwa mnaongea, nilizisikiliza hoja zenu; mlipokuwa mkitafuta maneno ya kusema,
Ekegusii: Naama! Nigo nategererete mono ekero mwarenge gokwana; nkaba ndemereretie koigwa chinkwana chiaino chi’obong’aini, ekero mwarenge koriga‐rigia ng’a mang’ana ki mwagwenerete gokwana.

English: All the tribes which fell away together sacrificed to the heifer Baal, and so did the house of Naphtali my father.
Kiswahili: Makabila yote yaliyoanguka pamoja yalimtolea dhabihu Baali, na nyumba ya Naftali baba yangu walifanya vivyo hivyo.
Ekegusii: Abaminto bonsi negesaku kia Nafutali bakarwera emori eria omorwoti Jeroboam o Israeli atenenetie aria ase omochie o Dan ase egetunwa kia Galili.

English: I have waited for your salvation, Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Ee Bwana, nautafuta wokovu wako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ninganyete ogotooreka kwao nogosemeria!

English: So Peter got up and went with them. On his arrival, they took him to the upper room. All the widows stood around him, weeping and showing him the tunics and other clothing that Dorcas had made while she was still with them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Petro akainuka akaenda nao, naye alipowasili, wakampeleka hadi kwenye chumba cha ghorofani alipokuwa amelazwa. Wajane wengi walisimama karibu naye wakilia na kuonyesha majoho na nguo nyingine ambazo Dorkasi alikuwa amewashonea alipokuwa pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Petero akaimoka, akagenda amo nabarabwo. Ekero aikire aroro, bakamoira akanyomba ka irongo. Ababoraka bonsi bagatenena ang’e nere bakorera, na komworokia chiganchwa ne chianga echi Dorika arenge koroisia ekero arenge amo nabarabwo.

English: If a boy can be circumcised on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses will not be broken, why are you angry with Me for making the whole man well on the Sabbath?
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtoto aweza kutahiriwa siku ya Sabato kusudi sheria ya Mose isivunjwe, kwa nini mnanikasirikia kwa kumponya mtu mwili wake wote siku ya Sabato?
Ekegusii: Gaki onye omonto okwarokigwa rituko ri’Esabato, erinde amachiiko a Musa tasareka; naki mokombea ekiagera nakora omobere bwonsi bw’omonto koba omogima kegima rituko ri’Esabato?

English: This is the revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His servants what must soon come to pass. He made it known by sending His angel to His servant John,
Kiswahili: Ufunuo wa Yesu Kristo aliopewa na Mungu ili awaonyeshe watumishi wake mambo ambayo ni lazima yatukie hivi karibuni. Alijulisha mambo haya kwa kumtuma malaika wake kwa Yohana mtumishi wake,
Ekegusii: Oko nokomaanoka kwa Yeso Kristo oko Nyasae amoete, erinde arokie abasomba baye amang’ana agwenerete gocha gokoreka bwango. Ase ogotoma omomalaika oye akoorokia omosomba oye Yohana,

English: Is this your jubilant city, whose origin is from antiquity, whose feet have taken her to settle far away?
Kiswahili: Je, huu ndio mji wenu uliojaa sherehe, mji wa zamani, zamani kabisa ambao miguu yake imeuchukua kufanya makao nchi za mbali sana?
Ekegusii: Inee! Oyo nomochie oria oino oichire nomogooko, omochie oyio oagachetwe ase chingaki chia kare, oyio amagoro ’abaanto baye abogoretie gochia komenya ase chinse chi’aare?

English: Esau said to his father, “Do you have only one blessing, my father? Bless me too, O my father!” Then Esau wept aloud.
Kiswahili: Esau akamwambia baba yake, “Je, baba yangu una baraka moja tu? Unibariki mimi pia, baba yangu!” Kisha Esau akalia kwa sauti kubwa.
Ekegusii: Esau akabooria ise: “Ogosesenia nokomo gwoka kwabwate, Tata? Nsesenia nainche boigo, Tata ominto.” Esau agaaka egakuura, na akarera nobororo.

English: Though his hatred is concealed by deception, his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.
Kiswahili: Nia yake ya kudhuru wengine inaweza kufichwa na udanganyifu, lakini uovu wake utafichuliwa kwenye kusanyiko.
Ekegusii: Naisa gotuba okogecha kwaye nobong’ainereria, obokayayu bwaye goika bomanyekane n’omosangererekano bwonsi.

English: “Go back and tell Hezekiah the leader of My people that this is what the LORD, the God of your father David, says: ‘I have heard your prayer; I have seen your tears. I will surely heal you. On the third day from now you will go up to the house of the LORD.
Kiswahili: “Rudi ukamwambie Hezekia, kiongozi wa watu wangu, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, Mungu wa baba yako Daudi: Nimeyasikia maombi yako na nimeona machozi yako; nitakuponya. Siku ya tatu kuanzia sasa utapanda kwenda Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Irana oteebie Hezekia, omoraai bw’abaanto baane, ng’a inche Omonene, Nyasae o Daudi, sokoro yaye, nigo ngoteeba iga: Naigure ogosaba kwao, narorire amariga ao. Rora, ninkogwenie. Rituko ria gatato notiire ogende ase enyomba yane, inche Omonene.

English: And now God sent me to heal you and Sarah your daughter-in-law.
Kiswahili: Na sasa Mungu alinituma nikuponye wewe na Sara mkwe wako.
Ekegusii: Boigo nere ontomete 'nchiche gokogwenia boigo na gokonya moka momura oo Sara.

English: I will also water the land in which you swim with your blood, even to the mountains. The watercourses will be full of you.
Kiswahili: Nitailowanisha nchi kwa damu yako inayotiririka njia yote hadi milimani, nayo mabonde yatajazwa na nyama yako.
Ekegusii: Ninyonsie ense nemegoko y'amanyinga ao, aichore aike ase ebitunwa igoro, ne chindooche chiichorwe naro.

English: Then he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy rooms for the priests, which looked toward the north. Behold, there was a place on the back part westward.
Kiswahili: Kisha mtu yule akanileta kwa kupitia kwenye ingilio lililokuwa kando ya lango mpaka kwenye vyumba vitakatifu vinavyoelekea kaskazini, ambavyo ni vya makuhani, naye akanionyesha mahali fulani upande wa mwisho wa magharibi.
Ekegusii: Erio omonto oria akang'eteria ase egesoero kiarenge ang'e negeita, agansoyia ase ebinyomba ebichenu bi'abakuani biarenge sugusu, nkarora aase aria korwa magega, ensemo ya bosongo.

English: But let your ‘Yes' be ‘Yes' and your ‘No' be ‘No.' Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.
Kiswahili: ‘Ndiyo' yenu iwe ‘Ndiyo,' na ‘Hapana' yenu iwe ‘Hapana.' Lolote zaidi ya hili latoka kwa yule mwovu.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana aino abe: Ee, gose: Yaaya; naki ayakomenteka ase aya, nigo akorwa ase oria omobe.

English: This is the burden of the word of the LORD against the land of Hadrach and Damascus its resting place— for the eyes of men and of all the tribes of Israel are upon the LORD —
Kiswahili: Neno: Neno la Bwana liko kinyume na nchi ya Hadraki na Dameski itakuwa mahali pa kupumzika, kwa kuwa macho ya watu na ya kabila zote za Israeli yako kwa Bwana,
Ekegusii: Eri nering’ana rikong’u riakwanetwe n’Omonene igoro y’ense ya Hadaraki, riikere nonya nomochie o Damesiki. Amaiso ’abaanto b’ebisaku amo nay’Abaisraeli nigo arigereretie Omonene.

English: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.
Kiswahili: Mawingu yalimwaga maji, mbingu zikatoa ngurumo kwa radi, mishale yako ikametameta huku na huko.
Ekegusii: Amare agaitera amaache; ne chinkoba chigaaka korwa igoro, chinsara chiao chikamesa ase chinsemo chionsi.

English: Under the authority of Pharaoh, let them collect all the excess food from these good years, that they may come and lay up the grain to be preserved as food in the cities.
Kiswahili: Wakusanye chakula chote katika miaka hii saba ya neema inayokuja na kuhifadhi nafaka chini ya mamlaka ya Farao, iwe akiba ya chakula katika miji.
Ekegusii: Tiga basangererie endagera eye yonsi y’emiaka eye emiya egocha, bayebeke erendwe ase emechie, ase okobua gwa Farao.

English: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans. This people didn't exist. The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness. They set up their towers. They overthrew its palaces. They made it a ruin.
Kiswahili: Tazama katika nchi ya Wakaldayo, watu hawa ambao sasa hawaonekani kama wapo! Waashuru wameifanya nchi hiyo kuwa mahali pa viumbe wa jangwani. Wamesimamisha minara yao ya vita kuuzunguka, wameziteka ngome zake na kuziacha tupu na kuufanya kuwa magofu.
Ekegusii: Rigereria ense y'Abakalidayo! Abanto aba tibaarenge egesaku. Abaasuri nabwo barentete ching'iti chi'orosana komenya aroro. Abwo bakaagacha chindwaki chi'okoboera, bakaonchorana chinyomba chi'obogaambi. Chi'omochie oyio, bakayotagora okaba etui.

English: When John's messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?
Kiswahili: Wajumbe wa Yohana walipoondoka, Yesu akaanza kusema na makutano kuhusu Yohana Mbatizaji. Akawauliza, “Mlipokwenda kule nyikani, mlikwenda kuona nini? Je, ni unyasi ukipeperushwa na upepo?
Ekegusii: Na abatomwa baria ba Yohana bachia kogenda, agachaaka goteebia omoganda igoro ya Yohana, “Inki mwachiete korora aria ase erooro? Egetonto gekonyegerigwa nembeo?

English: Let's oppress the righteous poor. Let's not spare the widow, nor regard the gray hair of the old man.
Kiswahili: Tuwaonee maskini wenye haki. Tusiwahurumie wajane, wala tusiwajali wazee wenye mvi.
Ekegusii: Omotaka naba omuya goika tomochande, boigo titokororera ababoraka amaabera gose gosika omogaka obwate chimbuche.

English: Issachar will have one portion bordering the territory of Simeon from east to west.
Kiswahili: “Isakari atakuwa na sehemu moja, itakayopakana na nchi ya Simeoni kuanzia mashariki hadi magharibi.
Ekegusii: Egesaku kia Isakaru keegwe orogongo rw’aye robebekane norwa Simioni korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.

English: so that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.
Kiswahili: ili wote wamheshimu Mwana kama vile wanavyomheshimu Baba. Yeyote asiyemheshimu Mwana, hamheshimu Baba aliyemtuma.
Ekegusii: erinde bonsi basike Omwana buna basigete Tata. Oyotasigeti Omwana tasigeti Tata oyo omotomete.

English: Judith dedicated all Holofernes' stuff, which the people had given her, and gave the canopy, which she had taken for herself out of his bedchamber, for a gift to the Lord.
Kiswahili: Yudithi aliweka wakfu vitu vyote vya Holoferne, ambavyo watu walikuwa wamempa, na akatoa dari, ambayo alikuwa ameichukua kutoka chumbani mwake, kama zawadi kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Bionsi ebio biarenge ebia Holoferne ebio abanto bamoete Yuditi, amo nekibisio abogoretie ere omonyene korwa ase oborere bwa Holoferne, Yuditi akabirwa koba okoruugwa ogochenu ase Nyasae

English: The priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh for his discharge.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atavitoa dhabihu, mmoja kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi na huyo mwingine kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Kwa njia hii atafanya upatanisho mbele za Bwana kwa ajili ya huyo mtu kwa sababu ya kutokwa usaha kwake.
Ekegusii: Omokuani arue erimo ribe ekeng'wanso ki'ebibe, na erinde ribe ekeng'wanso ki'ogosaambwa. Ase enchera eyio akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria ase obosio bwane, ase engencho y'okorua kwaye kw'amaache anga buna chimengere.

English: The slacker says, “A lion is in the road! A fierce lion roams the public square!”
Kiswahili: Mvivu husema, “Yuko simba barabarani, simba mkali anazunguka mitaa!”
Ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo agoteeba, “Endo nere isiko, ee, endo nere ase chiinchera chi’omochie.”

English: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.
Kiswahili: Kila mara Mungu alipowaua baadhi yao, waliosalia walimtafuta, walimgeukia tena kwa shauku.
Ekegusii: Ekero aitete abanto abatigari nigo bamorigetie; nigo baonchogete, bakamorigia ase ekeene.

English: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”
Kiswahili: Mvua ikanyesha, mafuriko yakaja, nao upepo ukavuma ukaipiga hiyo nyumba, nayo ikaanguka kwa kishindo kikubwa.”
Ekegusii: embura egatwa amo nomwaga, na eooro egaacha, bigatwoma enyomba eria, ekagwa; okogwa kwaye gokaba okonene.”

English: (for Solomon had made a bronze platform, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high, and had set it in the middle of the court; and he stood on it, and knelt down on his knees before all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven).
Kiswahili: Basi Solomoni alikuwa ametengeneza jukwaa la shaba, urefu wake dhiraa tano, na upana wake dhiraa tano na kimo chake dhiraa tatu, naye akaliweka katikati ya ukumbi wa nje. Akapanda juu ya hilo jukwaa kisha akapiga magoti mbele ya kusanyiko lote la Israeli, akanyoosha mikono yake kwelekea mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Sulemani konya oroisirie egetenenero korwa ase etai; obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw'amaboko atano, na obogare bwaye amaboko atano, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko atano, na konya okebekire gati y'eraaro enene; agatenena igoro ase kerokio. Erio agatung'ama namaru aye bosio bw'omosangererekano bwonsi bw'Abaisraeli, akarambora amaboko aye gochia igoro,

English: You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be to you most holy.
Kiswahili: Saga baadhi yake kuwa unga na uweke mbele ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda ndani ya Hema la Kukutania, mahali ambapo nitakutana nawe. Itakuwa takatifu sana kwenu.
Ekegusii: Orusie bike, erio obiswage bibe obosie. Obeke boke bosio bw'Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, ase Eema y'Omosangererekano, aase ndaumerane naye. Amanukato ayio abe amaachenu mono ase more.

English: the territory from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;
Kiswahili: na kuanzia Heshboni mpaka Ramath-Mispa na Betonimu, na kutoka Mahanaimu hadi eneo la Debiri;
Ekegusii: na ense korwa Hesiboni goika Ramati‐Misipa na Betonimu, na korwa Mahanaimu goika orobebe rwa Debiri.

English: In those days there was no king in Israel; everyone did what was right in his own eyes.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hizo Israeli hawakuwa na mfalme, kila mmoja akafanya kama alivyoona vyema machoni pake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria omorwoti tarenge ase Abaisraeli; kera omonto nigo arenge gokora kende gionsi arooche kere ekeronge aase okorora kwaye ere omonyene.

English: They served in the days of Joiakim son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and Ezra the priest and scribe. The Dedication of the Wall
Kiswahili: Walihudumu siku za Yoyakimu mwana wa Yeshua, mwana wa Yosadaki, na katika siku za mtawala Nehemia, na za Ezra kuhani na mwandishi. Kuwekwa Wakfu Ukuta Wa Yerusalemu
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo barengeo ase amatuko a Yoyakimu, mosinto o Yesua o Yosadaki, na ase amatuko a Nehemia omogabana, na ay’Ezara, oyorenge Omokuani na omworokia bw’amariko. Nehemia ogwatanana na gochena orwaki rw’Omochie

English: But Jesus looked directly at them and said, “Then what is the meaning of that which is written: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone’?
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akawakazia macho, akasema, “Basi ni nini maana ya yale yaliyoandikwa: “ ‘Jiwe walilolikataa waashi, limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni’?
Ekegusii: Akabarigereria, akabora, Engencho yaye ninki, ring’ana eri ririikeire: Rigena abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona?

English: Then Mordecai said to Hathach, “Go, and say to her, ‘Esther, don't say to yourself that you alone will escape in the kingdom, more than all the other Jews.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mordekai akamwambia Hathaki, “Nenda, umwambie, ‘Esta, usijisemee kwamba wewe peke yako utaokoka katika ufalme, zaidi ya Wayahudi wengine wote.
Ekegusii: Esiteri agakwana na Hataki, akamoteebia airane ase Modekai, amoteebie,

English: Seek good, not evil, so that you may live. And the LORD, the God of Hosts, will be with you, as you have claimed.
Kiswahili: Tafuteni mema, wala si mabaya, ili mpate kuishi. Ndipo Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote atakuwa pamoja nanyi, kama msemavyo yupo nanyi.
Ekegusii: Rigia ayare amaya, na tari ayare amabe, erio nario morabe moyo. Komorakore bo, Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nabe amo nainwe, buna inwe mwatebiire.

English: A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the Temple. By David. I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
Kiswahili: Utenzi wa kuweka wakfu hekalu. Zaburi ya Daudi. Nitakutukuza wewe, Ee Bwana, kwa kuwa umeniinua kutoka vilindi, na hukuacha adui zangu washangilie juu yangu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi ekero aatananete Hekalu ekaba enchenu) Aye Omonene, ningotogie, ekiagera kwanyimokirie korwa inse, tigwatigete ababisa baane betogie igoro yane.

English: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;
Kiswahili: kwa Waefraimu: Hoshea mwana wa Azazia; kwa nusu ya kabila la Manase: Yoeli mwana wa Pedaya;
Ekegusii: Hosea, mosinto bw'Asasia, ase Abaefraimu; Yoel, mosinto o Pedaya, ase ekeng'ese kende ki'egesaku kia Manase;

English: Now Abram’s wife Sarai had borne him no children, but she had an Egyptian maidservant named Hagar.
Kiswahili: Basi Sarai, mkewe Abramu, alikuwa hajamzalia watoto. Lakini alikuwa na mtumishi wa kike Mmisri jina lake Hagari,
Ekegusii: Bono Sarai, moka Aburamu, tamoiborerete bana. Sarai nareenge nomoiseke omosomba Omomisiri, ore korokwa Hagari.

English: The priest is to examine him, and if the swelling of the infection on his bald head or forehead is reddish-white like a skin disease,
Kiswahili: Kuhani atamchunguza, na kama kidonda kilichovimba juu ya kichwa chake au kwenye paji la uso ni chekundu au cheupe kama ugonjwa wa ngozi wa kuambukiza,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, Omokuani karamorenge arore ng’a egesambo kebimbete ase risio riria, magega gose bosio, kere nobobariri na oborabu, na nigo gekororekana buna oborwaire bwa ukoma mbore ase risankwa ri’omobere,

English: As Jesus drew near to Jericho, a blind man was sitting beside the road, begging.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa anakaribia Yeriko, kipofu mmoja alikuwa ameketi kando ya njia akiomba msaada.
Ekegusii: Ekero achia goika ang’e na Yeriko omonto oyomo omouko naikaransete enchera ensemo ogosaba ebiegwa.

English: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it. Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakagawanya nchi waliyokusudia kutafuta majani, Ahabu akaenda upande mmoja na Obadia upande mwingine.
Ekegusii: Erio bagaatanana ense eria ase egati yabo, bayetaare. Ahabu akagenda ensemo eyemo ere bweka, na Obadia ensemo ende ere bweka.

English: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says.' He who hears, let him hear; and he who refuses, let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.”
Kiswahili: Lakini nitakaposema nawe, nitafungua kinywa chako nawe utawaambia, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo.' Yeyote atakayesikiliza na asikilize, na yeyote atakayekataa na akatae; kwa kuwa wao ni nyumba ya kuasi.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero 'ndakwane naye, nimaanore omonwa oo, na aye obateebie iga: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba; Omonto oganetie koigwera, tiga aigwere, na oyo otaganeti koigwera, tiga aange, ekiagera barabwo negesaku getari koigwera.

English: So Solomon’s and Hiram’s builders, along with the Gebalites, quarried the stone and prepared the timber and stone for the construction of the temple.
Kiswahili: Mafundi wa Solomoni, wa Hiramu na watu wa Gebali walikata na kuandaa mbao na mawe kwa ajili ya ujenzi wa Hekalu.
Ekegusii: Naboigo abaagachi ba Sulemani, na aba Hiramu amo nabaanto b’omochie o Gebali bagakora emeremo y’okobaacha na gosenia amagena na koroisia chibao ase oboagacho boria.

English: Who may ascend to Yahweh's hill? Who may stand in his holy place?
Kiswahili: Nani awezaye kuupanda mlima wa Bwana? Ni nani awezaye kusimama patakatifu pake?
Ekegusii: Ning'o oragwenere gotiira ase egetunwa kia Omonene? Ning'o oragwenere gotenena aase aye aachenu?

English: The voice of one saying, “Cry out!” One said, “What shall I cry?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory is like the flower of the field.
Kiswahili: Sauti husema, “Piga kelele.” Nami nikasema, “Nipige kelele gani?” “Wanadamu wote ni kama majani, nao utukufu wao wote ni kama maua ya kondeni.
Ekegusii: Eriogi rigoteeba, “Raria amang'ana!” Na erinde rikoboria, “Mang'ana ki nkoraria?” “Raria ng'a Mwanyabaanto bonsi nigo banga buna obonyansi, obuya bwabo bwonsi nigo bonga egesicha kere mogondo.

English: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.
Kiswahili: Baada ya zile ghasia kumalizika, Paulo aliwaita wanafunzi pamoja akawatia moyo, akawaaga, akaanza safari kwenda Makedonia.
Ekegusii: Eburu‐buru eria egachia koera, Paulo akarangeria aborokigwa, akabaremia, agatigana nabarabwo, akaimoka akagenda Makedonia.

English: And the sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up to prepare the way for the kings of the East.
Kiswahili: Malaika wa sita akamimina bakuli lake kwenye mto mkubwa Frati, maji yake yakakauka ili kutayarisha njia kwa ajili ya wafalme watokao Mashariki.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika o gatano na rimo agaitera egetaabo kiaye igoro ase orooche roria oronene rokorokwa Eufarati, na amaache aye agakama. Erio enchera ekaroiserigwa abarwoti bakorwa moocha bagoetera.

English: In those days there was no king in Israel, and the tribe of the Danites was looking for territory to occupy. For up to that time they had not come into an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hizo Israeli walikuwa hawana mfalme. Katika siku hizo kabila la Wadani walikuwa wanatafuta mahali pao wenyewe pa kuishi, kwa sababu walikuwa hawajafika kwenye urithi wao miongoni mwa makabila ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria omorwoti tarenge ase Abaisraeli; na ase engaki eria abanto b’egesaku gia Dani nigo kiarenge kwerigeria orogongo ase keranyare komenya, ekiagera goika ase engaki eria konya tikeranyora omwando ase egati y’ebisaku binde bi’Abaisraeli.

English: Then he must take off his garments, put on other clothes, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a ceremonially clean place.
Kiswahili: Kisha atayavua mavazi haya na kuvaa mengine, naye achukue yale majivu nje ya kambi na kuyapeleka mahali palipo safi kwa kawaida ya ibada.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio arusie chianga chiaye, abeeke chianga ching’ao, naende aimokie ribu, arisokie isiko y’egetwori, ariire gochia aase achenire.

English: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.
Kiswahili: Walipokwisha kuwasha moto katikati ya ua na kuketi pamoja, Petro naye akaketi pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Bagachia gouta omorero egati y'egoora, bagaikaransa amo, na Petero agaikaransa ase egati yabo.

English: For the entrance of the inner sanctuary, he made doors of olive wood. The lintel and door posts were a fifth part of the wall.
Kiswahili: Kwa ingilio la Patakatifu pa Patakatifu akatengeneza milango ya mbao za mzeituni, zikiwa na miimo na vizingiti vyenye umbo la pembe tano.
Ekegusii: Ebisieri bibere bikaroisigwa korwa ase chibao chi'emezeituni bikabekwa ase egesoero gi'akanyomba ka ime. Emetobwa nigo yatenenirie ensemo eyemo ya isano y'enyasi.

English: He who plants and he who waters are one in purpose, and each will be rewarded according to his own labor.
Kiswahili: Apandaye mbegu ana lengo sawa na yule atiaye maji na kila mmoja atalipwa kulingana na kazi yake.
Ekegusii: Naboigo oyogosimeka, na oyokobeeka amaache nigo bareng’anetie; na kera omonto nanyore eng’eria yaye koreng’ana buna emeremo yaye ere.

English: While Peter was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice from the cloud said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to Him!”
Kiswahili: Petro alipokuwa angali ananena, ghafula wingu lililongʼaa likawafunika, na sauti ikatoka kwenye hilo wingu ikisema, “Huyu ni Mwanangu mpendwa. Ninapendezwa naye sana. Msikieni yeye.”
Ekegusii: Ekero arenge gokwana, rora, riire rirabu rikababisia, na eriogi rikarwa ase riire riria, rigateba, “Oyo n’Omwana one omwanchwa, ngokirie nere; moigwere ere.”

English: He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,
Kiswahili: Kisha yule malaika akanionyesha mto wa maji ya uzima, maangavu kama kioo yakitiririka kutoka kwenye kile kiti cha enzi cha Mungu na cha Mwana-Kondoo,
Ekegusii: Erio omomalaika oria akanyorokia orooche rw'amaache 'obogima rokomeka‐meka buna ekerore gekomeka‐meka, rokorua ase ekerogo ki'obonene kia Nyasae na eki'Emanwa y'Eng'ondi,

English: They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of Yahweh, as the waters cover the sea.
Kiswahili: Hawatadhuru wala kuharibu juu ya mlima wangu mtakatifu wote, kwa kuwa dunia itajawa na kumjua Bwana kama maji yajazavyo bahari.
Ekegusii: Aase onsi ase egetunwa kiane egechenu, ayare amabe, gose ayagosiria tagokorekana aroro; ekiagera ense neichorwe nabaanto bamomanyete Omonene, buna amaache aichire ase enyancha.

English: The thrice-accursed Nicanor, who had brought the thousand merchants to buy the Jews as slaves,
Kiswahili: Nikanori aliyelaaniwa mara tatu, ambaye aliwaleta wafanyabiashara elfu moja kuwanunua Wayahudi kama watumwa,
Ekegusii: Nikanori omosaria oria oyio orentete abakori ebiasara 1,000 erio kogora Abayahudi,

English: So the king said, “Go and see where he is, that I may send men to capture him.” On receiving the report, “Elisha is in Dothan,”
Kiswahili: Mfalme akaagiza akisema, “Nendeni, mkatafute aliko, ili niweze kutuma watu kumkamata.” Taarifa ikarudi kwamba, “Yuko Dothani.”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti agateeba: “Genda morigie aase amenyete, erio ntome abanto bamobwate.” Bakamoteebia ng’a naaria Dotani amenyete.

English: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number of people believed and turned to the Lord.
Kiswahili: Mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa pamoja nao, nayo idadi kubwa ya watu wakaamini na kumgeukia Bwana.
Ekegusii: Okoboko kw’Omonene nigo kwarenge amo nabarabwo; abanto abange bakamwege n’Omonene, na komoonchokera.

English: Do not be too quick in the laying on of hands and thereby share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.
Kiswahili: Usiwe na haraka kumwekea mtu mikono wala usishiriki dhambi za watu wengine. Jilinde nafsi yako uwe safi.
Ekegusii: Tobekera omonto amaboko bwango, gose tosanga nebibe bi’abaanto bande. Bwerende aye omonyene, obe omochenu.

English: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
Kiswahili: Bwana yu karibu na waliovunjika moyo, na huwaokoa waliopondeka roho.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are ang'e nabwo chinkoro chiabo chiabunekire, nigo akobatooria abwo berusirie moyo.

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: “Sema na Waisraeli uwaambie: ‘Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: “Teebia Abaisraeli ng'a nateebire iga: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.

English: Indeed, I won't travel with consuming envy, because envy will have no fellowship with wisdom.
Kiswahili: Hakika, sitasafiri na wivu mwingi, kwa sababu wivu hautakuwa na ushirika na hekima.
Ekegusii: Endamwamu embe tekoba mogisangio one, ekiagera obongaini tibori kogenda amo n'endamwamu.

English: But when Moses went in before Yahweh to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel that which he was commanded.
Kiswahili: Lakini kila wakati Mose alipoingia mbele za Bwana kuzungumza naye, aliondoa ule utaji mpaka alipotoka nje. Naye alipotoka nje na kuwaambia Waisraeli lile ambalo ameagizwa,
Ekegusii: Ekero kende gionsi Musa are gosoa eema ase obosio bw'Omonene gokwana nere, nigo are korusia egietubo goika osoka korwa aroro. Ekero asokire aba ogoteebia Abaisraeli amang'ana onsi aya achikirwe gokwana,

English: When you are in oppression, and all these things have come on you, in the latter days you shall return to Yahweh your God and listen to his voice.
Kiswahili: Wakati mnapokuwa katika dhiki, nayo mambo haya yote yamewatokea siku hizo, ndipo mtamrudia Bwana Mungu wenu na kumtii.
Ekegusii: Ekero moraabe n'emechando, na ayio onsi arabanyoore ase amatuko agochia goocha, imomoiranere Omonene Nyasae oino, naende moigwere eriogi riaye.

English: So there are to be eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo itakuwepo mihimili minane, na vitako kumi na sita vya fedha, viwili chini ya kila mhimili.
Ekegusii: Chibao chionsi nigo chirabe isano na isato, ne chinterekerero chiabo chi’echifeta ikomi na isano nemo, ibere ibere inse ya kera ebao.

English: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
Kiswahili: (Lakini Geshuri na Aramu wakateka miji ya Hawoth-Yairi, pamoja na Kenathi na viunga vyake; jumla ilikuwa miji sitini.) Wote hawa walikuwa wazao wa Makiri babaye Gileadi.
Ekegusii: Korende Abagesuri na Abaaramu bakaira korwa asare emechie etano nomo (6), emechie ya Yairi na Kenati amo nebichie biaetanaineo. Abanto bonsi bamenyeteo nigo barenge b'ororeria rwa Makiri ise Gileadi,

English: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.
Kiswahili: Sifa apewe Bwana, Mungu Mwokozi wetu, ambaye siku kwa siku hutuchukulia mizigo yetu.
Ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe, rituko ase rituko nigo agotobogoreria chigurube chiaito. Nyasae nere ogotooreka gwaito.

English: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.
Kiswahili: Kwa njia hii watajiwekea hazina kama msingi kwa ajili ya wakati ujao na hivyo watajipatia uzima, yaani, ule uzima ambao ni wa kweli.
Ekegusii: beagacheire abanyene oboroso obuya ase ekero kegochia-gocha erinde babwate obogima obore obogima bw'ekeene.

English: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can't save himself.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, viongozi wa makuhani pamoja na walimu wa sheria wakamdhihaki miongoni mwao wakisema, “Aliwaokoa wengine, lakini hawezi kujiokoa mwenyewe!
Ekegusii: Naboigo nabakuani abanene bakamosekereria barabwo ase barabwo, amo naborokia b'amariiko, bagateeba, “Natooretie abande, ere omonyene takonyara gwetooria.

English: But Peter kept on knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were astounded.
Kiswahili: Lakini Petro aliendelea kugonga langoni, nao walipofungua lango na kumwona Petro, walistaajabu sana.
Ekegusii: Petero akagenderera gokong’onta egesieri. Erio bakamoigorera, bakamorora, bagakumia.

English: Let his eyes see his own destruction; let him drink for himself the wrath of the Almighty.
Kiswahili: Macho yake mwenyewe na yaone maangamizi yake; yeye na ainywe ghadhabu ya Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Tiga barore ogosirigwa kwabo namaiso abo, naende banyoosigwe endamwamu y’Omonguru.

English: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father.
Kiswahili: Je, shomoro wawili hawauzwi kwa senti moja tu? Lakini hakuna hata mmoja wao atakayeanguka chini pasipo Baba yenu kujua.
Ekegusii: Inee! Chinchiro ibere tichiri koonigwa ase ebesa eyemo? Naende nonya nakamo kabo tigakogwa inse, Iso oino atancheti.

English: If I have written well and to the point in my story, this is what I myself desired; but if its poorly done and mediocre, this is the best I could do.
Kiswahili: Kama nimeandika vizuri na kwa uhakika katika hadithi yangu, hivi ndivyo nilivyotamani mimi mwenyewe; lakini kama imefanywa vibaya na si ya kawaida, hii ndiyo bora zaidi ningeweza kufanya.
Ekegusii: Onye orikire buya na ase omoroberio, nagokire; korende onye orikire bobe atabwati moroberio, nabo nanyarete goikera agwo.

English: You shall eat it within your gates. The unclean and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle and as the deer.
Kiswahili: Itawapasa kumla ninyi wenyewe katika miji yenu. Wote wasio safi na walio safi kwa desturi za kiibada mwaweza kula kama vile mnavyokula paa au kulungu.
Ekegusii: Chinyama chie ching'iti buna echio mochiriere agwo ase emechie yaino. Abanto bonsi onye bare abatachenegeti, gose bachenegete, 'nabachirie. Nabo morachirie buna mokoria chinyama chie chingabi gose echie chinsune.

English: A miser is evil. He turns away and disregards souls.
Kiswahili: Bakhili ni mwovu. Hugeuka na kupuuza roho.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore n'endamwamu oyio n'omoriri; nigo akorigereria 'nse ase ogosiereria abande,

English: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Tuzichunguze njia zetu na kuzijaribu, na tumrudie Bwana Mungu.
Ekegusii: Tiga twetuke intwe abanyene na toteeme chinchera chiaito, erio tomoiranere Omonene!

English: Then the angel showed me a river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb
Kiswahili: Kisha yule malaika akanionyesha mto wa maji ya uzima, maangavu kama kioo yakitiririka kutoka kwenye kile kiti cha enzi cha Mungu na cha Mwana-Kondoo,
Ekegusii: Erio omomalaika oria akanyorokia orooche rw’amaache ’obogima rokomeka‐meka buna ekerore gekomeka‐meka, rokorua ase ekerogo ki’obonene kia Nyasae na eki’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi,

English: When the Ammonites realized that they had become a stench to David, they hired twenty thousand Aramean foot soldiers from Beth-rehob and Zoba, as well as a thousand men from the king of Maacah and twelve thousand men from Tob.
Kiswahili: Waamoni walipotambua kuwa wamekuwa machukizo kwa Daudi, wakaajiri askari wa miguu 20,000 Waaramu kutoka Beth-Rehobu na Soba, pia mfalme wa Maaka pamoja na watu 1,000, na vilevile watu 12,000 kutoka Tobu.
Ekegusii: Abaamoni bakamanya ng’a bagechirie Daudi. Ase igo bagasaba Abasiiria ba Beti‐Rehobu na Soba baabae abarwani babo chilifu emerongo ebere (20,000), na omorwoti o Maaka ache amo nabarwani baye elifu eyemo (1,000); naende bagasaba baegwe abarwani chilifu ikomi na ibere (12,000) korwa Tobu.

English: I ask then, did they stumble so as to fall beyond recovery? Certainly not! However, because of their trespass, salvation has come to the Gentiles to make Israel jealous.
Kiswahili: Hivyo nauliza tena: Je, Waisraeli walijikwaa ili waanguke na kuangamia kabisa? La, hasha! Lakini kwa sababu ya makosa yao, wokovu umewafikia watu wa Mataifa, ili kuwafanya Waisraeli waone wivu.
Ekegusii: Bono nkoboria nde, “Inee! Nigo bagochirwe goika baguure kegima?” Yaya, taibo! Korende ase ogosaria kwabo ogotooreka gwaikeire abanto b’Ebisaku, erinde Abaisraeli bakorwe babe ne ribero.

English: Go, my people, enter your rooms and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourselves a little while until the wrath has passed.
Kiswahili: Nendeni, watu wangu, ingieni vyumbani mwenu na mfunge milango nyuma yenu, jificheni kwa kitambo kidogo mpaka ghadhabu yake ipite.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, inchwo mosoe ase chiero chiaino mwesiekere aroro; mwebise aroro ase engaki enke, goika endamwamu eyio ebe yaetire.

English: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,
Kiswahili: Nakuagiza mbele za Mungu avipaye vitu vyote uhai, na mbele za Kristo Yesu ambaye alipokuwa anashuhudia mbele ya Pontio Pilato alikiri ukiri mzuri,
Ekegusii: Nagochiikire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, oyokoa ebinto bionsi obogima, na ase Kristo Yeso, oyoruete oborori obuya ase Pontio Pilato,

English: If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies, saying, “I will prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink,” he would be the prophet of this people.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mwongo na mdanganyifu atakuja na kusema, ‘Nitawatabiria divai na pombe kwa wingi,' angekuwa ndiye nabii anayekubalika na watu hawa!
Ekegusii: “Abanto aba nigo batagete omobani ogoetanana n'oborimo amo n'obong'ainereria boigo ogoteeba, 'nababaneire buna Edivai n'amarwa naumoke ase more.

English: I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He said to me, “Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”
Kiswahili: Basi nikamwendea nikamwomba yule malaika anipe kile kitabu kidogo. Akaniambia, “Chukua na ukile. Kitakuwa kichungu tumboni mwako, lakini kinywani mwako kitakuwa kitamu kama asali.”
Ekegusii: Nkagenda ase omomalaika oria nkamoteebia, “Ing'a egetabu eyio enke.” Aganteebia, “Yebogorie, oyerie; ero nekobekere obororo ase enda yao, korende ase omonwa oo nebe enyansu buna obooke.”

English: “Look, an hour is coming and has already come when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and you will leave Me all alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.
Kiswahili: Saa inakuja, naam, imekwisha kuwadia, mtakapotawanyika kila mmoja kwenda nyumbani kwake na kuniacha peke yangu. Lakini mimi siko peke yangu kwa sababu Baba yu pamoja nami.
Ekegusii: Rora engaki neche, ee nabo yaikire gocha, namwatananeke, kera oyomo ase mwaye, namontige inche bweka, korende tindi inche bweka, ekiagera Tata nigo are amo nainche.

English: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.
Kiswahili: Hii ina maana kwamba, si watoto waliozaliwa kimwili walio watoto wa Mungu, bali ni watoto wa ahadi wanaohesabiwa kuwa uzao wa Abrahamu.
Ekegusii: Engencho yaye, tari abana b'ororeria bare Abana ba Nyasae, korende n'abana b'eira bakobarwa ng'a noroiboro rw'aye.

English: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh; they shall certainly not be unpunished.
Kiswahili: Bwana huwachukia sana wote wenye kiburi cha moyo. Uwe na hakika kwa hili: Hawataepuka kuadhibiwa.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto ore omoenenu nigo are kogechia ase Omonene; omonto oyio goika aegwe egesusuro.

English: Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yakobo akamwambia Labani, “Nipe mke wangu. Muda wangu umekamilika, nami nataka nikutane naye kimwili.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yakobo agateebia Labani: “Bono naikeranirie engaki yane, ing'a mokane, tobe nere.”

English: Sacrifice and offering you didn't desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.
Kiswahili: Dhabihu na sadaka hukuvitaka, lakini umefungua masikio yangu; sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za dhambi hukuzihitaji.
Ekegusii: Ebing'wanso na ebiruegwa tobiganeti, korende amato aane kwayatinoire. Ebing'wanso bi'ogosambwa, na ebi'ebibe tobiganeti.

English: I beg you, my child, to lift your eyes to the sky and the earth, and to see all things that are in it, and thus to recognize that God made them not of things that were, and that the race of men in this way comes into being.
Kiswahili: Nakusihi, mwanangu, uinue macho yako mbinguni na duniani, na uone vitu vyote vilivyomo, na hivyo kutambua kwamba Mungu hakuviumba kutokana na vitu vilivyokuwepo, na kwamba jamii ya wanadamu kwa njia hii inatokea.
Ekegusii: Ase igo omwana one nagosoroire origererie igoro n'ense. Rigereria buya mono kera egento okorora omanye buna bionsi ebio nigo biatongetwe na Nyasae boigo agatonga Mwanyabaanto.

English: Then they said to Jeremiah, “May the LORD be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not act upon every word that the LORD your God sends you to tell us.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakamwambia Yeremia, “ Bwana na awe shahidi wa kweli na mwaminifu kati yetu kama hatutafanya sawasawa na kila kitu Bwana Mungu wako atakachokutuma utuambie.
Ekegusii: Erio bagateebia Yeremia, “Tiga Omonene abe kirori bw’ekeene na oyo bw’obwegenwa igoro ase tore onye titogochia gokora koreng’ana onsi ay’Omonene, Nyasae oo aratoteebie goetera asore.

English: Men won't break bread for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead. Men won't give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.
Kiswahili: Hakuna yeyote atakayewapa chakula ili kuwafariji wale waombolezao kwa ajili ya wale waliokufa, hata akiwa amefiwa na baba au mama, wala hakuna yeyote atakayewapa kinywaji ili kuwafariji.
Ekegusii: Monto onde takoa oria okwereire endagera ase okomoremia; na oria okoreera ise gose ng'ina takoremigwa ase okoegwa ekenyugwa.

English: That is why I am so eager to preach the gospel also to you who are in Rome.
Kiswahili: Ndiyo sababu ninatamani sana kuihubiri Injili kwenu pia ninyi mlioko Rumi.
Ekegusii: Ase ensemo yane nigo nganetie mono korandia enchiri nonya nase more abamomenyete Rumi. Chinguru chi’enchiri

English: So the angel of the LORD answered Manoah, “Your wife is to do everything I told her.
Kiswahili: Malaika wa Bwana akamjibu, “Mke wako hana budi kufanya yale yote niliyomwambia.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ayio onsi nateebia omorugi oo, goika ayakore.

English: Heap on the wood. Make the fire hot. Boil the meat well. Make the broth thick, and let the bones be burned.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo lundika kuni na uwashe moto. Pika hiyo nyama vizuri, changanya viungo ndani yake, na uiache mifupa iungue kwenye moto.
Ekegusii: Beka chinko chinyinge, na omorero ogenderere gwoka mono, erinde oiyeke chinyama chiyie kegima, na omosori oyie oere, na amauga ayie arigise.

English: “Lord, they have killed your prophets. They have broken down your altars. I am left alone, and they seek my life.”
Kiswahili: Alisema, “Bwana, wamewaua manabii wako na kuzibomoa madhabahu zako, nimebaki mimi peke yangu, nao wanataka kuniua?”
Ekegusii: “Omonene, baitire ababani bao, batagoire egesasiimero kiao, ninche bweka natigaire, na barabwo nkorigia bare obogima bwane babosirie.”

English: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.
Kiswahili: Hawa wote waliungana pamoja katika maombi. Pamoja nao walikuwepo wanawake kadha, na Maria mama yake Yesu, pamoja na ndugu zake Yesu.
Ekegusii: Aba iga bonsi nigo bagendererete n'ogosaba ase omoyo oyomo, amo nabakungu bande, na Mariamu ng'ina Yeso, na bamura bamwabo Yeso.

English: For behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrow on the string to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.
Kiswahili: Hebu tazama, waovu wanapinda pinde zao, huweka mishale kwenye uzi wake, wakiwa gizani ili kuwapiga wale wanyofu wa moyo.
Ekegusii: Rigereria abakori amabe buna batingire amata abo, babekire chinsara chiabo ang’e ase chingori chi’amata, erinde barase abanto bare ne chinkoro chindonge.

English: but if you return to me, and keep my commandments and do them, though your outcasts were in the uttermost part of the heavens, yet I will gather them from there, and will bring them to the place that I have chosen, to cause my name to dwell there.'
Kiswahili: lakini mkinirudia na kutii amri zangu, ndipo hata kama watu wenu walio uhamishoni wako mbali sana katika miisho ya dunia, nitawakusanya kutoka huko na kuwaleta mahali ambapo nimepachagua kuwa makao kwa ajili ya Jina langu.'
Ekegusii: Korende komorang'iranere na kobwata amachiiko aane na koyarenda, nonya Abanto baino Baserigwe gochia ase chinsinyo chi'ense, nigo ndabasangererie korwa aase agwo, mbarente aase nachorire kobeeka erieta riane ribeereo.

English: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
Kiswahili: Lakini ni kwa nini mimi nimepata upendeleo kiasi hiki, hata mama wa Bwana wangu afike kwangu?
Ekegusii: Ng'ai ring'ana eri riarure, ng'ina Omonene one anchicheire inche?

English: “‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Katika huu Mwaka wa Yubile, kila mmoja atarudi kwenye mali yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: “Ase Omwaka oyio bw'Omochengo kera omonto airanigwe ase omwando oye.

English: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.
Kiswahili: Basi walikuwa wametumwa watu kutoka kwa Mafarisayo
Ekegusii: Na barabwo abatometwe nigo barwete ase Abafarisai.

English: When the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, they weighed anchor and sailed along Crete, close to shore.
Kiswahili: Upepo mtulivu ulipoanza kuvuma toka kusini, wakadhani kuwa wangeweza kufikia lengo lao, hivyo wakangʼoa nanga na kusafiri wakipita kandokando ya pwani ya kisiwa cha Krete.
Ekegusii: Naende embeo ya Irianyi egachia kogusa ake, bagakaga ng'a banyorire eki barigetie konyora, bakang'usa ekeroochi, bakagenda ang'e na Kirete, ang'e mono nengegu.

English: They will pursue us until we have drawn them away from the city, for they will say, ‘The Israelites are running away from us as they did before.’ So as we flee from them,
Kiswahili: Watatufuatilia mpaka tutakapokuwa tumewavuta mbali na mji kwa kuwa watasema, ‘Wanatukimbia, kama walivyofanya hapo awali.’ Hivyo tutakapowakimbia,
Ekegusii: Erio batobwatie, naintwe tobang’use gochia aare korwa ase omochie. Barabwo barengererie iga: Bono batamire korwa ase tore, buna bakorete engaki eria ye ritang’ani.

English: He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship;
Kiswahili: naye amemjaza Roho wa Mungu, pamoja na ustadi, na uwezo na ujuzi katika aina zote za ufundi,
Ekegusii: Omoichoirie omoika o Nyasae, omoeire obong'aini ne chisemi anyare gokora emeremo ende yonsi y'oboroisia,

English: And a number of those who had practiced magic arts brought their books and burned them in front of everyone. When the value of the books was calculated, the total came to fifty thousand drachmas.
Kiswahili: Idadi kubwa ya wale waliofanya mambo ya uganga wakaleta vitabu vyao na kuviteketeza kwa moto hadharani. Walipofanya hesabu ya thamani ya vitabu vilivyoteketezwa ilikuwa drakma 50,000 za fedha.
Ekegusii: Abange ase baria abaare gokora chingencho chi’oboragori, bagasangereria ebitabu biabo, bakabisamba ase amasio y’abaanto bonsi. Kobakorire omobaro bw’erigori ri’ebitabu ebio, bakanyora ng’a mbiisanete chiropia chi’echifeta chilifu emerongo etano.

English: There were capitals above also on the two pillars, close by the belly which was beside the network. There were two hundred pomegranates in rows around the other capital.
Kiswahili: Juu ya mataji ya zile nguzo mbili, juu ya ile sehemu yenye umbo kama bakuli, karibu na ule wavu, kulikuwa na yale makomamanga 200 katika safu kuzunguka pande zote.
Ekegusii: Ebisure ebio nigo biareenge igoro ase chisiiro chiria ibere na igoro ye chinsemo chiatambeete gochia isiko. Emegwekano y'amakomomanga amagana abere yareenge ase chindwaro ibere ase kera egesure.

English: I was there when He established the heavens, when He inscribed a circle on the face of the deep,
Kiswahili: Nilikuwepo alipoziweka mbingu mahali pake, wakati alichora mstari wa upeo wa macho juu ya uso wa kilindi,
Ekegusii: Ekero atongete igoro chionsi nao narenge, boigo nekero abeekerete amaache chimbebe.

English: Then I looked and saw a hand reaching out to me, and in it was a scroll,
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikatazama, nami nikaona mkono ulionyooshwa kunielekea. Nao ulikuwa na ukurasa wa kitabu,
Ekegusii: Ekero narigereretie, nkarora okoboko koramboire gocha asende, na ase okoboko okwo egetabu yaringire yarengeo.

English: But they dared to go up to the ridge of the hill country, though neither Moses nor the ark of the covenant of the LORD moved from the camp.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, kwa kiburi chao walipanda juu kuelekea nchi ya vilima virefu, ijapokuwa Mose hakutoka kambini wala Sanduku la Agano la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende bagekora abaremu, bagatiira gochia ase ense y’ebitunwa, nonya Esanduki eria yare ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’Omonene yatigarete ase egetwori, na Musa nao atigarete.

English: However he has anxious care, not because his powers must fail, nor because his span of life is short; But he compares himself with goldsmiths and silversmiths, and he imitates molders in brass, and considers it great that he molds counterfeit gods.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo ana wasiwasi, si kwa sababu nguvu zake lazima zishindwe, wala kwa sababu muda wake wa maisha ni mfupi; Bali anajilinganisha na mafundi wa dhahabu na fedha, naye anaiga wafinyanzi kwa shaba, na anaona ni jambo kubwa kwamba anafinyanzi miungu bandia.
Ekegusii: Korende ere tari gokumia buna amakweri amobereire ange, gose obogima bwaye n'obwenge; ere nigo akoamererania n'eriroba, n'etaabu ebinto ebio bikorwa ase riroba ere nigo akoroisia emebwekano y'okwegia.

English: but he sought the God of his father and walked by His commandments rather than the practices of Israel.
Kiswahili: bali alimtafuta Mungu wa baba yake na kuzifuata amri zake badala ya kufuata desturi za watu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: korende akaba okorigia Nyasae o ise, na akabwata amachiiko ’Omonene, na tabwatetie chinchera chi’Abaisraeli.

English: They found him and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”
Kiswahili: nao walipomwona, wakamwambia, “Kila mtu anakutafuta!”
Ekegusii: ekero bamonyorete, bakamoteebia, “Abanto bonsi ngokorigia bare.”

English: The plans contained everything David had in mind for the courts of the house of the LORD, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of the house of God and of the dedicated things,
Kiswahili: Akampa vielelezo vya yote Roho alikuwa ameviweka moyoni mwake kwa ajili ya kumbi za Hekalu la Bwana na vyumba vyote vilivyolizunguka, kwa ajili ya hazina za Hekalu la Mungu na kwa hazina za vitu vilivyowekwa wakfu.
Ekegusii: Naende akamoa omogwekano bw’ebinto bionsi arengereretie igoro y’okoagacha chiraaro chi’enyomba y’Omonene, na obw’ebinyomba bionsi biraetanane Hekalu biagachwe ase chimonga chi’enyomba ya Nyasae chiragachwe, amo ne chikungo chi’ebiegwa biare gocha gwatananwa bibe ebichenu.

English: As they were eating, he said, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”
Kiswahili: Nao walipokuwa wakila, Yesu akasema, “Amin, nawaambia, mmoja wenu atanisaliti.”
Ekegusii: Kobaikaransire koragera, akabora, “Nekeene nabateebirie: oyomo oino nandue.”

English: at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,
Kiswahili: Bilha, Esemu, Toladi,
Ekegusii: Bilaha, na Esemu, na Toladi;

English: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa njiani wakienda, mtu mmoja akamwambia Yesu, “Nitakufuata kokote uendako.”
Ekegusii: Ekero baare kogenda nchera omonto oyomo akamoteebia, “Ningotunyane aande onsi ase okogenda.”

English: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
Kiswahili: Lakini yeye Stefano, akiwa amejaa Roho Mtakatifu, alikaza macho mbinguni, akaona utukufu wa Mungu, na Yesu akiwa amesimama mkono wa kuume wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende ere oichire n'Omoika Omochenu, akarigereria mono gochia igoro, akarora obonene bwa Nyasae, na Yeso oteneine ensemo y'okoboko gw'okorio kwa Nyasae.

English: David spoke to the men who stood by him, saying, “What shall be done to the man who kills this Philistine and takes away the reproach from Israel? For who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?”
Kiswahili: Daudi akauliza watu waliokuwa wamesimama karibu naye, “Je, atafanyiwa nini mtu atakayemuua huyu Mfilisti na kuondoa aibu hii katika Israeli? Ni nani huyu Mfilisti asiyetahiriwa hata atukane majeshi ya Mungu aliye hai?”
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi agakwana na'baanto bateneine ang'e nere, akababoria: “Inee! Omonto oraite Omofilisti oria, na koruseria Abaisraeli ogochaaywa okwo, inki araegwe? Omofilisti oyo otarogeti, ninki aisaine goika are noboremu gochaaya emeganda y'eseegi ya Nyasae ore moyo?”

English: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,
Kiswahili: Kumbuka matendo ya ajabu aliyoyafanya, miujiza yake na hukumu alizozitamka,
Ekegusii: Inyora emeremo yo’gokumia eria akorire, ebikone biaye na ebiina biaye bi’ekeene arure

English: Now the appointed sign between the men of Israel and the ambushers was that they should make a great cloud of smoke rise up out of the city.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli walikuwa wamepatana na hao waviziaji kuwa wangefanya lipande wingu kubwa la moshi kutoka huo mji,
Ekegusii: Bono ekemanyererio giancheranetwe ase egati y'ekeombe ekenene ki'abarwani b'Abaisraeli n'abanto bebisete baboete nakio eke: Ekero barenge korora rikundesi ri'erioki rigochongororoka korwa ase omochie oria,

English: Now these are the heads of their fathers' households, and this is the genealogy of those who went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king:
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio viongozi wa jamaa pamoja na wale walioandikwa ambao walikuja pamoja nami kutoka Babeli wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Artashasta:
Ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo abateneneri be chiamate echio chiaruete Babiloni, chigatiira amo nainche, ekero Aritasasita arenge kogamba, na oyo nomoroberio bwe chinderia chiabo:

English: Next he presented the grain offering, took a handful of it, and burned it on the altar in addition to the morning’s burnt offering.
Kiswahili: Pia akaleta sadaka ya nafaka, akachukua konzi moja na kuiteketeza juu ya madhabahu, pamoja na sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya asubuhi.
Ekegusii: Akarenta okoruegwa kw’endagera, akaimokia obosie boichire roe, akabosaambera ase egesasiimero amo n’ekengwanso ki’ogosaambwa kia mambia.

English: Then the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, the priests second in rank, and the doorkeepers to remove from the temple of the LORD all the articles made for Baal, Asherah, and all the host of heaven. And he burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron and carried their ashes to Bethel.
Kiswahili: Mfalme akamwamuru Hilkia kuhani mkuu, makuhani waliomfuata kwa cheo, na mabawabu kuondoa kutoka kwenye Hekalu la Bwana vyombo vyote vilivyofanywa kwa ajili ya Baali na Ashera na jeshi lote la mianga ya angani! Akavichoma nje ya Yerusalemu katika mashamba ya Bonde la Kidroni, na kuyachukua hayo majivu mpaka Betheli.
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti agachiika Hilikia, Omokuani bw’omonene, na abakuani, abakoonyi baye, na abarendi b’egesieri, barusie korwa ase Hekalu y’Omonene ebikorero bionsi biaroisetwe ase ogosasimera Baali na Asera, na erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni chionsi chia igoro. Magega y’ayio akabisambera isiko ya Yerusalemu, agwo ase egetii gia Kidironi, akaira ribu riabo Beteli.

English: “Who touched Me?” Jesus asked. But they all denied it. “Master,” said Peter, “the people are crowding and pressing against You.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akauliza, “Ni nani aliyenigusa?” Watu wote walipokana, Petro akasema, “Bwana, huu umati wa watu unakusonga na kukusukuma kila upande.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabooria, “Ning’o onkuna?” Ekero abanto bonsi bagakana, Petero na baria barenge amo nere bakamoteebia, “Omonene, omoganda nigo ogoetanaine na gokomiga.”

English: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
Kiswahili: Heri walio wapatanishi, maana hao wataitwa wana wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abagokora omorembe, ekiagera barabwo 'nabarokwe abana ba Nyasae.

English: He said, “Greatly beloved man, don't be afraid. Peace be to you. Be strong. Yes, be strong.” When he spoke to me, I was strengthened, and said, “Let my lord speak; for you have strengthened me.”
Kiswahili: Akasema, "Mpendwa sana, usiogope. Amani iwe nawe. Uwe na nguvu. Naam, uwe na nguvu." Aliposema nami, nilitiwa nguvu, nikasema, "Bwana wangu na aseme; kwa maana umenitia nguvu."
Ekegusii: aganteebia, “Aye omonto bwanchire mono, tibwoboa, omorembe obe amo naye! Tenena bokong'u, naende obe omoremu!” Ekero arenge gokwana nainche, nkanyora chinguru, nkamotebia, “Aye Omonene one, kwana, ekiagera kwambekeire chinguru!”

English: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.
Kiswahili: Tumesema nanyi wazi, enyi Wakorintho na kuwafungulieni mioyo yetu wazi kabisa.
Ekegusii: Twakwanire maiso marore nainwe, Abakorinto; twaigoire chinkoro chiaito ase more.

English: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wale wanaoishi kwa kuufuata mwili huziweka nia zao katika vitu vya mwili, lakini wale wanaoishi kwa kufuata Roho, huziweka nia zao katika mambo ya Roho.
Ekegusii: Baria bagotunyana chingencho chiabo chi'ebibe nigo barengereretie chingencho chi'ebibe, korende baria bagotunyana chingencho chi'Omoika nigo barengereretie chingencho chi'Omoika.

English: So Yahweh sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.
Kiswahili: Basi Bwana akatuma tauni katika Israeli, watu 70,000 wa Israeli wakafa.
Ekegusii: Eri'Omonene akarentera Abaisraeli oborwaire obobe bw'ogoita; Abaisraeli chilifu emerongo etano na ebere (70,000) bagakwa.

English: Who has spoken and it came to pass, unless the Lord has ordained it?
Kiswahili: Nani awezaye kusema nalo likatendeka kama Bwana hajaamuru?
Ekegusii: Ning’o okwanete ring’ana, na rirorio rigakoreka, onye Omonene tarichiigete rikorwe?

English: After this, Samuel summoned the people to the LORD at Mizpah
Kiswahili: Samweli akawaita watu wa Israeli kuja kwa Bwana huko Mispa,
Ekegusii: Erio Samweli akarangeria Abaisraeli basangererekane amo ase obosio bw’Omonene agwo Misipa,

English: On the fifth day Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai, the leader of the Simeonites, drew near.
Kiswahili: Siku ya tano Shelumieli mwana wa Surishadai, kiongozi wa watu wa Simeoni, alileta sadaka yake.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano Selumieli, mosinto o Surisadai bw’egesaku gia Simioni, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.

English: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.
Kiswahili: ambaye ndani yake kumefichwa hazina zote za hekima na maarifa.
Ekegusii: Nere ekeigorero ase chinibo chionsi chi'obong'aini na echie chisemi chibisire.

English: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God's Good News free of charge?
Kiswahili: Je, nilitenda dhambi kwa kujishusha ili kuwainua ninyi kwa kuwahubiria Injili ya Mungu pasipo malipo?
