Ekegusii: Inee! Nebibe nakorire ase okweirania inse, erio mokiinigwe, ekiagera nabarandeirie enchiri ya Nyasae ntari neng'eria?

English: When I went out to the city gate and took my seat in the public square,
Kiswahili: “Wakati nilipokwenda kwenye lango la mji na kuketi katika kiwanja,
Ekegusii: Ekero narenge kogenda ase egeita ki’omochie, goikaransa ase ekerogo kiane agwo ase ekeraario,

English: I will stir up the Egyptians against the Egyptians, and they will fight everyone against his brother, and everyone against his neighbor; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.
Kiswahili: “Nitamchochea Mmisri dhidi ya Mmisri, ndugu atapigana dhidi ya ndugu, jirani dhidi ya jirani, mji dhidi ya mji, ufalme dhidi ya ufalme.
Ekegusii: “Inche Omonene ninseegete Abamisiri baitane boka abanyene; kera omonto nigo ararwane noyomwabo, na kera omoamate arwane nomoamate omwabo. Ninseegete abanto b'omochie oyomo barwane nab'omochie onde, na oborwoti borwane noborwoti bonde.

English: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden,
Kiswahili: Mwanamke akamjibu nyoka, “Tunaweza kula matunda ya miti iliyoko bustanini,
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria akairaneria eng'iti eria: “Amatunda a kera omote ore ase omogondo 'natonyare koyaria

English: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”
Kiswahili: Nilituma watu kwako mara moja, nawe umefanya vyema kuja. Basi sasa sisi sote tuko hapa mbele za Mungu kuyasikiliza yote ambayo Bwana amekuamuru kutuambia.”
Ekegusii: Erio bwango ngatoma abanto orangerigwe, na aye gwakorire buya gwachire. Na bono twensi nao tore aiga ase obosio bwa Nyasae, tonyare koigwa aya onsi Omonene agochikiire gokwana.”

English: But it was not long before a cyclone called the Northeaster swept down across the island.
Kiswahili: Lakini baada ya muda mfupi ikavuma tufani kubwa iitwayo “Eurakilo” toka kisiwa cha Krete.
Ekegusii: Magega ase ekero egeke omwaga bw’echinguru okorokwa Eurakilo, ore gocha buna ekembugu‐mbugu ogaaka emeeri.

English: and will pay no attention to Jewish myths or to the commands of men who have rejected the truth.
Kiswahili: ili wasiendelee kuangalia hadithi za Kiyahudi au maagizo ya wale watu wanaoikataa kweli.
Ekegusii: Naende totwara ribaga ri’ogotegerera emegano y’Abayahudi, gose amachiiko y’abanto abwo bakwanga ekeene.

English: Part Your heavens, O LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, that they may smoke.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, pasua mbingu zako, ushuke, gusa milima ili itoe moshi.
Ekegusii: Omonene, kumba igoro chiao ochiche inse aa! Kuna ebitunwa, erinde bisokie erioki.

English: having hope toward God, which these also themselves look for, that there will be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.
Kiswahili: Lakini, ninakubali kwamba mimi namwabudu Mungu wa baba zetu, mfuasi wa Njia, ile ambayo wao wanaiita dhehebu. Ninaamini kila kitu kinachokubaliana na Sheria na kile kilichoandikwa katika Manabii,
Ekegusii: Korende ring'ana eri ndaorokie ase ore, ng'a ase enchera eyio bakoroka ensemo y'ogweatanana, inche nigo nkomosaisima Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito, na kwegena ayariikire ase amachiiko na ase chibuku chi'ababani.

English: “Go and tell Hezekiah that this is what the LORD, the God of your father David, says: ‘I have heard your prayer; I have seen your tears. Behold, I will add fifteen years to your life.
Kiswahili: “Nenda ukamwambie Hezekia, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, Mungu wa baba yako Daudi: Nimeyasikia maombi yako na nimeona machozi yako. Nitakuongezea miaka kumi na mitano katika maisha yako.
Ekegusii: “Irana oteebie Hezekia ng’a inche Omonene, Nyasae o Daudi sokoro yaye, nigo ngoteeba iga: Naigure ogosaba kwao, narorire amariga ao. Rora, nakomentire emiaka ikomi na etano ase obogima bwao.

English: Then a champion named Goliath, who was from Gath, came out from the Philistine camp. He was six cubits and a span in height,
Kiswahili: Shujaa aliyeitwa Goliathi, aliyetoka Gathi, akajitokeza kutoka kambi ya Wafilisti. Alikuwa na urefu dhiraa sita na shibiri moja.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo omonto ore korokwa Goliato, omonto bw’omochie o Gati, akaoroka korwa ase egetwori ki’Abafilisti. Ere nigo areenge etuoni y’eseegi; obotaambe bwaye nigo bwareenge bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano na rimo na ekeng’ese.

English: But these two things will come to you in a moment in one day: the loss of children and widowhood. They will come on you in their full measure, in the multitude of your sorceries, and the great abundance of your enchantments.
Kiswahili: Haya mawili yatakupata, kufumba na kufumbua, katika siku moja: kufiwa na watoto, na ujane. Yote yatakupata kwa kipimo kikamilifu, ijapokuwa uchawi wako ni mwingi, na uaguzi wako ni mwingi.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana aya abere nagochere mobosokano ase rituko erimo; abana bao mbakwe, na omosacha oo akwe, obe omoboraka; ayio onsi nagochere, nonya oborogi bwao, na oboringoria bwao, bire ebinge mono.

English: He has laid waste His tabernacle like a garden booth; He has destroyed His place of meeting. The LORD has made Zion forget her appointed feasts and Sabbaths. In His fierce anger He has despised both king and priest.
Kiswahili: Ameharibu maskani yake kama bustani, ameharibu mahali pake pa mkutano. Bwana amemfanya Sayuni kusahau sikukuu zake zilizoamriwa na Sabato zake; katika hasira yake kali amewadharau mfalme na kuhani.
Ekegusii: Ere oiyeirie inse orobago rwaye rore buna orw’omogondo, ee, osaririe aase emesangererekano y’ogosasiima ekobeera. Omonene otigire abanto bebire Amatuko Amanene ne Chisabato agwo Sayoni, na ase okogechigwa kwaye okonene bwangire omorwoti na Omokuani.

English: Thus the Israelites did as Joshua had commanded them. They took up twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, one for each tribe of Israel, just as the LORD had told Joshua; and they carried them to the camp, where they set them down.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Waisraeli wakafanya kama Yoshua alivyowaagiza. Wakachukua mawe kumi na mawili kutoka katikati ya Mto Yordani, kulingana na hesabu ya kabila za Waisraeli kama Bwana alivyomwambia Yoshua, nao wakayabeba hadi kambini mwao, mahali walipoyatua chini.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora buna Yoshua abachigete. Bakaimokia amagena ikomi na abere korwa Yorodani, erimo ase kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli, buna Omonene konya atebereirie Yoshua, bakayaira ase baare gochia gotoora, bakayabeeka inse.

English: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.
Kiswahili: Ni kwa sababu pia walikuwa wamesikia kwamba alikuwa ametenda muujiza huu ndiyo maana umati wa watu ukaenda kumlaki.
Ekegusii: Ekio nakio kiagerete omoganda okagenda komoorotota, ekiagera baigwete ng'a okorire egekone eke.

English: then the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and the hair in it is yellow and thin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is an itch. It is leprosy of the head or of the beard.
Kiswahili: kuhani atakichunguza kile kidonda, na kama ataona kuwa kimeingia ndani, na nywele zilizoko juu yake ni njano na nyembamba, kuhani atamtangaza mtu huyo kuwa najisi, kwani ni upele; ni ugonjwa wa ngozi wa kuambukiza wa kichwa au kidevu.
Ekegusii: Omokuani areenge egesambo ekio. Onye gekorete engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, naende onye amarionya areo are monuri na konyererea, erio Omokuani ateebe ng'a omonto oyio tachenegeti. Erio nerichoncho ri'oborwaire bwa ukoma ase omotwe oye, gose ase ekenyonyobu.

English: For certain men have crept in among you unnoticed—ungodly ones who were designated long ago for condemnation. They turn the grace of our God into a license for immorality, and they deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa kuna watu waliojipenyeza kwa siri katikati yenu, watu walioandikiwa tangu zamani hukumu hii, waovu, wapotoshao neema ya Mungu wetu kuwa ufisadi wakimkana yeye aliye Bwana wetu wa pekee, Bwana Yesu Kristo. Hukumu Kwa Walimu Wa Uongo
Ekegusii: Naki mbare abanto besoirie bobisi, abwo barikeretwe kare okogambigwa oko, abanto batari ne chingencho chi’obonyasae. Barabwo nigo bakoonchorana obuya bwa Nyasae oito ase okobiserera ogokora kwabo kw’obonyaka, naende bagokana Omonene oito ore bweka, oyore Omonene oito Yeso Kristo. Korwa agwo kare amariiko nabanete okoragererigwa konya banyorire.

English: Then the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, inscribed by the finger of God with the exact words that the LORD spoke to you out of the fire on the mountain on the day of the assembly.
Kiswahili: Bwana alinipa mbao mbili za mawe zilizoandikwa kwa kidole cha Mungu. Juu ya mbao hizo kulikuwepo amri zote ambazo Bwana aliwatangazia kule mlimani kwa njia ya moto, siku ya kusanyiko.
Ekegusii: Omonene akang’a chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena echio Ere Omonyene ariigete n’ekiara kiaye. Nigo chiariikire amang’ana onsi Omonene konya akwanire nainwe agwo ase egetunwa korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero, ekero mwasangererekanete aroro.

English: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array with all kinds of instruments of war: fifty thousand who could command and were not of double heart.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Zabuloni, askari wenye uzoefu mkubwa walioandaliwa tayari kwa vita wakiwa na silaha za kila aina, ili kumsaidia Daudi kwa uaminifu thabiti, walikuwa 50,000.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Abasabuloni: abarwani abakong'u baare nomoyo oyomo, baisanerete ase okorwana esegi, babwate ebirwanero biisaine, abanto chilifu emerongo etano (50,000).

English: In the evening, quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp.
Kiswahili: Jioni ile kware wakaja wakaifunika kambi na asubuhi kulikuwa na tabaka la umande kuzunguka kambi.
Ekegusii: Mogoroba chinkware chigaacha, chigaichora ase batoorete, na mambia yaye aase onsi aetanaine aase aria akanyorwa atoorire riimi.

English: Jokmeam with its pasture lands, Beth Horon with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: Yokmeamu, Beth-Horoni,
Ekegusii: Yokimeamu na Beti‐Horoni,

English: It is better for me to fall into your hands, and not do it, than to sin in the sight of the Lord.”
Kiswahili: Ni bora nianguke mikononi mwako, na nisifanye hivyo, kuliko kutenda dhambi mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Nachorire gotakora bo; mbuya ngwe ase amaboko aino kobua gokora ebibe ase Omonene.”

English: who sets his heart to seek God, Yahweh, the God of his fathers, even if they aren't clean according to the purification of the sanctuary.”
Kiswahili: ambaye anauelekeza moyo wake kumtafuta Mungu, Bwana, Mungu wa baba zake, hata kama yeye si safi kulingana na sheria za mahali patakatifu.”
Ekegusii: “oyio oonchoire enkoro yaye ase ogokorigia aye Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, Omonene, nonya tachenegeti kobwatekana nomoroberio bwe Hekalu.”

English: He built an altar there, and called on Yahweh's name, and pitched his tent there. There Isaac's servants dug a well.
Kiswahili: Isaki akajenga madhabahu huko, akaliitia jina la Bwana. Akapiga hema lake huko, nao watumishi wake wakachimba kisima.
Ekegusii: Na Isaka akaagacha egesasiimero aroro, akarangeria erieta ri'Omonene, agatenenia chiema chiaye aroro. Na agwo abasomba baye bakarema, bakanyora entuboka.

English: Jesus replied, “Can you make the guests of the bridegroom fast while He is with them?
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, mnaweza kuwafanya wageni wa bwana arusi kufunga wakati yuko pamoja nao?
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inee! Inamonyare gotiga abachire ase enyangi beng’ate ekero omonywomi are amo nabarabwo?

English: Therefore David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I go and strike these Philistines?” Yahweh said to David, “Go strike the Philistines, and save Keilah.”
Kiswahili: akauliza kwa Bwana, akisema, “Je, niende na kuwashambulia hawa Wafilisti?” Bwana akamjibu, “Nenda, washambulie Wafilisti na uuokoe Keila.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi akaboori'Omonene: “Nkogenda nde korwania Abafirisiti abwo esegi?” Na Omonene akamoteebia: “Genda obarwanie, na otoorie Keila.”

English: They will know that I am Yahweh when I have set a fire in Egypt, and all her helpers are destroyed.
Kiswahili: Ndipo watakapojua kwamba mimi ndimi Bwana, nitakapoiwasha Misri moto na wote wamsaidiao watapondwa.
Ekegusii: Erio ekero 'ndabe natongirie omorero agwo Misiri, na abakoonyi baye bonsi basirigwe, barabwo mbamanye ng'a inche ninche Omonene.

English: Do not join those who drink too much wine or gorge themselves on meat.
Kiswahili: Usiwe miongoni mwa wanywao mvinyo, au wale walao nyama kwa pupa,
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koba ase egati y’abagotinda nedivai, gose ase egati y’abakoria chinyama bobe,

English: Then present Aaron and his sons at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.
Kiswahili: Kisha mlete Aroni na wanawe kwenye lango la Hema la Kukutania na uwaoshe kwa maji.
Ekegusii: “Erio orente Aroni amo nabamura baye ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, obasibie namaache.

English: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,
Kiswahili: Mjane yeyote asiwekwe kwenye orodha ya wajane isipokuwa awe ametimiza umri wa miaka sitini, na ambaye alikuwa mke wa mume mmoja,
Ekegusii: Omotakaanwa anyare koriikwa onye okoorire emiaka emerongo etano nomo, naende onye orenge omokungu bw'omosaacha oyoomo.

English: They will no more be a prey to the nations, neither will the animals of the earth devour them; but they will dwell securely, and no one will make them afraid.
Kiswahili: Hawatatekwa tena nyara na mataifa, wala wanyama pori hawatawala tena. Wataishi kwa salama, wala hakuna yeyote atakayewatia hofu.
Ekegusii: Tibagotwarwa buna ching'iti naende nabaanto b'ebisaku, gose ching'iti chi'orosana tichikobaria. Mbabe bamenyete bare noborendi obuya, gose onde tari oraboboie.

English: Keep me as the apple of Your eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings
Kiswahili: Nilinde kama mboni ya jicho lako, unifiche chini ya kivuli cha mbawa zako
Ekegusii: Indende buna orendete endorero y’eriso riao; intube ase ekiriri gie chimbaaba chiao;

English: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kwako miaka elfu ni kama siku moja iliyokwisha pita, au kama kesha la usiku.
Ekegusii: Asore aye, emiaka elifu eyemo nigo ere buna rituko ria igoro koriaetire, buna engaki enke y'okorenda botuko.

English: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can't be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.
Kiswahili: Mtu anapojaribiwa asiseme, “Ninajaribiwa na Mungu.” Kwa maana Mungu hawezi kujaribiwa na maovu wala yeye hamjaribu mtu yeyote.
Ekegusii: Omonto karateemwe, tateeba “Nateemirwe na Nyasae” ekiagera Nyasae tagoteemwa namabe, gose tagoteema omonto.

English: Now an angel of the Lord said to Philip, “Get up and go south to the desert road that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza.”
Kiswahili: Basi malaika wa Bwana akamwambia Filipo, “Nenda upande wa kusini kwenye ile barabara itokayo Yerusalemu kuelekea Gaza ambayo ni jangwa.”
Ekegusii: Omomalaika Omonene agateebia Filipo: “Imoka ogende ensemo ya Irianyi goika enchera eria egotirimboka korwa Yerusalemu ekogenda Gasa.” Eye nenchera y’erooro.

English: So the tabernacle was set up on the first day of the first month of the second year.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Maskani ya Mungu ilisimikwa katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kwanza, katika mwaka wa pili.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, omwaka o kabere magega kobarure Misiri, obomenyo boria bogatenenigwa.

English: and so that He may establish you today as His people, and He may be your God as He promised you and as He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
Kiswahili: kuwathibitisha ninyi siku hii ya leo kama taifa lake, ili aweze kuwa Mungu wenu kama alivyowaahidi na kama alivyowaapia baba zenu Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo.
Ekegusii: erinde ase rituko ria reero, Omonene anyare kobakora mobe abanto baye b’ekeene. Ere ’nabe Nyasae oino, buna abateebetie na buna arierete chisokoro chiaino Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo, eira ase ogotiana.

English: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. The Descendants of Seir (Genesis 36:20–30)
Kiswahili: Wana wa Reueli walikuwa: Nahathi, Zera, Shama na Miza. Watu Wa Seiri Waliokuwa Edomu (Mwanzo 36:20-30)
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Reueli nabwo aba: Nahati na Zera, Sama na Miza. Abanto bamenyete ase ense ya Edomu kare (Omoch 36:20-30)

English: You who tell good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who tell good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with strength! Lift it up! Don't be afraid! Say to the cities of Judah, “Behold, your God!”
Kiswahili: Wewe uletaye habari njema Sayuni, panda juu ya mlima mrefu. Wewe uletaye habari njema Yerusalemu, inua sauti yako kwa kupiga kelele, inua sauti, usiogope; iambie miji ya Yuda, “Yuko hapa Mungu wenu!”
Ekegusii: Aye Sayoni, omoraria bw'amang'ana amaya, tiira gochia ase ebitunwa ebitambe igoro. Aye Yerusalemu, omoraria bw'amang'ana amaya, aka eriogi riao ne chinguru; ee, aka eriogi mono, toiroka; teebiaemechie y'Abayuda iga: “Rora Nyasae oino!”

English: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.
Kiswahili: Angalieni! Ule ujira wa vibarua waliolima mashamba yenu mliouzuia kwa hila unapiga kelele dhidi yenu na vilio vya wavunaji vimefika masikioni mwa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Rigereria, mwabarinire abakoreri, abagesire emegondo yaino, eng'eria yabo. Bono eng'eria eria ekorera, na okorera kw'abagesi baria gwaikire ase amato 'Omonene bw'Emeganda.

English: Say to the king and to the queen mother, “Humble yourselves. Sit down, for your crowns have come down, even the crown of your glory.
Kiswahili: Mwambie mfalme na mamaye, “Shukeni kutoka kwenye viti vyenu vya enzi, kwa kuwa taji zenu za utukufu zitaanguka kutoka vichwani mwenu.”
Ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia, “Teebia omorwoti na ng'ina bekeyie babe abaitongo ekiagera chigutwa chiabo chingiya chiarusigwe ase emetwe yabo.”

English: All Your commandments are faithful; I am persecuted without cause—help me!
Kiswahili: Amri zako zote ni za kuaminika; unisaidie, kwa sababu watu wananishtaki bila sababu.
Ekegusii: Amachiiko ao onsi nigo are ay’ekeene, korende abanto nigo bagonchaanda ase okong’aacha. Koranche onkonye!

English: Moreover, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
Kiswahili: Neno la Bwana likamjia Yeremia kusema:
Ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia, rikamoteebia,

English: A prayer of Habakkuk, the prophet, set to victorious music.
Kiswahili: Sala ya nabii Habakuki iliyoimbwa kwa shigionothi.
Ekegusii: Oko nogosaba kw'omobani Habakuki.

English: Showing partiality to the wicked is not good, nor is depriving the innocent of justice.
Kiswahili: Sio vizuri kumpendelea mtu mwovu, au kumnyima haki asiye na hatia.
Ekegusii: Tari buya gwanchereria omokori amabe na gosaria ekiina ki’omonto omooronge.

English: Yahweh their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for they are like the jewels of a crown, lifted on high over his land.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wao atawaokoa siku hiyo kama kundi la watu wake. Watangʼara katika nchi yake kama vito vya thamani kwenye taji.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riri'Omonene, Nyasae obo, nabatoorie, ekiagera nigo bare abanto be riicho riaye. Barabwo nigo bare buna amagena e rigori rinene abekire ase egutwa, akomeka‐meka na komoreka ase ense yaye.

English: This Benaiah was mighty among the Thirty and was over the Thirty, and his son Ammizabad was in charge of his division.
Kiswahili: Huyu ndiye yule Benaya aliyekuwa shujaa miongoni mwa wale Thelathini na ndiye alikuwa juu yao hao Thelathini. Mwanawe Amizabadi ndiye alikuwa mkuu katika kikosi chake.
Ekegusii: Benaya nere orenge omonto etuoni, omanyekanete ase baria Emerongo etato, naende orenge nomochiki obo. Amisabadi, omomura oye, nere orenge komokonya ase ekeombe ekio.

English: You free me from the net laid out for me, for You are my refuge.
Kiswahili: Uniepushe na mtego niliotegewa, maana wewe ndiwe kimbilio langu.
Ekegusii: Indusie korwa ase oboreba bobisire bombwate, aye naye egekengero kiane.

English: Urijah the priest built an altar. According to all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus, so Urijah the priest made it for the coming of King Ahaz from Damascus.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Uria kuhani akajenga madhabahu kulingana na mipango yote ambayo Mfalme Ahazi alikuwa ameituma kutoka Dameski, na akamaliza ujenzi kabla ya Mfalme Ahazi kurudi.
Ekegusii: Uria Omokuani akaagacha egesasiimero koreng'ana nomogwekano oria Ahasi omorwoti amotomerete korwa Damesiki, agakeroisia ritang'ani Ahasi ataraika aroro korwa Damesiki.

English: For our appeal does not arise from deceit or ulterior motives or trickery.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana himizo letu halikutokana na hila wala nia mbaya au udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Naki ogosorora gwaito tikori ogw’okobasiria, gose ogw’okobabeka ase eubi, gose ogw’okobang’aina,

English: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
Kiswahili: Tamari, mkwewe Yuda, alimzalia wana wawili: Peresi na Zera. Yuda alikuwa na jumla ya wana watano.
Ekegusii: Tamari, moka momura o Yuda, akaiborera Yuda Peresi na Zera. Yuda nigo abwate abana abamura batano.

English: You will conceive chaff. You will give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will devour you.
Kiswahili: Mlichukua mimba ya makapi, mkazaa mabua, pumzi yenu ni moto uwateketezao.
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo morabe barito bw'obonyansi obwomo, moibore amasakwe. Omoika oino bw'okoeyana noro omorero orabasambe moere.

English: then hear in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
Kiswahili: basi usikie dua na maombi yao kutoka mbinguni, ukawatetee haki yao.
Ekegusii: rirorio oigwe korwa agwo igoro ogosaba kwabo, na okoboria kwabo kw'oboitongo, na obae oboronge bwabo.

English: It was reported to King Solomon: “Joab has fled to the tent of the LORD and is now beside the altar.” So Solomon sent Benaiah son of Jehoiada, saying, “Go, strike him down!”
Kiswahili: Mfalme Solomoni akaambiwa kuwa Yoabu amekimbilia kwenye hema la Bwana naye alikuwa kando ya madhabahu. Basi Solomoni akamwagiza Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada: “Nenda ukamuue!”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani agateebigwa, “Yoabu otamire gochia ase Eema y’Omonene, na rora, nao are ase egesasiimero.” Erio agatoma Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, akamoteebia, “Genda oake Yoabu, omoite.”

English: For You have been a refuge for the poor, a stronghold for the needy in distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat. For the breath of the ruthless is like rain against a wall,
Kiswahili: Umekuwa kimbilio la watu maskini, kimbilio la mhitaji katika taabu yake, hifadhi wakati wa dhoruba na kivuli wakati wa hari. Kwa maana pumzi ya wakatili ni kama dhoruba ipigayo ukuta
Ekegusii: Aye kwabeire egekengero egekong’u ase abataka, ee, kwabeire egekengero ase abaremeire ekero bare nemechando; kwabeire obotamero ase engaki y’embura omoubera, na ekiriri ekero ki’omobaso omoororo. Okogosa kw’abaanto abatindi nigo konga embura omoubera egotwoma enyasi,

English: I will fill its mountains with the slain; those killed by the sword will fall on your hills, in your valleys, and in all your ravines.
Kiswahili: Nitaijaza milima yenu kwa watu wake waliouawa, wale waliouawa kwa upanga wataanguka juu ya vilima vyako na katika mabonde yako na katika makorongo yako yote.
Ekegusii: Ning’ichorie ebitunwa biao nabaanto baraitwe nemioro; ee, abwo baraitwe nemioro mbagwe ase ebigoro biao, na ase amakura ao, na ase chindooche chiao.

English: that this shall be no grief to you, nor offense of heart to my lord, either that you have shed blood without cause, or that my lord has avenged himself. When Yahweh has dealt well with my lord, then remember your servant.”
Kiswahili: bwana wangu hatakuwa na dhamiri inayolemewa na mzigo kwa kumwaga damu kusiko na sababu, au kujilipizia kisasi yeye mwenyewe. Bwana atakapomletea bwana wangu mafanikio, umkumbuke mtumishi wako.”
Ekegusii: aye, omonene one, tokoba nomoichano gose nenkoro egokogambia, ng'a ngwaiterete amanyinga y'Abanto batari na komocha, gose ng'a nkweruseretie egesiomba. Bono kerabe Omonene ogokoreire amaya ayio, ong'inyore inche omosomba oo.”

English: Bring water for the thirsty, O dwellers of Tema; meet the refugees with food.
Kiswahili: leteni maji kwa wenye kiu, ninyi mnaoishi Tema, leteni chakula kwa ajili ya wakimbizi.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto momenyete ase ense ya Tema, abwo bare nerang’o, bae amaache, na abwo bagotama, bae endagera.

English: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
Kiswahili: Nimesema mara moja, lakini sina jibu; naam, nimesema mara mbili, lakini sitasema tena.”
Ekegusii: Inche nakwanire rimo, tinkomenta gento; ee, nakwanire kabere, korende tinkogenderera goetania ayio.”

English: They are resolved to spend the first fruits of the grain and the tithes of the wine and the oil, which they had sanctified and reserved for the priests who stand before the face of our God in Jerusalem, which it is not fitting for any of the people so much as to touch with their hands.
Kiswahili: Wameazimia kutumia malimbuko ya nafaka na zaka za divai na mafuta, ambazo walikuwa wamezitakasa na kuziweka akiba kwa ajili ya makuhani wanaosimama mbele za Mungu wetu huko Yerusalemu, jambo ambalo halifai kwa watu wote hata kugusa kwa mikono yao.
Ekegusii: Barabwo baetirie koria chindaagera chi'okobusenia korwa ase engaano, ensemo ya ikomi ye edivai amo na amafuta ebio bikoriegwa na abakuani amo na baria bagokora ase Hekalu ya Nyasae ime ya Yerusalemu booka. Chindagera echio chinchenu intwe totancheiri nonya nogokunwa na amaboko aito abanyene. 11:13 rora Okong' 23:19; Abal 27:30

English: In the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat’s reign over Judah, Jehoram son of Ahab became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria twelve years.
Kiswahili: Yehoramu mwana wa Ahabu akawa mfalme wa Israeli katika Samaria mwaka wa kumi na nane wa utawala wa Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda, naye akatawala kwa miaka kumi na miwili.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano na gatato bw’okogaamba kwa Yehosafati, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, Yoramu, mosinto bw’Ahabu, agachaaka kogaambera Abaisraeli, agwo Samaria, akagaamba emiaka ikomi na ebere.

English: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.
Kiswahili: Lakini heri macho yenu kwa sababu yanaona, na heri masikio yenu kwa sababu yanasikia.
Ekegusii: Korende amaiso aino nasesenirie, ekiagera nkorora are, na amato aino, ekiagera nkoigwa are.

English: Have you journeyed to the vents of the sea or walked in the trenches of the deep?
Kiswahili: “Je, umepata kufika kwenye chemchemi za bahari? Au kutembea mahali pa ndani pa vilindi?
Ekegusii: Inee! Kwana gosoa ime ase chinsoko chi’enyancha, gose kwana gotaara ase enkoro ye chindiba?

English: As he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akitawanya mbegu, nyingine zilianguka kando ya njia, nao ndege wakaja na kuzila.
Ekegusii: Agachia koba nkobusura are, chimbusuro chinde chikagwa ase enchera ensemo, chinyoni chigaacha chigachiria.

English: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.
Kiswahili: Kisha umati wote wa watu ukainuka na kumpeleka Yesu kwa Pilato.
Ekegusii: Bakaimoka bonsi, bakaira Yeso ase Pilato.

English: For if God didn't spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, kama Mungu hakuwasamehe malaika walipotenda dhambi, bali aliwatupa kuzimu katika vifungo vya giza wakae humo mpaka ije hukumu;
Ekegusii: Naki Nyasae tabarorerete amaabera abamalaika baria bakorete ebibe, korende akabaruta ase omorero o kare na kare aase barendire goika ekiina geche.

English: In opening his hands, a man will be made glad; so lawbreakers will utterly fail.
Kiswahili: Mtu akifungua mikono yake atafurahi; hivyo wavunja sheria watashindwa kabisa.
Ekegusii: Omonto omoitongo nanyoore omogooko, korende abamochi inabasire kegima.

English: He didn't do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
Kiswahili: Naye hakufanya miujiza mingi huko kwa sababu ya kutokuamini kwao.
Ekegusii: Ere takorete amakumia amange agwo, ekiagera batarenge nokwegena.

English: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
Kiswahili: Maovu yangu yamenifunika kama mzigo usiochukulika.
Ekegusii: Ebibe biane biantubire nonya nomotwe bwonsi, bianditoeire na kombua.

English: You are my brothers. You are my bone and my flesh. Why then are you the last to bring back the king?'
Kiswahili: Ninyi ni ndugu zangu, nyama yangu na damu yangu mwenyewe. Kwa hiyo kwa nini mwe wa mwisho kumrudisha mfalme?'
Ekegusii: Inwe n'abanto baminto b'amanyinga ane ne chinyama chiane. Inaki rende morigetie koba ab'omoerio ase okong'irania inche omorwoti inka?

English: For the Chief Musician. By David the servant of Yahweh, who spoke to Yahweh the words of this song in the day that Yahweh delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul. He said, I love you, Yahweh, my strength.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi mtumishi wa Bwana aliyomwimbia Bwana wakati Bwana alipomwokoa mikononi mwa adui zake wote, na pia mkononi mwa Sauli. Alisema hivi: Nakupenda wewe, Ee Bwana, nguvu yangu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera Daudi, omosomba bw'Omonene, atererete Omonene, ekero Omonene amotooretie korwa ase Saulo na ababisa bande) Aye Omonene, aye chinguru chiane, ningwanchete mono!

English: and sprinkle with his right forefinger some of the oil in his left palm seven times before the LORD.
Kiswahili: na kwa kidole chake cha shahada cha mkono wa kuume, atamnyunyizia yule anayetakaswa yale mafuta yaliyo kwenye kiganja chake mara saba mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Make ay’amaguta aria are roe rw’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee ayanyororokerie ara gatano na kabere nekiara gi’okoraga gi’okoboko kwaye kwa borio, agwo ase obosio bwane.

English: for the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya ishirini na tatu ikamwangukia Mahaziothi, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere na gatato (23) bokagwera Mahasioti; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: What then? What Israel was seeking, it failed to obtain, but the elect did. The others were hardened,
Kiswahili: Tuseme nini basi? Kile kitu ambacho Israeli alikitafuta kwa bidii hakukipata. Lakini waliochaguliwa walikipata. Waliobaki walifanywa wagumu,
Ekegusii: Inaki rende abeire? Egento keria Abaisraeli baare korigia tibakenyorete, Baria bachoretwe, mbarabwo bakenyorete, korende abatigarete bagakorwa koba abakong’u ase chinkoro chiabo,

English: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!
Kiswahili: Kisha nikasikia sauti kama ya umati mkubwa, kama sauti ya maji mengi yaendayo kasi na kama ngurumo kubwa ya radi wakipiga kelele wakisema: “Haleluya! Kwa maana Bwana Mungu wetu Mwenyezi anatawala.
Ekegusii: Erio nkaigwa buna neriogi ri'omoganda omonene, na buna eri'amaache amange, na buna eri'enkoba ye chinguru rigoteeba, “Haleluya! Omonene Nyasae Omobui nkogamba are.

English: and to have the chief seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.
Kiswahili: Pia wao hupenda kukaa kwenye viti vya mbele katika masinagogi, na kupewa nafasi za heshima katika karamu.
Ekegusii: na goikaransa aase e ritang’ani ase chisinagogi, na aase e ritang’ani ase emeyega.

English: or a harsh crashing of rocks hurled down, or the swift course of animals bounding along unseen, or the voice of wild beasts harshly roaring, or an echo rebounding from the hollows of the mountains, all these things paralyzed them with terror.
Kiswahili: au mgongano mkali wa miamba iliyorushwa chini, au mwendo wa kasi wa wanyama wakiruka-ruka bila kuonekana, au sauti ya wanyama wa porini wakinguruma kwa ukali, au mwangwi unaorudi kutoka kwenye mashimo ya milima, mambo haya yote yaliwapooza kwa hofu.
Ekegusii: gose eriogi ri'ebitunwa bikogwa, gose eriogi ri'ebitongwa bikoiruruka na kominyoka, gose eriogi ri'echingiti chikwana ase obotindi, gose eriogi korwa ase ebitunwa, barabwo nigo bare gwaka inse ase obwoba.

English: But who are you, O man, to talk back to God? Shall what is formed say to Him who formed it, “Why did You make me like this?”
Kiswahili: Lakini, ewe mwanadamu, u nani wewe ushindane na Mungu? “Je, kilichoumbwa chaweza kumwambia yeye aliyekiumba, ‘Kwa nini umeniumba hivi?’ ”
Ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto, aye naye ng’o okoiraneria Nyasae? Inee! Egento getongire nakemoteebie oyogetongete, “Ninki gwankorerete iga?”

English: Moses said to Yahweh, “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why haven't I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?
Kiswahili: Akamuuliza Bwana, “Kwa nini umeleta taabu hii juu ya mtumishi wako? Nimekufanyia nini cha kukuchukiza hata ukaweka mzigo huu wa watu hawa wote juu yangu?
Ekegusii: Ere akamoteebia Omonene, “Nase ki gwankoreire inche, omosomba oo, obobe obo iga? Naende 'ntanyoreti ogwancherwa ase ore. Nase ki kwang'eire emeremo emenene ase okoraa abanto aba?

English: Before them stood seventy elders of the house of Israel, with Jaazaniah son of Shaphan standing among them. Each had a censer in his hand, and a fragrant cloud of incense was rising.
Kiswahili: Mbele yao walisimama wazee sabini wa nyumba ya Israeli, naye Yaazania mwana wa Shafani alikuwa amesimama miongoni mwao. Kila mmoja alikuwa na chetezo mkononi na moshi wa harufu nzuri ya uvumba ulikuwa unapanda juu.
Ekegusii: Abagaaka b’Abaisraeli emerongo etano na ebere, amo na Yasania, mosinto o Safania, nigo bateneine ase egati y’emegwekano eyio y’ogosasiimwa. Kera oyomo nigo abwate ase amaboko aye egetaabo ki’ogosambera ubani, na erioki ria ubani richongororogete gochia igoro.

English: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.
Kiswahili: Watoto wadogo, huu ni wakati wa mwisho! Kama mlivyosikia kwamba mpinga Kristo anakuja, hivyo basi wapinga Kristo wengi wamekwisha kuja. Kutokana na hili twajua kwamba huu ni wakati wa mwisho.
Ekegusii: Abana baane abake, engaki eye ney'omoerio. Na buna mwaigwete ng'a omobisa o Kristo ngocha are, nonya mbono ababisa ba Kristo nabange baimokire. Ase ayio twamanyire ng'a engaki eye ney'omoerio.

English: Then they shall remove the ashes from the bronze altar, spread a purple cloth over it,
Kiswahili: “Wataondoa majivu kutoka madhabahu ya shaba na kutandaza kitambaa cha zambarau juu yake.
Ekegusii: Barabwo babuuche ribu, naende batube egesasiimero negetambaa kere monyinga.

English: In these visions of my mind as I was lying in bed, I saw this come to pass: There was a tree in the midst of the land, and its height was great.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo maono niliyoona nilipokuwa nimelala kitandani mwangu: Nilitazama, na mbele yangu ulisimama mti katikati ya nchi. Ulikuwa mrefu sana.
Ekegusii: “Oko nakwo okorora narooche ekero naraire borere bwane: Nkarora omote omonene orenge omotambe mono oteneine ase egati‐gati y’ense.

English: From the Negev he journeyed from place to place toward Bethel, until he came to the place between Bethel and Ai where his tent had formerly been pitched,
Kiswahili: Kutoka Negebu, akapita mahali hadi mahali, hadi akafika Betheli, mahali hapo ambapo mwanzoni alipiga hema lake kati ya Betheli na Ai
Ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa Negebu, akageenda agaika Beteli, agwo aase atenenetie eema yaye ritang’ani kegima, gati ya Beteli na Ai,

English: Cyrus king of Persia had them brought out by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, who counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.
Kiswahili: Koreshi mfalme wa Uajemi akavitoa kwa mkono wa Mithredathi mtunza hazina, aliyevihesabu mbele ya Sheshbaza mkuu wa Yuda.
Ekegusii: Ebikorero ebio Koresi, omorwoti bw’Abaayemi, akabia Mitiredati, omoteneneri bwe chikungo. Mitiredati akabibara, akabirika inse erio akabia Sesibasari, omogambi bw’Abayuda.

English: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they not die. This shall be a statute forever to them, even to him and to his descendants throughout their generations.”
Kiswahili: watanawa mikono na miguu yao ili kwamba wasije wakafa. Hii itakuwa ni amri ya kudumu kwa ajili ya Aroni na wazao wake kwa vizazi vijavyo.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo babe bagoisaba amaboko, basibie na amagoro abo, tibaabaisa gokwa. Ekio nigo korabe ogochika koragenderere asare na ase ororeria rwaye ebiaare ase ebiaare.”

English: Now, because you have done all these works,” says Yahweh, “and I spoke to you, rising up early and speaking, but you didn't hear; and I called you, but you didn't answer;
Kiswahili: Mlipokuwa mnafanya yote haya, asema Bwana, nilisema nanyi tena na tena, lakini hamkusikiliza; niliwaita, lakini hamkujibu.
Ekegusii: Naende inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Bono mwakorire amang'ana aya onsi, timorigeti koigwera ekero ngendererete gokwana nainwe, na ekero nabarangeretie timwaitabete.

English: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.
Kiswahili: Watu wacha Mungu wakamzika Stefano na kumwombolezea sana.
Ekegusii: Abanto abeegeni bagatindeka Stefano, bakamoreera okorera okonene.

English: You will sow much seed in the field but harvest little, because the locusts will consume it.
Kiswahili: Utapanda mbegu nyingi katika shamba lakini utavuna haba, kwa sababu nzige watazila.
Ekegusii: “’Namosimeke chimbusuro chinyinge ase emegondo, korende mogese endagera ensinini, ekiagera chingige ’nachirie chindagera chiaino.

English: But when he learned that Archelaus was reigning in Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. And having been warned in a dream, he withdrew to the district of Galilee,
Kiswahili: Lakini aliposikia kwamba Arkelao alikuwa anatawala huko Uyahudi mahali pa Herode baba yake, aliogopa kwenda huko. Naye akiisha kuonywa katika ndoto, akaenda zake sehemu za Galilaya,
Ekegusii: Korende agachia koigwa ng’a Arikelau obekirwe oborwoti Boyahudi ase ribaga ria Herode ise, akairoka kogenda aroro, korende erio gakuureirwe na Nyasae ase okorota, akagenda ensemo ya Galili.

English: But the people were exceedingly thirsty, and compelled us to do as we spoke to them, and to bring an oath upon ourselves, which we will not break.
Kiswahili: Lakini watu walikuwa na kiu sana, wakatulazimisha kufanya kama tulivyowaambia, na kujiapisha, jambo ambalo hatutalivunja.
Ekegusii: Korende ase engencho yokorang'a mono barabwo mbabetererie tobikeranerie chiira echio totanyaare kobuna.

English: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can't escape.
Kiswahili: Umenitenga na rafiki zangu wa karibu na kunifanya chukizo kwao. Nimezuiliwa, wala siwezi kutoroka;
Ekegusii: Kwabekire aare abagisangio baane twamanyaine, gwankorire nabeire okogechia ase bare; nasiekereirwe, tinkonyara gosoka.

English: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and command me to be struck contrary to the law?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Paulo akamwambia, “Mungu atakupiga wewe, ewe ukuta uliopakwa chokaa! Wewe umeketi hapo ili kunihukumu kwa mujibu wa sheria, lakini wewe mwenyewe unakiuka sheria kwa kuamuru kwamba nipigwe kinyume cha sheria!”
Ekegusii: Erio Paulo akamoteebia: “Nyasae nagoake aye, enyasi eakire echooka! Aye gwaikaransire konachera inche ekiina boronge koreng'ana buna ogochika, naende kogoteeba mamincha y'amachiiko ng'a ng'akwe?”

English: Then God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and settle there. Build an altar there to the God who appeared to you when you fled from your brother Esau.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Mungu akamwambia Yakobo, “Panda uende Betheli ukakae huko na ukamjengee Mungu madhabahu huko, Yeye aliyekutokea ulipokuwa unamkimbia Esau ndugu yako.”
Ekegusii: Rituko erimo Nyasae agateebia Yakobo: “Imoka, otiire ogende omenye Beteli, oagachere Nyasae egesasiimero aroro, Nyasae, oyo okoorokerete ekero kware gotama korwa ase Esau momura omino.”

English: You alone are to be feared. When You are angry, who can stand before You?
Kiswahili: Wewe peke yako ndiye wa kuogopwa. Ni nani awezaye kusimama mbele yako unapokasirika?
Ekegusii: Aye bweka nigo ore oyo bw’okoondokia mono. Ning’o oranyare gotenena ase obosio bwao, ekero kwabeire nendamwamu?

English: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.
Kiswahili: Je, hekima haipatikani katikati ya wazee? Je, maisha marefu hayaleti ufahamu?
Ekegusii: Obong'aini nigo bore ase abanto abanene, na okomenya emiaka emenge nakwo okomanya.

English: So the LORD was very angry with Israel, and He removed them from His presence. Only the tribe of Judah remained,
Kiswahili: Basi Bwana akawakasirikia sana Israeli na kuwaondoa kwenye uwepo wake. Ni kabila la Yuda tu lililobaki;
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene ase Abaisraeli na akabaseria korwa ase obosio bwaye; onde tatigarete otatiga egesaku ki’Abayuda gioka.

English: I didn't know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”
Kiswahili: Mimi mwenyewe sikumfahamu, lakini sababu ya kuja nikibatiza kwa maji ni ili yeye apate kufunuliwa kwa Israeli.”
Ekegusii: Inche tinamomanyete; korende aorokigwe ase Abaisraeli, nabo ase ayio ngacha na kobatisa ase amaache.”

English: Samuel came to Saul; and Saul said to him, “You are blessed by Yahweh! I have performed the commandment of Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Samweli alipomfikia, Sauli akamwambia, “Bwana akubariki! Nimetimiza yale Bwana aliniagiza.”
Ekegusii: Erio Samweli akagenda ase Saulo, na Saulo akamokwania, akamoteebia: “Omonene agosesenie. Naikeranirie ay'Omonene anchiigete.”

English: You will increase my honor and comfort me once again.
Kiswahili: Utaongeza heshima yangu na kunifariji tena.
Ekegusii: Aye omente obonene bwane, na ondemie naende.

English: Now Stephen, who was full of grace and power, was performing great wonders and signs among the people.
Kiswahili: Stefano, akiwa amejaa neema na nguvu za Mungu, alifanya ishara na miujiza mikubwa miongoni mwa watu.
Ekegusii: Na Stefano, oichire obuya na okobua, nigo arenge gokora amakumia amanene na ebikone egati y’abanto.

English: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren't you speaking to me? Don't you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”
Kiswahili: Pilato akamwambia, “Wewe unakataa kuongea na mimi? Hujui ya kuwa nina mamlaka ya kukuachia huru au kukusulubisha?”
Ekegusii: Erio Pilato akamobooria, “Togokwana nainche? Tomanyeti ng'a ninde nokobua gokobamba, naende ninde nokobua kogosibora?”

English: There is none like You, O LORD. You are great, and Your name is mighty in power.
Kiswahili: Hakuna aliye kama wewe, Ee Bwana; wewe ni mkuu, jina lako ni lenye nguvu katika uweza.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, onde tari okogwekaine; aye naye Omonene, na erieta riao nigo rire nokobua okonene.

English: God has delivered me to unjust men; He has thrown me to the clutches of the wicked.
Kiswahili: Mungu amenigeuzia kwa watu wabaya, na kunitupa katika makucha ya waovu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae ondure ase abanto batamoirogeti, ombekire ase amaboko abakori amabe.

English: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.
Kiswahili: Alikemea Bahari ya Shamu, nayo ikakauka, akawaongoza katika vilindi vyake kama vile jangwani.
Ekegusii: Nigo atogonyerete Enyancha eria Embariri egakamoka, erio agaetia Abaisraeli aroro buna nase ense enyomo.

English: When Jesus saw her, He called her over and said, “Woman, you are set free from your disability.”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipomwona, akamwita, akamwambia, “Mwanamke, uwe huru, umepona ugonjwa wako.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia komoorora, akamorangeria, akamoteebia, “Aye omokungu, gwasiboirwe korwa ase oboreu bwao.”

English: Bring out the blind people who have eyes, and the deaf who have ears.
Kiswahili: Uwaongoze wale wenye macho lakini hawaoni, wenye masikio lakini hawasikii.
Ekegusii: Renta abanto bonsi bare emeuko nonya babwate amaiso, na abare emetino nonya babwate amato.

English: “Stay here by your burnt offering while I am gone,” Balaam said to Balak. “Perhaps the LORD will meet with me. And whatever He reveals to me, I will tell you.” So Balaam went off to a barren height,
Kiswahili: Kisha Balaamu akamwambia Balaki, “Kaa hapa kando ya sadaka yako wakati mimi ninakwenda kando. Huenda Bwana atakuja kukutana nami. Lolote atakalonifunulia, nitakuambia.” Basi akaenda hata mahali peupe palipoinuka.
Ekegusii: Baalamu agateebia Balaki, “Beera aa, otenene mbarabare ase ekeng’wanso kiao ki’ogosambwa; inche ’ngende korora gose ande Omonene nang’orokere. Kende gionsi aranteebie, ekio nakio ndagoteebie.” Baalamu agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro aarabu.

English: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana akamwambia Anania, “Nenda! Mtu huyu ni chombo changu kiteule nilichokichagua, apate kulichukua Jina langu kwa watu wa Mataifa na wafalme wao na mbele ya watu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamoteebia: “Genda aye rioka, ekiagera oyio nomokoreri one omochore, aire erieta riane gochia ase abanto b'Ebisaku, na ase abarwoti, na ase Abaisraeli.

English: Yahweh's precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh's commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
Kiswahili: Maagizo ya Bwana ni kamili, nayo hufurahisha moyo. Amri za Bwana huangaza, zatia nuru machoni.
Ekegusii: Amachiiko 'Omonene namaronge, nigo akogokia enkoro; ring'an'Omonene achiikire nerironge, nigo rikorenta oborabu ase amaiso.

English: Then Moses set aside three cities across the Jordan to the east
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akatenga miji mitatu mashariki ya Yordani,
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agachoora emechie etato agwo moocha ya Yorodani.

English: Do not turn aside after worthless things that cannot profit you or deliver you, for they are empty.
Kiswahili: Msigeukie sanamu zisizofaa. Haziwezi kuwatendea jema, wala haziwezi kuwaokoa kwa sababu hazina maana.
Ekegusii: Timoonchokera chinyasae chire bosa chitanyare kobakoonya gose kobatooria, ekiagera nigo chire bosa.

English: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don't have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.
Kiswahili: Hata kama mnao walimu 10,000 katika Kristo, lakini hamna baba wengi. Mimi nilikuwa baba yenu katika Kristo Yesu kwa kuwaletea Injili.
Ekegusii: Naki nonya more nabateebereria chilifu ikomi ase Kristo, timori nabaiso abange. Naki ase Kristo Yeso nabeire buna iso, obaiboire ase enchiri.

English: Then I told them, “If it seems right to you, give me my wages; but if not, keep them.” So they weighed out my wages, thirty pieces of silver.
Kiswahili: Nikawaambia, “Mkiona kuwa ni vyema, nipeni ujira wangu, la sivyo, basi msinipe.” Kwa hiyo wakanilipa vipande thelathini vya fedha.
Ekegusii: Erio ngateebia abanto baria: “Onye morooche ng’a mbuya, ing’a eng’eria yane; onye taibo, yegache.” Barabwo bakarenga chitaabu chi’echifeta emerongo etato chikaba eng’eria yane.

English: Now these were the ones who sealed the document: Nehemiah the governor, son of Hacaliah, and also Zedekiah,
Kiswahili: Wale waliotia muhuri walikuwa: Nehemia mtawala, mwana wa Hakalia. Sedekia,
Ekegusii: Ababegete ebimanyererio biabo ase okobwatana koria nabwo aba: Nehemia omogabana, mosinto o Hakalia, na Zedekia.

English: If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,
Kiswahili: Kama lilikuwa kusudi la Mungu, naye akaiondoa Roho yake na pumzi yake,
Ekegusii: Ere aise koirania omoika oye, ee, airanie gochia asare omoika bw'obogima,

English: The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn't respect man.
Kiswahili: Njia kuu zimeachwa, hakuna wasafiri barabarani. Mkataba umevunjika, mashahidi wake wamedharauliwa, hakuna yeyote anayeheshimiwa.
Ekegusii: Chinchera chinene chiasarekire, omoeti tari ogoeta aroro. Okobwatana kw'ogotianania gwasarigwe; emechie yachayirwe, na abanto tibasikiri.

English: “When this letter arrives, since your master’s sons are with you and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city and weaponry,
Kiswahili: “Mara tu barua hii itakapokufikia, kwa kuwa wana wa bwana wako wapo pamoja nawe, nawe una magari ya vita na farasi, mji wenye ngome na silaha,
Ekegusii: “Abana b’omonene oino nao bare nainwe, ne chigari ne chibarasi nao chire amo nainwe, amo nemechie egiteire chindwaki, boigo nebirwanero bionsi. Ase ayio, riruube rikobaikera,

English: I was speechless and still; I remained silent, even from speaking good, and my sorrow was stirred.
Kiswahili: Lakini niliponyamaza kimya na kutulia, hata pasipo kusema lolote jema, uchungu wangu uliongezeka.
Ekegusii: Igo narenge nkirete‐kiri, tinare gokwana, tinaba na koremigwa konde, obororo bwane bokamenteka mono,

English: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers' house among the Simeonites.
Kiswahili: Jina la Mwisraeli ambaye aliuawa pamoja na mwanamke wa Kimidiani ni Zimri mwana wa Salu, kiongozi wa jamaa ya Simeoni.
Ekegusii: Omoisraeli oria oitetwe amo nomokuungu Omomidiani nigo arenge korokwa Simuri, mosinto o Salu, omotang'ani bw'eamate yaye ase egesaku gia Simioni.

English: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwadilifu hutembea salama, lakini mtu aendaye katika njia zilizopotoka atagunduliwa.
Ekegusii: Omonto okobwatia chiinchera chi'oboronge nigo araarendwe buya, korende oyo okobwatia chiinchera chimbe nigo aramanyekane.

English: I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the Sabbath day. Remember me for this also, my God, and spare me according to the greatness of your loving kindness.
Kiswahili: Kisha nikawaamuru Walawi kujitakasa na kwenda kulinda malango ili kutunza Sabato iwe takatifu. Ee Mungu wangu, unikumbuke kwa ajili ya hili pia, nawe unionyeshe wema wako sawasawa na upendo wako mkuu.
Ekegusii: Ngachiika Abalawi bechene, erio bachiche korenda ebiita na korenda rituko ri'Esabato ribe richenu. Aye Nyasae one, ing'inyore boigo ase engencho y'amang'ana aya, na ondorere amaabera, ekiagera aye nigo ore nobwanchani botari koera.

English: Whoever sheds the blood of man, by man his blood will be shed; for in His own image God has made mankind.
Kiswahili: “Yeyote amwagaye damu ya mwanadamu, damu yake itamwagwa na mwanadamu, kwa kuwa katika mfano wa Mungu, Mungu alimuumba mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi oraitere amanyinga a Mwanyabaanto, amanyinga y’omonto oyio neere naiterwe na Mwanyabaanto, ekiagera Nyasae nigo atongete Mwanyabaanto ase omobwekano oye ere omonyene.

English: There is nothing Egypt can do— head or tail, palm or reed. A Blessing upon the Earth
Kiswahili: Misri haiwezi kufanya kitu chochote, cha kichwa wala cha mkia, cha tawi la mtende wala cha tete.
Ekegusii: Ense ya Misiri tegosesenigwa ase ogokora konde gwonsi, kobe ogokora kw’omotwe gose ogw’ekemincha, okw’orosagia rw’omokendo gose orw’egetonto. Abamisiri mbasasime Omonene

English: For we must die, and are like water spilled on the ground, which can't be gathered up again; neither does God take away life, but devises means, that he who is banished not be an outcast from him.
Kiswahili: Kama vile maji yaliyomwagika ardhini, yasivyoweza kuzoleka tena, hivyo sisi kufa ni lazima. Lakini Mungu haondoi uhai, badala yake, yeye hufanya njia ili kwamba aliyefukuzwa asibaki akiwa amefarikishwa naye.
Ekegusii: Intwe twensi goika tokwe; nigo tore buna amaache aitekire inse atanyaare kobuuchwa naende. Nyasae tari gosiria obogima. Nigo akoroberia ng'a oria otamete taseerigwa na gwatananwa korwa ase are.

English: But whatever was gain to me I count as loss for the sake of Christ.
Kiswahili: Lakini mambo yale yaliyokuwa faida kwangu, sasa nayahesabu kuwa hasara kwa ajili ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Korende amang’ana aria arenge okonyora ase ’nde nayabarire koba bosa ase engencho ya Kristo.

English: Now on the day that the LORD spoke to Moses in Egypt,
Kiswahili: Bwana aliponena na Mose huko Misri,
Ekegusii: Rituko riri’Omonene akwanete na Musa ase ense ya Misiri

English: Then David the king went in and sat before Yahweh; and he said, “Who am I, Lord Yahweh, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mfalme Daudi akaingia ndani, akaketi mbele za Bwana, akasema: “Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, mimi ni nani, na jamaa yangu ni nini, hata umenileta mpaka hapa nilipo?
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi omorwoti agasoa akabeera ase obosio bw'Omonene, akabora, “Aye Omonene, inche inki 'ng'isaine, na eamate y'ane inki eisaine, ng'a aye gwankoreire amang'ana amaya iga?

English: Those who fear the Lord will seek his good pleasure. Those who love him will be filled with the law.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaomcha Bwana watatafuta radhi yake, na wale wanaompenda watajazwa sheria.
Ekegusii: Baria bamoirogete na bamwanchete Nyasae goika barigie komogokia na bakobwata ebirage biaye.

English: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
Kiswahili: Mwimbieni Mungu sifa, imbeni sifa, mwimbieni sifa Mfalme wetu, imbeni sifa.
Ekegusii: Tera amatera ay'ogotogia Nyasae, tera amatera ay'ogotogia! Tera amatera ay'ogotogia omorwoti oito, tera amatera ay'ogotogia!

English: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.
Kiswahili: Hii ilikuwa mara ya tatu Yesu kuwatokea wanafunzi wake baada yake kufufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu.
Ekegusii: Eke nekero kia gatato Yeso arorekanete ase aborokigwa baye magega y'okobokigwa korwa ase abakuure.

English: But any slave who has been purchased may eat of it, after you have circumcised him.
Kiswahili: Mtumwa yeyote ambaye mmemnunua aweza kuila kama mmemtahiri,
Ekegusii: korende omosomba onde bwensi omogorwa chitaabu ere ayerie gokwamwarokirie.

English: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
Kiswahili: Machozi yangu yamekuwa chakula changu usiku na mchana, huku watu wakiniambia mchana kutwa, “Yuko wapi Mungu wako?”
Ekegusii: Omobaso na obotuko nigo nkorera, na amariga abeire endagera yane; botambe abanto nigo bakomboria: “Nyasae oo ng'ai are?”

English: Engrave the names of the sons of Israel on the two stones the way a gem cutter engraves a seal. Then mount the stones in gold filigree settings.
Kiswahili: Yachore majina ya wana wa Israeli juu ya vito hivyo viwili kama vile sonara anavyochonga muhuri. Kisha uvitie vito hivyo katika vijalizo vya dhahabu,
Ekegusii: Ase chisemi chi’omooroisia omanyete buya gotura na komang’a ekemanyererio, omang’e amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli ase amagena aria abere. Erio obeke amagena aria ase ebikonde bie chitaabu.

English: They went out of the camp to battle. Those who were with Judas sounded their trumpets
Kiswahili: Walitoka nje ya kambi kwenda vitani. Wale waliokuwa pamoja na Yuda walipiga tarumbeta zao.
Ekegusii: bagasoka korwa ase ekambi yabo erio barwane esegi. Yuda na abanto baye bakabugi rirandi

English: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.
Kiswahili: Sedekia alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mmoja alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala huko Yerusalemu miaka kumi na mmoja. Jina la mama yake aliitwa Hamutali binti Yeremia, kutoka Libna.
Ekegusii: Zedekia nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere noyomo, ekero abeete omorwoti, akagaamba emiaka ikomi nomo agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Hamutali, mosubati o Yeremia korwa Libuna.

English: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.
Kiswahili: Hutumana kutoka mbinguni na kuniokoa, akiwakemea wale wanaonifuatilia vikali; Mungu huutuma upendo wake na uaminifu wake.
Ekegusii: Omonene nantomere ogotooreka korwa igoro, nababue abwo bagonkorera bobe babe nobosooku. Nyasae naorokie amaabera aye na ekeene kiaye.

English: The deep's fountains and the sky's windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.
Kiswahili: Zile chemchemi zilizo chini sana ya ardhi pamoja na malango ya mafuriko ya mbinguni yakawa yamefungwa nayo mvua ikawa imekoma kunyesha kutoka angani.
Ekegusii: Chinsoko chia amaache chiare kobera korwa inse amo na ebibao bia igoro bigasiekwa, na embura yaare gotwa egasira,

English: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.
Kiswahili: Mafuriko yataichukua nyumba yake, maji yaendayo kasi katika siku ya ghadhabu ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ebinto asangereretie ase enyomba yaye mbiirwe; bionsi nigo birairwe ase rituko ri'endamwamu ya Nyasae.

English: He has made me a byword among the people, a man in whose face they spit.
Kiswahili: “Mungu amenifanya kitu cha dhihaka kwa kila mtu, mtu ambaye watu humtemea mate usoni.
Ekegusii: Omonene onkorire nabeire ring’ana abanto bakorabaara, nabeire oyo abanto bagochaaya ase ogotwa amate.

English: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. Yahweh his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.
Kiswahili: “Haijaonekana bahati mbaya katika Yakobo, wala taabu katika Israeli. Bwana, Mungu wao yu pamoja nao, nayo sauti kuu ya Mfalme imo katikati yao.
Ekegusii: Ere tarochi obobe ase Yakobo, tarochi bokong'u bonde ase Abaisraeli. Omonene, Nyasae obo, nigo are amo nabarabwo, igo bakoraria nomochengo ng'a omorwoti nareo.

English: Then the hooves of horses thundered— the mad galloping of his stallions.
Kiswahili: Ndipo kwato za farasi zikafanya mshindo: farasi wake wenye nguvu huenda mbio kwa kurukaruka.
Ekegusii: Erio chibarasi chiare gotiria n’ebitaago biabo, chituoni chiachiriinete chiare gochara‐charaara.

English: After the sixty-two weeks the Anointed One will be cut off, and will have nothing. The people of the prince who come will destroy the city and the sanctuary. Its end will be with a flood, and war will be even to the end. Desolations are determined.
Kiswahili: Baada ya majuma sitini na mawili, Mpakwa Mafuta atakatiliwa mbali, wala hatabaki na kitu. Watu wa mtawala atakayekuja watauharibu mji pamoja na mahali patakatifu. Mwisho utakuja kama mafuriko: Vita vitaendelea mpaka mwisho, nao ukiwa umeamriwa.
Ekegusii: Nyuma ye chichuma “isano na ibere” ara emerongo etano na ebere: echio emerongo etano nomo, na ibere, Omoakwa Amaguta oria naitwe, tari ase engencho yaye ere omonyene. Abanto b'omogaambi orache mbasirie omochie oyo amo n'Obomenyo Obochenu. Omoerio oye noche buna chiooro, na goika omoerio esegi nebeo, ekiagera nigo ochiikeretwe ogosirigwa korwa kare.

English: He makes his feet like hinds' feet, and sets me on my high places.
Kiswahili: Huifanya miguu yangu kama miguu ya kulungu, huniwezesha kusimama mahali palipo juu.
Ekegusii: Ere okorire amagoro ane abeire buna ay'egesia, onkong'irie na gontenenia ase ebitunwa.

English: Now Ahab told Jezebel everything that Elijah had done and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.
Kiswahili: Ahabu akamwambia Yezebeli kila kitu Eliya alichokuwa amefanya na jinsi alivyowaua manabii wote kwa upanga.
Ekegusii: Ahabu agateebia Yesebeli amang’ana onsi Elija akorete, buna aitete ababani bonsi n’omoro.

English: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.
Kiswahili: Nawaandikia ninyi, akina baba, kwa sababu mmemjua yeye aliye tangu mwanzo. Nawaandikia ninyi vijana kwa sababu mmemshinda yule mwovu. Nawaandikia ninyi watoto wadogo, kwa sababu mmemjua Baba.
Ekegusii: Nkobariikera nde inwe abaise, ekiagera momomanyete ere oyorengeo korwa omochakano. Nkobariikera nde inwe, abamura, ekiagera mwamobuire oria omobe. Nabarikerete inwe, abana abake, ekiagera momomanyete Tata.

English: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,
Kiswahili: Tena ukageuka mashariki kuelekea Beth-Dagoni, ukagusa Zabuloni na Bonde la Ifta-Eli, ukaenda upande wa kaskazini hadi Beth-Emeki na Neyeli, ukipitia Kabul upande wa kushoto.
Ekegusii: Erio rokaonchoka gochia moocha, rokagenderera goika Beti‐Dagoni, rogatwomera Sabuloni na ense yo'mweremo o Ifuta‐Eli, ensemo ya sugusu, rogaika Beti‐Emeki na Neieli. Erio rokagenderera gochia sugusu goika Kabuli,

English: When you lend anything to your neighbor, do not enter his house to collect security.
Kiswahili: Unapomkopesha jirani yako chochote, usiingie nyumbani kwake kutwaa kile anachokitoa kama rehani.
Ekegusii: “Ekero okoa omogisangio oo egento kende gionsi singo, tobaisa gosoa ase enyomba yaye koira egento keria abeekire kebe intenenera.

English: You will be hated by all men for my name's sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.
Kiswahili: Watu wote watawachukia kwa ajili ya Jina langu. Lakini yule atakayevumilia hadi mwisho ataokolewa.
Ekegusii: Nainwe namogechwe n'abanto bonsi ase engencho y'erieta riane, korende oyoraremererie goika omoerio, oyio natooreke.

English: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!
Kiswahili: Ole wao wenye mimba na wale wanaonyonyesha watoto siku hizo!
Ekegusii: Korende nebe aakong’u ase abare morito na abakogonkia ase amatuko aria.

English: He spoke with them words of peace, and swore to them, saying, “We won't seek to harm you or your friends.”
Kiswahili: Akawaambia maneno ya amani, na kuwaapia, akisema, “Hatutajaribu kuwadhuru ninyi wala rafiki zenu.”
Ekegusii: Alikimo agakwana na barabwo amang'ana y'omorembe na koria chiira ase ogotiana ogoteeba: “Intwe titokobakorera bobe inwe abanyene gose abasani baino.”

English: The days in which we came from Kadesh Barnea until we had come over the brook Zered were thirty-eight years, until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the middle of the camp, as Yahweh swore to them.
Kiswahili: Miaka thelathini na minane ilipita tangu wakati tulipoondoka Kadesh-Barnea mpaka tulipovuka Bonde la Zeredi. Kwa wakati huo kile kizazi chote cha wanaume kuanzia wale wawezao kwenda vitani kilikuwa kimekufa, kama Bwana alivyokuwa amewaapia.
Ekegusii: Korwa engaki twarwete Kadeshi‐Barinea goika ekero twambogete akarooche ga Seredi nigo yarenge emiaka emerongo etato, na etano na etato (38). Abanto bonsi b'ekegori keria, abamanyete korwana esegi, bagakwa bakaera, buna Omonene konya atianire.

English: So Moses told the people, “Remember this day, the day you came out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery; for the LORD brought you out of it by the strength of His hand. And nothing leavened shall be eaten.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akawaambia watu, “Ikumbukeni siku hii, siku ambayo mlitoka katika nchi ya Misri, katika nchi ya utumwa, kwa sababu Bwana aliwatoa humo kwa mkono wenye nguvu. Msile chochote kilichotiwa chachu.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia abanto, “Mobe mokoinyora rituko eri mwang’anyete korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ense eyio mwarenge abasomba, ekiagera Omonene abang’anyetie korwa agwo nokoboko kwaye gwe chinguru. Ase rituko erio omogati obekire ememera toriegwa.
